11304414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11304414.value: 通過計算機輔助設計(CAD)軟件(如AutoCAD或瑪雅)進行曲線與曲面設計在很多應用領域如飛機，汽車，建築或者3D動畫電影建模，起著相當重要的作用。由於計算機自身的數字特性，曲線與曲面在計算機中只能通過離散的數據進行表示。在當今高科技工業產品(HDTVs, 3D電影等)的推動下， 計算機高效高分辨表示能力變得越來越需要。細分法通過對初始數據給出簡單的細分規則，提供了產生曲線曲面的高效方法。通過細分法，我們可以對曲線或者曲面在任意想要的分辨率與任意位置進行編輯。在小波分析與電子工程領域中，細分法在數字濾波器組與小波框架之間架起了一道橋樑：使用濾波器組分解與重構對應於一系列的小波細分與過渡算子。 在這個項目中，我們將重點放在設計有許多理想性能的多維細分法，包括高階Sum Rule，對稱特性，線性相位等。特別是多維對稱緊支集小波緊(雙)構架構建細分法掩模。此外，從細分法掩模得到的方向FIR濾波器組的應用也將被考慮。我們的研究結果將不單為算機輔助幾何設計(CAGD)提供理想的細分法，而且還將得到具有許多理想性能，非常適合小波分析與電氣工程的多維對稱緊支小波緊(雙)框架和方向FIR濾波器組。此外，我們將提供設計和實現的快速數字算法在高維數據分析，如圖像/信號處理，機器學習，等等的應用。

11304414.label: Realisation of objectives
11304414.value: Objectives as per 5.1 above. Objective 1: Characterization and Construction of Multidimensional Subdivision Schemes. To achieve this objective, the PI first investigated 1D subdivision schemes. Motivated by the need of short FIR filters for perfect-reconstruction multirate systems, the PI and his collaborators derived the shortest pairs of dual filters for M channels dual filter banks, based on the M-dilated refinement sequence of the m-th order cardinal B-spline with constraint of l-th order sum rule on the M-dual low-pass sequence. From such pairs of dual-filters, we can construct compactly supported dual wavelets with high-order of vanishing moments. The PI then investigated multidimensional subdivision schemes. The PI and his collaborators investigated quincunx subdivision schemes and developed several new families of canonical quincunx subdivision schemes including non-separable canonical quincunx subdivision schemes and separable canonical quincunx subdivision schemes. All these new subdivision schemes play very important roles in the investigation and development of our Objective 2 (see below). In summary, the Objective 1 has been achieved completely. For major findings and research outcome, we refer to 6.1 of this report. Objective 2: Multivariate Symmetric Compactly Supported Wavelet Tight (Dual) Frames and Directional FIR Filter Bank Together with the findings and developments in Objective 1, for this objective, we have several achievements. First, in 1D, for a pair of dual filter banks, a dual framelet filter banks can be derived efficiently in a recursively way. Second, in 2D, we developed several types of directional FIR filter banks associated with directional tight framelets. For the families of quincunx subdivision schemes discovered during the investigation of Objective 1, we showed that families of quincunx tight framelets and their associated quincunx tight framelet filter banks can be constructed with many desirable properties such as high order of vanishing moments, symmetry property, short supports of filters, uniqueness, directionality, and so on. Third, for even higher dimensions, affine shear tight frames and their associated digital affine shear transforms are considered. Applications in 2D image processing and 3D video processing are demonstrated. Along this line of research and in view of categorizing image features as smooth regions, edge parts, and oscillating patterns, the PI and his collaborators later incorporated a 2-layer structure in the affine shear tight frame systems and thus developed a more efficient directional filter banks for high-dimensional data processing. Last but not least, data are not necessarily defined on Euclidean domain. In network sciences, data points or cloud are typically unstructured but are connected through edge representing certain relations. That is, graph data. Representation of such data, especially directed graphs are considered and a tensor product approach is developed. Theoretical approximation results in terms of orthogonal polynomials on trees are developed and practical algorithmic applications for network data are demonstrated. In summary, the Objective 2 has been achieved completely. For major findings and research outcome, we refer to 6.1 of this report.

Multivariate Symmetric Compactly Supported Wavelet Tight (Dual) Frames and Directional FIR Filter Banks: We shall focus on the development of extension algorithms for the construction of the framelet masks (high-pass filters) from the scaling masks (low-pass filters) for our constructed subdivision schemes, and also on the construction of framelet generators having symmetry properties with respect to some commonly used symmetry group in CAGD. Motivated by the diamond-shape filters associated with the quincunx subdivision schemes, we shall also investigate the design of FIR filter banks having directional sensitivity. Applications of our wavelet tight (dual) frames and directional FIR filter banks in high-dimensional data analysis such as image/signal denoising shall be considered. In the spirit of reproducible research, we shall provide a publicly available software package of the implemented fast algorithms of our directional filter banks systems with testing experimental results for many suitable applications.

11304414.label: Major findings and research outcome
11304414.value: Shortest filters for multi-rate filter banks with M channels are derived based on the M-dilated refinement sequence of the m-th order cardinal B-spline. A family of Deslauriers-Dubuc like masks (even and odd orders) and dual framelet filter banks are derived. Results are published as a journal paper. See Part C, the paper in Applied and Computational Harmonic Analysis (ACHA) 2016. Families of quincunx subdivision schemes in dimension two that enjoy many desirable properties such as minimal support, explicit formulae, D4 symmetric, sum rules are constructed. Furthermore, quincunx tight framelets out of such families, which called canonical quincunx tight framelets, can be derived explicitly with high orders of vanishing moments, symmetry, short supports of filters, and so on. Results are published as a journal paper. See Part C, the paper in Mathematics of Computations (MCOM) 2018. Affine shear tight frames together with their associated digital affine shear transforms are constructed and developed. Such affine shear tight frames are directional filter banks enjoy tightness property, arbitrary number of directions, fast transform algorithms, and others. Results are published as a journal paper. See Part C, the papers in SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences (SIIMS) 2016. Affine shear tight frames with 2-layer structure are developed on top of affine shear tight frames. A directional filter bank with two-layer structure is shown to have the ability to sparsely representing images in terms of smooth regions, edge parts, and oscillating patters. Results are published as journal papers. See Part C, the papers in SPIE 2017 and IEEE Transaction on Image Processing 2018.

11304414.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11304414.value: Audios, images, videos, etc., are typically Euclidean type data. However, data are not necessarily defined on Euclidean domain. Such types of data are usually described in terms of graphs. As demonstrated on the paper (see Part C, paper in ACHA 2018), a directed graph can be viewed as a pair of undirected graphs and each undirected graph can be associated by orthogonal polynomials defined on a tree. Consequently, a tensor product approach can be used to represent data defined on directed graphs. A further and naturally development would be to investigate how to define directionality on such graph representations and how to develop framelet-like systems on such graphs.

11304414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11304414.value: In this project, we focus on the design of multidimensional subdivision schemes whose associated subdivision masks having many desirable properties including sum rule orders, symmetry properties, linear-phase moments, etc. We investigate the derivation of multivariate symmetric compactly supported tight framelets from those constructed subdivision masks. We design and apply directional filter banks for high-dimensional data analysis such as image/signal/video processing, sparse approximation, machine learning, and so on.

11400314.label: Major findings and research outcome
11400314.value: 經過三年來的研究，本研究共得四篇學術論文(三篇已接受刊登，一篇已寄至《臺大歷史學報》，正處於匿名名審階段)及一本已呈交上海人民出版社的專著(將於2018年上半年出版)。本研究也曾在學術工作坊或研討會上發表。 本研究深入地剖析章太炎聯省自治的思想，並由此而探究其政治思想的形成、發展與時代的關係。同時，也研究他的政治思想與時人如孫中山、毛澤東乃至新文化運動領袖人物如胡適、顧頡剛、傅斯年之間的關係，並特別突顯聯省自治思想不但在1920年代有其積極、多元及民主平等的思想意義，就是在今天這個進入新冷戰時代、國際政爭激烈的環境中也有其重要的啟示意義。相關研究的發表，相信可以補足目前這個領域的不足，說明了聯省自治運動在1920年代中期落幕，只是暫時性地成為時代的伏流及時代的低音，但是隨着時移勢易，今天在各種權力對抗而新威權時代的來臨，章太炎的聯省自治思想中對於國家、民族、世界與個人的關係的思考，將會給我們提供不少借鑒的思想資源。此外，本研究也從毛澤東對章太炎聯省自治的批評聲中，引發了專章論述毛澤東自治思想及其共產思想發展關係的研究興趣，並撰成一文。這篇文章深入論述了毛澤東如何把聯省自治徒當成一種革命工具。在工具化下，目標才是最終服膺的對象；在共產革命的長遠目標下，聯省自治或地方自治在實現地方奪權的階段性目標後，旋即受到批判及揚棄，因為要實現的是進一步的更為激烈的大革命與總革命，是要實現全國的解放。在這個視角下，毛澤東思想激進化的歷程便可以在聯省自治思潮為背景為場域下展現無遺。相關研究也有助於了解早期毛澤東及中共初期的革命主張與思想趨向。

11400314.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11400314.value: 本研究認為章太炎既聯合、統一但又主張各個單位、團體、省市、國家之間保持獨立、自主、自決與自尊的位置價值的思想，十分切合今天環球社會政爭下各個弱小組織、地域在面對大國的壓抑下亟亟於尋找出路的困境及其相關思考。太炎的聯省自治思想對於極權、專制的批判，對個體自主價值的維護及解放，有其時代的前瞻性。這些值得我們繼續進深發掘和研究。

11400314.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11400314.value: 章太炎的思想是多元的、開放的。但他的思想不論是在清末晚初，還是在今天，都不受主流思想或政治權要的重視或接受。原因就在於他對於皇權、專權、威權持守批判的庇度，對於國家權力堅守質疑的態度。他否定機構、國家乃至世界，目的是要批判背後所建構它們的那股對個體、自主性有所壓抑的權力。因此，他的聯省自治思想從他晚清時的聯亞思想發展出來，是對於弱小的國家之間的聯繫以對抗強權到聯省自治的聯合弱小省份以抗衡南北政府的武力統一中國的擠壓，無不是以強調個體平等、獨立自主的思想角度出發，構成了他以齊物論、佛學理論闡發的五無政治思想，對社會制度構成了強有力的批判。他的思想在今天這個看似越來越現代、越來越文明但實質上是往後倒退的時代裏仍巨大參考價值。

11400614.value: 英語冠詞是其中一個最常在英語作為第二語言的學習資源中提供給學生的語法形式，但它不存在於某些語言，如中文。它們非常複雜，不易為中國英語學生習得，但學生困難和錯誤的性質和主要原因很大程度上仍不清晰，而針對此學習問題的語言教學亦不見得有效。通過調查英語作為第二語言的粵語學生對英語冠詞系統的習得， 這研究項目旨在消除這長期的研究隔閡。100 名不同學科的本地大學生和20名對照組的英語母語使用者會參加研究。研究包括語言背景問卷、 自由寫作、 談話、填空測驗、 語法性判斷、 真值判斷和圖片描述等任務。語言背景問卷會於語言任務執行前進行，並將收集有關參與者的語言背景，對英語冠詞使用的知識和自我評價等資料。自由寫作和對話任務的目標是收集學生於不受控制的環境下使用冠詞時犯的錯誤，而填空測驗任務、語法性判斷任務、 真值判斷任務和圖片描述任務則探討學生在不同的的情境化學習環境下如何選擇及使用冠詞。完成填空測驗任務後，參與者還會被要求提供他們選擇某冠詞的原因。至於真值判斷任務，一些故事背景和測試句子會提供給參與者作真值判斷，參與者將被要求提供故事內那些句子導致他們對測試句子真值判斷的決定。焦點小組訪談在語言任務後進行，20名學生將參與，旨在深入地收集參與者對英語冠詞的認識、對正確使用英語冠詞的重要性感知、日常使用英語冠詞中遇到的問題，和解決問題的策略等資料。研究將使用定量和定性分析，分析在不同任務中獲得的資料，亦將比較參與者在不同任務之間及不同標記型別中的冠詞使用。研究結果將令第二語言習得領域的有關專業人士對英語作為第二語學生習得英語冠詞的過程獲得深入瞭解。結果也會使教學專業人員能精確地了解學生需要，從而啟發他們成功設計針對這種普遍存在的障礙的有效教學材料。

Objective 3: The relationship between learners' article choices and the interpretation of reference types have been identified. 11400614.label: Major findings and research outcome
11400614.value: Major Findings: The results of the different tasks in the study show that many Cantonese ESL learners are confident of their use of English articles, but they do not regard articles as very important for speaking, reading, writing or listening. They do not possess the metalanguage that enables them to articulate the functions and semantics of different English articles and have some misconceptions and/or confusion about the English article system. These misconceptions may be the source of certain article errors, such as substitution errors. The results also show that although learners may use articles correctly on certain occasions, targetlike use may not necessarily be grounded on implicit knowledge or explicit knowledge. Certain features in the use of English articles, such as the importance of identifiability for definiteness and the subtle differences between the countable and uncountable uses of an English noun and its associated article use, are not necessarily known by ESL learners. Despite the non-existence of articles in Chinese, Cantonese ESL learners occasionally resort to their mother tongue in their article selection and noun countability judgement processes. Research Outcomes: A total of five papers have been produced, of which two have been published in SSCI-listed journals and one has been published in an internationally refereed journal. Two other research papers have been written up and are currently under review. A total of 12 presentations have been/will be given in international conferences in different parts of the world. (Please see Research Output)

11400614.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11400614.value: The project has identified some problems about Cantonese ESL learners use of a bilingualized dictionary for determining noun countability and related article use. While the research findings are illuminating, the number of target words included is limited. Further studies into learners' use of different dictionaries, including both monolingual and bilingualized dictionaries, for determining the countability and related article use of a wide range of lexical items will give a more comprehensive picture of Hong Kong Cantonese ESL learners' problems in these two areas. The lexicographical insights thus obtained will also be more comprehensive. A GRF proposal addressing these two closely related resarch areas has been submitted to the RGC for consideration.

11400614.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11400614.value: Theoretically, the results of the study advance the knowledge of the SLA field with enlightening insights into the cognitive processes which learners undergo in their acquisition of English articles. Pedagogically, the results of the study illuminate English teaching professionals’ understanding of precise learner needs and serve as signposts guiding the design of effective teaching materials. Lexicographically, the results of the study provide lexicographers with signposts to the selection of noun information to be included in a learner’s dictionary and give explicit suggestions on how to improve the arrangement, presentation and content of noun countability information, so that students can make the best use of such important self-learning resources in their determination of noun countability and related article use.

11400814.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11400814.value: 對財產轉型的理解：中國農村土地市場的興起

11400814.label: Project Objectives
11400814.value: The objective of the project is to test theories of property rights change through a study of emerging rural land markets in China. To do this the project aims to: Collect data on 2 pilot projects for transactions in rural land in China: (1) in Shuangliu County, Chengdu Sichuan Province, and (2) Nanhai County, Foshan, Guangdong Province. Analyse the data to test the evolutionary hypothesis that property-holders assert individual tradable rights when their benefits outweigh their costs. Analyse the data to test the public choice hypotheses that (1) property transactions are driven by interest groups to capture a disproportionate share of their benefits; and (2) interest groups will resist property change when they lose under new institutional arrangements.

11400814.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11400814.value: 由于长期法律和制度上的限制，农村土地流转市场没有成长起来。尽管现在对开放农用土地市场的呼声很高，但决定开放是否成功的其中一个关键在于要评估一个适合有效率的登记制度来保障交易的稳定和可信赖性。尽管在中国有大量的文献阐明土地登记制度牵涉的重要性，但很少有人在做这方面的经验研究来决定一种合适的登记模式。本课题着重调查两个地方样本来进行定性和定量分析来决定“强制登记”和“自愿登记”的选择。

11400814.label: Realisation of objectives
11400814.value: All the stated research objectives have been successfully achieved. To be specific, please refer to detailed report below. 1 The objective of the project is to test theories of property rights change through a study of emerging rural land markets in China. First, the mainstream property rights theories have been identified to be tested. To be specific, the economic theory of property evolution upholds that property emerges as a response to the benefits of exclusion and the costs of open access (Demsetz 1967: 237). Simple bright line property rules are justified, as a baseline for the design of property rules, because of the high cost of information if the whole world needs to understand a range of permitted uses, or deal with multiple interest holders in a resource (Merrill & Smith 2011). These theories underline that legislators, legal practitioners and interest holders need more than governmental policies and a mish-mash of divergent local cultural norms. They need legal certainty provided by a set of simple and bright-line laws formalizing the property institutions. Nonetheless, the alternative pessimistic view of property change argues that property transitions take place through political processes. This is a public choice conception of property as a product of competition among interest groups. Powerful interest groups induce property change in order to capture a disproportionate share of its benefits. Political actors may favour a constituency or interest group without necessarily incurring the costs of compensating those who lose under the new property regime. Second, through this study, some problems that arose as a result of the spontaneous agreement have been provided. It helps show economic demand for property rights evolution (the economic story). But they also highlight the interaction of extra-legal processes with law, and thus inform us something about the multi-scale nature of property system change. Third, this research nuances around the above-mentioned theories by arguing that property system change is not simply a question of evolution of property rights. There are other dimensions of change, including most notably the governance of property. Governance of property occurs through systems of both private ordering and public ordering. Private ordering refers to norms of social function, contracts, and acts of coordination. And public ordering entails law, systems of public administration and land registration. The Chengdu example illustrates re-configuration of governance mechanisms as part of processes of change. 2 Collect data on 2 pilot projects for transactions in rural land in China: (1) in Chengdu Sichuan Province, and (2) Nanhai Foshan, Guangdong Province. Essentially, I obtained some information on spontaneous extra-legal land market transfers relating to rural agricultural land in both localities by way of comparison. The agreements between (1) village households and the village committee, and (2) village committees and outside investors. It is interesting to look at the way in which agreements handle agency risk issues: the nature of rights granted to outside investors; the authority of village committees to bind households through agreement; the enforceability of rights granted to outside investors against third parties such as village households. These studies illustrates how property system transitions create internal momentum for change through the interaction of agreements and law. 3 Analyse the data to test the evolutionary hypothesis that property-holders assert individual tradable rights when their benefits outweigh their costs. The economic theory asserting individual tradable rights certainly holds to a large extent in this study. But it cannot tell the whole story of property changes in the context of Chinese rural land market as addressed above. It may be inadequate to capture the complex legal, extra-legal and policy dynamics. For example, what the implications are for debates on “fuzzy” and “bright line” law. Whether Peter Ho’s idea of deliberate ambiguity in China’s property law is still valid. 4. Analyse the data to test the public choice hypotheses that (1) property transactions are driven by interest groups to capture a disproportionate share of their benefits; and (2) interest groups will resist property change when they lose under new institutional arrangements. Basically this objective has been achieved. First, it is about the winner/loser issue. For example: What strategies employed by the would-be-winners to push the legal reform? what were the strategic responses of “losers”? What if the strategies played by the losers confront the authoritarian regime's commitment to "catching up" the market? By illustrating this, it provides an analytical framework to capture the complex rural land system. Second, if there were collective protests or some other types of resistance, why did they not adopt formal mechanisms such as resort to the courts? Courts in different localities differ on whether and how they handle with these kinds of disputes. And, most importantly, how did the authorities respond to collective protests? Did they create momentum for law reform? The local governments’ capacity to coordinate governing techniques varies across regions. This partially explains why the rights granted to outside investors have been nebulous differing across regions. One needs to pay attention to another axe or dimension of the property transition, i.e. how to design governance of property through private ordering and public ordering.

11400814.label: Major findings and research outcome
11400814.value: 1) Property system change is not simply a question of evolution of property rights. There are other dimensions of change, including most notably in relation to the governance of property. Governance of property occurs through systems of both private ordering and public ordering. Private ordering refers to norms of social function, contracts, and acts of coordination. And public ordering entails law, systems of public administration and land registration. Chinese rural land law reform would fail if they do not consider the ways in which the envisioned types of land disputes correspond to the governance mechanism of property, whether socially embedded or legally enforced. 2) The relationship dynamics among stakeholders such as rural households, village committees, village heads, and local governments and outside investors in property transition in rural China, are critical because they directly impact reform designs as appropriate to specific contexts. That explains why the property rights transition in rural China is non-lineal. 3) The research finding indicates that to unveil an analytical framework for exploring the property rights transition in the context of Chinese rural land reform, apart from the cultural factors and local government's engagement, three more factors are relevant: economics of property, certain stakeholders’ interests and governance mechanism of property. When reforming Chinese rural land tenure laws, these factors should be taken seriously.

11400814.value: 1) facing the strategies employed by the would-be-losers to resist the potential reforms, how the authorities respond to the resistance, such as collective protests? To what extent did they create momentum for law reform? 2) to ascertain the legal nature of the rights granted to the outside investors? is it a property right or just contractual right? This research question is significant. for example, entitlement of compensation by the outside investors when the land is expropriated by the local government.

11400814.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11400814.value: While much has been written on the importance of property changes in rural China, from resource to assets, from collective to individual, to economic development, relatively little seems to be understood about processes of change in complex property systems, particularly in rural China, a socialist-transforming country. Specifically, there is a lack of reliable and empirical knowledge about the intricate relations between legal reforms, the interplay among all the relevant stakeholders, and formal and informal, legal and extra-legal mechanism that practically guide governance of property in rural Chinese society. This research attempts to provide a theoretical and empirical analysis of rural land reforms in China. China is a particularly important yet understudied jurisdiction, since both PRC property law and housing market underwent significant changes in the last few decades. A gap exists between PRC property law’s underlying assumptions and the policy orientations of how a property institution is often coordinated and enforced. The research findings are aimed to fill the gap by nuancing around some classical property change theories. In order to unveil an analytical framework for exploring the property rights transition in the context of Chinese rural land reform, apart from the cultural factors and local government's engagement, three more factors are relevant: rising value of property, certain stakeholders’ interests and governance mechanism of property. In relation to the governance of property, both public ordering and private ordering are employed to design an appropriate system. When reforming Chinese rural land tenure laws, these factors should be taken seriously.

11401214.value: 國際學生的職涯發展，是西方日益受重視的學術研究範圍 (e.g. Human et al. 2011)，其中以北美洲丶歐洲及澳洲的學術文獻居多, 內容多關於國際學生的個人及文化適應。現時香港在這方面的研究較為缺乏，不足以反映的在港國際及非本港學生的職涯發展經驗。 現階段，香港就如其鄰近的東亞國家一樣，正處於高等教育國際化的進程中。以成為區域教育樞紐為大前提，香港宣布増加非本地學生的學額，直至佔高等教育學額20%；另外推行新的入境政策，以擴大招生地域範圍，吸引更多優秀學生來港就讀。現時本港有關國際及非本港學生的研究，主要集中於政策範疇，欠缺針對職涯發展的實証研究作參考。 是項研究，是首項在西方國家以外，針對非本地華人大學生職涯發展的研究，目的是建立並透過一個理論架構，剖析文化適應丶支持關係丶及職涯探索等三方面如何影響非本地華人學生的自覺就業能力與及移居意向。相對於從內地前往西方國家升學的華人學生，內地來港的華人學生感受到文化差距一般較少(Pan & Wong, 2011)。這項研究，旨在探討非本港學生由大學到就業的轉變， 也是目前對國際學生研究之中比較欠缺的(Arthur & Flynn, 2011)。 在這項研究我們採用包括定量及定研究方法的混合方式設計(Creswell, 2009), 以增進對課題的探究和理解。第一階段將從450名非本地港華人大學生在其畢業前及畢業後的六個月取得量化資料，從而測試理論架構。 第二階段，則以第一階段的數據結果為基礎，採用多重個案研究設計 (Yin, 2009) 進行定性研究。屆時並會選出已經在港就業的研究對象，進行非結構化的訪談，了解受訪性他們的生涯發展經驗。這些個案配合理論架構，可作為香港在教育實踐、職業輔導丶移民入境及相關政策的參考。

11401214.label: Realisation of objectives
11401214.value: Objective 1 is on the extent the intention to migrate to Hong Kong is influenced by cultural adaptation, career exploration and relational support respectively among Mainland Chinese students in the Hong Kong context. We collected quantitative data from graduating nonlocal Chinese students (N=268; across 8 institutions), nonlocal Chinese graduates staying in Hong Kong upon graduation in the following year (N=147), as well as nonlocal undergraduate Chinese students from all years of study (N=145). On the whole, we find that majority of respondents (65% to 71% for students; 78% for graduates who stayed) were open to (neither rejecting nor committed to) migration. About one third of respondents in all samples favored Hong Kong as destination if they choose to migrate. Over 80% in all samples indicated that if they migrate, the time period to stay in migrated area as below 10 years, while over 50% of student samples indicated below 5 years. In the graduating student sample, we find that those indicated no intention to migrate have lower acculturation as compared to other nonlocal students. Some initial support the impact of peer support and acculturation hassles on migration intention was found. Subsequent qualitative interviews (N=14) revealed that students regarded obtaining undergraduate education as a first step, opening to possible further career development and geographical relocations. We revealed the complexity of tentative migration intentions which were further examined in our qualitative investigations. Results are discussed in Principal Investigator’s presentation entitled “Antecedents of career decidedness and migration intentions among non‐local Mainland Chinese university students in Hong Kong” in the Conference by International Association for Educational and Vocational Guidance (IAEVG) in Japan addressed to this objective directly. Objective 2 is on the extent employability is influenced by cultural adaptation, and career exploration among Mainland Chinese students in the Hong Kong context. We utilized data from the graduating students to address this meaningfully. We found through multiple hierarchical multiple regressions that perceived employability was explained by career exploration, relational support, acculturative hassles and the assimilation strategy of acculturation. Career exploration was also found to mediate the relationship between the assimilation strategy of acculturation and perceived employability. It is also addressed by presentation of the Principal Investigator entitled “Perceived employability of non-local Mainland Chinese graduating students in Hong Kong” in the “International Conference of Labor, Mobility and Development in PRD and Beyond” hosted by Chinese University of Hong Kong. Through hierarchical multiple regression, the differential impact of cross cultural, vocation and relational factors on perceived employability were demonstrated. A journal paper entitled “Perceived employability of nonlocal Chinese university students in Hong Kong: The impact of acculturative and vocational variables” was published in the Journal of Career Assessment. Objective 3 is on understanding cultural adaptation and career exploration and the transition from education to work from the experience and perspectives of graduating non-local Chinese students. We address this with longitudinal data collection and analysis. A first initiative was made to examine how acculturation strategies impact on career decidedness and subsequent job satisfaction among nonlocal Chinese university students in Hong Kong. We examined 268 nonlocal students from Mainland China in their final years in Time 1 and 147 Time 2 who stayed in Hong Kong upon graduation for work or study in the next year. We found that in Time 1 acculturation strategies of integration and separation were related to career decidedness, and environment exploration mediated the relation between integration and career decidedness. In Time 2, prior marginalization strategy was related negatively to job satisfaction and expected job utility. Implications on theory and practice are discussed. Results are summarized in a journal paper submitted to Journal of Vocational Behavior. In addition, we obtained data from 145 mainland students in all years of study one of the UGC-funded universities in Hong Kong, and found acculturation affected both career decision making self-efficacy and career commitment. This gives additional information about how acculturation strategies and environmental exploration are related to the process of career decision making among nonlocal Chinese students in Hong Kong. Results are presented in the HKERA International Conference in December, 2017. Objective 4 is on understanding career planning of non-local Chinese students prior and subsequent to their higher education in Hong Kong. It is addressed by the explanatory approach of mixed method involving a qualitative method to further explore the results and illustrate experience of the nonlocal students. From the longitudinal quantitative data of 150 nonlocal Chinese graduates who had stayed in Hong Kong upon graduation, we selected 14 for narrative interview with reference to their scores in perceived employability, migration intention and employment quality, maintaining a balanced representation of gender, graduating institution, discipline of study and industry of the present job. From the narrative interview, we obtained different career stories of non-local Chinese students prior, during and subsequent to their higher education in Hong Kong. A wide spectrum is identified, ranging from those with a clear/articulated career goal and worked strategically to position her/himself for attaining that goal throughout to students without prior preference and career preparation, just adjusting and constructing their careers gradually from university to work. A paper on these results is under preparation for submission to the British Journal of Guidance and Counselling. Objective 5 is on informing policy makers and guidance career practitioners to develop policies and interventions to enhance employability and career transition for non-local Chinese students. Aspiring to be a Regional Education Hub, Hong Kong has announced progressive plans to expand the percentage of its non-local students to 20% of the tertiary student population, as well as new immigration measures to attract quality students from areas inclusive of Mainland China. There is a lack of empirical data on the migration intention and career development on nonlocal Chinese students in Hong Kong. Our data revealed nature and complexity of migration intentions, as well as how acculturation, career exploration and relational support impact on perceived employability and migration intention. In our journal publications and conference presentations, we elaborated on implications of our study on higher education and career guidance. Research outputs have been disseminated to universities, non-local Chinese student associations, career practitioners and administrators, as well as local and international career scholars to stimulate interests, discussions and collaborations.

11401214.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11401214.value: In terms of submissions for journal publication, in addition to accepted and submitted papers, this study will possibly generate one more journal paper on migration intentions and another on narrative career stories of nonlocal Chinese students in journals related to career development and vocational behavior. We are working on it. The initial presentation and dissemination of results generated interest form administrators in higher education and student affairs. We shall follow up for possible consultation and further collaborations with them utilizing our research framework and measures. Moreover, encouraged by the enthusiastic response of overseas career researchers and the felt need to address the research gap on career development of international and nonlocal Chinese students, we shall explore to international research collaboration with reference to our tested research framework. Comparison across samples of nonlocal Chinese students across different counties and regions will be exciting and stimulating.

11401214.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11401214.value: Our study focuses on the impact of acculturation on career development and migration intention of nonlocal Chinese students in Hong Kong. We found significant effects of acculturation on perceived employability, career decidedness and subsequent job satisfaction among nonlocal Chinese students transiting into the workplace. Moreover, in addition to relating peer support and acculturation hassles to migration intention, we highlighted the nature of migration intentions of nonlocal Chinese students as tentative and uncertain in their preferred locations and duration of stay. Subsequent qualitative interviews also revealed that students regarded obtaining undergraduate education as a first step, providing opportunities for further career development and possibly geographical relocations. Hong Kong aspires to be a Regional Education Hub, with progressive plans to expand the percentage of its non-local students. There is a lack of empirical data on the migration intention and career development on nonlocal Chinese students in Hong Kong, and our results have addressed the gaps to inform policy and practice.

11401514.label: Realisation of objectives
11401514.value: Objective 1. A total of 155 dyads of frail elders and FDH were invited through 23 NGO service units. Excluding those who were cognitively impaired or not capable to communicate, 123 dyads (79.35%) were successful interviewed during January to July, 2016. In Phase Two, 75 dyads of the elders and FDHs were successfully interviewed (representing 60.97% successful rate) during January to March, 2017. Six work relation qualities perceived by the elders and FDHs were assessed by validated measurements, they included instrument support, emotional support, affect-based trust, cognition-based trust, social attraction and task attraction. Findings showed that FDHs consistently considered themselves providing more emotional support than what were perceived by the elders. Objective 2: Expectation and perception of both parties on six work relation qualities were assessed in Phase Two. Paired t-tests revealed that the elders generally thought that the FDHs provided not enough emotional support to meet their expectation, and the FDHs thought that they provided not enough instrument support as they expected. No other discrepancy was found. Since the expectation-outcome discrepancy (EOD) were too small across most of the work relation qualities, it was not meaningful to further explore its association with elderly’s well-being. Moderating effect of expectation on the relationship between work qualities and well-being was also not supported by regression analyses. Objective 3: The elders’ subjective well-being was assessed with several validated scales, and emotional closeness was measured by indicating their partner’s position in Social Convey Model (Kahn & Antonucci, 1980). Results of one-way ANOVAs showed that the elders were much satisfied with life and had less negative emotions if their FDHs regarded the elders as close or very close to them, compared to those who regarded the elders as not being included in their social circle. However, non-significant effect of emotional closeness was found in similar analyses for Phase Two data, i.e., the results cannot be validated across time. The significance/non-significance of the influence of emotional closeness may due to the uneven sample size at each emotional level. Objective 4 Since the expectation-outcome discrepancies were too small across most work relation qualities, attempt was shifted to examine the variation of elders’ well-being over time. However, it was found that the elders’ subjective well-being was steady across the two phases over a 1-year time period. Objective 5: Recommendations on support measures and policy directions were made from the results, and they were presented in an invitation symposium in the 15th World Congress on Long Term Care in Chinese Communities held from 29 Nov to 1 Dec 2018 (abstract attached).

11401514.label: Major findings and research outcome
11401514.value: 1. Perceptional difference between frail elders and FDHs on work relation qualities A major finding of the present study is the differences in nearly all work relation qualities (5 out of six) in perception between that of the elders and their FDHs. This may bring about mismatch in the dyads’ expectation on each other’s behavior and attitude, leading to frustration and disappointment, especially among FDHs. The FDHs tended to claim that they provided more instrumental and emotional support, compared to that perceived by the elders. This suggests that the elders might tend to underestimate the support, especially emotional, provided by FDHs. Or the FDHs have over-estimated the support they have provided. Another important finding is trust of FDHs towards the elderly was much likely affect-based, while trust of the elderly towards FDHs was much likely cognition-based. Moreover, FDHs might found themselves to be close to the elderly through social pathway rather than working tasks. One of PI’s qualitative studies found that the elders tended to overestimate their ability in self-care, claiming they did not need the FDHs’ help. It is therefore recommended to encourage the elders and their family members to give more recognition to the contribution of the FDHs, in order to motivate the FDHs. 2. Emotional closeness Both phases found that a larger proportion of FDHs (68.7~82.7%) thought that the elderly were close or very close to them, while the corresponding elderly counterpart (23.6~64.0%) was much less. This suggested that the FDH was less important to the elders’ emotional life while the elderly were more important to FDHs’. This is understandable since the FDHs are separated from their families while in Hong Kong, so the elder might become their proxy families. On the other hand, the elders still have their own families and support networks, and thus may take the FDHs more as a source of instrumental help than emotional support. 3. Impact of emotional closeness on elders/ wellbeing Results in Phase 1 showed that the elders were much satisfied with life and had less negative emotions if their FDHs regarded the elders as close or very close to them, compared to those who regarded the elders as not being included in their social circle. It is therefore recommended to provide more emotional support and encouragement to the FDHs to sustain the positive impact of FDH’s perceived emotional closeness on elders’ subjective wellbeing.

11401514.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11401514.value: 1. It is suggested to adopt the framework of work relation quality between the migrant workers and the frail elders in gerontological studies. With FDH required by law to live in their employer’s domestic home in HK, the work relation between the elder and the FDH lies between the formal work relation and the informal family relation; it is intriguing and requires more indepth understanding to find out how this relation would affect elders’ wellbeing. 2. This study found that emotional closeness affects elders’ wellbeing. Future studies are recommended to identify other potential moderators between work relation and elders’ well-being, such as communication style.

11401514.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11401514.value: The objective of this longitudinal survey was to examine the emotional closeness between the elders and their foreign domestic helpers (FDHs), and its relation with the elders’ subjective wellbeing. Two phases of data collection were conducted. The first phase (January to July 2016) has interviewed 123 dyads of elders (65+, mainly mildly impaired physically and/or cognitively) and their FDHs (mean age= 37.44 (SD = 8.33), majority (77.0%) from Indonesia). Phase 2 survey was conducted from January to March 2017, and 75 dyads were interviewed (response rate of 60.97%). A larger proportion of FDHs (68.7~82.7%) thought that the elderly were close or very close to them, while much less elders thought so (23.6~64.0%). This suggested that the FDHs were less important to the elders’ emotional life while the elders were more important to FDHs’. The elders were satisfied with life and had less negative emotions if their FDHs regarded the elders as close or very close to them, compared to those who regarded the elders as excluded from their social circle. The elders and their family members are therefore recommended to provide emotional support to the FDHs to sustain the positive impact of FDH’s perceived emotional closeness on elders’ wellbeing.

11401714.value: One central mission of China’s 2009 Tort Liability Law is to reform the previous medical negligence law, which was notorious for its legal barriers that prevented the victims of medical negligence from obtaining fair and reasonable compensation. Chapter VII of the Tort Liability Law, titled “Liability for injury in medical treatment”, has introduced a set of new provisions on medical negligence liability, in an attempt to better balance the interests of the patient victims and the health care providers in medical negligence disputes. However, it is far from clear whether such a legislative purpose has been achieved in judicial practice, especially when the Tort Liability Law has failed to offer clear provisions with respect to three critical issues for determining medical negligence liability, including the two-track system, the burden of proof on causation, and the form of medical authentication. Drawing on the datasets to be constructed on court judgments of medical negligence cases applying the new medical negligence law during the first five years of the implementation of the Tort Liability Law, this project will conduct both qualitative and quantitative empirical research to analyze the following three interrelated questions. First, how the courts, in determining medical negligence liability, deal with the above three issues unsettled by the Tort Liability Law. Second, whether (if yes, and to what extent) the new medical negligence law has made the patient victims in medical negligence litigation better off. Third, how the medical negligence law should be refined in the future. This project will generate empirical findings on the effects of the new medical negligence law after the 2009 tort law reform, and provide socio-legal analysis of the empirical findings. It will present recommendations for the improvement of the medical negligence law of China. It will also, through the lens of medical negligence litigation, shed light on judicial activism in reforming the law in China. 2009年侵權法改革之前的中國醫療過失法因其對請求損害賠償的受害人設置了種種法律限制而飽受爭議，而醫療過失法律改革也成為侵權法改革的重要議題之一。盡管2009年頒佈的《侵權責任法》第七章（醫療損害責任）規定了一套新的醫療過失法律規則，以平衡醫療過失爭議中醫患雙方的利益；但卻未能就醫療過失雙軌制規範模式、因果關係的舉證責任以及醫療過失的鑒定方式等問題規定清晰規則，從而造成司法實務上的困惑。而侵權法改革後的醫療過失法對醫患雙方的實際影響亦不甚明朗。通過對適用新舊法律的醫療過失案件的實證分析，本項目探討法院在實務中是如何處理醫療過失雙軌制規範模式、因果關係的舉證責任以及醫療過失的鑒定方式這三個未解問題；醫療過失的受害人是否因侵權法改革後的醫療過失法而受益；以及如何完善現行的醫療過失法。本項目將提供新的醫療過失法實施的實證效果並分析法社會學上的原因，為進一步完善相關法律提供建議；同時通過醫療過失案件的視角，探討中國司法能動與法律改革的關聯。

11401714.label: Realisation of objectives
11401714.value: The research objectives have been achieved through two publications under this project. One publication has investigated and analysed how the three unsettled critical issues for determining medical negligence liability have been addressed and solved through judicial activism (in particular, local judicial activism) after China's 2009 tort law reform. The implications of the post-reform development of medical negligence law for the medical institutions, the medical practitioners and the victim patients, who are three stakeholders involved in medical negligence disputes, have been discussed and assessed. The publication has also elaborated the political and social reasons for judicial activism in developing the post-reform medical negligence law in the context of China. The other publication under this project has explored the existing problems concerning medical negligence authentication and medical expert opinions, which are indispensable and significant to the operation and outcome of medical negligence litigation in practice. Based upon the investigation of more than three thousand medical negligence judicial decisions delivered by Chinese courts, it has presented and analysed the empirical findings as well as the recommendations regarding the roles of medical expert opinions in medical negligence litigation in China.

11401714.label: Major findings and research outcome
11401714.value: The major findings of this projects are presented in two publications. The first publication finds that although the 2009 tort law reform did not settled three critical issues for determining medical negligence liability (that is, the two-track system, the burden of proof regarding the issue of causation, and the proper form of medical negligence authentication), local courts in China have actively engaged in seeking legal solutions to these unsettled questions through local judicial interpretations. The local solutions were largely adopted by the Supreme People's Court in its judicial interpretations on medical negligence liability promulgated in December 2017. The research further finds that the post-reform development of medical negligence law in China has presented a unique case that local judicial activism drives the bottom-up legal development in China and provided a vivid illustration of interactive and cooperative relationship between the national and local judiciary in carrying out their de facto law-making function. It is found that while the Supreme People's Court was inactive in solving the three critical issues for determining medical negligence law that were of great political sensitivity at the national level, local courts demonstrated their legitimacy, competence and social responsibility to explore the solutions and pushed Chinese medical negligence law to go through a second-stage law reform after the 2009 tort law reform. The second publication finds that medical negligence authentication is of extremely important to the operation and outcome of medical negligence litigation in China. While medical negligence authentication conducted by the medical association has advantages in terms of the competence of authenticators over medical negligence authentication conducted by the forensic authentication agency, the victim patients and the courts still prefer the latter mainly because the public generally deem it neutral and less likely to favour local protectionism and medical professional protectionism and they value the neutrality more than the competence of authenticators. It further finds that Chinese courts show great judicial deference to medical expert opinions and the outcome of medical negligence litigation significantly depends on medical judgment. It is found that a number of socio-legal factors, such as the court-appointed expert system, the enhancement of judicial efficiency and the shifting of judicial responsibility, are major reasons for the extreme judicial deference in medical negligence litigation in China.

11401714.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11401714.value: Potentially, the research can be further developed by investigating how Chinese courts determine the causation issue and the mental suffering awards in medical negligence lawsuits in order to fully understand the characteristics and inadequacies of Chinese medical negligence law after the 2009 tort law reform.

11401714.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11401714.value: Although Chinese medical negligence law was reformed in 2009, there remained three critical issues for determining of medical negligence liability unsettled by the 2009 Tort Liability Law: the two-track system, the burden of proof regarding the issue of causation, and the proper form of medical negligence authentication. This project has examined how these unsettled issues have been handled and sovled by Chinese local courts and analysed why the Supreme People's Court was inactive in providing solutions after the implementation of the new law and how local courts drove the bottom-up legal development of medical negligence law in China. Also, this project has investigated the importance of medical negligence authentication and the roles of expert opinions in medical negligence litigation in China. The findings of this project not only help deepen the understanding of the post-reform medical negligence law of China, but also provides the lawmakers and the judiciary with insights into practical problems existing in the operation of the post-reform medical negligence law.

11401914.label: Major findings and research outcome
11401914.value: My major findings in this project are: 1. The relationship between the anti-schistosomiasis campaign and the political campaign during the period 1950–1970. I have finished an article, based on the archives of Hubei Province, discussing a promotional method termed “Speaking and Recalling Bitterness” used in the anti-schistosomiasis campaign in 1963–4. In 1963, speaking and recalling bitterness was highlighted as an important way to educate the masses to actively participate in the campaign. My article explores how the Chinese Party of Communism made use of speaking and recalling bitterness in the campaign and organized meetings for it in villages. Thus, the anti-schistosomiasis campaign must be placed in the historical context of the PRC. 2. Although the PRC energetically promoted the anti-schistosomiasis campaign, the public did not follow the central policy. The central government of the PRC promoted the three-day antimony potassium tartrate (APT) treatment, but villagers resisted using this treatment. The People’s Daily offered the central government’s point of view to promote the idea that the disease could be cured and that the three-day APT treatment was safe and effective. However, many archives reveal that villagers were not willing to undergo the three-day APT treatment because of their concerns about its safety and cost; the villagers came up with many creative ways of avoiding the treatment. It was believed in previous studies that the anti-schistosomiasis campaign was conducted smoothly based on vigorous promotion by the central government of the PRC. However, actually, the degree of success of controlling the disease during the period 1950–70 should be re-evaluated. 3. The treatment methods of the disease promoted by the central government of the PRC were not based on scientific research but on political agendas such as the policy of using a combination of Chinese and Western medicine, the three-day APT treatment, speaking and recalling bitterness, etc. It is worth probing into the campaign from this neglected perspective. 4. Many campaigns in the PRC during 1950 to the 1970s were internal. The anti-schistosomiasis campaign was investigated by medical delegations from the Soviet Union, Japan and the U.S. This should be a good case study to examine the public health movement and Sino-foreign relations. I have published six articles (one is accepted and two are published OnlineFirst) in this period. Among them, five are listed in Scopus, including articles 1, 2, 4, 6 and 7. Two further articles are under review.

I will keep visiting archives in different provinces. I am writing a book to integrate my previous findings and my current articles under this project.

11401914.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11401914.value: The southern provinces of China have long been threatened by schistosomiasis, a potentially fatal disease that is contracted from water snails which are the intermediate hosts of the parasite Schistosoma japonicum. Schistosomiasis has reemerged as a critical public health issue in the People’s Republic of China. The spread of schistosomiasis prompted Chairman Mao Zedong to initiate a mass anti-schistosomiasis campaign in 1955. By the 1970s, after much orchestrated effort, schistosomiasis was considered to be under control. This project is divided into two parts. First, collecting relevant information related to the prevention of schistosomiasis, such as local official records and documents, and reports from newspapers. The information includes promotional tools including propaganda movies, posters, educational materials, illustrated booklets, pamphlets, and so on. Documentation concerning schistosomiasis will be examined. The second part involves examining the historical context surrounding the efforts to prevent schistosomiasis from the 1950s to the 1970s. I shall place the control of schistosomiasis in its historical context and examine the promotional materials that were used, as well as the concepts and strategies used for mobilizing the masses and implementing policies. This study will offer a new perspective to investigate public health and politics, as well as Sino-foreign relations from 1950 to the 1970s.

11402514.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11402514.value: Externalizing behavior problems (aggressive and antisocial behaviors) are widely recognized as predisposing to significant mental health problems and violence among adolescents in secondary schools. These in turn result in enormous economic and social costs to schools as well as to society (Snyder & Sickmund, 1999). These costs include mental illness, crime, and violence. Similarly, violence is widely recognized as a major public health problem which has also largely defied successful intervention and prevention. Because an increasing body of research is documenting health and neurobiological risk factors for aggression and violence, part of this prevention failure may be due to intervention efforts ignoring biological contributory factors which include impaired neurocognitive and psychophysiological functioning. One benign biological intervention that may help attenuate behavior problems in children consists of omega-3 supplementation of the diet, a long-chain fatty acid critical for brain structure and function. The overarching aim of this study is to assess whether omega-3 supplementation can reduce the base level of externalizing behavior problems in children and adolescents. Secondary but important aims are to assess whether any behavioral improvement is due to enhanced neurocognitive and psychophysiological functioning produced by omega-3 supplementation. The specific aims are as follows: 1. To assess the effectiveness of omega-3 dietary supplementation in reducing externalizing behaviors in adolescents. 2. To assess whether omega-3 supplementation can enhance childhood neurocognitive and psychophysiological functioning. 3. To assess whether any such enhanced neurocognitive functioning mediates the relationship between omega-3 enhancement and reductions in externalizing behavior. Hypotheses will be tested in a placebo-controlled, double-blind, randomized trial involving 11 to16 year-old adolescents drawn from secondary schools in Hong Kong. Omega-3 supplementation will be in the form of a Norwegian fruit juice drink. 300 adolescents will be randomly assigned into: (1) omega-3 supplemented drink, (2) placebo drink, (3) treatment-as-usual controls. Behavioral, neurocognitive, and psychophysiological measures will be assessed at baseline (0 months), end of treatment (6 months), and 6 months post-treatment (12 months). This initial study could be the first to identify possible mechanisms of action by which omega-3 may reduce behavior problems in children, and the first to document efficacy of omega-3 in reducing behavior problems in an East Asian population. If successful, this study could yield enormous long-term financial benefits in terms of the saved legal, medical, social, and psychological costs resulting from the long-term consequences of adolescent behavior problems. 以奧米加3補充劑減少邊緣青年的外化行為： 一項隨機、雙盲及安慰劑對照實驗 外化行為（攻擊與反社會行為）已被廣泛認定會誘發校園暴力和青少年精神問題。它們為學校和社會製造沉重的經濟和社會負擔──包括精神病、犯罪活動及暴力事件 (Snyder & Sickmund, 1999)。同樣，暴力行為會對社會造成嚴重的問題和具深遠的影響，所以急切需要尋求有效的介入和預防的方法。近來有些研究以神經生物學的角度指出，人的健康狀況會引致增加暴力行為的風險。以往的預防措施不能有預期的果效，可能是因為它們忽略了生物學上的因素──包括神經認知和生理功能方面的受損。其中一種有效地減少兒童的行為問題的介入方法，是在日常飲食中加入奧米加3──含有一種長碳鏈脂肪酸，對腦部結構和功能有重要影響。 本研究旨在評估奧米加3補充劑能否減少青少年的外化行為。其次，本研究亦會評估奧米加3補充劑能否提升青少年的神經認知和生理功能，以致改善他們的行為。具體的研究目標如下： 1. 評估奧米加3口服補充劑能否減少青少年的外化行為 2. 評估奧米加3補充劑能否提升青少年的神經認知和生理功能 3. 評估奧米加3補充劑是否透過提升神經認知功能，以減少外化行為 本研究會運用隨機、雙盲及安慰劑對照的設計驗證以上假設。參與的青少年會是十一至十六歲的香港中學生。奧米加3補充劑將會以果汁的形式提供，全均由挪威製造。三百個青少年會被隨機分配到：（一）奧米加3補充飲料組、（二）安慰劑組及（三）對照組。研究會評估青少年的行為、神經認知功能及生理反應三次：基線、治療後（第六個月）及六個月跟進（第十二個月）。本研究將會是第一個發掘奧米加三脂肪酸減少青少年行為問題背後機制的研究；同時亦會是第一個評估奧米加三脂肪酸能否減少東亞地區青少年行為問題的研究。如果研究成功，將會為社會帶來具大的經濟效益──減少青少年行為問題所衍生的法律、醫療、心理及社會成本。

11402514.label: Realisation of objectives
11402514.value: The Omega-3 Supplementation Project has been successfully executed and fully accomplished. Open recruitment was through promoting while the Principal Investigator (PI) was organising training seminars for the Education Bureau (EDB) of the HKSAR, which covered over 2,000 principals and frontline educators. Eventually, five schools and a Children’s Home showed interest in participating. After meetings with all the schools, three schools turned down due to food safety and legal liability concerns. Besides, since the Children’s Home was found not enough targeted sample, it was excluded in the project. Ultimately, St. Bonaventure Catholic Primary School and T.W.G.Hs. Mr. & Mrs. Kwong Sik Kwan College were selected and invited in joining the project. Before formally implementing the project, written consents from all schools and parents have been obtained. A total of three hundred and eighty-six community-dwelling schoolchildren were eligible to participate. However, due to the seafood allergy, mental retardation, epilepsy, declined participation, and significant usage of fish-oil supplements reasons, an accumulation of sixty-two eligible participants were excluded. Eventually, three hundred and twenty-four participants aged from 8 to 18 (age=11.89, s=2.59) and their primary caregivers were recruited in this randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, stratified, and parallel-group (1:1:1 ratio) study. Subsequently, the participants were randomly assigned into (1) 6-month Omega-3 Treatment Intervention Group (n=108), (2) 6-month Placebo-drink Group (n =110), and (3) No-treatment Control Group (n =106) with the use of the URN software stratifying the participants’ age, sex, and subtypes of aggression in the two-factor model of aggression. After random assignment, the participants and their primary caregiver were requested to complete an electronic questionnaire consisted of the Reactive-Proactive Aggression Questionnaire (RPQ), the Antisocial Process Screening Device (APSD), and the Conduct and Oppositional Defiant Disorder Scales (CODDS) on the 0th month (pre-test), 6th month (post-test), and 12th month (6-month post-test follow-up). Meanwhile, to investigate the cognitive variation among participants with different psychopathic levels, neurocognitive (the Tower of London), and psychophysiological (Electroencephalography; EEG) measures were adopted. All participants involved in data collection were blinded to group allocation. The allocation concealment was conducted separately by a collaborator, who was at an overseas site, independent with all the participants, and not involved in data collection. Also, to minimise the effect of the self-fulfilling prophecy, both drinks from Norway for the treatment and placebo groups had neither design nor label, but a barcode for distribution only. At the end of the project, both participants and their primary caregivers were asked to guess whether they were in the omega-3 group or placebo group. The result indicated that the blinding was successful (p=.49), with 76.0% members in the placebo group guessing they were assigned to the omega-3 group, compared to 72.6% in the omega-3 group. Studies revealed that there is a much stronger heritability for externalising antisocial and criminal behaviour in psychopathic children compared to children with normative level. Also, sex differences in omega-3 level have been reported in the influence of DHA on anti-inflammatory processes in the brain. Furthermore, it is well-documented that poor nutritional status is a risk factor for developing psychopathic traits. Omega-3 has been postulated as an adjunct therapy for explaining the relationship between externalising behaviour and poor nutrition. While studies have investigated the efficacy of the omega-3 supplementation in reducing externalising behaviour, no prior study has adopted the role of psychopathic personality and sex in moderating the effectiveness of omega-3 supplementation. Therefore, this project aimed to take account of the psychopathic personality and sex in modulating the outcome of consecutive taking omega-3 supplements for six months and also examine the neurocognitive relationship between P300 responses, which is transferred from fronto-central to parietal sites, and the dimensions of psychopathy in schoolchildren. A series of studies have demonstrated that impairment in neural processing of salient environmental stimuli has been postulated to predispose psychopathic individuals to perform antisocial and criminal behaviour. It is believable that a stronger neurobiological basis for psychopathic-liked children to display externalising behaviour compared to non-psychopathic children. Brain studies revealed that psychopathic individuals have abnormalities in some region of the brain. For example, they have a relatively smaller amygdala, the emotional region of the brain, and relative bigger striatum, the reward centre of the brain. The impairments predispose them to have lower sensitivity on punishment and fear, and higher sensitivity on reward-seeking; hence externalise antisocial or criminal behaviour. This project aimed at enhancing the brain executive functioning and hence reduce the externalising behaviour of the schoolchildren with psychopathic traits by taking omega-3 dietary supplements. Given that children with certain psychopathic-liked traits have shown impartments in recognition of fearful facial expression, reduced fear conditioning, and smaller P300 event-related potential, the high blood level of omega-3 is associated with better semantic processing of facial affect as measured by event-related potentials whereas intravenous administration of omega-3 in rats is associated with enhanced fear conditioning. It is conceivable that taking omega-3 supplements would reduce antisocial behaviour in children with psychopathic-liked traits by reversing neurobiological and neurocognitive impairments, including boosting synaptic functioning, reducing cell death, and regulating neurotransmitter functioning and expression. The objectives of the project have been well achieved. The randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, stratified, and parallel-group study of omega-3 supplementation suggested that there is a significant reduction in antisocial behaviour among female schoolchildren and schoolchildren with high psychopathic-liked traits after consecutive omega-3 supplements for six months compared to male children and those with low psychopathic traits, respectively. Although omega-3 supplementation reduced externalising behaviour in psychopathic-liked children and female children, no significant effect could be found in those with low psychopathic-liked traits. This surprising result was not consistent with the studies accomplished in other countries. One of the possibilities needed to be considered is that this study was conducted in Hong Kong, which is the second-highest level of marine fish per capita in the world (Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations, 2013). Hence, it is conceivable that there may be a ceiling effect that limits the efficacy of omega-3 supplementation in Hong Kong schoolchildren. The Electroencephalography (EEG) study examined the contribution of the interpersonal, affect, and behavioural dimensions of psychopathic traits to P300 responses of the brain, which has been associated with the ability to identify the task relevance of a stimulus and actively engaging it for further action. Studies demonstrated that psychopathic adults have P300 abnormalities in temporal-parietal junction, indicating the atypical capability to direct attention to events of importance. The result of the EEG study revealed that novelty P300 responses in the right parietal site were negatively associated with behavioural dimension of psychopathy (impulsivity, irresponsibility, proneness to boredom, novelty seeking, and anti-sociality), positively with interpersonal dimension of psychopathy (narcissism, manipulativeness, superficial charm, egocentricity, and glibness), and not related to affective dimension of psychopathy (callousness, a lack of empathy and remorse, and short-lived emotions). The P300 reduction in the parietal sites, indicating an inefficient transfer of information from the fronto-central sites, which posits that deficits in neural indicators should be related to the features of psychopathy that overlap most with externalising tendencies, and that reduced P300 amplitudes may serve as a neurodevelopmental marker for externalising/impulsive behaviour. In conclusion, the project successfully achieved the objectives that examined the effectiveness of omega-3 supplementation in reducing externalising behaviour in female schoolchildren and psychopathic schoolchildren and examined the neurocognitive relationship between P300 responses, and the dimensions of psychopathy in schoolchildren.

11402514.label: Major findings and research outcome
11402514.value: To cover all areas of this pioneering project, the Principal Investigator (PI) started to invite interdisciplinary research team globally in order to provide various expertise covering treatment for aggression, nutrition, psychophysiology, and neurocognition. The result of the global project was compelling, demonstrating that omega-3 supplementation significantly reduced antisocial behaviour among female and psychopathic schoolchildren after taking omega-3 supplementation compared to male and those with low psychopathic traits, respectively. The success of omega-3 supplements intervention strongly suggested that the development of psychopathy and antisocial behaviour have a neurobiological basis. The finding of this project in line with previous studies that consuming omega-3 regularly would enhance brain structure and function, including boosting synaptic functioning, reducing cell death, and regulating neurotransmitter functioning and expression. In a word, the omega-3 supplementation could remove the brain dysfunction that predisposes one to develop psychopathic-liked traits. As the PI was invited to offer regular training and consultations by various Government Departments and well-established institutions, including the Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF), Education Bureau (EDB), Social Welfare Department (SWD), Correctional Services Department (CSD), NGOs, Schools, and so forth. The PI has promoted and popularised this compelling finding towards over 10,000 practitioners to adopt not only the omega-3 supplementation project (11402514), but also the Essence of Chinese Martial Arts and Ethics projects (141613), and the group storytelling project (11611517). Remarkably, the HKPF and CSD that are in further discussion on the possibility of adoption of omega-3 supplementation. For the HKPF, the omega-3 supplementation would assist the guardians of the juveniles in the Police Superintendent’s Discretion Scheme (PSDS) in reducing their children’s aggressive behaviour, and hence lower the recommitment rate and prevent those from perpetrating severe crimes in later adulthood. For the Correction Service Department (CSD), omega-3 supplementation is an effective way of helping inmates to reduce their aggressive behaviour and thus lowering the relapse rate and recidivism. The findings have been presented in six international conferences including the United States (Washington D. C., New York, and Columbia with three different presentations), Spain (Barcelona), Portugal (Lisbon), and Norway (Bergen). Moreover, five papers have been published in high-tier international peer-reviewed journals, which are the Journal of Adolescent health (Impact factor: 4.098), Personality and Individual Differences (Impact factor: 1.967), Neuropsychiatry (Impact factor: 4.778), Applied Research in Quality of life (Impact factor: 1.025), and the last one, which is currently under review, the British Journal of Nutrition (Impact factor: 3.657).

11402514.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11402514.value: The success of this pioneering omega-3 supplementation project, which targeted to repair the structure and function of the brain, suggested that the development of psychopathic personality has a strong neurobiological basis. With no doubt, this study contributed to the clinical nutritional psychology that omega-3 supplementation plays a role, albeit at a modest level, in reducing antisocial behaviour in psychopathic schoolchildren. Although the omega-3 supplementation would significantly reduce antisocial behaviour in psychopathic schoolchildren, the level of antisocial behaviour in the high psychopathy group at the post-test still remain higher than low psychopathy group. Future research should examine the therapeutic effectiveness of omega-3 supplementation while combined with other treatment options. On the other hand, the electroencephalography study revealed that psychopathic schoolchildren showed less increment in P3 amplitudes at the right hemisphere compared to non-psychopathic schoolchildren. The result was consistent with studies that antisocial behaviour and psychopathy were associated with structural and functional reductions at the right orbitofrontal cortex and anterior cingulate cortex, regions that are critical in emotion processing and decision-making. Future study should examine that the right-sided neural pathology might be associated with cognitive, emotional, and empathy deficits that contribute to impaired decision-making and antisocial behaviour in psychopathic individuals.

11402514.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11402514.value: While many studies reviewed the effectiveness of omega-3 supplementation in enhancing the brain executive functioning, the use of the psychopathic personality in modulating the outcome of the omega-3 adjunct intervention has not been examined. The present project examines the efficacy of omega-3 supplementation in reducing externalising behaviour as well as the biological mechanism behind different dimensions of psychopathy amongst children and adolescents in Hong Kong. Three hundred and twenty-four participants aged between 8-18 and their primary caregivers were recruited at two schools in Hong Kong. Participants were randomly assigned into three groups: (1) Omega-3 (n=108), (2) Placebo-drink (n=110), and (3) No-treatment Control (n=106). Results were collected before the treatment, after the treatment, and six months after the treatment. No overall treatment effect was found. However, significant moderating effects of psychopathic-liked traits and sex were observed. Female Schoolchildren or Children with high psychopathic-liked personality in the Omega-3 group showed significant improvements in child-reported antisocial behaviour at the end of the treatment compared with the placebo and control group. This neurobiological approach for reducing aggressive behaviour could yield enormous long-term financial benefits in terms of the saved legal, medical, social, and psychological costs resulting from the long-term consequences of adolescent behaviour problems.

11402614.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11402614.value: 日本当代文学与群岛观念

11402614.label: Project Objectives
11402614.value: To compile a systematic study of the imagery of the remote island in Japanese contemporary literature by connecting the analysis to postcolonial critique in general and the theorizations of island space in the context of the Caribbean and the Pacific in particular (c.f.Elizabeth DeLoughrey, Tidalectics: Repeating Islands, 2007).
rows: To compile a systematic study of the imagery of the remote island in Japanese contemporary literature by connecting the analysis to postcolonial critique in general and the theorizations of island space in the context of the Caribbean and the Pacific in particular (c.f.Elizabeth DeLoughrey, Tidalectics: Repeating Islands, 2007).

11402614.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11402614.value: The Japanese archipelago comprises 6852 islands, but apart from those few that are the focus of heated territorial disputes, the popular metaphor for Japan as a whole is that of a monolithic island conveying a monolithic cultural identity. In the area of Japanese Studies the spatial interplay remote island/archipelago has been systematically addressed only by the French geographer, Philippe Pelletier (1998), who has proposed the term Japonesie (Japanesia) to acknowledge the internal heterogeneity/internal insularities of the Japanese archipelago. Combining geophysical, geohistorical, geopolitical and sociocultural issues, Pelletier includes a poetic dimension to this term and pays tribute to an understudied Japanese writer, Shimao Toshio, who promoted the term Yaponeshia as a way to decentralize the image of Japan (Pelletier 2006) by focusing on its margins. A separate body of literature, postcolonial critique, has addressed the controversies and hybridity of cultural identity outside the West through extended elaborations of the notions of “stereotype,” “marginality,” “rupture,” and “trauma” (Bhabha 1994; Trinh 1991), and, precisely, “archipelago” (Glissant 1990, 2005) . Postcolonial ideas have also inspired a number of Japanese thinkers (Ukai 2003; Imafuku 2008) to poetically theorize the limits of a singular ethnic identity through the image-concept of “archipelago,” a critical and poetic questioning of cultural territories. This poetic aspect of the visions of island/archipelago requires deep engagement with the workings of literary imagination; however, an integrated critical study of the abundance and complexity of insular imagery in Japanese contemporary literature is missing from cultural discourses on Japan. This absence precludes a potentially powerful contribution to postcolonial studies complicating the role of borders and borderlands as boundaries of cultural identity in the Japanese case. I am applying for a GRF grant for individual research in order to complete a book that proposes to fill this gap through comparative textured literary analyses centered on the significance of the “island/archipelago” settings in important works by Oba Minako (Shipworms, 1970), Ariyoshi Sawako (Dark Sea, 1967), Hino Keizo (Dream Island, 1985), Ikezawa Natsuki (The Fall of Macias Guili, 1993), Shimada Masahiko (Iturup Love, 2003), and Tawada Yoko (Wounds in the Alphabet, 1993; “US+SR”, 2005). Approaching literary visions of Japan through the model of "island"/"archipelago," this research provides a crucial interface between the typically narrow study of Japanese literature and a broader research community sharing an interest in postcolonial articulations of cultural identity within the interplay of the multiple power dynamics of ruptures and continuities in (self) representation. 日本列島總共由六千八百五十二個島嶼組成，但撇除一些因主權爭議受注目的島嶼，在主流眼光下的日本卻象徵著擁有單一文化身份的單一島嶼。在日本研究領域內，曾經有系統地探索離島／群島的空間相互性的，就只有法國地理學家Philippe Pelletier（1998）。他提出「日本洲」（Japonesie ／Japanesia）這個概念，以代表日本群島的異質性及內在的孤立。「日本洲」橫跨地理、地緣歷史、地緣政治及社會文化各個層面，並向提出「日本尼西亞」（ヤポネシア／Yaponeshia ）的作家島尾敏雄致敬。島尾敏雄提出這個概念，是要透過聚焦到日本的邊緣，把日本本來單一的形象分散。 另外，一些文學及後殖民批評，通過廣泛探索諸如「典型」（stereotype）、「邊緣化」（marginality）、「斷裂」（rupture）、「傷痕」（trauma）（Bhabha 1994; Trinh 1991），以至「群島」（archipelago）（Glissant 1990, 2005）這些概念，嘗試在「西方」的框架之外，觸及關於文化身份的矛盾與混雜性。後殖民思想亦啟發了一些日本思想家（鵜飼哲；今福龍太2008），通過「群島」的形象（作為對文化區塊的質疑），以文學的方式，將單一民族身份的限制理論化。要建構離島／群島的意境中具文學性的部分，需要深刻的關注以及對文字的幻想力。然而，在關於日本文化的論述當中，仍然沒有就日本當代文學中，島嶼的形象的廣泛性與複雜性，作過綜合的研究，而這研究，可以搞亂國界／邊境作為文化身份界線的角色，從而對後殖民研究產生貢獻。 我希望透過申請優配研究金，以完成一本可以填補日本研究中這個斷層的著作。這本書以「離島／群島」的意象為中心，對一系列作家的重要作品進行篇章比較文本分析（comparative textured literary analyses），包括大庭みな子（ふなくい虫／Shipworms, 1970）、有吉佐和子（海暗／Dark Sea, 1967 ）、日野啟三（夢の島／Dream Island, 1985）、池澤夏樹（マシアス・ギリの失脚／The Fall of Macias Guili, 1993）、島田雅彦（エトロフの恋／Iturup Love, 2003）以及多和田葉子（アルファベットの傷口／Wounds in the Alphabet, 1993; “US+SR”, 2005）。這項研究從「離島／群島」建構日本的文學意象，為範圍較窄的日本文學研究提供一個重要的介面，在（自我）表象斷裂與延續的多元權力動態中，連接到更廣闊的，對後殖民話語的文化身份感興趣的研究社群。

11402814.label: Project Objectives
