11405614.label: Project Objectives
11405614.value: 1. This study aims to give a comprehensive study of the many different manifestations of religious life in Ming-Qing China. 2. Using the GIS system, I will present a clearer general outlook of the distribution of temples of different persuasions, which will provide a solid physical ground to make spatial and other analysis. 3. Re-examining the role of supernatural forces in shaping Zhu Yuanzhang’s ideology in ruling the empire, I will show that researches in the past have overstated the importance of Confucian orthodoxy at the expense of the influence of Zhu Yuanzhang’s supernatural beliefs. When discussing the systems established by Zhu Yuanzhang, I will single out the ritual of she (community) for particular analysis. As argued by Zheng Zhenman and the others, the collapse of lijia system in the mid-Ming period had a profound impact on the economy and society then. One of the changes it brought about was that the functions of traditional she were largely replaced by temples. Temples now became the center of all sorts of ritual and religious activities. I will attempt to find out if similar changes can be substantiated in the city of Nanjing. 4. Taking the Great Baoen Temple (the Temple of Repaid Gratitude) as an example, I will further illustrate the relationship between the prosperity of a temple and the patronization of royal household. Besides, the Temple can also be used as a paragon to testify to the widespread influence of leading Buddhist monks among all strata of contemporary society. The close ties between the monks and celebrated literati will be discussed as well. 5. In addition to their relationship with the Buddhist monks, the literati’s great enthusiasm with and firm beliefs in the supernatural beings which were found at street corners or their courtyards also require our further and comprehensive analysis. 6. The way how Nanjing streets were categorized into different quarters in accordance with professions and local cults offers a good opportunity for us to explore the relationships between different human groups and different cults. Following the studies done by Zheng Zhenman and the others on the roles played by temples or local cults in establishing communal, commercial and ritual networks in Fujian and southeast China, I will also endeavor to find out if similar phenomena existed in the local communities in Ming-Qing Nanjing. 7. By addressing some of the issues mentioned above, I attempt to respond to a “big” issue that has been haunting scholars whose research interests revolve around traditional Chinese cities in general and Nanjing in particular: in what sense we can say that the late imperial Nanjing was already a cosmopolitan city? Meanwhile, can we find out any characteristics of rural society in Fujian or Southeast China in the organizations in Ming-Qing Nanjing?

11405614.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11405614.value: Religious Life in Ming-Qing Nanjing Apart from being a reputed capital city famous for its decadent pleasure culture since the early 3rd century, Nanjing was also well known for its vigorous religious activities from about the same period. This project aims to present the many different aspects of religious life in Ming-Qing Nanjing. With the aim to offer a general outlook on these religious activities, I will first reconstruct the geographical distribution of all the Buddhist, Taoist temples and temples of popular cults in this period. On the basis of this physical ground, I will then examine the relationships between these supernatural beliefs and human agents, as well as spatial configuration. For the part of human agents, I will first discuss the role played by the ruling class at that time. Nevertheless, among all the emperors and royal households, I will single out Taizu of the Ming dynasty for particular analysis, for it is Taizu who set up most of the guidelines which most religious activities would follow and develop in later generations. In addition to the ruling class, I will also explore the roles of gentry-literati, merchants, different professors and the masses in promoting various beliefs. Regarding the relationship between spatial configuration and religious activities, I will attempt to analyze the possible connections between religious beliefs and several major areas of Nanjing city. It is noted that because of the major difference between the north and the south of the city, Nanjing was further divided into 35 compartments in around the 16th century and several of these compartments were named either after a certain cult or the different professions of craftsmanship. The relationship between these compartments and the religious cults has long been a neglected yet interesting topic. In addition to these local cults, I will also take a close look at the beliefs in ghosts and spirits, which seemingly have enchanted several of the leading gentry-literati who had left monumental accounts of life in Nanjing at different times. I would argue that this belief in ghosts and spirits had been related to both literary tradition and the unique structures of the Nanjing streets, which tended to be long and narrow in the south eastern and south western parts of the city. 明清南京的宗教生活 南京，作為魏晉南朝以來聞名遐邇的六朝古都，不僅以精緻的逸樂文化享譽於世，更以自西元三世紀起即繁複發達的宗教活動而廣為人知。通過對一系列宗教活動的概觀呈現，本計畫聚焦於明清時期南京宗教生活的多維面向，並嘗試重構此一時段內南京城內佛寺、道觀及民間信仰祠廟的地理分佈。在此基礎上，本計畫還將對宗教生活中所涉超自然信仰、俗世代理人及空間構型之關係進行探討。 以俗世代理人部分為例，本計畫將首先討論其時統治階層，包括皇帝及勳戚貴胄在宗教生活中所起的作用，而又以明太祖作為個案進行集中探討。因其制定相關章程法令於明清兩代宗教政策及實踐影響深遠，明太祖足以作為典型進行細緻考察。此外，本計畫同樣關注地方士紳、商人、文人及一般民眾在宗教生活中所扮演的角色，以期全方位呈現明清時期南京精彩紛呈的宗教生活。

11405614.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11405614.value: Both Buddhism and believes in ghosts and supernatural forces are still an integral part of the daily life in our own contemporary word. In this regard, we see the continuity between traditional and modern world. On the other hand, this project shows to us that the religious world of Ming-Qing Nanjing is different from our own religious world in terms of the role played by emperors and highly educated class. In addition, we will never see another Great Baoen Temple in our own world, whether in the building itself or the myths around it.

11405714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11405714.value: For health-promoting behaviors such as physical activity (PA), gain-framed messages (i.e., benefits of engaging in PA) are suggested to be more effective than loss-framed messages (i.e., costs of non-participation). According to some age-related mechanisms (i.e., increases in heuristic/affective processing, preference toward positive affect, and personal importance of PA), the gain-frame advantage for PA may be more pronounced for older versus younger adults. The regulatory fit theory, however, predicts the opposite. Messages are more effective when individuals’ regulatory focus orientations match with the frames, i.e., promotion-to-gain and prevention-to-loss. Older adults are more prevention-oriented about health, which may lead to a more favorable evaluation toward loss frames. This study aims to uncover the contributions of these age-related mechanisms. Besides overall-valence framing (i.e., gain-loss), messages can be framed by end-state valence (i.e., positive-negative). For instance, gain-framed messages can be framed as the presence of positive outcomes (e.g., enhance heart health) or the absence of negative outcomes (e.g., avoid heart disease). Messages are more effective when individuals’ regulatory focus orientations match with the end-states (i.e., promotion-to-positive and prevention-to-negative). Commonly seen PA messages, however, often include both end-states, which may confound with the overall-valence framing effect. This methodological issue needs to be addressed for meaningful examinations of age moderations. Study 1 compares the effectiveness of four single-framed conditions varied by overall valence and end-state valence, together with a mix-framed condition, which shows the most commonly seen PA outcomes in their corresponding ideal frames (i.e., gain-to-positive and loss-to-negative). In addition, age moderation will be explored. Participants will be 150 younger (aged 18-35) and 150 older (aged ≥ 60) sedentary adults. They will be randomly assigned to five possible message conditions. Effectiveness will be measured by information acceptance, PA attitudes, and PA intentions immediately after message reading, as well as PA behavior at a two-week follow-up. Study 2 examines the age-related moderators (i.e., age, affective processing, positivity, regulatory focus orientation, and PA importance) of the overall-valence framing effect. To control for end-state framing effects, only positive end-states will be used. A gain-frame advantage is expected to be stronger for older than for younger adults. Study 2 also examines whether age moderation can be explained by other moderators. Participants will be 160 younger and 160 older sedentary adults. They will be randomly assigned to read either the gain- or loss-framed messages. Effectiveness will be measured objectively by monitoring the participants’ PA behaviors for two weeks using accelerometers. 在推廣健康促進行為(如體力活動)方面，以益處(即從事體力活動的利益)比以損失(即不參與的成本)作宣傳信息的框架更為有效。根據某些與年齡相關的理論機制（即啟發式或情感式資料處理，對正面情感的偏好，和體力活動對個人的重要性等的增長），以益處作信息框架的優點，可能在長者當中更為顯著。可是，調節配適理論(regulatory fit theory)有相反的預測。當個人的調節焦點(regulatory focus orientations)與信息框架相配，即促進焦點對益處，及預防焦點對損失，信息會更為有效。在健康方面，長者比較聚焦於預防，因此對損失框架可能有較優勝的評價。本研究旨在揭示這些與年齡相關機制。 除了整體框架方向性（即益處對損失）外，信息框架可以通過終端狀態（即正面對負面）來分類。例如，增益框信息可以被描述為有正面的結果（例如，加強心臟健康），或者沒有負面的結果（例如，避免心臟疾病）。當個人的調節焦點與終端狀態相配（即促進對正面，預防對負面），信息會更為有效。可是，常見的體力活動信息通常包括了兩種終端狀態，這可能與整體框架方向性的效應混淆。要對年齡的調節作用作有意義的研究，必需解解決這研究法的問題。 第一個研究項目，會在整體框架方向性及終端狀態上有所不同的四個單框實驗條件，以及一個用了最常見的體力活動結果及相應的理想框架（即益處對正面，損失對負面）的混合框架條件中，作出比較。此外，這研究項目也探討年齡的調節作用。研究參與者將包括150位年輕（ 18-35歲）和150位年長（年齡≥ 60 ）的靜態成年人。他們將被隨機分配到五個有可能的實驗條件。用心閱讀信息後的信息接受程度，對體力活動的態度，和進行體力活動意圖，以及在其後兩星期的體力活動行為，將會作為測量有效性的準則。第二個研究項目，會考察在整體框架方向性上，與年齡有關的調節作用（例如，年齡，情感式資料處理，正面偏好，調節焦點，和體力活動的重要性）。為了控制終端狀態的框架效應，只有正面的終端狀態會被使用。研究的期望結果是，以益處作信息框架的優點，可能在長者當中比在年輕人中更強。第二個研究項目，還探討其他的調節作用，可否解釋年齡的調節作用。研究參與者將包括160位年輕和160位年長的靜態成年人。他們將被隨機指定閱讀益處框架或損失框架的信息。利用加速度計作監察，參與者在兩週內的體力活動，將會作為測量有效性的客觀準則。

11405714.label: Major findings and research outcome
11405714.value: Objective 1: This project examined whether PA messages are more effective, when the overall-valence framing matches with the end-state framing (i.e., gain-to-positive and loss-to-negative). The results of MANOVA with multiple PA outcomes as dependent variables did not support this matching effect. The univariate analysis showed that this matching effect was significant only in the report PA intention at the post-experiment assessment. Objective 2: This project examined whether mix-framed PA messages (i.e., a mix of common gain-positive and loss-negative frames) are more effective than the other four single-framed conditions (i.e., gain-positive, gain-negative, loss-positive, and loss-negative). Based on the results of both multivariate and univariate ANOVA, the mix-framed PA message was not more effective than the four single-framed conditions. Objective 3: This project examined whether the effectiveness of the five message conditions differs by age. The findings revealed that the gain-loss framing effects on PA outcomes were moderated by age. The age moderation was found in PA attitude and intention, but self-report PA behavior. No age moderation effects were found on end-state framing. Objective 4: This project examined whether age moderates the overall-valence (gain-loss) framing effects. Using the accelerometer data in Study 2, age moderated the overall-valence only for men but women. Specifically, the gain-frame advantage was found only among older men. Objective 5: This project examined whether the age-related mechanisms moderate the overall-valence framing effects. Five mechanisms including issue involvement, promotion orientation, prevention orientation, need for cognition, and preference toward positive information, were tested. None of the age-related mechanisms moderate the framing effect on accelerometer-assessed PA behaviors in Study 2. However, issue involvement and preference toward positive information could moderate the message framing effect on attitude and intention measured in Study 1. Objective 6: This project examined whether the age-related mechanisms explain the age moderation in framing. The two age-related mechanisms that were found to moderate the framing effects were able to mediate the age moderation. Research Outcome To enhance the impact, the findings from Study 1 and Study 2 will be presented in one paper. The manuscript is in preparation. Another manuscript that examined the moderating effects of affect on message framing had been submitted previously to a few journals for publication. This manuscript is currently under review. In addition, 2 international conference presentations and 1 MPhil dissertation were developed from this project.

11405714.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11405714.value: Age moderation on the message framing effect was found in some self-report PA outcomes. For objective PA behavior, age moderation was found only among men. Different age-related mechanisms may explain the different patterns of age moderation. Age-related mechanisms that are more relevant to the cognitive processing may explain the age moderation on in self-report measures, whereas behavioral mechanisms may explain the age moderation on objective PA measures. These two lines of research will be able to enhance the understanding of age differences in both the motivational and volitional processes of PA participation. With regards to the findings of this project, research proposals can be developed to investigate further how and why the framing of message can differentially influences people of different age groups. Further studies should use objective PA measures as much as possible to understand more about how the framing effects can be translated into actions. With the cumulative evidence, the research paradigm can be shifted from identifying the mechanisms to designing tailor-made message frames according to the demographic and psychological characteristics of the individuals.

11405714.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11405714.value: Gain-framed messages (i.e., emphasizing benefits of participation rather than costs of non-participation) are suggested to be more effective among older adults rather than younger adults to promote physical activity. This project aimed to uncover the underlying mechanisms that explain the differences in framing effects between younger and older adults. The gain-frame advantage was found greater in older adults, especially older men when objective physical activity measures were concerned. Issue involvement (i.e., the extent that physical activity is personally relevant) and preference toward positive information were found to explain the age differences in framing effects on physical activity attitude and intention. For objectively measured physical activity, no age-related mechanism was found. The findings suggest that more research efforts are warranted for unpacking the age differences in message framing effects. The accumulation of evidence can benefit message design for physical activity promotion. The findings, if proven effective, can be applied to promote other health-related behaviors. With more evidence on the mechanisms of such age differences, future studies may examine how message can be effectively tailored to individuals based on their demographic and psychological characteristics. With advances in technology, message tailoring can be tested and adopted easily in mobile devices.

11405814.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11405814.value: 自1992年《里约环境与发展宣言》发布以来，环境信息公开已在全球范围内逐渐制度化。作为一种合意的公共物品，信息公开制度可以推动政府提高环境监管的效能、保护个人免遭环境损害、激发协作式环境执法、促进社会学习。然而，信息公开制度能否取得实效，取决于一个社会的法律基础、主流价值观和其他社会经济条件，以及收集、处理、公布、使用环境信息的意愿和能力。只有当以上要素在个体、机构与地区层面都具备的时候，环境信息公开制度才能获得成功。国家环保部于2007年颁布《环境信息公开办法（试行）》，迄今地方的政策执行情况参差不齐、逊于预期。但鲜有著述论及到底为何这项政策在执行过程中出现巨大的地方差异。面对污染防治和绿色发展两项重任，中国急迫地需要对执行环境信息公开制度的影响因素进行系统的审视。 本研究填补当前环境治理文献的空白，检视环境信息公开制度的利益相关者：政府官员个人、环保局、经济管理和发展规划部门、非政府组织和公众对环境信息的供给和需求及其影响因素。在个体层面，政府官员是否公开环境信息取决于其对信息公开的看法、个人价值观及其对信息公开的成本和收益的感知。在组织层面，机构能力（人力、财力）和跨部门合作的顺畅程度可以解释环保部门执行环境信息公开制度的地方差异。在地区层面，社会、经济、环境状况，官员领导力，公民意识和地区文化等要素会影响当地政府如何定位环境信息公开。本研究将考察个体偏好、环保局特征、地方社会经济政治状况这些要素如何共同影响个体、组织、地区三个层面与环境信息公开相关的活动，并最终决定地方执行环境信息公开制度的成效。 根据中国污染信息透明指数，本研究对环保部确定的113个全国环境保护重点城市进行分层随机抽样，选取了12个在环境信息公开制度的执行程度和地域上具有代表性的城市作为分析的样本。研究对象包括政府官员、环保局和当地居民。数据收集的方法主要为焦点小组、个体访谈、问卷。新闻报道、政府文件、环保非政府组织等编撰的报告会对田野调查所获得的第一手资料提供有益的补充。 本研究会给学者、实务操作人员、政策制定者提供关于中国环境信息公开的推动力、制度设计、社会学习机制的最新研究成果，从而为提高中国环境信息透明度和改善环境治理的成效做出贡献。更宽泛地，本研究还会对环境治理、政府-社会关系，政府管治质量等方面的文献提供有益的补充。

11405814.label: Realisation of objectives
11405814.value: This project has examined the collection, transmission, and use of environmental information in China. The air quality monitoring network at both a national and provincial (Shandong) level has been carefully studied. Adopting a case study method, both primary and secondary data have been collected for gaining a good understanding about the factors that promote or impede environmental information transparency in China. Through field observation, face-to-face interviews and ad hoc meetings during workshops, the PI and her collaborators were able to learn perspectives of government officials, academics, and operators of the monitoring networks. Empirical knowledge gained on the contractual relationships between the central/provincial monitoring centers and operators helped advance scholarly understanding of the contract design, incentive mechanisms, quality control, and economic costs of environmental information collection and transmission. The results revealed enabling and impeding factors of environmental information transparency at the individual, organisational and regional levels (objective 1 fully achieved). Focusing on how the government has made use of available environmental information for mainstreaming environmental protection, this study has examined the following two strategic move, naming of national model city for protecting the environment and quantitative examination of comprehensive control of urban environment. By reading program documents and conducting interviews with responsible officials, the study analyzed the program features and assessed to what extent the strategic use of environmental information transparency programs has helped diagnose environmental challenges, facilitated learning, and initiated negotiation and social learning among different stakeholders and interest groups. Although environmental issues involve multiple agencies, because of time limit, this study was not able to include government officials beyond environmental protection bureaus. In this case, it is difficult to draw conclusions on to what extent environmental information transparency has facilitated inter-agency coordination and collaboration. Thus, the implications of strategic use of environmental information transparency programs for the quality of government are left for future studies (objective 2 not fully achieved). To make up this insufficiency, another GRF proposal has been developed for mapping institutional collective action in air pollution and carbon reduction in China among different government agencies at a local level. Complemented by secondary data on government regulations and policies on air quality standards, environmental monitoring and public reporting, the study was able to locate the issue of environmental information transparency in the broader economic, social and political context in China. Given environmental information transparency is a global trend, this study has broadened the scope of analysis by also including cases of strategic uses of environmental information transparency programs in other countries. The reasonably large sample of cases allowed an opportunity for the project to develop a conceptual and methodological framework that delineates activities individuals and institutions could possibly engage in environmental management, diagnosing environmental problems, learning, negotiating and bargaining, and social learning (objective 3 fully achieved). However, in recent years, dramatic changes have occurred to the field of environmental protection in China. Rising public environmental awareness and the Internet technology have enabled ordinary citizens and environmental NGOs to actively participate in environmental information collection, verification, and publication. In the future, the conceptual and methodological framework can be validated, modified, and further improved when having identified more cases on strategic uses of environmental information transparency programs by non-state actors. As a whole, by offering empirical knowledge and conceptual and methodological framework on environmental monitoring and performance evaluation, the project contributed to an evidence-based approach in understanding and assessing environmental information transparency in China (objective 4 fully achieved). This said, because this project has mainly focused on state actors, it remains an open question how to assess non-state actors’ contribution to environmental information transparency in China. In summary, although the project has accomplished reasonably well the pre-set objectives, this project has a great potential to be extended to also include government agencies beyond environmental protection bureaus as well as non-state actors for gaining a more nuanced understanding of the dynamics of environmental information transparency, institutional collective action, and state-society relations in China.

11405814.label: Major findings and research outcome
11405814.value: This project has advanced our understanding of environmental information transparency in China along the following two aspects: production and consumption of environmental information, mainly focusing on state actors. Monitoring is critical for the production of credible environmental information. The Chinese government has long been blamed for concealing and manipulating environmental quality data, especially ambient air quality reporting. Acquiring air quality monitoring data through the government hierarchy in China and uses the Shandong case study for illustrating how it is addressed using the market at a subnational level. Adopting transaction cost economics perspective, we analyzed contractual hazards in both relying on the hierarchy and the market. We found the Shandong provincial environmental protection bureau has crafted contract terms that can reduce the risk of being held up resulted from asset specificity, increase efficiency, improve observability of both input and output quality, and induce accountability by enforceable rewards and punishments. The lessons learned contribute to the literature on public management broadly and outsourcing specifically, and are useful for institution building for achieving sustainable development in China (Li and Huang, 2018) (manuscript ready for submission). Furthermore, societal actors have been using publicly available environmental information for pursuing sustainable development outcomes. During the past decades numerous environmental performance evaluation programs have been developed and implemented on different geographic scales. This paper develops a taxonomy of environmental management behavioral patterns in order to provide a practical comparison tool for environmental performance evaluation programs. Ten such programs purposively selected are mapped against the identified four behavioral patterns in the form of diagnosis, negotiation, learning, and socialization and learning. Overall, we found that schemes which serve to diagnose environmental abnormalities are mainly externally imposed and have been developed as a result of technical debates concerning data sources, methodology and ranking criteria. Learning oriented scheme is featured by processes through which free exchange of ideas, mutual and adaptive learning can occur. Scheme developed by higher authority for influencing behaviors of lower levels of government has been adopted by the evaluated to signal their excellent environmental performance. The socializing and learning classified evaluation schemes have incorporated dialogue, participation, and capacity building in program design. In conclusion we consider the ‘fitness for purpose’ of the various schemes, the merits of our analytical model and the future possibilities of fostering capacity building in the realm of wicked environmental challenges (Li and Mauerhofer, 2016).

11405814.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11405814.value: Stakeholders of environmental information transparency are not limited to the government. This project can be further extended to also include non-state actors. Increasing public environmental awareness and access to social media have created opportunities for the public and environmental NGOs to collect, verify, and publish environmental information as well as to push the government to take actions. Along this line, my collaborator and I have developed a project to map environmental protest events in China and to analyze the connection with broader socio-economic local contexts. In the meantime, with increasing environmental information transparency, the government may enhance inter-agency collaboration striving for environmental improvement on the ground. This is particularly true for air pollution control and prevention. Given energy activities and motor vehicles fueled by gasoline are major causes of air pollution, especially in cities. They are also major sources of carbon emissions. To gain a good understanding of synergies in air pollution and carbon reduction across different government agencies, I have prepared another GRF proposal for mapping institutional collective action at a local level in China.

11405814.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11405814.value: This project has examined the collection, transmission, and use of environmental information in China. The air quality monitoring network at both a national and provincial level has been carefully studied. Adopting a case study method, both primary and secondary data have been collected for gaining a good understanding about the factors that promote or impede environmental information transparency in China. Compared with acquiring air quality data through the government hierarchy, hiring operators in the market for air quality monitoring may be advantageous if contract terms are carefully designed. The following measures have helped improve data accuracy and environmental information transparency, prescribing qualification requirements for entering the bidding process, specifying performance parameters, introducing independent quality check, and employing enforceable rewards and punishments. Although increased environmental information transparency has facilitated better diagnosis of and solution finding for environmental problems, it remains an open question whether it has advanced inter-agency collaboration and/or social learning. As a whole, by offering empirical knowledge and conceptual and methodological framework on environmental monitoring and performance evaluation, the project contributed to an evidence-based approach in understanding and assessing environmental information transparency in China.

11405914.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11405914.value: 公共健康危機經常發生，並對社會產生重大影響。當危機發生時，公眾從各種渠道了解有關危機的信息。媒體有關危機的報道通常成為最重要的信息來源。媒體對危機的廣泛報道會影響公眾對有關問題的感知與態度，最終會影響他們如何應對危機，並對社會產生直接與長期影響。由媒體信息帶來的人們在感知、態度和行為方面的變化對公眾利益與社會穩定具有重要意義，尤其是在面臨公共健康危機時。 例如2009年H1N1豬流感流行時，媒體作了廣泛報道，不僅提供了有關疫情的信息，對公眾對疫情的感知與態度也產生影響，並帶來重要社會影響。H1N1豬流感已經過去，但是具有重大社會影響的公共健康危機經常發生。了解公共健康危機發生時，公眾如何應對危機，確保采取相應措施以控制疫情，減少損失，變得刻不容緩。類似於H1N1豬流感這樣的疫情將為觀察了解公眾在媒體廣泛報道下如何應對並采取自我保護行為提供極好機會。也有助於了解影響人們應對公共健康危機行為的因素。 到目前為止，多數有關自我保護行為的研究集中於對於艾滋、糖尿病之類疾病威脅的意向和行為，以及影響這些意向和行為的因素。很少有研究涉及媒體與其它渠道有關公共健康危機的信息對公眾感知、態度、意向與行為的影響。而且以往的研究都訴諸恐懼心理來測試人們對媒體信息對健康保護行為的影響，而那些刺激恐懼心理的信息都是人工制作用來測試專門人群的。雖然這些研究對於一定情況下媒體信息的效果提供了有用的知識，但是訴諸恐怖心理的信息與媒體在公共健康危機期間報道的新聞完全不同。媒體信息對公眾對於大規模健康危機的態度及反應的影響目前尚不清楚。 本項目將通過開展壹項長期問卷調查來檢測一個媒體廣泛報道公共健康危機情況下民眾應對保護行為的模型以填補目前文獻的不足。這項研究將考察接觸媒體和其它有關信息對人對公共健康威脅感知和效能感知的影響，威脅感知引發的恐懼，以及威脅感知和效能感知互動導致的危險控制與恐懼控制結果。我們將分兩步來完成這項研究。第一步，我們將檢測人對媒體對公共健康危機報道的感知以及他們在過去的健康危機中應對行為的一般模式。第二步，我們將研究廣泛媒體報道對於威脅感知和效能感知的影響，以及媒體和其它渠道信息引發的恐懼對人們應對大規模公共健康危機的影響程度。

11405914.label: Realisation of objectives
11405914.value: The research project has 6 objectives, all of which have been achieved. The realization of the objectives is explained as follows: 1) To explore people’s perceptions of the media coverage of a public-health emergency and their perceived efficacy. The project explored perceived threat of a public-health emergency due to media exposure and perceived efficacy in dealing with the situation of a public-health emergency. The understanding of the effect of media exposure on perceived threat is advanced with the findings of the two aspects of media exposure and their corresponding effect on the two aspects of perceived threat, susceptibility and severity. 2) To examine how these perceptions and perceived efficacy affect people’s behavior in response to the public health emergency. The project examined the effects of risk perceptions and perceived efficacy on people’s behavior in response to the public health emergency. The findings of the effects of risk perceptions and perceived efficacy add knowledge to the body of literature regarding risk perception and self-efficacy associated with media exposure. The findings of three aspects of efficacy in predicting protective behaviors further advance the understanding of the roles of different aspects of efficacy in a public health emergency involving people in a community at different levels. 3) To investigate key factors influencing public perceptions of and behavior in response to public-health emergencies that are extensively covered by the media. Media exposure was examined as a key factor that influenced public perceptions of and behavior in response to public-health emergencies. Media exposure was tested as a predictor of perceived threat and perceived efficacy. Its effect on the behavior in response to a public-health emergency mediated through perceived threat and fear was also tested. The results expanded the understanding of media exposure in influencing protective behaivors in a public health emergency as a direct as well as an indirect factor. 4) To model the influence of people’s perceptions of a public-health emergency on their behavior in response to the extensive media coverage of the threat. The influence of people’s perceptions of a public-health emergency on their behavior in response to the extensive media coverage of the threat was modelled based on the Extended Parallel Process Model and the Social Learning Theory. The model went beyond the scope of the studies of health communication behaviors using experiments and integrated media exposure into a more sophisticated model to explain the effects of both media exposure and the public perception on protective behaivors in response to a public health emergency. 5) To empirically test the above model of the influence of perceptions on behavior in response to the media coverage of a public-health emergency. The model was tested with Structural Equation Modelling. The results of model testing provide illustrative explanation on the influencing factors of people’s perceptions of a public-health emergency and their behavior in response to the extensive media coverage of the threat in two different routes: danger control and fear control outcomes. The role of media exposure was clearly highlighted in the refined model of health communication in the context of pervasive media messages. 6) To generate applied knowledge of people’s perceptions of and behavior in response to public emergencies that are extensively covered by the media. Guided by the Extended Parallel Process Model and the Social Cognitive Theory, this study examined the effects of media coverage of a public health emergency on perceived threat and perceived efficacy, which further affect people’s protective behaviors. The results of the study offer new insight into the health protection behavior in response to the extensive media coverage of a public health emergency, and generated applied knowledge of people’s perceptions of and behavior in response to public emergencies that are extensively covered by the media. The findings presented as the results of Structural Equation Modelling clearly identified the key factor influencing people’s protective behaivor in a public health emergency, and the relationships of the key factors in a health communication process that involves extensive media coverage.

11405914.label: Major findings and research outcome
11405914.value: Major findings Media exposure was found to have an effect on perceived threat, but the effect varied by exposure frequency and extensity in relation to susceptibility and severity. Media exposure produces societal level risk perception more due to exposure extensity than exposure frequency. The finding implies that the access mode of media coverage of the epidemic could produce different orientations of risk perception in a public health emergency. The finding confirmed a direct and an indirect effect of media exposure on fear in a public health emergency. The effects of media exposure on fear mediated by perceived threat further confirmed the role of media exposure in arousing fear. The findings clarified the role of self-efficacy as a moderator of the effect of perceived threat on danger control and fear control outcomes. The finding confirmed that proxy efficacy had a stronger effect than self-efficacy and collective efficacy on danger control outcomes. The leading role of self-efficacy on danger control outcomes would therefore give way to proxy efficacy, when the public has confidence in the agent’s ability to address the crisis and protect the people. 11405914.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11405914.value: The research project on media use and protective behavior during public-health emergencies funded by a GRF grant initiates a new direction for research on health communication associated with media use and information access through various communication channels. The study identified a few key factors that influence how people respond to and deal with public health emergencies, and lay foundation for further exploration on health related behaviors in the context of multi-facet communication, especially the communication through the Internet and social media. A series of new studies will be designed using different methods to further explore the issues in areas concerning public health and the effect of media exposure and communication patterns on human behaviors that have crucial implications for public health and social stability. The future studies on media use, information exchange and public communication in association with different aspects of public health issues will generate insightful knowledge of health communication in the context of pervasive media messages distributed by the Internet and mobile media.

11405914.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11405914.value: This project contains several studies that examined how media coverage of public-health related events affects people’s perception of risks, and how people respond to media messages and take actions to protect themselves. The major contributions of these studies are as follows: First, these studies go beyond previous research using intimidating messages through experiments to test the effect of media messages regarding public-health issues on people’s perception of risks and the consequent protective behaviors. Media messages in real life were used to test how people are influenced by messages regarding an immediate threat and their health-related behaviors. Second, these studies treat media exposure in a more delicate way and tested the effect of media exposure on perceived risk through two aspects: exposure frequency and exposure extensity. The findings clarify the effect of media exposure on different level of risk perception in a public health emergency. Third, these studies demonstrated the effect of the three aspects of efficacy (self-reflected capability) based on the Social Cognitive Theory on protective behaviors in health-related events. The findings suggest that the effects of perceived efficacy on protective behaviors are contingent upon the nature and the social context of a public health event.

11406014.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11406014.value: 败诉的媒体？ 中国媒体诉讼案件的实证研究

11406014.label: Project Objectives
11406014.value: To survey litigation involving news media in China from 1980 to 2013, as a quantitative documentation of media transition in China. We will document what kinds of litigation involving news media have been accepted by the courts, and how they change over time and vary across regions, issues and courts. To estimate the relative winning probability of the parties when suing the media or being sued by the media. To examine what factors affect court decisions. We pay attention to who sues and whom is sued. We will identify key features of both parties in litigation, such as social status, occupation, available resources for litigation, political influence etc. We then analyze under which conditions what kinds of news media organization are more likely to win litigation. To investigate the relationship between the media and the court in transitional China and to discuss the implications on maintaining institutional resilience in China. We will articulate the mechanisms of commercialization in the process of constructing, or deconstructing, the court-media relations.

11406014.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11406014.value: 近年来涉及媒体的诉讼案件数量在中国不断上升。尽管这类诉讼案件对研究媒体在社会转型期的角色有深刻的意义，但实证研究匮乏。通过研究法院正式的判决文件，我们力图分析媒体组织在该类诉讼案中的获胜概率及影响因素。这些影响因素包括如案件类型，当事人的社会地位，涉案媒体的特征，诉讼地等。同时，通过和记者及法官进行的结构性访谈，我们进一步探讨法官的判决过程，以及相关的判决又将如何影响记者的工作惯例及他们对媒体角色的认知和看法。对处于转型期的中国而言，该项目的研究结果不仅能展示媒体和法院之间的动态关系，为理解媒体行为提供了一个新的角度；而且也有助于探讨中国如何维持与提高其制度性的适应力以面对当下的信息革命。

11406014.label: Major findings and research outcome
11406014.value: Three major findings: 1) The empirical patterns of media-related litigation in Chinese courts. In the arena of defamation (1993-2013), on average, the success rate of news media was 42%, and this rate has been increasing since 2005. Government officials, and party organs had consistent advantages in defamation courts, while ordinary plaintiffs, magazines and websites had less success. The medium of the media (i.e. print, broadcast, Internet) makes a difference, as do the government policies governing the media (Xie and Lin, 2017). In the arena of intellectual property rights protection involving China’s Big Five Websites (2003-2013), the win rate was 24 % for websites being sued – but the rate jumped to 90% for websites suing others. Plaintiffs were awarded a median 5,502 yuan in damages – representing a median 10% of their claims. The average win rate fluctuated in the period, while the amount of median damages awarded decreased over time (Lin, 2017). 2) Impacts of various factors on the court decisions on media-related litigation. In the arenas of defamation (Xie and Lin,2017) and intellectual property rights protection (Lin, 2017), the studies investigated how the party capacity of litigants, the medium, and the media’s political influence affected the outcomes of cases. And in both arenas, local protectionism existed, but it was less rampant than expected. In addition, such media-court dynamics uncovered inspired further investigation on the process how the media and the court constructed social justice in the transitional China (Lin and Yang, 2017). 3) Typologies to further study the media-court dynamics and China’s ongoing transition. I proposed an updated “information conflicts” model to analyze how various institutions – the market, the technology, the court and the media – shape the information regime in China (Lin, 2018). Based on such understanding on China’s information control, we further extended our analysis to collective actions and proposed a typology of activism in digital China (Lin and Zhang, 2018). 11406014.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11406014.value: The findings in this project further inspires two lines of research, which has led to two more successful GRF grants. One investigates further on how the price of Chinese reputation is determined in Chinese courts (Project#11672616, Principal Investigator, “The Chinese Reputation: A Community Approach on Defamation Litigation in China,” 514,000 HKD. 01/06/2017 – 31/05/2020). The other explores how the media and the court interact with each other to construct the social justice (Project#11608717, Principal Investigator, “Constructing social justice: The evolving media–court relation and media trials in China,” 260,264 HKD. 01/01/2018 – 30/06/2021.)

11406014.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11406014.value: 1) Based on the newly available court decision files, the project not only outlines the empirical patterns of media-related litigation in Chinese courts but also analyzes how various factors shape the outcomes of litigation, which is the first empirical study in this research area. 2) The project proposes a new research field on the media-court relation in the authoritarian regime, which creates an interdisciplinary and innovative perspective in both media study and China research. 3) The project also brings the big-data approach into the empirical study on law. 4) The project creates the potential comparative studies, not only across different professions (journalists and lawyers) but also across different regions and countries (mainland China, Hong Kong and the world). 5) Both the empirical and theoretical findings generated by the project generates helpful insights in discussing and formulating the media policies and legal reform.

11406114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11406114.value: The environmental effects of economic development, shifting land use patterns, population growth and climate change have severely threatened China’s biological resources and habitats. According to the 2013 IUCN Red List there are 880 threatened species in China but protecting them has proven difficult as policymakers have struggled with the often contradictory priorities of economic development and conservation objectives set out in national legislation and international commitments such as the Convention on Biological Diversity. Besides the maintenance of biological resources through the creation of reserves and efforts to eliminate unsustainable poaching or other illegal resource uses, an important aspect of Chinese conservation efforts must involve encouraging sustainable use of natural resources. Much of this resource use involves subsistence and cultural uses by minority groups in more remote and undeveloped autonomous regions which have an abundance of protected species, or less degradation of biodiversity. As such, minority group practices can have a disproportionate impact on wildlife and biodiversity preservation and conservation efforts. The research will seek to explore the content, extent and implementation of law (national and local) related to minority customary hunting, fishing and gathering practices in various autonomous prefectures in Yunnan and Inner Mongolia autonomous region. Using surveys and interviews with minority groups and governmental officials, the project will analyse various environmental management regulations, minority involvement in developing those regulations as well as cataloguing minority hunting, fishing and gathering practices in order to assess the effectiveness of local institutions and approaches to wildlife management in areas where there are significant minority populations. It will analyse this data in light of legal and policy developments regarding hunting, fishing and gathering practices for minority/indigenous peoples in other jurisdictions. The research will generate specific suggestions on how the relevant national and/or regional regulations and the institutional/administrative structure should be reformed to facilitate wildlife and biodiversity conservation. It argues that national efforts to conserve and preserve biological resources must include consideration of local/minority subsistence and cultural needs in the formulation and implementation of the regulations. The output of the research will enable policymakers to better understand the effectiveness of their regulations, to implement policies and procedures more sensitive to minority practices, and to overcome the often significant political, cultural, technical and institutional obstacles to flora and fauna management by adopting a co-management model that allows for significant local participation. 經濟發展、土地使用用途的轉變、人口增長和氣候變化嚴重威脅了中國的生態資源和野生動物棲息地。根據2013年有關國際組織所編撰的瀕危物種，中國有880種。由於政策制定者需要在相互矛盾的經濟發展優先與國內立法所規定的保育目標和中國通過《生物多樣性公約》所作出的國際承諾之間取得平衡，因此對這些瀕危物種作出有效的保護就顯得非常困難。除了通過設立保護區和消除不可持續的違法狩獵及其他非法的資源使用方式來保護生態資源之外，中國保育工作的一個重要方面必須是鼓勵對自然資源的可持續性使用。在中國對自然資源使用的很大一部分是在資源豐富的偏遠和不發達地區的少數民族為了其生存和文化而進行的使用。這就是為什麼少數民族的實踐對野生動物和生物多樣性的保護和保育有著不成比例的重大影響。 本研究將對雲南和內蒙古兩個少數民族自治區涉及少數民族傳統狩獵、捕魚和採集的法律、法規、規章和政策進行實證和比較研究。通過和少數民族群體以及政府官員的調查和訪談，本研究將分析不同的環境管理法規和少數民族在制定有關法規過程中的參與程度，並將有關的法規進行分類以便評估在少數民族聚居區的少數民族組織/機構和其對自然資源管理的取態對自然資源保護/保育的影響。本研究還將根據外國少數民族有關狩獵、捕魚和採集法律和政策的發展來分析上述中國的資料。本研究將就中國有關的全國性和地方性的法規、有關自然資源保護的機構和管理架構該如何改革，從而使其更有利於野生動植物和生物多樣性的保育提出具體的建議。我們的基本觀點是，全國性的對生態資源的保護和保育法規和政策的制定必須是在對少數民族的生存和文化需要作出充分考量的基礎之上作出的。本研究的成果將有助於政策制定者更好地理解其所制定的政策的有效性，根據少數民族的實踐去靈活實施其政策，並通過採用允許少數民族參予的共同管理的模式來克服在動植物管理中通常非常重要的政治、文化、技術和機構設置方面的障礙。

11407214.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11407214.value: 长距离反身代词——从亚洲视角来看

11407214.label: Project Objectives
11407214.value: to give an adequate account of the Chinese long-distance reflexive ziji; to conduct a comparative study among the anaphoric binding systems in Asian languages, mainly the ones in Chinese, Japanese and Korean, and to account for the universals as well as the variations among them; to clarify the relationship between the discourse-based notions including indexicality, de se, logophoricity and empathy, and then provide a more elegant formal analysis for them.

to conduct a comparative study among the anaphoric binding systems in Asian languages, mainly the ones in Chinese, Japanese and Korean, and to account for the universals as well as the variations among them;
to clarify the relationship between the discourse-based notions including indexicality, de se, logophoricity and empathy, and then provide a more elegant formal analysis for them.

11407214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11407214.value: Although the canonical binding theory developed by Chomsky (1981) has a strong foundation in the typology of anaphoric forms, it is also well known that there are many languages in which some forms that can be used as local reflexives can also take antecedents outside their local domain (henceforth long-distance reflexives). These “exceptions” then lead to the discussion in this sub-field of binding theory on whether one should abandon or revise Chomsky's Binding Condition A, namely that an anaphor should be bound in its governing category, or rethink the assumption that long distance bound reflexives are indeed anaphors that are directly bound long-distance. In this project, we plan to investigate the anaphoric systems in Asian languages such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean, which receive less attention, compared to those in European languages, but still retain a lot of controversy regarding the description of their properties as well as their accounts. More specifically, we attempt to examine the Chinese long-distance reflexive ziji and give it a discourse-based analysis based on Oshima’s (2004, 2007) distinction on logophoricity and empathy. Then, we will conduct a comparative study among the long-distance reflexives in Chinese, Japanese and Korean to provide our explanations of the universals as well as the variations among them by resorting to the different effects of the relevant discourse factors. Finally, we will discuss the more general issue like the relationship between the discourse-based notions including indexicality, de se interpretations, logophoricity and empathy, and try to give them a formal representation in syntax, following Cinque (1999), Speas and Tenny (2003), Giorgi (2010) and others who suggest to put discourse-pertinent information in the left periphery, so that the long-distance reflexives in these three Asian languages can be accounted for in a unified framework. Our investigation on the long-distance reflexives in Asian languages will contribute to the theory of binding in that it reflects the diversity of the anaphoric binding systems in human languages as well as the importance of the discourse factors in regulating the binding conditions. It will further benefit the relevant theoretical research such as the nature of belief, self-knowledge, the empathic point of view and consciousness. The outcomes can help people better communicate with each other, and also explain what the cognitive process and mechanism are like when people learn and use reflexives. 众所周知，尽管Chomsky (1981)经典约束理论中提及的照应语的 约束条件具有很强的类型学基础，然而人们发现很多语言中存在 一些形式的局部用法的反身代词也可以在其局部辖域外被约束， 因而被称作长距离反身代词。这些“特例”迫使人们重新审视 Chomsky约束理论中的约束条件A（即照应语应当在其管辖语域 内被约束），进而考虑是否应当将其抛弃或修正，还是长距离反 身代词本身其实并非真正被长距离约束这一问题。 在该项目中，我们将对亚洲语言中汉语、日语和韩语里面的照应 语系统进行研究。亚洲语言相比欧洲语言中的长距离照应语得到 的关注较少，但其中存在许多争论，包括对长距离照应语性质的 描述及其相应的解释理论。具体而言，首先，我们将研究汉语中 的长距离反身代词“自己”，并根据Oshima (2004, 2007)对话者指 示性和移情两个概念的区分对其给出一个基于话语的解释理论； 然后，我们将对比汉语、日语和韩语中的长距离反身代词，揭示 它们在分布上的异同，并试图采用话语中的不同因素来解释它们 性质的差别；最后，我们将探讨更为一般性的问题如话语中的一 些概念索引性、涉己解、话者指示性及移情之间的关系，并根据 Cinque (1999), Speas & Tenny (2003), Giorgi (2010)等人提出的将 话语中的相关信息放在左边缘这一思想考虑它们在句法上的形式 表达，进而将上述三种亚洲语言中的长距离反身代词在一个统一 的框架中进行解释。 我们对亚洲语言中长距离反身代词的研究的意义首先在于其对约 束理论的贡献，它反映了人类语言中的照应语系统的多样性及话 语中的因素对于约束规则的重要性。此外，我们的研究还有助于 推动相关问题的研究如信念的本质、关于自我的知识、移情视角 及自我意识等。研究成果则能帮助人们之间进行更好的交流，并 解释人们在习得和使用反身代词时的认知过程和机制是怎样的。

11407214.label: Realisation of objectives
11407214.value: 1. To give an adequate account of the Chinese long-distance reflexive ziji; To achieve the first objective, we first re-examine the three properties of LD ziji that are often discussed in the literature – i.e., the de se interpretation, subject orientation, and the blocking effect. We have some novel observations, e.g., possible non-de se readings of LD ziji in intensional contexts such as indirect speech, backward binding phenomena of LD ziji in extensional contexts and the blocking effect induced by a second person pronoun in cases with a first person matrix subject. Then, to account for all the properties of LD ziji, we use the theories of empathy, including Kuno et al.'s classic theory of empathy, the relationship between empathy and logophoricity (Oshima 2006, 2007), and the nature of the empathic and logophoric uses of LDRs (Hirose 2002, 2014), and finally we provide a new unified empathic account of Chinese LD ziji in intensional and extensional contexts. 2. To conduct a comparative study among the anaphoric binding systems in Asian languages, mainly the ones in Chinese, Japanese and Korean, and to account for the universals as well as the variations among them; To achieve the second objective, we first compare the long-distance reflexives in three Asian languages in terms of the three main properties associated with them, i.e., the de se interpretation, subject orientation, and the blocking effect. Data are collected from the previous relevant literature and our consultations with native speakers. Then, we argue that discourse factors play a more important role over syntax in the licensing the relevant items, contra those LDRs in European languages. As to the contrast between Chinese LD ziji and Japanese LD zibun, we mainly resort to their different sensitivity to pragmatic factors, i.e., logophoricity and empathy. More specifically, while Chinese LD ziji is invariably subject to the empathy constraints in both intensional and extensional contexts, Japanese LD zibun is not, as it is only restricted by the logophoric conditions in intensional contexts. Moreover, we agree with Han & Storoshenko's (2012) semantic account of Korean LD caki as a bound variable so as to distinguish it from the other two long-distance reflexives, though empathy plays a role in some blocking cases, as observed in Park & Pan (2017). 3. to clarify the relationship between the discourse-based notions including indexicality, de se, logophoricity and empathy, and then provide a more elegant formal analysis for them. To achieve the third objective, we first clarify the relevant notions according to the literature. More specifically, we adopt Kuno & Kaburaki's (1977) definition of empathy and Oshima's (2006, 2007) logophoric/empathic distinction, hence using the notion of logophoricity in its initial narrow sense, contra Sells' (1987). Then, we reveal their relationship by examining how these notions are manifested in different languages. For instance, in spite of the distinction between empathy and logophoricity, we find that these two notions are actually compatible with each other, as most occurrences of Chinese long-distance reflexive ziji in attitude reports are both logophoric and empathic. Moreover, due to the blocking effect in Chinese, we contend that empathic expressions cannot co-occur with first/second person pronouns as well as the third person NPs of deictic use, though logophors can, as there is no perspective conflict between primary indexicals and secondary indexicals, contra Huang and Liu (2001). Finally, we explain the relationship among them from the cognitive perspective in the spirit of Hirose's (2002, 2014) theory on self (the private self vs. the objective self).

11407214.label: Major findings and research outcome
11407214.value: 1. Our main claim on the interpretation of Chinese LD ziji is that LD ziji is always empathic, i.e., it requires that the speaker empathize with its antecedent in both intensional and extensional contexts; and it also tends to be a de se anaphor, or logophoric, in intensional contexts, though there are exceptions in some particular cases, e.g., indirect speech (see Wang & Pan 2015). 2. Our comparative study on Chinese LD ziji, Japanese LD zibun and Korean LD caki shows that (1) LD zibun can be long-distance bound by a source in an adjunct position and also co-occur with first person pronouns in embedded clauses in an intensional context (See Wang & Pan 2015, under review); (2) LD caki is much looser on the requirement of subject-orientation, as c-commanding arguments including subject, direct object and indirect object as well as non-c-commanding genitives can serve as an antecedent of caki, and LD caki is also subject to the blocking effect when empathy plays a role in the relevant cases (See Park & Pan 2017). 3. Our generalization on the grammatical status of the three LDRs in East Asian languages is: although discourse/pragmatics plays a role in the licensing of each of these LDRs, i.e., Chinese ziji, Japanese zibun, Korean caki, certain effects (e.g., logophoricity, empathy) are present in a quite strong form for the former two items, but in a weakened form for the latter. More precisely, while LD ziji is invariably subject to the empathy constraints, LD zibun is not, and it is strictly restricted by the logophoric conditions in intensional contexts, instead; as to LD caki, what is more important is a lambda-binder in the semantic sense.(See Wang & Pan under review) 4. Our conclusion on the nature of logophoricity and empathy from the cognitive perspective in the spirit of Hirose (2002, 2014) is that while a logophor represents the private self (or the subjective self), i.e., the subject of thinking or consciousness, an empathic anaphor represents the (the speaker’s) objective self, i.e. the self that the speaker dissociates from his consciousness and projects onto another person. Therefore, although a long-distance reflexive is always self-pointing, its logophoric use is different from its empathic use in their self-pointing mechanisms, which supports Oshima’s (2006, 2007) distinction between these two notions.(See Wang & Pan to appear)

11407214.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11407214.value: (1) As mentioned in Wang & Pan (2014), our observation of possible non-de se readings of Chinese LD ziji in intensional contexts may pose a challenge to the traditional de se/ de re distinction of attitude reports. So, in future research, we shall extend this idea to the interpretation of attitude reports, and try to find more empirical and psychological evidence to support it. (See Wang 2015) (2) Besides Asian languages, we shall consider more languages including PRO, logophors, shifted indexicals and long-distance reflexives in languages such as Ewe, Mundang, English, Icelandic to develop a more adequate taxonomy of anaphoric expressions, as well as correctly capture typological generalization on binding phenomena related to logophoricity and empathy.

11407214.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11407214.value: In linguistics, binding is related to the distribution of anaphoric elements like the pronoun ‘her’ and the reflexive ‘herself’. The goal of Chomsky’s canonical binding theory is to identify the syntactic relationship that can or must hold between such an element and its antecedent. For instance, in the sentence like ‘Alice believes that Mary loves herself’, ‘herself’ can only refer to its local antecedent ‘Mary’, but not the long-distance one ‘Alice’. Although Chomsky’s theory predicts many cases like this correctly, researchers have discovered a lot of exceptions in different languages that license long-distance binding by using the same forms as the local reflexives. In our research, we focus on the long-distance anaphors in Asian languages such as Chinese reflexive ‘ziji’, Japanese reflexive ‘zibun’ and Korean reflexive ‘caki’, because we find that they pose a challenge to the previous research which primarily treats such a binding phenomenon as a syntactic one and propose various structural rules to derive them. In view of their special characteristics such as blocking effects, backward shifting, and so on, we have developed a discourse-based analysis for them by resorting to the different effects of the relevant discourse factors such as de se, logophoricity and empathy.

11408414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11408414.value: Facing an acute housing shortage and high housing prices in recent years, the Hong Kong government is exploring the possibility for non-government organizations (NGOs) to provide welfare housing for the working class. This research project aims to provide a historical reference for the government and interested NGOs, through case studies of welfare housing schemes developed by four philanthropic agencies from the 1950s to the 1960s. It seeks to demonstrate that philanthropic housing can be a viable alternative to government public housing. Official accounts often describe the governmental response to resettle the victims of the disastrous squatter fire in Shek Kip Mei in 1953 as the beginning of welfare housing in Hong Kong. Such a description renders the initiative to provide homes for the poor a mere disaster relief effort rather than a thoughtful response to the rapid population growth in postwar Hong Kong. It also implies that the colonial government was the only welfare housing provider at that time, ignoring the efforts of non-government agencies. Hence, the government’s resettlement housing built on the destroyed Shek Kip Mei site was often incorrectly considered the first welfare housing prototype in Hong Kong. In fact, before the Shek Kip Mei fire, a number of philanthropic housing agencies had already been established to provide low-cost, working-class accommodation. What motivated the founding of these philanthropic housing agencies? What form did the early philanthropic housing take? What prompted the government eventually to take on the responsibility to provide public housing? Most importantly, what lessons can we draw from these past efforts in terms of solving Hong Kong’s current housing problems? While many philanthropic organizations built cottage villages in the 1950s to accommodate the poor, only four organizations have had the vision to build multi-story welfare housing: the Hong Kong Model Housing Society (HKMHS), the Hong Kong Housing Society (HKHS), the Hong Kong Settlers Housing Corporation Limited (HKSHCL), and the Hong Kong Economic Housing Society (HKEHS). These four organizations effectively initiated the high-density collective living culture in Hong Kong. This research study examines the history of these four philanthropic housing organizations and compares the planning and design of their earliest welfare housing estates with those constructed by the government in the same period of time. It argues that these philanthropic housing schemes have germinated ideas relating to architecture, management, and tenant selection that later shaped the course of the government’s long-term public housing development.

11408414.label: Realisation of objectives
11408414.value: Objective 1: To advance understanding of the role of non-government organizations (NGOs) in housing provision and suggest that philanthropic housing can be a viable alternative to public housing. The project team has completed extensive historical research on the works of non-governmental housing organizations in post-war Hong Kong. We have studied almost all the archival records available in Hong Kong. These records include the reports and publications of the philanthropic organizations, the correspondence between the government and the four selected philanthropic organizations, the Colonial Office files, the historical newspaper articles, as well as historical photographs, maps, and building plans. The project team discovered that between the 1940s and the early 1950s, several non-governmental organizations and churches had contributed to the provision of affordable housing for refugees, squatters, and victims of natural disasters. Most of these housing units were single-story cottages located in resettlement areas designated by the government. The project team believes that only four philanthropic organizations, namely the Hong Kong Model Housing Society (HKMHS), the Hong Kong Housing Society (HKHS), the Hong Kong Settlers Housing Corporation Limited (HKSHC), and the Hong Kong Economic Housing Society (HKEHS), had managed to develop multi-story housing estates for low-income families in Hong Kong. Although other organizations, such as the Kowloon Resident’s Association and the Methodist Church, had shared similar ideas for building multi-story welfare housing, their requests for land grants had been denied by the government. Objective 2: To increase understanding of Hong Kong’s welfare housing history, with detailed case studies on four selected philanthropic housing organizations. The project team has studied Hong Kong’s housing policy from the 1930s to the 1950s. The purpose is to understand the ways the colonial government addressed the huge housing demand, due to the influx of Chinese refugees, before it launched the squatters resettlement program and the public housing program in the 1950s. The archival records show that the government insisted that no public funds should be spent on the building of public housing. Nevertheless, the project team discovered that as early as in 1946, some government officials had discussed the possibility of following Singapore in establishing a housing society to develop low-cost housing for the working class. In the end, the government decided to rely on NGOs to solve the housing crisis. NGOs could lease land from the government through private treaty and on favorable terms, to develop low-cost housing for the working class. This was how welfare housing began in Hong Kong. Based on the historical records and the housing policy review, the project team has carried out detailed case studies of the four selected philanthropic organizations. The case studies focus on the history of the organizations, the objective of their formation, and the directors and key personnel involved. The project team also studied the reasons for the dissolution of the HKMHS and the HKEHS in 1985 and 1990, respectively. Objective 3: To compare the design and planning of four early multi-story philanthropic housing estates developed from the 1950s–1960s. The project team has selected the earliest housing schemes, one from each of the four philanthropic organizations, for detailed case studies. The selected housing estates include the Model Housing Estate, built by HKMHS, the Sheung Li Uk Estate, built by HKHS, the Lady Grantham Villas, built by HKEHS, and the Tai Hang Sai Estate, built by HKSHC. The project team has collected the architectural drawings of the four selected housing estates from various sources, including the drawings kept in the Hong Kong Building Department, the publications and reports from the philanthropic housing organizations, and the architectural journals published in the 1950s. The collected drawings form the basis for the architectural design analysis. The Sheung Li Uk Estates and the Tai Hang Sai Estate supplied simple, self-contained family units comprising one living space with a kitchen, balcony, and lavatory opening off it; no bedrooms were provided in the units. In contrast, bedrooms were provided in the housing units in the Model Housing Estate and the Lady Grantham Villas. To catch natural light and fresh air, the depth of each unit in the four estates was usually kept under 3 to 4 meters. Objective 4: To analyze the influences of philanthropic housing on the government’s public housing policy and design. The archival records have clearly stated that the multi-story philanthropic housing had effectively changed the government’s squatter resettlement policy. Since 1948, the government had resettled squatters to designated cottage areas, where they could build their own cottages. Nevertheless, the completion of two philanthropic housing estates, the Model Housing Estate in 1952 and the Sheung Li Uk Estates in 1953, made the government aware that multi-story housing blocks could accommodate more tenants than did the single-story cottage villages. Therefore, after the outbreak of the Shek Kip Mei fire in December 1953, which rendered over 50,000 squatters homeless, the government changed the resettlement policy and started building multi-story resettlement estates, following the footsteps of the philanthropic organizations. Objective 5: To evaluate the performance of the philanthropic housing estates in social welfare terms. The government’s resettlement housing, established in 1954, was reserved for only those people who lost their homes due to fire, natural disaster or government land requisition. Ordinary, low-income families were not eligible for these resettlement housing options. To these people, the philanthropic housing estates developed by non-government agencies were an accessible and affordable housing option. The philanthropic housing agencies were most active from the 1950s to the 1960s, a period of a serious housing shortage in Hong Kong. Based on the archival records and the reports from the philanthropic organizations, the project team has compiled a statistical record on the production of philanthropic housing from the 1950s to the 1960s. The record shows that within these two decades, philanthropic organizations in Hong Kong built 1,753 cottages and 13 multi-story housing estates with almost 15,000 units. More than 50,000 people benefited from their works. Objective 6: To understand and interpret the lived experience of residents of early multi-story philanthropic housing estates. The project team has interviewed former and current residents of the Lady Graham Villas (already demolished), the Model Housing Estate, and Tai Hang Sai Estate. Some of the residents had moved into the housing estates in the 1950s, when the estates were just completed. From them, the project team can understand how the residents managed to obtain a unit in the estate. The early philanthropic housing estates were well-received by the Hong Kong people as they offered a much lower rent than did private housing. The news of the philanthropic housing scheme was widely reported in the media at that time and caught the attention of many Hong Kong people who had suffered from the high cost of housing. Some former residents informed the project team that they needed to provide supporting letters from employers or people with high social status to secure a unit in the housing estates. Unfortunately, the project team cannot find the former residents of the demolished Sheung Li Uk Estate. Nevertheless, the project team has obtained the archival records, which documented the news reports on the opening and tenant recruitment of the Sheung Li Uk Estate, as well as the application letters written by the people who wished to get a unit there.

11408414.label: Major findings and research outcome
11408414.value: The research has three major findings. First, the project team has reconstructed the history of the four philanthropic organizations studied in this research project. The Hong Kong Housing Society had its roots in the Christian churches. The Model Housing Society and the Hong Kong Settlers Housing Corporation were founded by a group of foreign and local businessmen, respectively. The Economic Housing Society was founded by a single philanthropist, Daniel Chan. The diversified background of the organizations shows that not only the government can be involved and contribute to the provision of public goods. Based on the research finding, in 2016, the Principal Investigator (PI) has presented a paper, “Welfare Housing in Colonial Hong Kong: The Contributions of Philanthropic Organizations,” at the Third Biennial Conference of the Association of Critical Heritage Studies in Montreal, Canada. Second, the philanthropic housing organizations had created a model for the colonial government’s public housing programme. Before the emergence of multi-story philanthropic housing estates, the colonial government had never seriously contemplated the provision of permanent subsidized housing for the people of Hong Kong. The philanthropic housing estates provided a very useful reference for the colonial government, not only in planning and architectural design, but also on the management, leasing, and allocation of the housing units. Lastly, the survival of the philanthropic housing organizations depended heavily on the government’s housing policy. The biggest problem to the philanthropic housing agencies during this period was to secure funds for operations. After the Shek Kip Mei Fire in 1954, the colonial government launched its own resettlement housing programme and decided to stop lending money to philanthropic organizations. Without the government’s loans, many housing agencies could not survive. The reduction in government funding made the philanthropic organizations’ financial position quite difficult. Among the four philanthropic organizations studied, three of them had built only one housing estate and afterward, were dissolved or became inactive. Only the HKHS, which had obtained financial support from local banks, continues to operate today. Nowadays, the HKHS is still active and has become a key part of the philanthropic housing development in Hong Kong. It has developed a total of 73 projects thus far, accommodating over 144,000 people in total. The PI discusses the experience and potential of philanthropic housing in Hong Kong in an article, entitled “Can Nongovernmental Organizations Provide Affordable Homes to Hong Kong?” in the HKIA Journal.

11408414.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11408414.value: This research project provides an historical reference for the government and interested NGOs, through case studies of welfare housing schemes developed by four philanthropic agencies from the 1950s to the 1960s. It has the potential to be further developed into a project that studies the potential of philanthropic housing as a viable alternative to current government public housing. Facing an acute housing shortage and high housing prices in recent years, both the Hong Kong government and many non-governmental organizations are exploring ways to help the working poor. In 2012, the government launched the “Youth Hostel Scheme” to encourage NGOs to provide hostels for working youths who are unable to afford their own living space. Currently, the Hong Kong Council of Social Services (HKCSS) is operating a “Community Housing Project” to provide shared homes to families in need. The HKCSS is also planning to provide the first pre-fabricated welfare housing in Hong Kong using containers. More and more, NGOs have expressed interest in providing housing for the poor. All these initiatives prove that NGOs could be a major welfare housing provider in Hong Kong.

11408414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11408414.value: Official accounts often describe the governmental response to the challenge of resettling the victims of the disastrous squatter fire in Shek Kip Mei in 1953 as the beginning of welfare housing in Hong Kong. Such a description renders the initiative to provide homes for the poor a mere disaster-relief effort, rather than a thoughtful response to the rapid population growth in postwar Hong Kong. In fact, before the Shek Kip Mei fire, a number of philanthropic housing agencies had already been established to provide low-cost, working-class accommodation. While many philanthropic organizations built cottage villages in the 1950s to accommodate the poor, only four organizations had the vision to build multi-story welfare housing: the Hong Kong Model Housing Society, the Hong Kong Housing Society, the Hong Kong Settlers Housing Corporation Limited, and the Hong Kong Economic Housing Society. These four organizations effectively initiated Hong Kong’s high-density, collective living culture. This research study examines the history of these four philanthropic housing organizations and the architectural design of their earliest welfare housing estates. It argues that these philanthropic housing schemes have germinated ideas relating to architecture, management, and tenant selection that later shaped the course of the government’s long-term public housing development.

11409114.value: 背景﹕有資料顯示華人可能比其他文化背景的人士有更多的賭博問題。在香港，有大約135,000人可能正受賭博問題所困擾。現今，在外國及香港只有很少以實證為本的研究集中於解決華人問題賭徒的心理需求。雖然外國的研究均發現認知行為療法 (CBT) 能有效地治療問題賭徒，但是對於它的應用方面的問題，我們還存有很多疑問。首先，從文化的角度來說，現有的 CBT 手法對華人問題賭徒是否有足夠的敏感度這一點仍然備受質疑。其次，至今對於治療問題賭徒仍然沒有一套標準化的 CBT 手法。再者，能夠支持 CBT 手法能長遠地有效解決賭博問題的可信的研究並不足夠。最後，以個人和小組形式進行的 CBT 治療問題賭徒的成效的清晰度依然不足。目的：本研究的主要目的是為了成立和評估綜合認知行為介入手法以小組形式去治療在香港的華人問題賭徒。方法：本研究擬採用隨機等待式控制組設計，及進行前測、後測及介入後六個月後的追蹤評估。總共有98名參加者將會被隨機邀請進入實驗組和對照組。在兩年內，實驗組的參加者將會參與五個 CBT 小組，而對照組的參加者將會參與五個社交活動小組。CBT 小組有八節課堂，當中包括了CBT治療問題賭徒的四個重要元素﹕(一) 動機因素﹔(二) 賭博的衝動和渴望﹔(三) 與賭博有關的行為和認知因素﹔及 (四) 負面的情緒狀態。參加者將填寫一系列已被驗證的中文問卷。我們將進行統計分析，來調查CBT小組是否有治療成效及其是否能維持六個月﹔在個人上，賭博問題的嚴重程度、賭博的衝動及心理困擾、及臨床上的改善這幾方面的變化。本研究的重要性：如果能夠證明綜合認知行為介入手法是有效的，它將可以被使用或經修改後適用於在世界的其他地方的華人問題賭徒身上。

11409214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11409214.value: Restorative justice (RJ) is a new approach to understanding and managing crime that has gained popularity since the 1980s. Evidence suggests that restorative processes that empower crime victims, offenders and communities to actively participate in resolving the impact of crime increase public trust in the justice system and may reduce reoffending behaviour (Liebmann, 2007; Maxwell, 2007). Pioneering activities at government and community levels suggest that RJ is gaining importance in mainstream criminological and professional practices worldwide. Though RJ is increasingly used to deal with offending, particularly youth offending, in many Western countries, there is relatively little experience of RJ in the Greater China region. However, mediation (tiaojie) has long existed in China and is often used in informal social control. Chinese scholars sometimes refer to it as a type of RJ (Leng, 2011; Zhang, 2013). A review of literature on mediation practices (tiaojie) and RJ (hufuxing xifa) in mainland China suggests that hufuxing xifa is generally considered to be a western approach to criminal mediation (reconciliation) distinct from the traditional Chinese approach. Despite having much in common, mediation and RJ differ in areas such as the power of facilitators and the emphasis on victims attending conferences (Leng, 2011; Li, 2010). With the continuous development of legal systems in Hong Kong, Taiwan and the mainland over the decades, RJ now appears to be rapidly displacing traditional mediation in China (Zhang, 2013; Wong & Lo, 2011; Mok & Wong, 2013). The proposed study will analyze the evolution of RJ in the Greater China region and its relevance to Chinese culture. Through comparative policy studies, focus groups and in-depth interviews, a thorough comparison of RJ and their cultural relevance in four major cities will be performed, covering Hong Kong, Taipei, Shanghai and Beijing, and examine their compatibility with Chinese cultural values, and integration into the criminal justice system. We will interview academic scholars, legal practitioners, lawyers, judiciary members, mediators or conference facilitators, as well as participants and/or their families who have involved in the RJ process, to uncover the characteristics of Chinese RJ and establish whether western or non-Chinese RJ models are suitable for and favored by Chinese users. The results will help to establish a set of basic principles and procedures that are culturally relevant to Chinese. The findings can be used to improve the service impact of RJ programmes and provide guidelines in assessment, awareness promotion, and policy-making throughout Chinese communities. 復和司法(或稱恢復性司法)是一個處理違法行為的新概念，自1980年代開始已被廣泛應用。復和司法司法能推動受害者、犯事者和社區三方的積極參與，並共同解決因違法行為所帶來的負面影響，從而增強大眾對司法制度的信任及減少犯事者重犯的機會。復和司法正廣泛應用於政府和地區的各個層面上，並於犯罪學和其他專業的領域上得到世界各地的重視。 在很多西方國家中，復和司法普遍應用於處理有關犯罪行為的個案，特別是在青少年越軌行為方面。目前，有關大中華地區復和司法的研究及實踐經驗卻不太多，當中源遠流長的中國調解制度已被納入為其中一種復和司法手法。從有關中國調解和復和措施的文獻中得知，復和司法一般可被視為具有西方特色的刑事調解手段，其本質跟中國傳統的調解制度有明顯的分別。縱然兩者擁有很多相同之處，調解和復和司法也存在著不少差異，包括復和會議主持人的權力、以及受害者參與復和會議時的必要性。過去數十年間，復和司法在香港、台灣和中國大陸持續地發展，中國傳統的調解制度亦已開始被復和司法所替代。 本研究首先分析復和司法在大中華地區的發展情況和它與中國文化的關聯性，透過政策比較及文獻回顧、焦點小組及深入訪談，本研究希望可深入比較四個主要的中國城市(包括香港、台北、上海與北京) 的復和司法實踐方案，並探討復和司法與中國傳統文化價值及刑事司法制度的相容性。本研究的訪談對象包括學者、執法者、律師、司法人員、調解員或復和會議主持人，以及曾接受復和司法服務和培訓的參加者及/或其家人。本研究旨在找出大中華地區推動復和司法的特色，對其方案的推動作出相關建議，並評估具西方特色的復和司法模式如何應用於大中華地區的可行性。本研究希望建立一個能適用於大中華地區的復和司法模式，並希望可以改善其服務成效，找出一些復和司法的評估標準、提高大眾的意識和訂立相關的政策，並對未來恢復性司法的推動提出具體可行的建議。
