14110714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14110714.value: This project aims to investigate the pyrrolizidine alkaloid (PA)-contamination in local and regional honey products and also to assess the potential risk of prolonged exposure to PA-contaminated honey. Over 660 PAs have been identified in approximately 3% of flowering plants worldwide. Consumption of PA-containing herbs/plants could induce acute hepatotoxicity with typical symptoms of extensive haemorrhagic necrosis, ascites and hepatomegaly, resulting in high morbidity and mortality. Moreover, there is also increasing awareness that some staple and commonly consumed foods are contaminated with PAs. After a long time chronic or intermittent low-level intake, these PA-contaminated foodstuffs may imperceptibly induce chronic liver diseases such as cancer that may not show overt symptoms in the early stage during disease development. A representative example is the transfer of PAs from plants into honey by bees. Honey products in European countries show frequent incidence of contamination with relatively high PA contents. It is notable that the currently recommended limit for daily PA intake could easily be exceeded by regular consumption of such PA-contaminated honey. However, to date there is no practically achievable regulation for PA content in foodstuffs. In Hong Kong and Mainland China, there is no study on PA-contamination in foodstuffs. The PI’s team has been working on the PA-induced hepatotoxicity for many years and is leading in the investigation of PA-containing medicinal herbs and development of biomarkers for assessing PA intoxication. Recently, we tested 20 honey samples purchased from different shops in Hong Kong and identified that 75% of them contain PAs. Moreover, we determined pyrrole-protein adducts (our well-established biomarker of PA-induced liver injury) in 63% (17/27) of patients who had liver damage with unknown cause in China and demonstrated their exposure to PAs, suggesting that there is a high risk of PA intoxication due to the intake of PA-contaminated foodstuffs, including honey. Therefore, the proposed 3-year study will focus on the investigation of PA-contamination in local and regional honey products, and identify botanical origins causing PA-contamination by pollen analysis. Furthermore, the potential risk of prolonged exposure to PA-contaminated honey will be assessed in animal models using our well-established mechanism-based biomarkers and specific indicators. The results obtained will provide scientific foundation for monitoring PA-contamination in honey and minimizing PA entering into food chains. The production of well-controlled PA-free honey and other dietary products will certainly benefit Hong Kong, Mainland China and global public health. 此项目旨在研究本地區蜂蜜產品中吡咯裡西啶(PA)生物鹼的污染情况，並評估長期服用含PA的蜂蜜可能存在的風險。 在全世界約3%的開花植物中，已經發現了超過660 多種PA生物鹼。若食用含PA生物鹼的草藥或植物會出現很高的致病性和死亡率，在臨床上表現為多種症狀的急性肝損傷，包括大面積出血性壞死、腹水和肝腫大。此外，一些主食或者常吃的食物也会被PA生物鹼污染。若長期食用或間歇攝入低劑量PA生物鹼可能誘發諸如癌症之類的慢性肝病，而在發病早期沒有明顯的症狀。蜂蜜是被PA生物鹼污染的食物中具有代表性的例子， 蜜蜂將植物中PA生物鹼帶到了蜂蜜中。在歐洲各國的蜂蜜產品中常發現較高含量的PA生物鹼。值得注意的是，若食用這種被PA生物鹼污染的蜂蜜，很容易超出目前限定的每日PA生物鹼攝入量上限, 有可能造成急性肝損傷。然而到目前為止，對食物中PA生物鹼的含量仍沒有切實可行的质量控制規定或要求。 在香港和中國大陸地區尚无对食物被PA生物鹼的系统研究。我們的研究團隊在PA生物鹼誘導的肝中毒方面有着多年的研究經驗，包括研究含有PA生物鹼的藥材以及開發了檢測PA生物鹼毒肝性的生物標誌物。最近我們在香港不同的商店購買了20種蜂蜜樣品，經檢測發現其中75%含有PA生物鹼。不僅如此，我們还檢測了中國大陸27例未知原因的肝損傷病人體內的PA生物鹼導致肝損傷的生物標記物，結果显示其中63%（17/27）的病人可能服用过PA生物鹼，說明如果攝入包括蜂蜜在內的被PA生物鹼污染的食物，將有很大幾率誘發PA生物鹼中毒。因此，這份為期三年的研究計畫將致力於調查本地區蜂蜜被PA生物鹼污染的情况，並利用花粉分析研究鑒定PA生物鹼的植物來源。另外還計畫在動物模型上進行實驗，利用我們開發的生物標記物和特殊分析指標，對長期攝入被PA生物鹼污染的蜂蜜可能造成的風險進行評估。 预期的研究結果將會為監測蜂蜜中的PA生物鹼以及減少其進入食物鏈提供科學依據。最終指导生產出品質可靠的不含PA生物鹼的蜂蜜和食品，這無疑將惠及本地區、乃至全人類的健康。

14110714.label: Realisation of objectives
14110714.value: Both objectives have been well accomplished. Objective 1: Qualitative and quantitative determination of PA-contamination in local and regional honey and identification of the botanical origins by pollen analysis Pyrrolizidine alkaloids (PAs) are common phytotoxins and widely distributed in ~3% of flowering plants worldwide. More than 660 PAs have been identified and over half of them were reported to be hepatotoxic causing liver damage and cancer. In recent decades, collective data of PA occurrence in honey especially from European countries is growing steadily, which shows a relatively high degree and frequency of PA-contamination. It is notable that the currently recommended limit for daily PA intake could easily be exceeded by regular consumption of such PA-contaminated honey. PA-contamination in honey in many countries/regions has been reported as highly frequent but is largely unknown in Chinese honey. China is the largest global producer of honey, representing for over 1/4 of the total amount of world honey production. China is also one of the largest honey exporters, dominating world export of honey with market share of 12% of an approximately value of 260 million US dollars yearly. Therefore, for the global public health, it is necessary to investigate PA-contamination in Chinese honey products. We have tested a total of 375 retail honey samples from 21 regions of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. The regions in China cover the main geographic and honey producing areas in China. PAs were detected in 58% (218/375) of all honeys tested, revealing a high frequency PA-contamination in Chinese honeys. Our findings provided comprehensive information on PA-contamination in retail honeys in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Comparing with PA-contamination in honeys reported in other countries/regions, Chinese honeys had relatively lower prevalence of PA-contamination but a comparable PA content with a wide range over 0.04–288.1 μg/kg of total PA content. Among 218 PA-contaminated Chinese honey samples, a total of 16 PAs were identified with echimidine, lycopsamine and monocrotaline as 3 predominant PAs in most of the identified PA-contaminated honeys. Interestingly, as one of the predominant PA in Chinese honey, monocrotaline has been rarely reported present in honeys in other countries/regions. Botanical origins for PA-contamination in honeys were investigated by pollen analysis. Echium spp., Senecio spp., Eupatorium app., and Borago spp. have been found as the main plant sources for PA-contamination in honeys in European countries. In Chinese honeys tested, Echium spp. was also identified in the majority of PA-contaminated honeys, particularly pollen of Echium plantagineum was the most frequent PA-related pollen detected in all honey samples. Thus Echium spp. was considered as the most common plant source responsible for PA-contamination in Chinese honeys. Moreover, considerable quantities of Senecio pollens were also found in honey samples tested. Therefore, plants of Echium spp. and Senecio genera were identified as potential botanic sources for two predominant PAs, echimidine and lycopsamine. In addition, monocrotaline was identified to be originated from Crotalaria spp. plants, a unique but common nectar source in main honey producing regions in China. Furthermore, a combined multiple approach integrating pollen and chemometric analysis was developed and demonstrated useful for future building a monitoring network on botanical and geographical origins of PA-contamination in honeys. For instance, both hierarchical cluster analysis (HCA) and partial least-squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA) of selected five geographically areas, representing southern, central, eastern, western and northern part of China, demonstrated that PA patterns in contaminated honeys were well-separated into five significantly divided groups according to the five geographical origins. The results suggested possibility for future development of networks monitoring nectar sources in different geographical origins to reduce/control upstream foodborne PA-contamination for producing PA-free honeys in individual local regions. To date, the most part of the results of Objective 1 has been published (Papers 1 and 6 in Part C) and reported in conferences (Abstracts 1-2, 4-5, 7, 9-10 in Part C). Objective 2: Assessment of a potential risk of prolonged exposure to PA-contaminated honey The current regulations for PA exposure thresholds are based on the total PA content. For instances, the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)-recommended 1.0 µg PAs/day and the European Medicines Agency (EMA)-recommended 0.35 µg PAs/day are the most commonly used thresholds for short-term (not more than 6 weeks) and long-term (life-long) exposure respectively. Using these thresholds and assuming a general serving of 20 g honey/day, all 375 honey samples were calculated according to our quantified total PA content in honeys, and the results indicated that 4.8% and 12.8% of the honeys had short-term and long-term exposure risk respectively. However, this is obviously inappropriate because it is well-known that toxic potency varies significantly in different PAs, but the current regulations only consider a total content of all PAs and assume different PAs having an equal toxic potency. Therefore, we developed a new approach, integrating both toxic potency (using LD50 value in rats) and content of individual PAs in honeys, to re-evaluate and identified more significant risks with 12.1% and 30.1% of Chinese honeys having short-term and long-term exposure risk respectively (Paper 6). Obviously, our findings identified remarkable problems of the current exposure risk assessment, and also suggested a more appropriate risk assessment system for further development. The currently adopted indicators for liver damage, such as serum ALT and bilirubin levels, and hepatic morphological changes by H&E staining, are general for the evaluation of moderate and severe liver injury, especially acute hepatotoxicity. However, they are non-specific and non-sensitive to PA-induced liver injury (PA-ILI), particularly by prolonged exposure with low dosages. PAs are pro-toxins and undergo hepatic P450-mediated metabolic activation to generate pyrrolic esters, which rapidly bind with cellular proteins to form pyrrole-protein adducts leading to hepatotoxicity. Based on the metabolism-mediated toxicity, we developed novel, sensitive, and specific mechanism-based biomarkers, pyrrole-protein adducts, for assessing PA-ILI and risk of prolonged exposure to relatively lower doses of PAs (Papers 2, 4; Abstracts 3, 8). We also for the first time discovered that ATP synthase subunit beta (ATP5B) was one of the proteins bound to pyrrolic esters, and the formation of pyrrole-ATP5B adduct caused sinusoidal endothelial cells (SEC) and hepatocytes damage leading to PA-ILI (Paper 3). Furthermore, although SEC is known target in PA intoxication, PA-ILI cannot be directly investigated in SECs in vitro because of the lack of P450 enzyme activities in SECs. We developed a novel two-layer transwell co-culture model for specifically and quickly screen PA-induced SEC damage. This model allows us to rapidly screen PA intoxication and also investigate toxic mechanisms of PA-induced SEC damage (Paper 5). Moreover, we have studied PA-ILI via prolonged exposure to PAs with relatively lower dosages, which are comparable with daily PA exposure via PA-contaminated honey, in mice model. The results demonstrated obvious PA-ILI in mice with progressive pathological lesions, including persistent inflammation, vascular hyperplasia, fibrosis and steatosis after 14-week exposure and liver cirrhosis and tumour formation after 10-month exposure. Our findings demonstrated the potential risk of liver damage via prolonged exposure to PAs, even with relatively lower levels which could be reached by continuous intake of PA-contaminated foodstuffs, such as PA-contaminated honeys. Parts of the results have been reported in conferences (Abstracts 6, 9, 12-14), and 2 papers reporting these findings are currently under preparation.

14110714.label: Major findings and research outcome
14110714.value: Our findings for the first time provided a comprehensive information on PA-contamination in Chinese retail honeys in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and China. Although the prevalence of PA-contamination in Chinese retail honeys is relatively lower, the contaminated PA levels are similar to that in the reported retail honeys in European countries. Among 3 predominant PAs identified in Chinese honeys, monocrotaline is unique in Chinese honeys originated from Crotalaria spp. plants but rarely reported in other countries (Papers 2 and 6; Abstracts 1, 4-5, 7, 9-10). We established a new approach integrating pollen and chemometric analysis to evaluate the association of PA patterns in honeys with geographical origins having PA-producing plants and demonstrated usefulness of future building a monitoring network on botanical and geographical origins of PA-contamination in honeys (Paper 6). We developed pyrrole-protein adducts as novel, sensitive and specific biomarkers for assessing PA-ILI (Papers 2, 4; Abstracts 3, 8). We also for the first time identified pyrrole-ATP5B adduct and reveal its important impact on PA-ILI (Papers 2-4; Abstracts 2-3, 8). We developed a novel two-layer transwell co-culture in vitro model for specifically and quickly evaluate risk of PA-induced SEC damage and investigate the underlying toxic mechanisms (Paper 5). We also using in vivo mice model evaluated PA-ILI via prolonged exposure to relatively lower dosages of PAs, and confirmed PA-ILI with progressive pathological lesions, fibrosis, and steatosis for 14-week exposure and liver cirrhosis and tumour formation for 10-month exposure. Our findings demonstrated the potential risk of liver damage via prolonged exposure to relatively lower levels of PAs (Abstracts 6, 9, 12-14). For the regulation of potential risk of PA exposure, we developed a more appropriate assessment considering both toxic potency and content of individual PAs in honeys. Using this new approach, our findings demonstrated that about 30% of Chinese honeys tested having a potential exposure risk (Paper 6; Abstracts 1, 7, 9), indicating the needs for future establish more appropriate regulations for risk assessment and exposure thresholds.

14110714.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14110714.value: Monocrotaline was found as a predominant and unique PA in Chinese honeys originated from Crotalaria spp. Monocrotaline is a well-known hepatotoxic PA and can also cause lung toxicity. Hopefully, our findings will encourage more investigators to attract funding for further follow-up investigations on plant species of Crotalaria, their locations, the potential risk of lung toxicity of monocrotaline-contaminated honeys, and eventually the potential of producing PA/monocrotaline-low/free Chinese hones. In addition to paper publication and conference reporting, further dissemination of our findings to public is needed and will certainly alert public awareness of potential risk of exposure to PA-contaminated honeys to take cautions with intake amount and time periods. Our current findings on PA-ILI was induced by prolonged exposure of representative PAs. Using our developed in vitro cell and in vivo mice models, we shall further investigate the risk of PA-ILI via prolonged exposure to lower dosages of mixed PAs, either PA-producing herbal extracts or PA-contaminated foodstuffs, such as PA-contaminated honey, which more reflect the real human exposure situations. The results will provide scientific evidences for relevant authorities to establish more appropriate quality control and monitoring regulations for PA-contaminated foodstuffs, including honey in the future.

14110714.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14110714.value: Pyrrolizidine alkaloids (PAs) are naturally occurring toxins produced by ~3% flowering plants, and cause liver toxicity. PA-poisoning cases are caused by consumption of PA-producing herbs/herbal teas, and PA-contaminated foodstuffs, like bread made from PA-contaminated wheat flour. It is also known that some commonly consumed foods, like honey, are contaminated with PAs. Frequent incidence of PA-contamination with relatively high PA contents in honeys in European countries is well-known, and the current limitation for PA intake could be easily exceed by their regular consumption. However, information on PA-contamination in Chinese honeys is largely unknown. We tested 375 retail honeys in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, and detected PAs in 58% of them with content of 0.04–288.10μg PA/kg, revealing comparable frequency (relatively lower) and content to that in European honeys. Based on European regulation for PA intake limitation, 12.1% and 30.1% of Chinese honeys were estimated to have poisoning risk via short-term (<6 moths) and long-term (life-long) intake. Our animal studies also demonstrated the risk of chronic liver disease development via prolonged intake of PAs with the dosages comparable to the intake of honeys having high PA contents. The results indicated a potential risk of honey intake.

14110814.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14110814.value: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common form of dementia in elderly people with huge health and economic burden to the society. Although we have now better understanding of the pathogenesis of AD, treatment for AD is largely unsatisfactory, and effective treatment for AD clearly remains an unmet medical need. Previous studies undertaken by our research group demonstrated that Uncaria rhynchophylla (Gou-Teng in Chinese), a component herb of many frequently prescribed herbal formulae for treating dementia in Chinese medicine, ameliorated the D-galactose-induced cognitive deficits in an animal model of AD. In addition, the observed cognition-improving effect of U. rhynchophylla was found to be associated with inhibition of acetylcholinesterase activity and enhancement of the antioxidant status of the brain tissues. Subsequent experiments using bioassay-directed fractionation approach have led to the identification of isorhynchophylline (IRN) as the main active ingredient of U. rhynchophylla, and the mechanisms of action were associated with the inhibitions of oxidative stress, calcium overload and phosphorylation of tau protein as well as suppression of cellular apoptosis. Furthermore, preliminary in vivo experiment revealed that IRN could ameliorate Aβ25-35-induced cognitive deficits in rats through inhibiting neuronal apoptosis and tau phosphorylation expression of the hippocampus. Based on these promising preliminary data, we hypothesized that IRN could also possess significant anti-AD efficacy on other established AD animal models including aluminum chloride (AlCl3)-treated mice and TgCRND8 transgenic mice. The testing of this hypothesis and elucidation of the underlying molecular mechanisms would further advance our knowledge about the potential of IRN as an anti-AD agent. This is a resubmission of last year’s proposal having carefully taken into account the reviewers’ valuable comments and suggestions. Since no single animal model can recapitulate all aspects of AD owing to the complexity of its etiology, this proposed project is aimed at affirming the potential of IRN as a novel anti-AD agent using two well-established AD animal models, i.e. AlCl3-treated mouse and TgCRND8 transgenic mouse models. In-depth cellular and molecular mechanisms of the anti-AD action of IRN will be probed through in vivo and in vitro experiments. Moreover, the blood brain barrier (BBB) permeability and the pharmacokinetic profile of IRN will also be determined. The rational characterization of the therapeutic mechanisms underpinning the anti-AD action of IRN, its BBB permeability and pharmacokinetic profile will provide strong justification and is a prerequisite for future clinical development of this plant-derived alkaloid as a novel anti-AD therapy for this devastating disease. 阿茲海默病是老年人中最常見的癡呆症, 全球現有超過三千五百萬人患有老年癡呆症, 到2030年患有本病的人數將會多一倍. 雖然我們現在對阿茲海默病的病理機制的認識有了長足的進步, 但是至今為止對本病的治療效果仍然未盡人意, 尋找有效治療阿茲海默病的方法仍然是當今醫學的重要課題和難題. 我們在先前的研究中發現中藥鉤藤能夠顯著地改善D-半乳糖誘導的阿茲海默病動物模型的認知障礙. 另外, 還發現鉤藤提升認知的能力與其抑制乙醯膽鹼脂酶活性和增強腦部組織抗氧化功能有關. 隨後進行的以生物活性為導向的植物化學分離與純化實驗成功地確定異鉤藤堿為鉤藤的主要活性化學成分, 並證實異鉤藤堿的作用機理與抑制氧化應激, 鈣離子超載, tau蛋白質磷酸化和細胞凋亡有關. 此外, 初步的動物體內實驗闡明異鉤藤堿能改善澱粉樣蛋白片段(Aβ25-35)誘導的認知功能障礙, 而其作用機制與抑制大鼠海馬區神經元細胞的凋亡和通過PI3K/Akt/GSK3信號通路而起到抑制tau蛋白質磷酸化的表達有關. 由於阿茲海默病的病因病理十分複雜, 至今沒有任何單一一種動物模型能全部涵蓋阿茲海默病的各個病理方面. 在建議的研究項目中我們將利用三氧化鋁誘導阿茲海默病小鼠和TgCRND8轉基因小鼠兩種動物模型來探索異鉤藤堿作為一種新型抗阿茲海默病的潛力,並深入研究異鉤藤堿抗阿茲海默病的內在細胞和分子學機理. 此外, 我們還將檢測異鉤藤堿通過血腦屏障的能力及其藥動學數據. 上述的實驗將為我們今後的臨床研究和開發這個植物源性生物鹼成為一種新的抗阿茲海默病療法提供正當理由. 我們預計本研究計畫的實施將為現今非常有限的治療阿茲海默病方法增添新的方向和途徑.

14110814.label: Realisation of objectives
14110814.value: 1. Objective 1: To investigate the cognitive deficit ameliorating effects of IRN in AlCl3-treated and TgCRND8 transgenic mouse models. (100% achieved) 1.1. IRN ameliorated the cognitive deficits induced by AlCl3 in mice The Radial Arm Maze test was used in this experiment to assess the reference memory and working memory of animals. The results showed that the higher numbers of total entries, reference memory errors (RMEs) and working memory errors (WMEs) were found in AlCl3-treated mice, indicating that AlCl3 could cause worsening of cognitive functions. However, when compared with the AlCl3 + vehicle group, IRN treatment (40 mg/kg) significantly reduced the numbers of total entries (p < 0.01), RMEs (p < 0.05) and WMEs (p < 0.01), indicating that IRN could improve the overall cognitive functions in AlCl3-treated mice. 1.2. IRN ameliorated the cognitive deficits in TgCRND8 transgenic mice When compared with the Tg + vehicle group, IRN treatment (40 mg/kg) significantly reduced the numbers of total entries (p < 0.05), RMEs (p < 0.05) and WMEs (p < 0.05), indicating that IRN could improve the overall cognitive functions in TgCRND8 transgenic mice. To sum, IRN significantly ameliorated the cognitive deficits in AlCl3-treated and TgCRND8 transgenic mice 2. Objective 2: To illuminate the cellular and molecular targets and mechanisms associated with neuroprotective effects of IRN in the brains of AlCl3-treated and TgCRND8 transgenic mice. (100% achieved) On AlCl3-induced AD mice - 2.1. IRN reduced the oxidative damage Our experiments showed that IRN treatment could decrease the oxidative damage induced by AlCl3, suggesting IRN is a potent antioxidant for AD. 2.2. IRN inhibited the AChE activity in the brains Our results showed that IRN treatment significantly inhibited the AChE activity, but not the BuChE activity, indicating IRN is a selective AChE inhibitor for AD treatment. 2.3. IRN inhibited the activation of NF-κB signaling pathway in the brains Our result revealed that IRN significantly decreased the phosphorylation of NF-κB p65 and IκBα, suggesting that IRN could inhibit the activation of NF-κB signaling pathway in the AlCl3-treated mice. 2.4. Effects of IRN on the number of pyramidal neuronal cells in the hippocampal CA1 region When compared with the AlCl3+vehicle group, treatments with IRN (20 and 40 mg/kg) did not show significant effects in the number of hippocampal neurons of CA1 region as determined by Nissl’s staining method (p > 0.05). 2.5. Effects of IRN on the protein levels of Bax and Bcl-2 When compared with the AlCl3 plus vehicle group, treatments with IRN (20 and 40 mg/kg) did not show significant effects on the protein levels of Bax and Bcl-2 (p > 0.05) as determined by western blotting. On TgCRND8 mice - 2.6. IRN reduced the levels of Aβ40 and Aβ42 in the brain tissues When compared with Tg+vehicle group, treatment with IRN at dosage of 40 mg/kg significantly reduced Aβ40 level (p < 0.05) and Aβ42 level (p < 0.05) with reductions by 26% and 23%, respectively. 2.7. IRN reduced Aβ level by regulating abnormal expressions of secretases, APP phosphorylation and Aβ-degrading enzymes IRN significantly reduced the levels of BACE-1 (the major β-secretase), PS-1 and APH-1 (the two major components of γ-secretase), indicating its inhibitory effect on both of β- and γ-secretases, hence the reductions in β- and γ-cleavage of APP. Moreover, IRN significantly attenuated APP phosphorylation at Thr668 (facilitates β-cleavage of APP), suggesting that IRN modulates β- and γ-cleavage of APP also through regulating the phosphorylation of APP. On the other hand, no significant differences were found between groups on the protein level of NEP (a major Aβ-degrading enzyme). However, the IDE (a major Aβ-degrading enzyme) level was significantly reduced in TgCRND8 transgenic mice, while IRN treatment (40 mg/kg) significantly increased it (p ˂ 0.05). Taken together, these findings suggested that IRN could reduce Aβ level by modulation of APP. 2.8. IRN reduces Tau hyperphosphorylation We found that IRN down-regulated the Tau protein hyperphosphorylation at the sites of Ser396 and Thr205 in the brains of TgCRND8 mice, indicating that the inhibition on these specific hyperphosphorylation sites of Tau protein is one of the major anti-AD molecular mechanisms. 2.9. IRN reduced Aβ deposition and Aβ plaque-associated neuroinflammation When compared with Tg+vehicle group, IRN treatment (40 mg/kg) significantly decreased the Aβ plaque burden both in the hippocampus (p < 0.05) and cortex (p < 0.01), suggesting IRN treatment could reduce the Aβ deposit in the brains. When compared with Tg+vehicle group, IRN treatment (40mg/kg) significantly decreased the astrocyte density both in hippocampus (p < 0.05) and cortex (p < 0.05) of TgCRND8 mice, suggesting that IRN treatment could reduce the Aβ plaque-associated astrogliosis in the brains of TgCRND8 mice. 2.2.9 IRN inhibits activation of JNK signaling pathway When compared with Tg+vehicle group, IRN treatment (40mg/kg) significantly decreased the ratios of p-c-Jun/c-Jun (p < 0.05) and p-JNK/JNK (p < 0.01), suggesting IRN significantly inhibited the activation of JNK signaling pathway. To conclude, IRN exerted anti-AD effects in AlCl3-treated mice through reducing the oxidative damage and inhibiting the AChE activity of the brain tissues via inhibiting the activation of NF-ΚB signaling pathway. In TgCRND8 mice, IRN exerted anti-AD action by modulating the cerebral Aβ plaque deposition, Tau hyperphosphorylation and Aβ plaque-associated neuroinflammation via inhibiting the JNK signaling pathway. 3. Objective 3: To delineate the molecular mechanisms and pathways associated with neuroprotective effect of IRN in the primary culture of rat hippocampal neurons. (100% achieved) Our results showed that Aβ42 (5 μM) treatment significantly reduced the cell viability in the cultured primary rat hippocampal neuronal cells. However, when compared with the Aβ42 group, treatment with IRN (80 µM) and SP600125 (0.1 and 20 µM, a JNK inhibitor) significantly blocked the injury caused by Aβ42. Treatment with IRN (40 and 80 µM) and SP600125 (20 µM) significantly suppressed the upregulated ratios of p-JNK/ and p-c-Jun/c-Jun in the Aβ42-treated primary rat hippocampal neurons, suggesting that IRN exerts anti-AD like effect by protecting the neurons from Aβ42-induced cytotoxicity via inhibiting JNK signaling pathway. 4. Objective 4: To evaluate the blood brain barrier permeability and pharmacokinetic profiles of IRN on rats. (100% achieved) After p.o. administration, IRN exhibited wide distribution in the body (Vd/F, 0.77 ± 0.09L/kg) and fast elimination (t1/2, 0.84 ± 0.05 h; CL/F, 0.64 ± 0.07L/h/kg) from plasma. On brain distribution of IRN, after the oral administration of 20 mg/kg of IRN to rats for 24 h, the concentration of IRN in rat brain sample was below the limit of quantitation. On the other hand, about 1548.14±153.37ng and 2667.83±319.18ng of IRN were recovered from urine and feces, respectively, after 24 h of IRN administration, suggesting IRN was not predominantly eliminated as parent drug.

14110814.label: Major findings and research outcome
14110814.value: This project aimed to investigate the potential of isorhynchophylline (IRN) as a novel anti-AD agent using two AD animal models i.e. AlCl3-treated and TgCRND8 transgenic mouse models, and the underlying mechanisms. The results from the in vivo experiments using RAM tests showed that IRN treatment (40mg/kg) significantly reduced the numbers of total entries, both reference and working memory errors in both AlCl3-treated and TgCRND8 transgenic models, indicating that IRN could improve the overall cognitive functions in these two AD models. In the ensuing mechanistic studies, IRN treatment could decrease the oxidative damage induced by AlCl3. In addition, IRN treatment markedly inhibited the AChE activity, but not the BuChE activity, indicating IRN is a selective AChE inhibitor for AD treatment. Moreover, IRN significantly decreased the phosphorylation of NF-κB p65 and IκBα, indicating IRN could inhibit NF-κB signaling pathway in the AlCl3-treated mice. In the TgCRND8 mice experiments, IRN (40 mg/kg) significantly reduced Aβ40 level and Aβ42 level with reductions by 25.5% and 23%, respectively. More importantly, IRN markedly reduced the levels of BACE-1 (the major β-secretase), PS-1 and APH-1 (the two major components of γ-secretase), indicating its inhibitory effect on both of β- and γ-secretases, hence the reductions in β- and γ-cleavage of APP. Moreover, IRN significantly attenuated APP phosphorylation at Thr668 (facilitates β-cleavage of APP), suggesting that IRN modulates β-cleavage of APP also through regulating the phosphorylation of APP. IRN also down-regulated the Tau protein hyperphosphorylation at the sites of Ser396 and Thr205 in the brains of TgCRND8 mice, indicating that Tau protein inhibition is one of the important anti-AD molecular mechanisms. Furthermore, IRN (40 mg/kg) significantly decreased the astrocyte density in hippocampus and cortex, suggesting its role in attenuating the Aβ plaque-associated astrogliosis in the brains of TgCRND8 mice. Lastly, inhibition of the JNK signaling pathway was found to be associated with the anti-AD effect of IRN in this AD model. In the in vitro experiment, IRN (40 and 80 µM) significantly suppressed the upregulated ratios of p-JNK/ and p-c-Jun/c-Jun in the Aβ42-treated primary rat hippocampal neurons, suggesting that IRN protects the neurons from Aβ42-induced cytotoxicity via inhibiting JNK signaling pathway. In the PK studies, after p.o. administration, IRN was found to widely distribute in the body (Vd/F, 0.77 ± 0.09 L/kg) and fast eliminate (t1/2, 0.84 ± 0.05 h; CL/F, 0.64 ± 0.07 L/h/kg) from plasma, and the concentration of IRN in rat brain sample was low.

14110814.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14110814.value: 1. To further confirm the anti-AD effect of IRN on other transgenic AD model such as 5× FAD mouse. The present project has successfully evaluated the anti-AD effect of IRN using TgCRND8 transgenic mouse model which harbors double mutant APP genes. We would like to further confirm the anti-AD efficacy of IRN on the 5×FAD transgenic mouse model which expresses 3 mutant forms of human APP (the Swedish mutation: M671L, K670N; the London mutation: V717I; the Florida mutation: I716V), and the murine presenilin-1 (PSEN1) with the M233T and L235P familial AD (FAD) 2. To evaluate the anti-AD effect in a pilot clinical trial. The present project is a preclinical study on the anti-AD efficacy of IRN. To develop IRN into a pharmaceutical agent for AD treatment, it is necessary to test the effectiveness and safety of this promising chemical compound in human mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or AD patients. We propose to initiate a randomized placebo-controlled clinical trial on MCI patients to test the efficacy and safety of IRN using internationally recognized protocol and assessment tools.

14110814.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14110814.value: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common form of dementia in elderly people. Current treatment for AD is largely unsatisfactory, and effective treatment is badly needed. The current project aimed to investigate the anti-AD efficacy of isorhynchophylline (IRN), a chemical compound from Chinese herb Gou-teng, and the underlying mechanisms. Our results indicates that IRN could improve the overall cognitive functions in AlCl3-treated and TgCRND8 transgenic mouse AD models. IRN could decrease the oxidative damage induced by AlCl3, and inhibited the AChE activity. Moreover, IRN significantly inhibited NF-κB signaling pathway in the AlCl3-treated mice. In the TgCRND8 mice experiments, IRN significantly reduced Aβ40 and Aβ42 burdens via modulating β- and γ-cleavage of APP. IRN also down-regulated the Tau protein hyperphosphorylation in the brains of TgCRND8 mice. Lastly, inhibition of the JNK signaling pathway was found to be associated with the anti-AD effect of IRN. IRN was able to significantly inhibit JNK signaling pathway based on cultured primary rat hippocampal neurons experiment. The results obtained from this project have established IRN as a promising candidate for AD treatment, and the findings serve as a foundation for launching a clinical trial to evaluate its efficacy and safety in human AD patients.

14111414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14111414.value: 背景：大約三分之一的老年人于核磁共振成像中可見瀰漫性腦白質病變。腦白質病變和血管危險因素密切相關，其通常繼發於大腦局部缺血。目前認為，顱內小血管動脈硬化所造成的管腔狹窄，以及與內皮損傷相關的血管舒張功能受損是造成瀰漫性腦白質病變的主要病理機制。 腦白質病變目前被認為是引發血管性認知障礙的最重要的原因。該病變的發生可顯著增加癡呆的發病風險。腦白質病變往往逐漸進展，而且進展速度與認知下降水平相平行。最近，當局提出，腦白質病變的患者可作為血管性認知障礙的研究對象，而腦白質病變的進展程度則可作為評估血管性認知障礙的重要指標。根據我們最新的研究結果，即使傳統的血管危險因素得到最優控制，具有腦白質病變的患者的認知水平仍然持續性快速下滑。因此，除了目前使用的針對血管危險因素的標準治療方案外，有關腦白質病變的特殊治療仍需要進一步研究。 作為一種抗血小板藥物，西洛他唑同時具有血管舒張的作用。它既可應用於外周動脈疾病的治療，也可作為非心源性缺血性卒中的二級預防手段。動物實驗表明，西洛他唑可以降低小動脈管腔的狹窄程度，改善血管內皮功能，減少腦白質病變。 目的及假設：評估西洛他唑對治療非癡呆/非中風的腦白質病變患者中腦白質病變的安全性及有效性。假設西洛他唑可以延緩腦白質病變的進展。 方法：本研究將採取隨機，雙盲，安慰劑對照的方法，對一百四十名癡呆/非中風的腦白質病變患者進行研究。根據腦白質病變量表，所有患者的腦白質病變整體評分≥2。入組患者將被隨機分為藥物治療組（西洛他唑100毫克，一日兩次）（n=70）和安慰劑組（n=70），接受兩年隨訪。磁共振成像上腦白質病變的變化程度（可自動定量）將作為主要結局指標，其他大腦損傷（腔隙性梗死，微出血，灰質體積，大腦整體體積，彌散性成像，動脈自旋標記）和臨床指標（蒙特利爾認知評估量表，執行能力和記憶能力測試，行為改變，工具性日常活動量表，步態異常，臨床事件「如中風，癡呆」）將作為次要解決指標。臨床和生化指標將於基線，隨訪第一年和第二年分別採集，磁共振成像將於基線和隨訪第二年進行。安全性評估將採用不良事件的出現和實驗室檢查的異常作為衡量標準。 意義：隨著老齡化社會的到來，癡呆的預防變得愈發重要。因此，正確評估潛在的治療手段以減少腦白質病變相關的認知障礙，迫在眉睫。

14111414.label: Realisation of objectives
14111414.value: This is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study that investigates whether cilostazol can retard WMH progression among dementia/stroke-free subjects with WMH over a 2 year-period. The first objective was to investigate the safety and efficacy of cilostazol upon WMH progression over a 2 year-period among dementia/stroke-free subjects harboring WMH. This objective was fully achieved in the subjects who have completed the study by measuring the drug compliance and the (serious) adverse events related to the study. The objective has been achieved. The second objective was to measure the effects of cilostazol upon other brain-related (lacunes, microbleeds, cortical grey matter and whole brain volumes, diffusion tensor imaging measures, arterial spin labeling) and clinical (Montreal Cognitive Assessment, executive and memory tests, behavior, instrumental activities of daily living, gait, incident clinical events [e.g. stroke, dementia]) measures among subjects harboring confluent WMH. This objective was fully achieved in subjects who have completed the study by measuring cognition (NINDS- CSN VCI Neuropsychology Protocols) and magnetic resonance imaging pre- and post-treatment of cilostazol and placebo. Issues and solutions The original recruitment source was based on those who have already been identified with SVD from two on-going studies led by the same principal investigator of this study. However, the recruitment progress was not satisfying as many eligible subjects refused to participate in the drug trial. We attempted to overcoming the problem by boosting the recruitment rate in a new cohort. We started a screening procedure in the community elderly. Unlike the patient cohort we planned to use, there was no prior knowledge of any indication of SVD in the community subjects. Therefore, we have offered an additional brain MRI to a total of 427 subjects in order to identify subjects that fits the inclusion criteria (global score of the Age-Related White Matter Changes scale of ≥2 as reflected on brain MRI). From the total screened subjects, 120/427 subjects were eligible to enter this study. Among these potential subjects, only 109 subjects were willing to participate. After excluding subjects who have been withdrawn from the study due to medical or person reasons, 87 subjects remained (n=45 completed; n=39 on-going). In summary, the overall recruitment rate is relatively low due to the high refusal rate. The underlying reason was due to the reluctance to participate as they have concern to take medication for research reasons. While 120 subjects consented to participate, 9 subjects refused and withdrew before randomization; 2 subjects withdraw before randomization due to unexpected clinical events (e.g. stroke, enlarged pituitary gland) As the remained 109 subjects were randomized, 25 subjects withdrew due to the following reasons: - Lower limb problem or knee pain (n=5) - Other concurrent medical events (e.g. pace maker implantation, cancer, iron deficiency anemia) (n=4) - Heart related discomfort (e.g. palpitation, premature ventricular contractions ischemic heart disease, congestive heart failure)(n=3) - Minor storke (n=2) - Severe headache (n=1) - Ear discomfort (n=1) - Personal reasons (n=2) - Reasons unknown (n=7) 45 subjects had completed the study while 39 subjects are on-going.

14111414.label: Major findings and research outcome
14111414.value: There are 3 research findings related to the study. First, the study has high patient reported compliance (mean drug compliance = 92.72%). Second, cilostazol has good safety profile. In the completed 42 cases, the reported number of adverse events (AE) was 92 (with 25 events possibly to probably related to the drug) while the reported number of serious adverse events (SAE) was 19 while no subjects permanently discontinued the study. This study reported low AE/ SAE related to the drug. Third, comparing the placebo and cilostazol groups, there was no statistical significance in cognitive and imaging outcomes between the two groups. However, when assessing the change in processing speed score over time, the cilostazol group showed worse performance in processing speed over the 2-year period. The following statistic base on 45 subjects who has completed the study (Placebo n=23, Cilostazol, n=22): Cognitive test (SDMT) change (Year 1 minus Baseline); mean ± SD: (Placebo: 2.5 ± 6.9) (Cilostazol:-1.7 ± 5.0)(P value: 0.025) Cognitive test (SDMT) change (Year 2 minus Baseline); mean ± SD: (Placebo: 1.4 ± 5.8) (Cilostazol:--2.9 ± 4.7)(P value: 0.009)

14111414.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14111414.value: The main aim of this research study was to evaluate the effects of cilostazol upon cognition and other brain-related measures among subjects harboring confluent WMH. This study concluded that cilostazol, compared to placebo, did not improve cognition and the brain as reflected by neuroimaging over the 2-year period. On the contrary, there was a decline in processing speed observed in the cilostazol group. Therefore, we propose that cilostazol may not be effective in preventing or delaying cognitive decline and brain changes in those with confluent WMH.

14111414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14111414.value: This randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study showed that cilostazol is a safe drug with good safety profile and high compliance. However, cilostazol did not improve cognition and brain function (retard WMH progression) among dementia/stroke-free subjects with WMH over a 2 year-period.

14111514.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14111514.value: Rotavirus vaccines are recommended for universal use by the World Health Organization. These vaccines have been available in private medical clinics in Hong Kong since 2006 and are not yet part of Hong Kong’s Childhood Immunization Programme. This enables us to conduct a case-control study will assess the effectiveness of rotavirus vaccines. Approximately 970 children aged >30 days and < 5years who are admitted with acute gastroenteritis to three study hospitals (Prince of Wales Hospital, Queen Mary Hospital and Tuen Mun Hospital) will be enrolled. After fulfilling eligibility criteria and signing consent, families will complete a questionnaire and details of their child’s vaccinations will be recorded. Results of routinely collected stools specimens will be obtained from the medical records and rotavirus positive stool specimens will be centralized for strain characterization for G and P serotyping. After matching “rotavirus positive” case-patients and “test-negative” control-patients on age and date of admission vaccine effectiveness will be calculated with stratification for potential effect modifiers. The study results will help further inform decisions about whether rotavirus vaccines should be provided to all Hong Kong children through the Childhood Immunisation Programme. Title (Chinese): 輪狀病毒疫苗於香港兒童的效用 Abstract (Chinese): 世界衞生組織建議全球使用輪狀病毒疫苗。由二零零六年起，香港的私營診所已提供該疫苗予合適人士接種，但至今仍未列入香港兒童免疫接種計劃，所以我們進行一個病例對照研究，以評估輪狀病毒疫苗的效用。我們將會招募約970個年齡介乎30天至未滿5歲，及因急性腸胃炎而到研究醫院治理的兒童。當參與家庭符合所有參與是次研究的資格及在知情同意書上簽署後，他們就會完成一份問卷調查和提供孩子的疫苗接種記錄的相關詳情。我們亦會從醫療記錄中取得在醫院例行收集的糞便樣本之結果，並儲存及收集所有輪狀病毒陽性的糞便樣本，以作有關G和P血清型的菌株差異之研究。輪狀病毒測試呈陽性的病人將定為病例組，而測試呈陰性的病人將定為對照組，經過配對病例組和對照組的病人的年齡及入院日期，及分層分析可能的效應修飾因素後，我們將計算出輪狀病毒疫苗的效用。此研究將幫助進一步了解把輪狀病毒疫苗列入香港兒童免疫接種計劃內，供給所有香港兒童的需要。 Title (English): Effectiveness of rotavirus vaccine in Hong Kong children Revised Abstract (English): Rotavirus vaccines are recommended for universal use by the World Health Organization. 14111514.value: This study has shown that rotavirus vaccine is highly effective in preventing rotavirus acute gastroenteritis hospitalisation and found that only half of the parents or guardians of rotavirus infected children were aware of the availability of the vaccine before the children were 6 months old. 14111514.label: Major findings and research outcome
14111514.value: Background Rotavirus is a common infectious cause of childhood hospitalisation in Hong Kong. Rotavirus vaccines have been used in the private sector since licensure in 2006 but have not been incorporated in the government’s universal Childhood Immunisation Programme. This study aimed to evaluate rotavirus vaccine effectiveness against hospitalisation. Methods This case-control study was conducted in the 2014/2015 rotavirus season in six public hospitals. Hospitalised acute gastroenteritis patients meeting inclusion criteria were recruited and copies of their immunisation records were collected. Case-patients were defined as enrolled subjects with stool specimens obtained in the first 48 hours of hospitalisation that tested positive for rotavirus, whereas control-patients were those with stool specimens obtained in the first 48 hours of hospitalisation testing negative for rotavirus. Vaccine effectiveness for administration of at least one dose of either Rotarix (GlaxoSmithKline Biologicals) or RotaTeq (Merck Research Laboratories) was calculated as 1 minus the odds ratio for rotavirus vaccination history for case-patients versus control-patients. Results Among the 525 eligible subjects recruited, immunisation records seen in 404 (77%) subjects. 31% (162/525 and 126/404) tested positive for rotavirus. In the 404 subjects assessed for vaccine effectiveness, 2.4% and 24% received at least 1 dose of either rotavirus vaccine in case- and control-patients respectively. The unmatched vaccine effectiveness against hospitalisation for administration of at least one dose of either rotavirus vaccines was 92% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 75%, 98%). The matched analyses by age only and both age and admission date showed 96% (95% CI: 72%, 100%) and 89% (95% CI: 51%, 97%) protection against rotavirus hospitalisation respectively. Conclusions Rotavirus vaccine is highly effective in preventing hospitalisation from rotavirus disease in young Hong Kong children. Yeung KH, Tate JE, Chan CC, et al. Rotavirus vaccine effectiveness in Hong Kong children. Vaccine 2016 Sep 22;34(41):4935-42.

14111514.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14111514.value: The two rotavirus vaccines have similar effectiveness against a range of different rotavirus genotypes. However, types of circulating strains of rotavirus may change over time and new strains may appear, against which vaccines are less effective. Therefore, doing genotype surveillance is considered important to monitor strains.

14111514.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14111514.value: Over 400 cases of hospitalised children at the age of 30 days to 5 years with acute gastroenteritis from six public hospitals were studied during the peak season of rotavirus in 2014/15. Among the 126 children tested positive for rotavirus infection, only 3 (2.4%) had been vaccinated against rotavirus disease. This study shows that rotavirus vaccine is highly effective and can prevent 90% cases of hospitalisation from the disease. Take the 2015 birth cohort of 60,000 newborns as an example, an estimated 1,800 children will be admitted to hospital with rotavirus. As implicated by our study, an approximate1,600 – 1,700 cases of rotavirus hospitalisation could be prevented by vaccination. In Hong Kong, although rotavirus vaccines have been available in the private market since 2006, the study shows that only half of the parents or guardians of infected children were aware of the availability of the vaccine before the children were 6 months old. Rotavirus vaccines have not yet been included in Hong Kong’s routine Childhood Immunisation Programme. The study results will help parents appreciate the benefit of rotavirus vaccine and provide the government with useful information for making decisions about inclusion of the vaccine in the Childhood Immunisation Programme.

14112714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14112714.value: 骨折是最常見的骨科疾病，主要因創傷（年齡不限）或骨質疏鬆（老年人）所致。即便手術技術日趨改進以及各種骨折固定材料的廣泛應用，骨折不癒合（尤其是骨質疏鬆患者）發生率仍居高不降。因此，對新型而更有效的骨折治療手段的需求是十分迫切的。 近年來，由於具備生物可降解，良好的生物相容性的特性，並且有着與接近皮質骨力學強度的特點，鎂金屬及其合金在骨科的應用前景得到了廣泛的關注。鎂是骨基質中主要的礦物元素之一，而且人體內60%的鎂是儲存於骨組織內。研究報導鎂缺乏減少活性維生素D3的合成從而降低了激素與骨組織的結合。本課題組最新的研究結果發現，鎂補給可以顯著地促進新骨形成。這與前人的報導是一致的。但是，鎂促進骨合成代謝的內在機制一直是未解之謎。我們率先地開展了一些前期研究並發現高純度鎂棒植入到完好的長骨之後，皮質骨外周的骨膜部位新骨形成最為明顯，伴隨着該部位感覺神經元降鈣素基因相關肽（CGRP）的釋放增加。CGRP本身就是一種已知的促進骨合成代謝的神經肽。 從邏輯性上來講，直接研發鎂基金屬並用於初始的骨折固定，在癒合過程中金屬逐步降解，最終免除二次內固定物取出手術，這是最吸引廣大科學家及骨科臨床醫生之處。事實上，本課題組也曾嘗試了使用純鎂或鎂基合金作為髓內針來固定骨折後的動物長骨，卻發現植入後鎂棒的快速降解導致骨痂塑形過程中得不到良好的固定。因此，本項目將通過設計一種新型的含鎂髓內針來 “揚長避短”地充分發揮鎂在促進骨折癒合的作用。首先，我們將利用已建立好的大鼠閉合性骨折模型（正常和卵巢切除大鼠）來檢測該新型材料的骨折固定和增強修復的效果。X-ray、micro-CT、掃瞄電鏡、生物力學測試、組織學（免疫組化）等結果用於療效評估，並與不含鎂的髓內針固定組相比較。其次，我們將應用CGRP受體拮抗劑（BIBN4096bs）來明確鎂在體內促進骨折癒合的機制是否由分佈於骨膜的感覺神經末梢釋放的CGRP所介導的。最後，CGRP和鎂離子本身對體外培養的骨膜幹細胞和骨髓間充質幹細胞分化及遷移 的影響也是本項目的研究內容之一。 本研究項目旨在研發一種新型的具備“雙效”功能（長骨骨折固定和促進癒合）的含鎂髓內針。研究成果將不僅顯著緩解社會和病人的經濟壓力，還利於明確潛在而未被認知的分子機制而進一步優化設置。

14112714.label: Realisation of objectives
14112714.value: We focused on the mechanisms underneath the beneficial effect of magnesium on bone formation as well as identifying the translational potential of an innovative magnesium-containing intramedullary nail (Mg-IMN) in fixing the fractured long-bone (i.e., femur, weight-bearing site). Implantation of pure magnesium into rat distal femur triggered dramatic new bone formation at the periosteal region, rather than the endosteal region of the cortical bone. According to the anatomical characteristics of long bone, there are sensory nerve endings [∼80% of fibres are positive for calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)] and periosteum-derived stem cells (PDSCs) densely distributed in the fibrous membrane (i.e., periosteum) covering the outer layer of long bone; therefore, the intriguing magnesium-induced periosteal bone formation was likely attributed to the unique structure of periosteum. Indeed, in this study, we found that no new bone was formed in the area with periosteum stripped after magnesium implantation. In addition, the effect of magnesium was significantly abrogated by either CGRP receptor antagonist or knock-down of the calcitonin receptor-like receptor or receptor-activity modifying protein 1 in vivo, confirming that a CGRP receptor is of particular importance for magnesium-induced periosteal bone formation. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay and immunofluorescence results indicated that CGRP expression was significantly higher in magnesium-implanted samples compared with stainless steel-implanted ones. All these results suggest that CGRP and its receptor are indispensable in the aforementioned interesting phenomenon. When conducting in vitro experiments, we firstly found evidence that the entry of magnesium ions mediated by two important ion channels (magnesium transporter 1 and transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily M member 7) could lead to an increase in the content of synaptic vesicles (miniscule sacs within the cell where CGRP are stored) and consequently increased CGRP release. In primary isolated periosteum-derived stem cells (PDSCs), CGRP promotes osteogenic differentiation via calcitonin receptor-like receptor- and receptor-activity modifying protein 1-dependent activation of cyclic adenosine monophosphate-responsive element binding protein 1 and Osterix. Thus, to our knowledge, for the first time, we are able to comprehensively understand how magnesium ions stimulate sensory neurons to secret CGRP and how CGRP promotes the PDSCs to differentiate toward osteogenic lineage. We have also made a great breakthrough in the translational application of Mg-IMN for treating the challenging osteoporotic fracture created at long bone (femur). Importantly, macrobiomechanical test results show that about 30% enhancement in terms of maximum compressive load in femora received Mg-IMN implantation compared with those with stainless steel. This outcome is of great clinical significance. Additionally, Mg-IMN was able to promote the formation as well as the remodelling of fracture callus, which is likely to be attributed to the sole effects of CGRP exhibited at different stages. As magnesium degradation products are reported to inhibit the activity of osteoclasts, which is crucial for the bone remodelling; together with our finding, at least, we can rule out the possibility that magnesium itself directs the bone remodelling at a late stage of fracture healing. While supplementation of CGRP did not affect the proliferation of PDSCs, it did affect the proliferation of osteoblasts in vitro and in vivo, explaining why fracture callus was larger in the Mg-IMN group compared with the IMN group. Overall, we have fully addressed the objectives as stated.

14112714.label: Major findings and research outcome
14112714.value: In this project we have found that new bone was formed abundantly at peripheral cortical sites after intramedullary implantation of a pin containing ultrapure magnesium into the intact distal femur in rats. This response was accompanied by substantial increases of neuronal calcitonin gene-related polypeptide-α (CGRP) in both the peripheral cortex of the femur and the ipsilateral dorsal root ganglia (DRG). Surgical removal of the periosteum, capsaicin denervation of sensory nerves or knockdown in vivo of the CGRP-receptor-encoding genes Calcrl or Ramp1 substantially reversed the magnesium-induced osteogenesis that we observed in this model. Overexpression of these genes, however, enhanced magnesium-induced osteogenesis. We further found that an elevation of extracellular magnesium induces magnesium transporter 1 (MAGT1)-dependent and transient receptor potential cation channel, subfamily M, member 7 (TRPM7)-dependent magnesium entry, as well as an increase in intracellular adenosine triphosphate (ATP) and the accumulation of terminal synaptic vesicles in isolated rat DRG neurons. In isolated rat periosteum-derived stem cells, CGRP induces CALCRL- and RAMP1-dependent activation of cAMP-responsive element binding protein 1 (CREB1) and SP7 (also known as osterix), and thus enhances osteogenic differentiation of these stem cells. Furthermore, we have developed an innovative, magnesium-containing intramedullary nail that facilitates femur fracture repair in rats with ovariectomy-induced osteoporosis. Taken together, these findings reveal a previously undefined role of magnesium in promoting CGRP-mediated osteogenic differentiation, which suggests the therapeutic potential of this ion in orthopedics. The aforementioned results have been published in Nature Medicine in 2016 (see Part C).

14112714.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14112714.value: On the top of the promising findings as mentioned, we are confident to move on to further test if the beneficial effects of magnesium could be fully utilized for other indications challenging the orthopaedic surgeons. The PI Prof. Qin is now in charge of three on-going General Research Funded projects (Ref.14140816, 14173917, and 14121918) focusing on atypical femoral fracture induced by bisphosphonates and bone defect of critical size. As with highly translational potential merit, gathering top experts and scientists in Hong Kong locally and internationally, Prof. Qin has also been supported by the Collaborative Research Fund (Ref. C4026-17WF) and Hong Kong RGC Theme-based Research Scheme (Ref. T13-402/17-N). We are working intensively on fabrication and modification of magnesium, preclinical testings using in vitro settings and various animal models, and product registration by collaborating with regulatory bodies.

14112714.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14112714.value: This is a typical translational research to test from ‘bench to bedside’ concept. For the first time, we confirm that magnesium is beneficial for fracture healing at the weight-bearing site in osteoporotic animals established by ovariectomy. In addition, calcitonin gene-related peptide-delivery system will also be another translational direction, as the promotive role of calcitonin gene-related peptide in fracture healing is supportive. These cost-effective and innovative treatment approaches will likely bring a reduction not only in the suffering of patients, but also in the economic burden for their families and our society.

14112814.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14112814.value: 分娩是一个复杂的、将胎儿排除母体而结束妊娠的生殖过程，其分子机制目前尚未被阐明。分娩过程中出现的问题，例如早产或难产，可能对母亲或胎儿构成生命危险。早产的发生率在世界范围内（5-15%）及香港（7%）都相当高，且目前对早产的发生仍无法预测。母体子宫正反馈式的收缩运动是自然分娩必需的驱动力。然而，母体子宫收缩的分子调控机制尚不清楚。我们的前期工作表明：1）上皮细胞来源的前列腺素能调节平滑肌收缩；2）激活子宫内膜上皮钠通道能促进前列腺素E2的合成与分泌。值得注意的是，上皮钠通道被报道在其他系统中能被机械刺激所激活。另外，我们最近的工作发现，上皮钠通道在小鼠子宫内的表达水平于分娩时显著升高。这些证据促使我们提出以下的工作假设：分娩时，子宫收缩力可能会激活子宫内膜上皮钠通道，从而促发了一系列信号通路，导致前列腺素E2的产生；前列腺素E2进一步加强子宫收缩程度，从而形成正反馈调控机制，促进分娩过程。为了验证该假设，我们提出以下三点研究目标：1）阐明子宫内膜上皮细胞中机械激活上皮钠通道产生前列素E2的分子机制；2）阐明上皮钠通道参与子宫收缩过程；3）阐明上皮钠通道在小鼠自然分娩与分娩并发症中的作用。我们的实验结果将为更清楚地了解分娩中子宫收缩调控机制提供依据，从而为分娩相关疾病提供潜在的临床治疗靶点。

14112814.label: Realisation of objectives
14112814.value: A series of experiments have been done to achieve Objective-1. First, we adopted an ex vivo model where stretch stimulation was applied to uterine preparations collected from mice at labor. Expression of phosphorylation/activation of CREB (pCREB), a key transcription factor known to promote the expression of pro‐inflammatory cytokines including COX2/PGE2, was examined. Results have shown, after 1‐h stretch, immunofluorescence labeling in the uterine tissues showed abundant pCREB expression in the nuclei of the uterine epithelial cells, whereas other cell types (e.g., muscle cells) showed much weaker or absence of fluorescence. Quantification of the fluorescence intensity revealed that the epithelial nuclear pCREB expression was significantly stronger in the stretched uterine preparations as compared to that in non‐stretched ones. Moreover, the stretch‐induced nuclear expression of pCREB was abolished in the presence of amiloride, a selective blocker of ENaC, indicating ENaC‐dependent epithelial CREB activation by mechanical stimulations. We also examined COX‐2 level in the stretched uterine tissues and the PGE2 concentration in the incubating media. The results showed that the levels of both COX‐2 and PGE2 were significantly elevated by overnight uterine stretch, which were abrogated by the treatment with amiloride. We further investigated whether the stretch‐induced ENaC/CREB activation could lead to a shift in cytokine profile, switching on the pro‐inflammatory cytokines involved in labor. Indeed, the stretch of mouse uterine tissues upregulated IL‐6 and TNFα, which were both significantly inhibited by amiloride, suggesting the involvement of ENaC in the upregulation of pro‐inflammatory cytokines. Second, we use a human endometrial epithelial cell line, Ishikawa (ISK) cells. Results showed that stretch (15% elongation) of the cells for 30 min increased phosphorylation of CREB, which was blocked by pretreatment with amiloride. We next used ISK cells in conjunction with ENaC knockdown by shRNAs. To better mimic mechanical stimuli in the uterus during labor, which are mostly rhythmic contractile forces, we applied a cyclic stimulation of stretch (15% elongation) at frequency of 1 Hz to ISK cells grown on flexible culture supports. shRNAs against ENaCα (shENaCα), the rate‐limiting subunit of ENaC, were used to knockdown ENaC. Quantitative PCR showed ~ 50% reduction in ENaCα mRNA level in ISK cells treated with the shENaCα as compared to the cells treated with non‐silencing control shRNAs. The cyclic stretch‐induced increases in mRNA levels of IL‐6, IL‐8, TNFα, and COX‐2 were all significantly inhibited by ENaC knockdown, confirming the involvement of ENaC. In addition, in these cells we also applied auto-patch experiment which showed mechanical evoked and amiloride-sensitive whole-cell currents, suggesting mechano-sensitivity of ENaC in uterine epithelial cells. These results in together have suggested that the stretch‐induced upregulation of pro‐inflammatory cytokines including PGE2 may be a subsequence to the mechano‐activation of ENaC. Given the results of Objective-1, we next examined possible involvement of uterine epithelium and ENaC in regulating uterine contractions in response to mechanical stimulation as planned in Objective-2. The contractility of mouse uterine tissue preparations (19 d.p.c. labor day) was measured ex vivo, which exhibited rhythmic spontaneous contractions. Stretches by 10–40% elongation of in situ length (L0) of the preparations were applied at the end of a rhythmic spontaneous contractive phase, which substantially advanced the following contractive phase. The stretch‐induced phase‐advancing effect was calculated, according to a previously reported method, as (T0−T1)/(T0−Ts). The maximal phase‐advancing effect on 19 d.p.c. uterine preparations was achieved by 20% L0 stretch, which was then used in the following experiments. To explore a possible role of the epithelium, we denudated the epithelium from the uterine preparations and this resulted in significant inhibition of the stretch (20% L0)‐induced phase advancement as compared to the intact tissues, suggesting a role of the epithelium in regulating uterine contractions. Similarly, inhibition of ENaC by amiloride (10–200 μM), starting from a low dose (10 μM), significantly inhibited the stretch (20% L0)‐induced phase advancement in a concentration‐dependent manner, indicating the involvement of ENaC in stretch‐facilitated contractions. Of note, in contrast to the time of parturition (19 d.p.c.), the stretch (20% L0)‐induced phase‐advancing effect was found significantly less in uterine preparations from mice at 15 d.p.c. This is consistent with the time course expression profile of ENaC, with stronger uterine contractions observed when ENaC expression level is maximal, further suggesting the involvement of ENaC in regulating uterine contractions during labor process. We next explored, as planned in Objective-3, the role of ENaC in preterm labor and possible prevention in two well‐established preterm labor mouse models, induced by RU486 (a progesterone receptor antagonist) and lipopolysaccharide, respectively. We subcutaneously injected RU486 (200 μg per mouse) into pregnant mice at 15 d.p.c., which resulted in preterm labor in ~ 20 h. Uterine tissues were collected either at preterm labor from RU486‐treated mice or time‐matched vehicle‐injected ones as control. RU486‐treated uterus showed significantly higher protein levels of ENaCα and its cleaved/activated form, as compared that in the control group. If the upregulation of ENaC by RU486 is involved in preterm labor in these mice, blocking ENaC would prevent or delay RU486‐induced labor. To test this, amiloride (initial dose, 10 mg/kg body weight) was intraperitoneally injected into the mice right before and every 7–8 h after the RU486 injection (200 μg per mouse). Up to four injections of amiloride were done before the labor was initiated and the cumulative doses of amiloride were used from 10 to 40 mg/kg body weight. Results showed that all the RU486‐treated control mice (n = 26) gave birth within 24 h; however, amiloride dose‐dependently reduced the number of RU486‐induced birth, with none of the mice (n = 9) delivered within 24 h at the cumulative dose of 40 mg/kg. We also injected siRNAs against ENaCα (siENaCα, 600 pmole per mouse, i.p.) into pregnant mice at 14 and 15 d.p.c. before RU486 injection (200 μg per mouse). The siENaCα treatment resulted in ~ 40% lower ENaCα expression in the uterus, as compared to mice treated with control siRNAs (siNC). Even at this low transfection efficiency, knockdown of ENaC significantly reduced the number of births delivered in 20 h after RU486 injection (33.3%, 2 out of 6) in siENaCα‐treated mice, whereas 100% (5 out of 5) in the control siNC‐treated group. In another preterm mouse model by injection of LPS mimicking infection‐associated preterm labor, overwhelming inflammation as indicated by extensive redness of intraperitoneal tissues was observed. The expression levels of ENaCα and γ expression in the uterus at labor were found to be decreased even though COX‐2 expression was increased in LPS‐treated mice as compared to the controls, suggesting that upregulation of COX‐2 in the infection‐associated preterm labor may be ENaC‐independent. As expected, the treatment with amiloride failed to delay LPS‐induced preterm labor in mice. Taken together, all the objectives have been achieved, suggesting a previously undefined role of ENaC in leading mechanical signals to pro‐inflammatory responses (e.g PGE2 production), which essentially contributes to uterine contractions for labor at term and preterm. The study has also suggested ENaC as a potential target for the prevention and treatment of preterm labor.

14112814.label: Major findings and research outcome
14112814.value: The project has revealed a novel role for the epithelial sodium channel (ENaC) in transducing the mechanical signal from uterine contractions that results in production of pro‐inflammatory cytokines during labor. ENaC has the potential to be targeted for the prevention and treatment of preterm labor. Related results have been recognized of clinical significance and have been published in 2018 (Sun et al. EMBO Molecular Medicine, 2018). The newly discovered role of ENaC beyond its regular function in epithelial transport also prompted us to study another epithelial ion channel, CFTR, highly related to ENaC, and its non-epithelial transport function. Results showed that CFTR contributes hormone production in islet cells (published in Frontiers in Physiology 2017 and Endocrinology 2017). We were also involved in a collaborative study on polycystic ovarian syndrome, a reproductive and endocrine disease (published in Fertility and Sterility 2019). Through this project, we also trained a number of postgraduate students. 3 of them have been graduated within the period of the project. For the work partly supported by this project, the PI (Prof RUAN) and Co-I (Prof CHAN) were awarded with National Science and Technology Award in Women and Children's Health (First Class) in 2015.

14112814.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14112814.value: The identified role of ENaC in leading mechanical signals to inflammatory responses are being studied in other systems beyond the uterus. We are also developing ENaC and its network genes, upstream or downstream, as molecular targets for treatment and diagnosis of preterm-labor.

14112814.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14112814.value: The preterm labor/birth is so far hardly predictable and preventable, which is largely because we have little understanding of the labor process. Results from this project reveal a novel role for the epithelial sodium channel (ENaC) in transducing the mechanical signal from uterine contractions, and results in production of pro‐inflammatory cytokines and positive feedback of uterine contractions during labor. ENaC, therefore, has the potential to be targeted for the prevention and treatment of preterm labor.

14113114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14113114.value: The recent outbreak of H7N9 in China and sporadic transmission of avian H5N1 virus from poultry to human have been a major concern to public health. To have a better preparation against future epidemics and pandemics, there is an urgent need to understand how influenza virus functions by studying the interaction among the viral proteins. The ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complex is the essential element for performing transcription and replication of viral genome. It is composed of a trimeric polymerase (PA, PB1 and PB2), nucleoprotein (NP) and viral RNA. NP binds to PB1 and PB2 of the polymerase. These interactions are thought to be essential for proper functioning of the polymerase. Recently, we have found that NP interacts with aa 320-483 of PB2, which encompasses the cap-binding domain. In this proposal, we aim at studying the interaction of NP with PB2 at its N-terminal cap-binding domain in-depth and elucidate the significance of this interaction. The proposed work will: (1) define how PB2 N-terminal region, in particular the cap-binding domain interacts with NP and identify the interacting surfaces on these two proteins; (2) find if the interaction between NP and PB2 cap-binding domain would affect PB2 localization and PB2 binding with capped RNA and PB1; (3) investigate the relative importance of this interaction in comparison to the NP-PB2 C-terminal domain interaction in RNP functioning and virus survival. The proposed work besides deepen our understanding on the interaction between PB2 and NP, the elucidated interacting surface may also be used as a drug target for screening of new classes of chemicals that inhibit the interaction and hence may be used as anti-influenza agents to combat influenza virus. 近年在中國大陸出現的H7N9和由禽鳥傳人的H5N1流感使人極度 關注。為更好準備應付將來流感的爆發，了解流感病毒的生長機 制和病毒蛋白的相互作用至為重要。 流感病毒的核糖核蛋白(RNP) 用作病毒的轉錄和轉譯。由聚合酶 PA，PB1和PB2加上核蛋白和RNA組成。NP與PB1及PB2的相互 作用，對聚合酶的功能十分重要。我們發現NP和PB2的aa320-483 相互作用，這個位置是PB2的cap連結穴。我們建議深入探討這個相互作用並找出其重要性。 建議包括：(1) 探討PB2 N-末端區域，尤其是cap連結穴如何與NP 相互作用；(2) 找出NP和PB2的相互作用如何影響PB2在細胞內的 位置和PB2與capped RNA及PB1的接合；(3) 比較這個相互作用和 NP與PB2 C-末端相互作用在RNP功能和病毒生存的重要性。 研究可增加我們對PB2和NP相互作用的了解。相互作用的介面可 成為篩選抗流感病毒化合物的靶點。

14113114.label: Realisation of objectives
14113114.value: Objective 1: We further discovered the involvement of RNA in the interaction between NP and PB2 cap-binding domain, RNA involvement in the interaction posed a difficulty in mapping the interacting site. Mutation study of the proteins involves the alternation of RNA binding ability of the two proteins, interaction was abolished as predicted when the proteins lack RNA binding ability. The binding model may suggest that proteins interact with one another through RNA or RNA binding induces conformation change in the protein hence enables the interaction. Objective 2: The interaction was suggested to involve RNA. Cap-binding domain was reported primarily for its binding activity of the 5’ cap of mRNA. However, such activity was not crucial in the interaction. We studied the interaction with different variants of the domain, variants with reduced cap-binding activity showed a similar binding to NP. Furthermore, other than cap-binding activity, we discovered the domain possesses RNA binding ability which agrees with the hypothesis proposed by other research group. Therefore, we investigated the RNA binding capacity of the domain rather than the cap-binding capacity. Surprisingly, specific RNA sequence is not important in the interaction as synthetic short RNA with poly-uracils showed binding to the domain which indicated the presence of RNA maintains and mediates the interaction. Previous study claimed the interaction with NP occurs in the first 269 amino acids of PB2, which is also the region where PB1 and PB2 interacts. Therefore, mutational study of those residues may affect both NP and PB1 binding of PB2, as there are a few NLS in PB1, we planned to investigate the effect on PB2 localization when PB1 interacts with PB2 N-terminal variants. However, our results showed that the first 269 amino acids of PB2 do not interact with NP, the effect on PB2 localization was therefore not studied. Objective 3: PB2-NP interaction is mediated by both the N-terminal and C-terminal of PB2, we performed co-immunoprecipitation to compare the significance of the two regions in NP binding. D605 of C-terminal of PB2 was identified to be the key residue for binding NP, variant D605A of PB2 abolished NP-PB2 C-terminal interaction as shown in the previous study. We expressed full-length PB2 D605A variant with NP in mammalian cell culture. This allowed us to study how the interaction would be affected when one of the regions failed to bind NP. By comparing the amount of NP precipitated, we can estimate the significance of N-terminal and C-terminal of PB2 in the interaction. We found that the amount of NP precipitated by D605A variant was similar to the amount precipitated by wild-type PB2, suggesting a similar importance of the N- and C- terminal regions.

14113114.label: Major findings and research outcome
14113114.value: In previous study, the interaction between influenza A nucleoprotein (NP) and N-terminal region was found to occur in residue 1-269 of PB2. Our study showed that NP interacts with residue 318-483, PB2 cap-binding domain (CBD) instead. The interaction of NP and CBD were further investigated. (1) We found that this interaction is mediated by RNA as removal of RNA by the addition of RNase abolished the interaction, and such interaction was restored when RNA was re-introduced to the reaction mixture. Also, specific sequence of RNA did not play a role in the interaction, short synthetic RNA with sequence of poly-uracils can restore the interaction. This may suggest a role of NP in the process of transcribing influenza viral genome. It is possible that as the mRNA is synthesized, NP plays a role by locating close to the cap-binding domain of PB2 to stabilize the newly formed RNA. (2) Both NP and PB2 have been reported to bind RNA, and mutations that hampered this ability also hampered the interaction of the two proteins. NP has a high affinity to RNA, and we have generated a variant with multiple mutation (R74A, R75A, R174A, R175A, R221A) that is deficient in RNA-binding. This variant was unable to bind PB2 cap-binding domain in the pull-down study. In the truncation study of cap-binding domain, we discovered that the domain is important for the interaction, deletion of only a few amino acids resulted in the loss of interaction with NP. 3) Since there are two regions in PB2 (N-terminal and C-terminal) that interact with NP, we tried to understand the importance of these regions in the interaction and compare their significance. In Co-immunoprecipitaion study, amount of precipitated NP did not show significant difference when PB2 C-terminal region had lost the ability in binding bind NP. This implied that both regions are important for binding NP.

14113114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14113114.value: This study proposed potential interacting model and condition for NP and PB2 cap-binding domain interaction. To confirm this model, structural study of the complex by protein crystallography is necessary.

14113114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14113114.value: Influenza virus causes flu pandemics and epidemics which may kill up to half a million annually, understanding how this virus replicates inside the cells is an important step to combat this virus. The process is mediated by a protein-RNA complex called ribonucleoprotein complex (RNP). The complex consists of four major subunits, interruption of interactions between these subunits greatly affect the complex activity, hence the replication of the virus. Among these subunits, NP have been shown to interact with PB2 N-terminal and C-terminal sequences by previous studies, and mutation studies of these two terminal sequences result in a drastic decrease in the complex activity. This project aims to understand the nature of the interaction between NP and PB2 N-terminal, and the importance of PB2 N-terminal in the whole PB2. We have shown that cap-binding domain of PB2 together with RNA is responsible for the interaction. Both the N-terminal and C-terminal region of PB2 play a role in the interaction with NP. With this information, it will be a step to further the study of the mechanism of the RNP complex. Also, the interacting site may propose a novel target site for drug screen for the development of anti-influenza medicine.
