15303714.label: Realisation of objectives
15303714.value: Transition metal mediated carboradical cross coupling reactions are currently attracting extensive interest. Based on our earlier success in the Pd-catalyzed direct C-H acylation of 2-arylpyridines and acetophenone oximes using acyl radicals, this project hopes to address some fundamental issues in this coupling reaction. For objectives 1 and 2, dinuclear Pd(II)-Pd(II) carboxylate complexes have been characterized as the catalyst resting state. In this work, we successfully employed benzophenone as substrates for the Pd-catalyzed ortho-C-H acylation using alpha-ketocarboxylates as the acyl reagents. We have successfully isolated and characterized the cyclopalladated complex of the benzophenone. Apparently, the ketone group coordinated to the Pd(II) center and direct the C(aryl)-H bond cleavage at the ortho position. We have performed a stoichiometric acylation reactions with the alpha-ketocarboxylate reagent under the oxidizing conditions, and the desired acylation product was obtained in 43% yield. Considering acyl radicals are formally one-electron oxidants, we initially assumed that coordination of acyl radicals with the Pd(II) center involves one-electrom oxidation of the metal center to form Pd(III) center, which is better stabilized by Pd(III)-Pd(III) metal-metal bonding. We have attempted to isolated the putative dipalladium(III, III)-acyl complexes using a variety of acylating reagents, including the ketocarboxylates, acylsilanes, 1,2-diketones and carboxylic acid anhydrides which are known in the literature to serve as acyl group donors. However, our effort were thus far unsuccessful. Using ESI-MS analysis of the reaction mixtures involving in the stoichiometric reactions of dipalladium(II, II) carboxylates of 2-arylpyridines with those defined acyl donor reagents failed to produce characterizable signatures of the putative acyl-dipalladium species. Noted the aryl-palladium bond should be reasonably strong, we previously demonstrated that aryl radicals are effective coupling partners with 2-arylpyridine-palladium(II, II) carboxylate complexes. Thus, we considered that isolation of some well-defined aryl-dipalladium(III, III) intermediate may be more feasible than the acyl analogues. By reacting aryldiazonium salts with 2-arylpyridine-dipalladium(II, II) carboxylates afforded the expected arylation product in 43% yield. Radical trap experiment by TEMPO supported the involvement of aryl radicals with the aryl-TEMPO adduct being isolated in 74% yield. However, we were not able to isolate the putative aryl-palladium(III) complex. Based on bond energy consideration, we further our attempt to isolate trifluoromethyl (CF3)-palladium(III, III) complexes in a radical trifluoromethylation reactions employing Baran's CF3SO2Na reagent. Employing persulfate as oxidizing agent and 2-arylpyridine-palladium(II, II) carboxylate as starting materials, we did not observed effective formation of trifluoromethylation product. Instead, homodimer of the 2-arylpyridine was observed (~20% yield). Recently, organonickel and -copper complexes are shown to exhibit fruitful coupling reaction chemistry with carboradicals for C-C and C-heteroatom bond formations. Using photoredox chemistry, carboradicals can be easily generated from some precursors such as hydroxyphthalimide (NHPI) esters. The research groups of Molander, Baran, Fu and MacMillan plus many others demonstrated the mononuclear arylnickel complexes would react with carboradicals to effect C-C bond formation. We considered that the analogous mononuclear palladium(II) complex may react with carboradicals (e.g. aryl radicals, CF3 radicals and cyclopentyl radicals) with the result of C-C bond formation. With this hypothesis in mind, we prepared a well-defined cyclopalladacyclic aryl complex with picolinamide auxiliary. The complex was prepared by the literature method with complete spectral agreement with the reported examples. Subjecting the palladium complex under the radical coupling conditions (with reference to the literature procedures), we were unable to characterize any desired C-C coupled products for the reactions with the aryl and CF3 radicals. Even employing the more nucleophilic cyclopentyl radicals (generated from NHPI esters under photoredox conditions with iridium based photocatalysts), no effective C-C coupled products were obtained. During the search for carboradical coupling partners with organopalladium, we accidentally found that alpha-diazoacetate would undergo regioselective N-alkylation at the terminal diazo group to form N-alkyl hydrazones. The reaction occurs under photoredox conditions involving the use of Rose Bengal as the photocatalyst, NHPI esters as carboradical source and dihydropyridine as the proton and electron donors. The N-alkylhydrazones can be isolated in almost quantitative yields in many examples. Apparently, the use of NHPI esters for carboradical coupling has a clear advantage since the esters is easily prepared from readily available carboxylic acids. The reaction has been meticulously optimized and is run under yellow irradiation (versus commonly blue irradiation) at room temperature to avoid product decomposition. The scopes on both the diazoacetates and the NHPI esters have been examined, and over 60+ examples involving highly functionalized and skeletal diversified substrates have been studied. Mechanistic study by UV-Vis spectroscopy revealed that the use of organic base such as DBU is critical for tuning the spectral absorption window of the Rose Bengal to the yellow color region, and cyclic voltammetry and fluorescent quenching experiments suggested that the dihydropyridine probably reductively quench the photoexcited Rose Bangel molecule by single electron transfer. The Rose Bangel radical anion that reduces the NHPI ester by a second single electron transfer reaction. Radical fragmentation and decarboxylation afforded the carboradical for subsequent coupling with the terminal nitrogen atom of the alpha-diazoacetates. A manuscript detailing this work is in preparation (see attached for reference) gem-Difluoroalkenes is a characteristic motif found in many bioactive / medicinal products, and it is known to be a metabolically stable bioisostere of the keto groups. Prompted by our initial success in radical acylation of arylpalladium(II) complexes, we considered installation of gem-difluorovinyl group to arenes would be a meaningful extension of this project. The conventional strategies for synthesis of gem-difluoroalkenes include difluoroolefination of carbonyl or diazo compounds and organometallics- or strong base-mediated nucleophilic addition to trifluoromethyl alkenes involving the β-fluoro elimination step. However, many of these methods suffer from narrow substrate scope and / or poor functional groups tolerance. Here we prepared a 2,2-difluorovinyl benzoate reagents for Ni-catalyzed arylboronic acids coupling to form 2,2-difluorostyenes derivatives in excellent yields. Our Ni-catalyzed reaction caters a large diversity of skeletal structures and functional groups, and reagents containing highly functionalized natural product motifs can be tolerated. The difluorovinyl benzoate reagents were prepared conveniently from 2-bromo-2,2-difluoroacetates by treatment with zinc powder. The structure of the difluorovinyl benzoates has been established by X-ray crystallography. To our knowledge, this Ni-catalyzed approach is probably the first precedent example for synthesis of highly diversified gem-difluorostyrenes. A manuscript summarizing this work is in preparation (see attached for reference). For objective 3, the Pd-catalyzed enantioselective direct C-H acylation of diarylmethylamine is currently under investigated. Using chiral monoprotected amino acids (MPAA) and 1,2-diketones as the acyl donors, the desired ortho-selective acylation products were obtained in up to 60% yield and 51%ee. This work is on-going for further optimization on the yield and enantioselectivity. This work will be completed with a scope study and mechanistic investigation. A progress report is attached for reference.

15303714.label: Major findings and research outcome
15303714.value: (1) Pd-catalyzed ortho-C-H acylation of benzophenones has been developed, and alpha-ketocarboxylates were used as the acyl donors under oxidative conditions. The desired acylation products were obtained in excellent regioselectivity and functional group tolerance. A cyclopalladated complex with the keto group coordinating to the Pd(II) center has been isolated and characterized. This work has been published in Organic Letters. (2) A photoredox metal-free carboradical N-alkylation of diazoacetates has been developed for synthesis of structurally and functionally diversified N-alkylhydrazones. The conventional methods for N-alkylhydrazones are limited in scope with poor functional group tolerance. In this work, NHPI esters derived from abundant carboxylic acids were used as the carboradical sources. Under our photoredox conditions, primary, secondary and tertiary carboradicals can effectively couple with diazoacetates. Radicals and diazoacetates derived from functionalized natural product scaffolds are effective coupling partners. Over 60 examples have been completed for investigation. A manuscript detailing this work is in preparation. (3) A Ni-catalyzed cross coupling reaction of arylboronic acids with 2,2-difluorovinyl benzoates has been achieved for structurally diverse synthesis of gem-difluoroalkenes, which are metabolically stable bioisostere of a keto group. The 2,2-difluorovinyl benzoates were prepared by zinc treatment with the 2-bromo-2,2-difluoroacetates, and the structure has been established by X-ray crystallography. The coupling reaction is applicable to a highly diversified substrate scope with more than 40 examples (including natural product motifs) have been included in this study. A manuscript detailing this work is under preparation. (4) Pd-catalyzed enantioselective C-H acylation of diarylmethylamines is under investigation. Using monoprotected amino acids (MPAA) as chiral ligands, 1,2-diketones as acyl donors, the desired ortho-acylation products were obtained in up to 60% yield and 51%ee. Optimization of the yields and enantioselectivity is underway, and a manuscript will be prepared for publication.

15303714.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15303714.value: The unique azomethine motif of hydrazone (C=N–NH) containing a nucleophilic imine / amino group and an electrophilic imine carbon center has endowed hydrazone with distinctive physical and chemical properties crucial for designing new materials such as covalent organic frameworks, hole-transporting materials and molecular switches. Most studies focus on libraries of (hetero)aryl-substituted hydrazones for the search of favourable properties, few studies were designed to examine structurally distinct libraries of C(sp3)-rich N-alkylhydrazones libraries for lead structures discovery. Indeed, the N-alkylhydrazones display conformationally restricted scaffolds and well-defined spatial orientation of functional groups in a candidate compound that often leads to higher binding affinity to target molecules. Notably, the hydrocarbon skeleton containing sp3 stereocenters also display stereochemical information thereby creating a further dimension in designing new drugs and materials. However, the current lack of synthetic routes to access functionally and structurally diverse N-alkylhydrazones severely limits the realization of the full potential of this class of molecules. Here we developed a photoredox carboradical coupling reactions of diazoacetates for highly functionalized N-alkylhydrazones, which should provide a large chemical space for search of functional molecules for life and materials science application.

15303714.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15303714.value: We examined carboradicals as coupling reagents for C-C and C-N bonds formation. Treating arylpalladium(II) complexes, prepared by electrophilic C(aryl)-H bond cleavage, with some acyl radicals precursors such as alpha-ketocarboxylates and 1,2-diketones under oxidative conditions, effective acylation of the Pd-C bond occurs to afford the arylketone products. In this work, keto group was found to serve a directing group so that only the ortho-C-H bonds are activated for C-C coupling reactions. Using chiral monoprotected amino acids (MPAA), enantioselective C-H cleavage on diarylmethylamines can be achieved using palladium(II) acetate as catalyst. Initial results indicated that the product arylketone was obtained in 51%ee, and optimization of the reaction is on-going. Employing NHPI esters as carboradical precursors, we developed a photoredox metal-free carboradical coupling reaction with diazoacetates to form N-alkylhydrazones. Since the NHPI esters are easily derived from abundant carboxylic acid feedstocks, libraries of highly structurally and functionally diverse N-alkylhydrazones, previously inaccessible, have become accessible by this reaction. The carboradical alkylation occurs selectively at the terminal nitrogen of the diazoacetate, reaction functional groups such as alkene, hydroxy and amide groups are tolerated. Some natural products exhibiting elaborate conformational and stereochemistry have been coupled to the diazoacetate using this carboradical coupling reactions.

15304114.label: Realisation of objectives
15304114.value: Objective 1: First, to synthesize atom transfer radical polymerization (ATRP) initiators which able to self-assembly onto graphene surfaces, we synthesized a macroinitiator containing pyrene group at one end that could anchor on graphene sheets effectively. Objective 2: By immersing the chemical vapor deposited (CVD) graphene sheets grown on copper (Cu) foils into the solution containing the as-fabricated initiator, initiator-modified graphene surface was achieved. After that, polymer brushes could be grown on the graphene side via surface-initiated atom transfer radical polymerization (SI-ATRP) with the graphene sheets were transferred into the polymerization solution. In this project, we decorated the graphene films with five different types polymer brushes, including poly (methyl methacrylate) (PMMA), Poly (glycidyl methacrylate) (PGMA), poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) (PNIPAm), poly[(2-(methylacryloyloxyl)ethyl) trimethylammonium (PMETAC) and poly(oligo(ethyleneglycol) methacrylate) (POEGMA). Objective 3: To demonstrate the uniqueness of polymer brushes-grown graphene sheets, we presented the patterned polymer brushes layer on graphene sheets through femtosecond (fs) laser pulses. A femtosecond laser was then used to generate square or dot holes on the polymer brushes grown graphene layer. After etching the Cu foil, the patterned films were transferred onto a SiO2 wafer. The achieved patterns are observed to be uniform (50-µm squares and 5-µm circles) under a microscope. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) study also indicated that the patterns were distributed on the substrate with a regular depth of ~43nm. In addition, we used microcontact printing to print the macro-initiator on the graphene surface, patterned PNIPAm brushes on graphene were generated successfully. Objective 4: These one-side functionalized graphene films could be transferred onto many different target substrates for characterization and future usage. For example, the single-side functionalized graphene films could be readily transferred onto many other substrates including polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), silicon dioxide (SiO2), textiles, quartz, gold and polyethylene terephthalate (PET) films. The resulted Raman spectra of the modified graphene films did not show obvious differences when compared with those of pure graphene films, further confirmed our surface modification is a damage-free approach towards CVD graphene. Objective 5: The polymer brushes grown graphene films also possessed excellent mechanical stability and flexibility. We used a porous substrate (TEM grid) to acquire the PMMA brushes grown graphene sheet. When the thin film was stuck to one end of the TEM grid, it remained intact and curled after drying. The thicknesses of the obtained polymer brush layers grown on graphene films are ranging from 26 to 115 nm. All of these functionalized graphene films exhibited high transparency greater than 80% at 550 nm. Since the graphene sheets we used were 2-3 layers thick that absorbed ~7% of the optical light, the polymer brushes only contributed 5-12% to the absorption of optical light. From the chemical point of view, different polymer brushes alter the surface wettability and biochemical reactivity of graphene in unique ways. For pristine CVD graphene transferred on a SiO2 wafer, the water contact angle for the graphene surface was found as ~90°. After the grafting of polymer brushes, all the water contact angle measurement values were smaller than the pristine graphene film, showing that all the polymer brushes grafted on top made the graphene surface more hydrophilic. The water contact angles for PMMA, PGMA and POEGMA grafted surface were observed at 80°, 77° and 45° respectively. Furthermore, the water contact angle of PMETAC grafted graphene surface was ~0°, showing the growth of PMETAC brushes dramatically increase the hydrophilicity of the graphene sheets. PNIPAm brushes also enable the graphene film to be temperature-responsive. When environmental temperature (T) is lower than the critical solution temperature of PNIPAm, the water contact angles of the PNIPAm modified graphene surface were ~60°. When T is larger than the lower critical solution temperature, the water contact angles increased to ~80°. For PGMA modified graphene surfaces, 3’TET-labeled single strand DNA oligonucleotides were covalently bonded to the PGMA brushes through the ring-opening reaction of epoxy groups. Moreover, a patterned PGMA layer was demonstrated via simple ink-jet printing. The patterned PGMA layer could act as bio-microarrays which can be potentially applied in sensor and diagnostic applications. Objective 6: In previous researches, the folding behaviors of the patterned graphene-based thin films were studied by anchoring the films on a rigid substrate, while the study of free-standing graphene-based films is still limited. However, due to the difficulties of handling, locating and observing few-ten-nm thick free-standing graphene flakes inside the solution based on our previous equipment, we had not yet achieved a comprehensive set of data about this right now. We believe that we could have a deeper understanding about the folding behaviors of these asymmetric functionalized graphene sheets by adopting the fluorescent microscopy and laser scanning confocal microscopy in near future. Objective 7: To demonstrate the application of asymmetric functionalized graphene sheets as transferrable surface functionalization templates for fabricating flexible and stretchable interconnects, graphene surfaces were decorated with metal layers. As PMETAC is a positively charged polymer, where its quaternary ammonium groups have a strong affinity to metal anions such as [PdCl4]2− and [AuCl4]−, electroless deposition of metal could be performed on the PMETAC brushes decorated graphene sheets. The thickness of Cu layers deposited on PMETAC brush layer was measured as ~80 nm, with a sheet resistance ~ 8 Ω. After transferring the Cu coated graphene films on PET substrates, they were found to be highly flexible as their sheet resistance remain unchanged after 1000 bending cycles (bending radius = 4 mm). Thus, such asymmetric functionalized graphene sheets were highly applicable as interconnects for flexible and stretchable electronics. On the other hand, we demonstrated that Au layers (~10 -100 nm) thermally deposited on CVD graphene/Cu foil could be transferred onto a foreign substrate by simple wet etching and fishing process. We found that graphene could act as a supporting and adhesive layer that enables the wet-transfer of a complete Au film onto arbitrary substrates. The graphene supported Au layers obtained a far lower roughness when compared to transferred pure Au films. A transferred 20 nm-thick Au film supported by CVD graphene obtained a sheet resistance of 5 Ω sq-1 and showed satisfactory flexibility with only 8 % increase in resistance after 5500 bending cycles (bending radius = 4 mm). To expand the application range of the metal coated graphene films, we also demonstrated the fabrication of a transferable, flexible and transparent electrode by combining the metal mesh with the CVD graphene films. Via photolithography and simple rinsing processes, patterned Au meshes were fabricated on CVD graphene/Cu foil. Via etching of Cu foil underneath, the whole Au covered CVD graphene (Au@G) meshes becomes a free-standing electrode and were transferred on target substrates and devices. These Au@G meshes proceed a high transmittance of light in the visible region (~92 % T) and less than 10 % increase in sheet resistance after 1000 bending cycles (bending radius = 4 mm). An organic solar cell was successfully fabricated by adopting the Au@G mesh as a top electrode through the wet transfer process.

15304114.label: Major findings and research outcome
15304114.value: In this project, the first major finding is about the successful surface functionalization of graphene sheets via non-covalent π-π stacking interactions. We found that the pyrene group bearing ATRP-initiator could firmly anchor on the graphene basal plane and allow the growth of polymer brushes on top. The polymer brushes decorated graphene films are highly transparent, freestanding, lightweight, flexible, transferable to various substrates with good stability and are patternable into different structures. This approach enabled a robust route for fabricating ultrathin, transferable functional 2D organic materials when compared with the conventional methods. As various kinds of polymer brushes with different functional groups possess unique properties, the graphene supported organic layer could be tailor-made for specific reactivity-required applications. The other major finding is the wet transfer of Au thin film enabled by graphene support. Via the simple thermal deposition of Au layer on CVD graphene film, Au layers could be patterned and wet-transferred onto various target substrates without any protection on top. Good flexibility with satisfactory conductivity makes them very suitable for being applied as electrodes for flexible electronics. Base on the above findings and deepened knowledge about graphene functionalization, we have published four related articles and reviews listed as the followings: 1. 15304114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15304114.value: Although several examples of the non-covalently modified graphene-supported 2D materials have been fabricated and studied in this project, further studies and mass-scale production development based on such graphene modifying approach still needed to be conducted in the future. Specifically, for the polymer brushes functionalized graphene, further improvements of the film roughness could be achieved by a further investigation of optimum thickness of each type of polymer brushes, which was determined by the polymerization kinetic, but as we did not vary the brush thickness in detail in this work. For the metal deposited graphene films, we only deposited and transferred the graphene supported Au layers. A wider range of inorganic layers should be studied in the future, further investigate the crystal phases, physical and chemical properties of the deposited inorganic layers on the graphene surface. Moreover, to apply the graphene-supported inorganic layers in various aspects.

15304114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15304114.value: Graphene, a one-atom-thick 2D material with a honeycomb structure that made up of carbon atoms only. It possesses a series of fascinating behaviors, including its extraordinary high mechanical strength, flexibility, optical transparency, and conductivity. However, there is no functional group on the pure graphene surface. Such chemical inertness becomes an obstacle for incorporating graphene into devices or matrices in sensing and actuating areas, which requires biochemical reactivity. Surface modifications are therefore necessary for introducing specific functional groups on graphene. However, plenty of the modifying strategies depend on the covalent bond formation between foreign molecules and graphene film, which damage the graphene basal plane and sacrifice its mechanical and electronic merits. Therefore, non-covalent modification, which allows the grafting of functional groups on graphene without any structure distortion, is largely demanded. In this project, we successfully achieved transferrable, flexible and functional graphene-based 2D materials via non-covalent approach, with desirable properties of graphene preserved. Graphene-based functional polymer films were fabricated via non-covalent interaction between graphene and pyrene-group bearing initiator for polymerization. Graphene-supported ultrathin metal films and metal mesh were also achieved via physical deposition. All of them are highly applicable to a wide range of flexible and wearable devices.

15400414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15400414.value: The state of mental health in Hong Kong has received growing attention due to the increase in economic and societal stress. Family plays an important role in help seeking and care for emotional/mental problems of its members. Help-seeking behavior can be viewed as a reflection of family influence as well as an individual decision. The position that family is necessarily a source of help and support, however, cannot be assumed. Where do people in Hong Kong turn for help when they experience emotional/mental problems? What barriers do they perceive when they attempt to access professional services? How do family structure/dynamics function as risk or protective factors during the help-seeking process and influence the particular type of help sought? The proposed study is in collaboration with the Hong Kong Panel Study of Social Dynamics (HKPSSD), a longitudinal survey with a stratified sample of over 3,000 ethnic Chinese households and nearly 8,000 adult respondents. We will contribute 30% of the total survey costs, which will allow us to include questions on mental health and help seeking in the third wave of the survey in 2015 and to share the longitudinal data from the standard household and individual questionnaires of all waves. The new information we gather in the third wave can provide a detailed description of the patterns of help seeking and barriers to service use in Hong Kong. The special emphasis on family and the longitudinal design of HKPSSD will enable us to better unravel how family structure/dynamics predict individual mental health help-seeking behaviors and to avoid drawing causal inferences based on cross-sectional data, which are inherently less suitable than true longitudinal data. The data will be further contrasted with data we have collected and will continue to collect in several other cities in Mainland China. The study will enable us to better understand the bases of choices regarding help seeking and service use for mental health problems in Hong Kong, particularly from the family perspective. It also has implications for future policy decisions and innovative practice interventions that aim to reduce existing barriers and enhance the accessibility and quality of mental health and family services. Particularly, insight into the associations between family structure/dynamics and mental health/help seeking will be informative and useful in the development of mental health treatments that integrate family intervention and individual counseling, and in broadening family services to encompass mental health treatments. 由於人們經濟與社會壓力的不斷增加，精神健康問題在香港愈益凸顯。家庭在精神健康問題求助及對其成員情緒、精神問題的照顧方面扮演重要的角色。求助行為可被視為是家庭影響及個人決定的反映。然而，家庭卻不一定必然會提供幫助和支持。當遇到情緒或精神問題的時候，香港人到哪裡尋求幫助？當試圖使用專業服務的時候，人們會遇到哪些障礙？在求助過程中，家庭結構及動態是危險因素還是保護因素，從而影響求助的模式？本研究將利用香港社會動態追蹤調查(HKPSSD)的平臺，於2015年繼續實施跟蹤調查。問卷內容除了既有的有關人口、就業、家庭、社區、健康和經濟狀況等基本問題外，還包括測量精神健康、求助行為、服務使用及制度與文化障礙等新的問題。家庭的視角及HKPSSD追蹤式調查設計將有助於我們更好的理解家庭結構及動態怎樣影響個人精神健康的求助行為，從而避免基於橫斷面調查資料而得出的因果聯繫。香港的資料還會進一步同我們在北京等其他內地城市收集的資料進行比較研究。這項研究將有助於我們從家庭的視角進一步瞭解香港居民尋求專業精神健康幫助或使用相關服務的情況，從而為未來的政策制定和實務幹預提供啟示，以減少目前存在的障礙，提升精神健康和家庭服務的品質。

15400514.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15400514.value: The influences of globalization have permeated various aspects of life in contemporary society, from technical innovations, economic development, and life styles, to communication patterns. In a metropolitan society such as Hong Kong, people become multilingual and multicultural due to increasing intercultural contact, and this process affects acculturating individuals psychologically. Consequently, theorizing and research on multiculturalism have received growing attention in the literature. The present research seeks to examine individuals’ psychological outcomes and behavioral manifestations in response to globalization. Built on our previous work on immigration-based and globalization-based acculturation, this research attempts to assess global orientation in both the majority and minority groups in Hong Kong, and examine its impact on psychological well-being and sociocultural competence among community adults. The project will also compare the effects of global orientation on the attitudes and tolerance of local Hong Kong Chinese towards ethnic groups and the acculturation strategies and perceived discrimination among three minority groups, viz., Indians, Nepalese, and Pakistanis. Theoretically, this research program will offer another perspective to study individual differences in adjusting to the multicultural millennium, and adopt a new measure to assess feelings, thoughts, and behaviors arising from being acculturated to an emerging global culture. Practically, the findings of this study will provide strategic implications for managing intercultural relations among the majority and ethnic minority groups. 全球化的影響力已經滲透到現代社會中生活的各個方面，從科技創新、經濟發展以致生活方式和交流模式。在一個國際大都市如香港，由於越來越多跨文化交流，人們逐漸擁有多種語言和多元文化，這個過程在心理方面影響著他們的文化適應。因此，多元文化的理論和研究在文獻中日益受到重視。本研究旨在探討全球化對個人心理的影響以及行為表現。基於我們之前以移民為主及以全球化為主之文化適應的研究，此項研究旨在評估香港普遍大眾和少數族群的全球化取嚮，同時探討它對於社區內成年人的心理健康以及社會文化適應的影響。本研究也會比較全球化取嚮對於本地香港人對少數族裔的態度及包容的影響，以及三個少數族裔，包括印度、尼泊爾和巴基斯坦，在文化適應上的策略和受到歧視的情況。在理論層面上，此研究項目會提供另一個角度去了解對於適應多元文化時代的個人差異，並採納一個新的量度來評估人們在適應一個新興全球文化的感覺、思想和行為。從應用層面來說，此研究的結果將對處理大眾和少數族群之跨文化關係的策略上有重要的意義。

15401114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15401114.value: Family caregivers of people with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders are confronted by a various physical, psychosocial and financial hardships. This can adversely affect family members’ caregiving experiences, psychological distress, general well-being, and family relationships and emotional involvement, which in turn may contribute to a greater risk of patient relapse and non-recovery. While family psycho-education and mutual support groups are effective in reducing caregivers’ burden of care, these approaches usually require regular meetings and encounter difficulties in extensive training of group leaders/facilitators and engaging participants to actively share their caregiving experiences due to time inconvenience and fear/inability of expression of feelings. By virtue of the above, an alternate model of self-help program in book form named bibliotherapy, which is a guided reading and self-practice program with problem-solving training facilitated by a psychiatric nurse, has recently demonstrated evidences in clinical trials for families of depressive and psychotic patients by the research team, and other researchers. This proposed randomized controlled trial will test the effectiveness of a problem-solving based bibliotherapy program (PSBBP) for Chinese family caregivers in schizophrenia spectrum disorders. A repeated-measures, three-group design will be used to evaluate and compare the effects between two treatment groups(PSBBP and psycho-education group) and routine outpatient service and family support(controls with a self-help booklet) for 129 randomly selected family caregivers of outpatients with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders over a 12-month follow-up. Primary outcomes include caregivers’ burden of care, caregiving experiences and coping and social problem-solving skills using validated instruments. Secondary outcomes are patients’ mental state, functioning, perceived expressed emotion, and re-hospitalization rate. They will be measured at recruitment, one week, and 6 and 12 months following the interventions. Kaplan-Meier survival analysis will be used to analyze the relative risks of re-hospitalizations amongst the treatment and control groups over 12-month follow-up. It is hypothesized that the PSBBP participants will produce significantly better improvements in caregivers’ perceived burden, caregiving experience and coping and problem-solving skills than those in psycho-education and control groups over 12-month follow-up. Focus group interviews will be conducted after the first post-test with 20 caregivers (10 participants per group) in both treatment groups. Their data will be content analyzed to identify their perceived benefits, limitations and difficulties encountered and therapeutic ingredients of the two programs. With significant positive outcomes found in the PSBBP, this program will be adopted by community mental healthcare services in Hong Kong, and replicated in other Asian countries, to improve family-based care in schizophrenia-spectrum disorders. 撮要: 患有精神分裂症譜系障礙患者的家庭照顧者需要面對各種生理、心理、和經濟上的艱辛。這些辛酸不但對家庭成員造成精神困擾，而且影響他們生活質素和家庭成員之間的關係或感情，從而增加患者復發的風險，及妨礙患者康復。雖然家庭心理教育和互助小組能有效減少照顧者的心理和社交上的負擔，這些方法的困難在於必須定期舉行會議 ; 需要組長 (或主持) 接受一定程度的專業訓練 ; 並且要求參加者縱使時間不便及懼怕或無能力表達情感，仍需積極分享自己的照顧經驗。基於上述原因，一項嶄新自助治療方法定名為『閱讀療法』(bibliotherapy) ，近期在抑鬱或精神症失常 (或稱 思覺失調) 患者的家庭進行研究，展示了一些臨床實據。『閱讀療法』是一項利用書籍，自我實踐，並以精神科註冊護士引導的閱讀和解決問題培訓誴合而成的自助式干預方法。 這項擬定的隨機對照實驗將測試基於自助問題解決方式的『閱讀療法』（PSBBP）對精神分裂症譜系障礙患者的中國籍家庭照顧者的有效性。我們將會採用一個重複測量、三組對比的設計，評估和比較兩個治療組 (PSBBP 和心理教育課程) 和日常門診和家庭支持服務 (附有自助手冊的對照組) 的治療成果。以隨機抽樣形式挑選129位在門診部的精神分裂症譜系障礙患者的家庭照顧者接受其中一項干預，其後進行十二個月的跟進。主要評量結果包括照顧者的負擔、照顧者經驗、及應對壓力和解決社交性問題的能力。次要研究結果包括患者的精神狀態、日常功能、自覺表達情感、及住院率。參加者將會在招募階段及干預後一周、六個月和十二個月進行評估。再者在十二個月的跟進期，採用Kaplan-Meier生存分析，分析治療及對照組再次住院的相對風險。這項硏究假定為接受 PSBBP 的參加者相比起心理教育干預和對照兩組，在十二個月的跟進期內為止，將會在照顧者的負擔、照顧經驗、及應對壓力和解決問題的能力等方面有更顯著的改善。 經過干預後第一輪評估 (干預後一周內)，我們會對兩個治療組之中挑選二十位照顧者(每組十位) 進行焦點小組訪談。就著他們的分享資料進行內容性的數據分析，以識別他們對干預過程感受到的效益、限制和遭遇的困難，以及兩個干預方法治療性的成分。藉着『閱讀療法』(PSBBP) 研究中發現的正面成果，這干預方法將可採用於香港社區精神衛生服務，更可在亞洲其他國家進行複製研究，好讓照顧患有精神分裂症譜系障礙患者的家庭護理得到更大的改善。

15401114.label: Realisation of objectives
15401114.value: The above two study objectives were fully fulfilled. The study has tested and supported the two hypotheses that, comparing with those in psycho-education and routine care, the problem-solving-based bibliotherapy programme (PSBBP) for families in schizophrenia indicated significantly greater reduction of caregivers’ perceived burden and improvement in caregiving experiences at 1-week, 6-month and 12-month follow-ups; and greater improvements in patients’ mental state, psychosocial functioning and re-hospitalization rate at the 6-month and 12-month follow-ups. Apart from the very positive quantitative outcomes found, the caregivers’ feedbacks in this study also suggested some improvements: (1) having the manual in electronic format (pdf/online) for easy access and convenient to read; (2) weekly self-record for reading progress and difficulties in problem-solving activities; (3) having facilitated group sessions (and telephone calls for reminders) to guide/motivate problem-solving activities.

15401114.label: Major findings and research outcome
15401114.value: One hundred and forty of 460 eligible patients were randomly selected and contacted by the first author; 129 patients agreed to participate (response rate=92%). One hundred and twenty families (93%) completed the intervention and follow-up; one family in the PSBBP and two from usual care group withdrew, and also two participants in PSBBP and psychoeducation group were lost to contact during interventions and thus not included in the final analysis. While two caregivers discontinued their PSBBP participation, 38 (88%) completed ≥4 modules and 2 review sessions (>80% of PSBBP). Reasons for withdrawal/discontinuing from the PSBBP/study were: insufficient time to attend (n=2), patient’s mental state worsened (n=1), and lack of interest in participation (n=2). Qualitative feedbacks on the PSBBP were very positive (i.e., mainly helpful to their caregiving). Results of the MANOVA indicated a statistically significant difference between groups on the combined outcome variables, F(6,117)=6.34, p=0.001 (Wilks’ Lambda=0.86; a large effect with partial Eta squared=0.27). There was statistically significant interactive (Group x Time) treatment effects for the PSBBP (with large effect sizes), with significantly greater improvements in caregivers’ Caregiving Experience [F(1,116)=7.01, p=0.001, partial eta-squared=0.25] and its subscale scores [Positive experiences: F(1,116)=5.79, p=0.005; Negative experiences: F(1,116)=7.21, p=0.001] and family burden [F(1,117)=6.40, p=0.001, partial eta-squared=0.20]. The PSBBP group also had significant greater improvements in patients’ functioning [F(1,117)=6.04, p=0.005, partial eta-squared=0.20], mental state/symptom seveirty [F(1,117)=6.08, p=0.003, partial eta-squared=0.20], and length of re-hospitalizations [F(1,116)= 5.92, p=0.004, partial eta-squared=0.17]. The Helmert’s contrasts tests results indicated thatthe PSBBP had statistically greater significant improvements than the usual care (control) group on the changes in caregiving experience (both p=0.01), family burden (p=0.01 and 0.005), patient functioning (p=0.008 and 0.005), symptom severity (p=0.01 and 0.003), and length of re-hospitalisations (p=0.01 and 0.006) at 6-month and 12-month follow-ups. There were also statistically significant differences between the PSBBP and psycho-education group on the changes in family burden, patient functioning and symptom severity at 6- and 12-month follow-ups. However, there were no significant differences in the dosages of anti-psychotics (p=0.1), service use (p=0.15), medication adherence rates (p=0.17), and study sites (p=0.28) across measurements between-groups. Although no significant difference found between PSBBP and psycho-education group, the PSBBP group indicated greater reduction in the percentages of patients being re-hospitalised at the post-tests than usual care group [42.2% and 44.0% (pre-test), 33.0% and 43.4% (1-week post-intervention), 30.3% and 44.1% (6-month), and 27.5% and 42.8% (12-month)]; and these reductions were significantly different between-group across time (Kruskal-Wallis test, p=0.03).

15401114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15401114.value: Apart from the very positive quantitative outcomes found, the caregivers’ feedback in this study also suggested some improvements: (1) having the manual in electronic format (pdf/online) for easy access and convenient to read; (2) weekly self-record for reading progress and difficulties in problem-solving activities; (3) having facilitated group sessions (and telephone calls for reminders) to guide/motivate problem-solving activities. These suggestions are integrated into the latest version of PSBBP and thus we proposed another adequate-powered trial of this refined PSBBP with a diverse sample of family carers in recent-onset psychosis. Our research team has proposed another randomised controlled trial of the refined/modified online caregiving self-help manual to examine its early intervention effects on family caregivers of people with recent-onset psychosis in Hong Kong. We had submitted a proposal to Health and Medical Research Fund for such a controlled trial investigating its effects on wide varieties of family carers’ and patients’ outcomes over 12-month follow-up, compared with usual psychiatric outpatient care (or early intervention service) only. It has recently been recommended for being funded subject to clarifications and amendments within a month and thus we are waiting for the final decision for this funding.

15401114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15401114.value: This randomised controlled trial supported the effectiveness of the problem-solving based bibliotherapy program (PSBBP) for Chinese family caregivers in schizophrenia-spectrum disorders in Hong Kong. The results indicate that the PSBBP group reported significantly greater improvements in family burden and caregiving experience, and reductions in severity of psychotic symptoms and re-hospitalisations, than the conventional psycho-education and usual care group at a moderate long-term (12 months) follow-up, and is also a low-cost adjunct to usual psychiatric care. The study provides scientific evidence on the effectiveness of the problem-solving-based bibliotherapy for Chinese caregivers in schizophrenia, where self-help programs are relatively less common than Western countries. The PSBBP pilot-tested by the research team (Hong Kong/Australia) has been evaluated in this trial to confirm its long-term benefits to family burden, experiences and well-being in caregiving, and improving patients’ relapse and functioning. This self-help programme can be recommended to clinicians and managers to be integrated into the local, national and international community mental health services (i.e., the English and Chinese versions are ready for use). The findings shed light into the acceptability and clinical efficacy of self-help and problem-solving strategies for family caregivers in Chinese, Australian (with the original version), and Asian psychotic patient populations.

15401414.label: Project Objectives
15401414.value: We want to examine to which extent (versions of) design-led innovation is being used by companies in China and how this compares to companies in the western world. We will have a closer look at designers who are graduates from design schools teaching strategic design methods. We want to find out to what extent they are involved in innovation related activities. We will assess the barriers and enablers to adopting design-led innovation in China. Those barriers and enablers can originate from: history, politics, culture, etc. In this study we concentrate on cultural aspects. Asian societies are more prone to authoritarian leadership than societies that tend to more democratic leadership. Authoritarian leadership may not be the most effective leadership style when it comes to exploring and defining new inroads for innovation. It is often said that innovation requires an environment in which ideas can flourish, in which mistakes are allowed and in which freedom is given to individuals to experiment (e.g. Hauser, 1998). Compared to Japan and South-Korea, China scores lower on uncertainty avoidance and higher on long-term orientation (Hofstede et al. 2010). This normally this is positive for innovation. So, deeper insight in China is needed to understand the barriers and enablers to innovation. Based on the insights on barriers and enablers that affect the adoption of design-led innovation in China, strategies will be formulated to facilitate the successful adoption of such approaches. A judgment will be made as to how promising the various strategies are in dealing with the observed barriers to the adoption of design-led innovation. At the end of the project, much effort will be put behind the dissemination of the outcomes.A report will be written that will serve as a basis for publications in academic conferences and journals. The outcomes from the study will be the basis for re-writing teaching materials for various audiences: students of design strategy, design professionals and senior managers responsible for innovation. Those teaching materials can take many forms, such as: brochures, a website, a game, a video, etc.

15401414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15401414.value: In the last decade, design has become more popular as a means to stimulate innovation. In particular in the USA, many organizations employed strategic design consultancies to benefit from these new approaches to innovation. Many success cases are being presented on conferences, through books and TED-talks. Many educational institutions in design and business are now educating their students in design methods and approaches, like design thinking, to ensure that design not just applies to the making of more beautiful and functional objects, but to also to the formulation of new strategic directions. While the popularity of the more strategic design approaches has reached Asia and China, it remains unclear as to how successful they are in an Asian or in a Chinese context. There are eminent cultural differences between China and the USA. Despite its rich tradition of innovation in the past, China nowadays is more known for imitation strategies than for innovation. At the same time, China wants to move from low-end manufacturing to value-added manufacturing and services. This raises the questions as to which extent the strategic design approaches could be useful for China in making this transition. It is quite well possible that design methods that have been developed and proven to be successful in the western world, need to be adapted to be useful in China. This study aims to find out what kind of barriers and obstacles are potentially hindering the adoption of western design methods approaches to innovation in China and how those can be removed. The results of the study will bring insights to the innovation literature, in particular in relation to the impact of cultural differences on the implementation of design-led innovation approaches. It will inform design professionals and students of strategic design about new models of design-led innovation suitable for China and thereby serve as an alternative way to support organizations in China in becoming more innovative. 設計創新實踐在中國 摘要 過去的二十年，設計在創新環節中扮演了一個越來越重要的角色。特別在美國，很多企業和組織都聘請設計戰略咨詢專家，通過發掘創新潛力和市場機會來創造新的商業價值。各種會議，書籍，和活動都廣泛宣傳設計對創新的作用，比如TED演講中分享的設計創新案例。學校和教育機構的設計和商業專業也積極推廣設計的方法和工具。如對設計思維的運用，不僅能夠讓產品外觀更加美觀，還能為企業開拓創新戰略方向。 近年來，亞洲特別是中國逐漸認識到了設計戰略的重要性。但是因為文化和環境的不同，設計戰略的成效在中國仍然有待研究。雖然中國有著悠久的歷史和創新傳統，但是當代中國在國際創新領域卻多數扮演跟隨者和模仿者的角色。而政府和企業希望通過創新，提升企業競爭力，促進企業從傳統的低端製造業轉型為高附加值的生產和服務業。其中設計戰略如何幫助企業創新和成功轉型成為一個重要的課題。然而西方國家多年積累的設計方法可能需要本土化才能適用於中國的具體情況。因此，本項目會研究西方設計方法本土化的過程和存在的阻力，以及如何解決這些問題，並根據中國的具體情況提出改善方式。 本研究將會為創新研究領域，特別是對文化差異影響下的設計創新研究做出貢獻。對於實踐中的設計管理者，設計師，學生，以及企業提供了設計創新的方法和模式建立的可能性。 關鍵詞 設計創新，不確定因素，文化，以用戶為中心的設計，領導力

15401414.label: Realisation of objectives
15401414.value: The project objectives have been achieved through expert interviews and an alumni survey. The outcomes have been written down in papers and have been presented in conferences. This led to the following achievements: Insights into the utilisation of design-led innovation in China as compared to The USA and the Netherlands (based on survey) Insights into the barriers to implement Design Driven Innovation at the Actor level (designer, consumer, CEO), the Corporation level (strategy, organisation) and Ecosystem level (industry chain, government policies). Based on expert interviews. Insights in the difference in barriers between China, Europa and the USA (innovation readiness, orientation senior management). A Framework to stimulate innovation from Hong Kong (Ignite Innovation Program) that is being put into practice at the School of Design Guidelines for design education to stimulate design-driven education. These guidelines are an essential building block to define the curriculum for Innovation Design in Mainland China The objectives 3 and 4 have not been achieved completely since the discussions are still ongoing on what are the best strategies. Also the teaching materials are under development now. The wish is to deliver design education from Shenzhen to innovators from the Pearl-River Delta in collaboration with Tongji University. The implementation was slowed down for external reasons. It now seems there are new possibilities to proceed with this later.

15401414.label: Major findings and research outcome
15401414.value: In this project, that only had a modest funding amount and formally only ran for one year, much has been achieved. The topic chosen for this study was found to be important by many stakeholders, both in academia and in policy making. The literature review gave me already good ammunition to develop ideas about the differences in innovation between the Western world and China. This resulted in the first paper on the Ignite Innovation Program. I was invited to give a keynote in the Design for Business Research Conference in Melbourne on which I talked about strategic design in China. After this I was invited to turn my keynote into a paper for the Journal of Design, Business & Society. The interviews with the design-led innovators have been quite insightful and informative. These 20 interviews has been the basis for a paper in a world-wide leading design journal (Design Issues). A second paper has been accepted by Sheji: The Journal of Design Economics and Innovation. The alumni survey appeared to be more difficult. First of all it took rather long to finalise the discussions with IIT Chicago and the Delft University of Technology on the questionnaire. After that, the response rates were below expectations. We could still use the information to be presented in meetings, but it was not possible to incorporate in academic studies. Overall, the GRF project has helped to build the foundation of my research activities on strategic design in China. It has given very useful contents for my teaching activities and for guiding my PhD students. The topic of the adoption of strategic design continues to be of the utmost importance in this part of the world. It is quite encouraging to witness that policy makers at the highest level in China have adopted strategic design as an important building block to make organisations more innovative.

15401414.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15401414.value: Further development can be thought of in various directions. The ideas on design education need to be taken further to design educators to find out how design education can be changed to better equip design students to drive innovation. Some of the barriers on the adoption of strategic design by firms in China can be addressed. These include the information provision to CEOs and the on-the-job training of designers. In terms of collecting new information, it might be interesting to focus on Hong Kong, where it seems to be is more difficult to implement strategic design than in China. Maybe in a next study the focus could be on the barriers of adopting strategic design in Hong Kong. What can Hong Kong learn from China>

15401414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15401414.value: In this project the emphasis was on finding out how design could play a stronger role in making Chinese firms more innovative. Design is now mostly used at the operational level and not at the strategic level. In the research project it became clear that there are specific barriers in the Chinese context. For instance CEOs are not aware of the potential of strategic design. Also the designers are not always well equipped to be instrumental to innovation. A model is developed to ignite innovation. This model is referred to as the Ignite Innovation Program. The recommendations are to address the barriers to innovation and to improve the educational program of the design students. The outcomes are also used for national policy making in China and the development of Design Innovation as a field of study.

15402714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15402714.value: Background: There is a high prevalence of obesity among children with disability and special needs, which is increasingly recognized as an international phenomenon and one that requires active intervention to address. Obesity is a significant health concern for children and adults with disabilities, and many children with disability will grow into obese adults with all the associated chronic health problems, such as diabetes, hypertension and cardiovascular disease. There are as a result significant health and social-related issues for the individual, their family and care services. Interventions to promote physical activity, improve dietary habits and reduce sedentary behaviors have been recommended for weight reduction. There is clear evidence of the efficacy of interventions to establish health-enhancing behaviors at the individual level to reduce health-risks such as obesity and the wider associated health complications. The limited maintenance of behavioral change seen in initial intervention efforts may be due to the failure to take account of how social contextual factors such as collective efficacy that may influence the relationships between self-efficacy and behavior at group level. Aim: The aims are to evaluate the effectiveness of a school-based weight management program and to further examine the mediating effect of collective efficacy on BMI, body fat composition and waist-hip ratio of students with mild intellectual disability (MID) in the intervention group; and the secondary outcome measures are improvement in quality of life, self-esteem, body shape and body image, self-efficacy in peer interactions, physical activity and nutrition. Methods: A randomized controlled trial with a repeated measures control design with pre- and post-interventions, mid-evaluation and follow-up measures at four time points. Four special schools will be randomized into either an intervention group (n=70) or a control group (n=70). Thirty-five overweight or obese P.3-F.4 students with MID who meet the inclusion criteria will be recruited from each special school (140 overweight/obese students in total). The 8-month 24-session program involving peers and parents has a direct mediating effect to modify overweight students’ health behaviors and lose weight. Ten study tools will be used for outcome measures at the four time points: pre- and post-intervention, mid-evaluation and follow-up measures of an 8-month weight management program. Implications: It is anticipated taht an 8-month school-based weight management program involving peers and parents based on collective efficacy of social learning theory is superior to conventional interventions for overweight and obese students with intellectual disability in terms of primary and secondary outcome changes. 這項研究目的是使用集体功效之社交學習来執行及評估校本体重管理课程的效能. 研究對象來自4間學校，分為對照組和實驗組; 對象為 8-16 歲過重及肥胖輕度智障的兒童青少年及其家長. 研究是採用了隨機控制實驗的方法. 體重控制課程設計針對體能和營養，亦鼓勵和邀請家長參與這個管理體重課程，從而減低學童肥胖所引致的疾病，例如心臟病，高血壓，中風和糖尿病等。此次研究是需要 家長及子女參與飲食營養輔導、運動量評估，和管理體重課程。 有關之調查結果將有助設計針對過重及肥胖之輕度智障兒童及青少年體重控制課程

15402714.label: Realisation of objectives
15402714.value: It was hypothesized that students in the intervention group would experience reductions in body mass index (BMI), body fat percentage, and waist-hip ratio compared to the control group as primary outcome changes. Secondary outcome changes were improvements in quality of life, self-esteem, social relationship, perceived body shape and figure rating scale, self-efficacy in physical activity and nutrition. To achieve the above objectives and hypotheses, the present study was designed as a randomized controlled trial comparing intervention and control groups in pre- and post- intervention assessments of a 12-month SBWMP extended from school to the home setting by involving parents via mHealth. Firstly, this study aimed to measure the differences in anthropometrics, including body weight, BMI, and triceps and subscapular skinfold thickness. Secondly, we aimed to investigate whether extending the SBWMP from school to home improved lifestyle health knowledge using the food pyramid test, the sports pyramid test and the snack choice test with the students’ and their parents’ preferred cooking methods. Thirdly, the study aimed to measure the students’ and their parents’ preferred cooking methods. Finally, we examined the students’ self-efficacy in nutrition and peer interaction, and the psychosocial impacts of these factors on their relationships with peers, parents and school teachers as well as on their self-esteem, quality of life, perceived body shape and perceived body image. All the above objectives have been achieved with the study findings showed in the research outcomes through the collaborative efforts among the intersect oral team. Schools were regarded as a strategic setting in health promotion and health education for children since the 1980s. The World Health Organisation (WHO) Health-Promoting School (HPS) framework was widely adopted by primary and secondary schools globally since the 1990s. The framework has been promoted by some Hong Kong healthcare experts and universities in local public primary and secondary schools since the early 2000s, but evidence of its effectiveness is inconclusive. This situation leads to the call of international HPS scholars for more qualitative research in order to better realize the process of implementation, and to develop theoretical understanding of the HPS adapted in local contexts. Therefore, a grounded theory approach was adopted in the study in order to fill the knowledge gap. I supervised a PhD student using a qualitative research design to examine the process how health promoters in the schools become, attain and sustain as health-promoting institutions. The study had been completed and the student passed his PhD viva examination. The research study aimed to generate a grounded theory from schools implementing and sustaining to be a health-promoting school (HPS), or the status of a health-promoting institution. The main research question of the study was: What is the process whereby schools become and sustain as health-promoting institutions? The class grounded theory (CGT) was adopted in this study. A total of 22 interviews (10 individuals and 12 focused groups) were conducted. There were 42 participating individuals interviewed from 15 schools of the public sector in Hong Kong for this study. Overall, there were 8 principals, 5 vice-principals, 13 teachers, 9 school nurses (Registered Nurses), 1 social worker, 1 non-teaching staff (clerk), 3 parents (representatives of the Parent-Teacher Association), and 2 primary school students (student health ambassadors) participated in the interviews. Both normal and special HPS and non-HPS schools were included in the study. Demographics were considered as confounders in general linear model and binary logistic regression model analyzing the relationship between the SBWP and the outcome variables. Categorical demographics such as gender, birthplace and religious belief were statistically controlled. Demographic variable measured with dichotomous scale or ordinal scale was statistically controlled when its association with an outcome has a Spearman’s correlation coefficient larger than 0.2. Baselines of dependent variables were statistically controlled. Little research has been conducted to examine the effectiveness of strategies involving parents in the weight management of children and adolescents with IDs. Parents play an important role in enhancing the adoption of healthy lifestyle behaviors and regular physical activity by children and adolescents with IDs. They are the key persons in preparing and supporting the adoption of these healthy lifestyle behaviors. They act as role models who reinforce and monitor their children’s health behaviors in the home setting. There are, as a result, significant health- and social-related issues for the individual, their family and care services. Interventions involving parents’ commitment and technology to promote physical activity, improve dietary habits and reduce sedentary behaviors have been recommended for overweight and obese children with IDs in weight reduction. 1.3. Hypotheses It was hypothesized that students in the intervention group would experience reductions in body mass index (BMI), body fat percentage, and waist-hip ratio compared to the control group as primary outcome changes. Secondary outcome changes were improvements in quality of life, self-esteem, social relationship, perceived body shape and figure rating scale, self-efficacy in physical activity and nutrition. 1.4. Study Aim The present study was designed as a randomized controlled trial comparing intervention and control groups in pre- and post- intervention assessments of a six-month SBWMP extended from school to the home setting by involving parents via mHealth. Firstly, this study aimed to measure the differences in anthropometrics, including body weight, BMI, and triceps and subscapular skinfold thickness. Secondly, we aimed to investigate whether extending the SBWMP from school to home improved lifestyle health knowledge using the food pyramid test, the sports pyramid test and the snack choice test with the students’ and their parents’ preferred cooking methods. Thirdly, the study aimed to measure the students’ and their parents’ preferred cooking methods. Finally, we examined the students’ self-efficacy in nutrition and peer interaction, and the psychosocial impacts of these factors on their relationships with peers, parents and school teachers as well as on their self-esteem, quality of life, perceived body shape and perceived body image.

15402714.label: Major findings and research outcome
15402714.value: After the 12-month program (T0, T1, T2, & T3), anthropometric measures, lifestyle health knowledge test, pyschosoical well-being outcomes, self-efficacy, social relationships and preferences of cooking method were conducted for students in the intervention and control groups. The anthropometric measures included height, weight, BMI, triceps skinfold thickness, scapular skinfold thickness, waist-hip ratio and body fat percentage. Skinfold of scapular was significantly thicker (4.77 [2.88, 6.66], p<.001) and waist to hip ratio was significantly lower (-0.02 [-0.04, -0.001], p=.010) in the intervention group than in the control group at T3 from T0. There were lower body weight, BMI, waist to hip ratio, triceps and subscapular skinfold thickness in the intervention group than in the control group, especially the differences were statistically significant between T0 and T3 in subscapular skinfold, waist to hip ratio. Perceived body image scale and figure rating scale in the intervention group were significantly lower than in the control group. The lifestyle health knowledge test of intervention group was higher than control group at time 3 in terms of food pyramid (3.13[1.56, 4.7], p<.001), sports pyramid (0.86 [-0.03, 1.75], p=.02) and snack choice test (11.8 [1.51, 2208], p=.01) and they all were significantly better in the intervention group than in the control group at T3 from T0. Scores on quality of life (7.95 [6.19, 9.72], p<.001) and self-esteem ()2.14 [.83, 3.42], p<.001) in the intervention group were significantly higher than those in the control group. Scores on figure rating scale (-1.30 [-2.09. -.52], p<.001) and perceived body image scale (-.21 [-.40, -.02], p=.008) in the intervention group were significantly lower than those in the control group. The adjusted differences in scores of nutrition self-efficacy scale (2.09 [0.18, 4], p=.10) and self-efficacy in peer interaction scale (5.12 [2.68, 7.56], p<0.001) were significantly higher in the intervention group than in the control group. The adjusted differences in scores of relationship with father (.5 [-.2, 1.2], p=.080), mother (.02 [-.71, .75], p=.950), and teachers (.38 [-.13, .88], p=.070) were higher in the intervention group than in the control group although the results were not significant. The study findings showed that the intervention group, which participated in the 12-month school-based weight management program focused on collective efficacy with social support from peers, teachers and parents, experienced a positive effect on BMI, subscapular skinfold and waist-to-hip ratio for the primary outcome measures, and on self-esteem, self-efficacy and social relationship for the secondary outcome measures.

15402714.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15402714.value: As children age, more teamwork is needed between the parent and child. For most adolescents, the advice is targeted directly at the adolescent himself or herself. Even at a young age, however, the child should be included in identifying feasible and desirable goal behaviors and strategies for change. The study findings show that the children, adolescents and families had benefited from the 12-month SBWP program extended to home environment with parental involvement and provided psychosoical support to the overweight and obese children and adolescents with intellectual disability. Thus, future research should focus on additional strategies via mHealth tools to support parents to promote and monitor healthy lifestyles for overweight and obese children with intellectual disability, in order to reinforce and monitor postie behavior change in the home setting. The effects of health education may extend from school to home. mHealth tools, Whatapp instant messaging and video clips were elements of the intervention to reinforce health education at home and promote the family's engagement in health-promoting activities.

15402714.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15402714.value: Today, the specific intervention strategies to promote healthy healthy for children with special needs are limited. The findings provide an evidence-based intervention strategy to guide weight reduction program re-development, especially for students with special needs, and to improve the ability of modeling studies to accurately predict their impact. This study was conducted to determine the impact of a school-based weight reduction program that extended to a home setting with parental participation, in order to promote healthy lifestyles for children with special needs. Health professionals and parents can advocate in their communities for school meals and home meals that meet dietary guidelines, more frequent and effective physical activity programs in schools with parental participation, and more after-school and summer programs that include heart-healthy food choices and physical activity in order to reduce chronic health conditions in later life. The study findings can provide an intervention protocol for the Child Health Policy that was recently drafted by the Hong Kong Paediatric Foundation. Department of Health and Education Bureau in Hong Kong should make recommendations to integrate the key elements of the protocols into the school curriculum and develop school health policy to promote healthy lifestyle behaviors for students in school settings, with parental involvement.

15403114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15403114.value: Sciatica, a common type of nerve disease, leads to excruciating and unbearable afflictions; in particular, the hyper-sensitivity of the skin causes unimaginable pain. Various attempts have been made to treat this disease through pharmaceuticals, surgery, physical and psychological therapy, and non-prescription treatments and so on. Nevertheless, the effect of these conventional treatments is not prolonged or significant. Some of these treatments even cause side effects, such as adverse psychological effects, and the recovery rate is not as high as expected. This study aims to develop a textile-based transdermal thermo-stimulated drug-delivery system to treat sciatica without undesirable effects. Unlike existing textile-based drug-release systems, this system can effectively deliver a precise dose, and the release rate, which is controlled by the self-heating of the system, can be independent of the environmental impact and offer convenience and comfort to patients. The performance of the system will be assessed using both objective instrumental methods and subjective clinical trials. Both Chinese medicine and textile technology will be employed to enhance the functionality of the system and thus provide an innovative potential curing method for sciatica patients, which will help the patients and their families to improve their quality of life and reduce their burdens. The proposed textile-based drug-release system combines various advanced technologies with Chinese medicine and textile design. It is expected that the developed system will span multidisciplinary gaps and contribute to a new form of medical therapy. Furthermore, this study is a pilot study for demonstrating the possibilities of a drug-release system that uses hollow fibers and self-heating. The proposed system can be applied to other drugs upon the demonstration of successful application to borneol and subsequently used to treat other diseases. The developed system will not only offer great benefits to patients but also provide a fundamental understanding of smart textiles in medical aspects and Chinese medicine, thus accelerating the innovative development of smart garments in medical applications.

15403114.label: Major findings and research outcome
15403114.value: Scientific research was conducted on the drug delivery performance of the hollow fibers - based textile materials using a system of drug loading and releasing for examining the effectiveness. The thermal distribution of the drug delivery textile layers was examined in accordance with the conceptual idea of developing a transdermal thermo-stimulated drug-delivery apparel. A simulation model of the electrical resistance, temperature precision and temperature ventilation of the thermal conductive textiles was studied. This series of studies and publications led to the design of a textile-based transdermal thermo-stimulated drug-delivery apparel for providing an effective and convenient therapy . The developed apparel offers the potential benefits, i.e. in a precise and controllable rate of drug delivery, to achieve maximum convenience and comfort for guiding the industrialization and commercialization of the medical apparels.

15403114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15403114.value: The potential for further development of the research is to develop an integrated systematic approach (product design) to the design of the textile-based transdermal thermo-stimulated drug-delivery apparel products to address the needs of end users, i.e. patients who need a long-term medical therapy, and to reveal the multidisciplinary connections among fashion technology, human science and the benefits of society. The conceptual idea of the apparel products will be realized with specific manufacturing processes. Through the investigation of a new form of medial treatment, a multi-functional and high-value-added apparel products will be designed with the advancement of both drug delivery and thermal conductive E-fabric layers. Potential garments and accessories can be further developed with the interrelationships of both fashion and function.

15403114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15403114.value: This research is to explore the controlled and precise delivery of loaded-drugs from textile materials to human skin with thermo-stimulation technology. A comprehensive medication and healthcare protection to patients via drug-skin permeation can be provided with the following significance which include 1) offering repeatable drug loading, 2) providing a controllable and precise manner with defined drug delivery strategies, 3) providing a specific thermal energy and thermal distribution for different medical requirements, 4) being commercialized and industrilized. This project was therefore to compensate the limitations of conventional drug delivery system as well as to introduce a novel drug delivery model with the implementation of the apparel product design. Any type of drug that requires delivery in a precise and controlled manner could be loaded into the textile materials; therefore, the potential applications of this apparel development are numerous and significant in a wide range of medical therapeutic functions.

15403414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15403414.value: The feet, although very useful for support and locomotion, have often been neglected in footwear design. In fact footwear fit is greatly determined by shoe-last (a 3D mold for making the shoe). An improperly designed shoe-last will result in bad fit, causing foot injuries and illnesses. There are two steps for better fit – a well-designed standard (or master) shoe–last; and an accurate sizing system. Master shoe-last is usually tested for fit using fit trials, however due to cost not all the sizes are fit tested. Therefore, the method for creating sizes might result in ill-fitted shoe in spite of perfectly designed master shoe-last. Currently, sizing is based on foot length and foot width (or foot girth), but research has indicated that sizing based on foot length and foot width may not be appropriate. Given that many anthropometric measures can be extracted from a foot, there should be a scientific basis on selected the ‘best’ anthropometric measure for sizing. What is ‘best’? A method to calculate the relative accuracy or fit level for different sizing parameters is needed. Due to availability of 3D foot scanners, it is essential to explore methods to use the complete 3D foot shape rather than only anthropometric measures to extract sizing parameters. Appropriate mathematical techniques have to be used to process complete 3D foot shape. Once we have determined the sizing parameter, size increment and grading technique have to be computed. Currently proportion grading technique is used. Size increments of 5mm (Chinese) to 10mm (Mondopoint system) are used for length. Parameter increment has not been scientific determined. Which size increment is accurate? Is size increment related to the size of the foot? Furthermore, other factors may influence footwear sizing. Different footwear style covers different foot region, and it might affect number of sizes or fit when considering style specific footwear. Furthermore, secular trends are common and it also affects sizing. This research will explore methods to find the best sizing parameters from anthropometric measures and the complete 3D foot shape. In addition, prediction accuracy method will be used to compare the different sizing parameters, parameter increments, and grading rules. Models will be developed for style specific sizing and sizing to account for secular trends. Experiments will be carried out to validate the results. Results of this research will provide a scientific basis for footwear sizing and grading. 雖然人類足部對身體支撐和運動非常有用，但是在鞋類設計中常常被忽視。事實上鞋楦 （一種用來制鞋的三維模具）是鞋類適合度的關鍵因素。一個設計不當的鞋楦會導致配合不良，造成足部傷害和疾病。好的適合度有兩個要素：一個精心設計的標準鞋楦; 和一個準確的尺碼體系。標準鞋楦通常經過適合度測試，但是由於成本原因，不是所有的尺碼都經過測試。因此，用於建立尺碼體系的方法可能會導致適合度的減低。目前，尺碼體系是基於足長和足寬（或足周長）建立的，但研究表明，根據足長和足寬的尺碼體系未必是最適當的。鑒於足部有許多的人體測量參數，尺碼體系應該有一個科學依據來選擇“最佳”的測量參數。什麼是“最好的”？不同的尺碼參數需要一種計算相對準確性或適合度的方法。三維足部掃描儀的應用使得我們可以探索使用三維完整足形的方法，而不是僅僅使用人體測量來提取尺碼參數。處理三維足形需要恰當的數學計算方法。一旦我們確定了尺碼參數，參數增量和分級方法也要計算出來。目前的尺碼體系使用的是按比例的分級方法。長度參數的增量為5毫米（中國）到10毫米（Mondopoint系統）。參數增量尚未用科學方法檢驗。哪個參數增量是更準確的？參數增量是否和足部大小相關？此外，其它因素也可能影響鞋類尺碼。不同的鞋類款式覆蓋不同的足部區域，這可能會影響尺碼數目或適合度 。另外長期趨勢也會影響尺碼。本研究將基於人體測量和三維足型，探討不同方法以找到最佳尺碼參數。預測精度的方法將被用於比較不同的尺碼參數， 參數增量和分級標準。開發鞋楦模型時也會考慮特定款式和長期趨勢因素。結果最後會用實驗的方法來驗證。這項研究成果將對鞋類尺碼和分級體系提供科學的依據。
