15502414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502414.value: Understanding how residents view and react to local tourism development is one of the most important topics in the tourism literature. To date, most studies focused on the formation and change of locals’ attitudes toward tourism development, whose predictive power to behavioral responses remains controversial. This study proposes the notion of “resident sentiment” as a more encompassing concept to describe local residents’ overall perceptions and views of tourism development, with attitude as a constituent part of sentiment. Further, the research team suggests that there are two levels of sentiment: individual sentiment and public sentiment, with the former being a broad and general internal dispositional system shaped mainly by private encounters, whereas the latter being shared sentiment resulted from dynamic, multilateral interactions among people. Based on the social representations theory and extant tourism studies, the research team suggests personal experience, social interactions, as well as destination-specific extrinsic characteristics as sources of individual resident sentiment. The research team further conceptualizes media sentiment as the proxy of a community’s public sentiment, thus an analysis of mass and social media content will reveal much of the collective sentiment of a community. A model is hence proposed aiming to illustrate the determinants and consequences of resident sentiment as well as the general pattern of interrelationships among the key variables of interest. To empirically test the model, the research team proposes to use Hong Kong as the study context and examine its resident sentiment of tourism and mainland Chinese tourists. To this end, the research team will take a multi-disciplinary, mixed-method approach by incorporating concepts and methods applied in the fields of tourism, sociology, social psychology, and information management. Specifically, a five-phase research plan is developed, which involves a comprehensive literature review, in-depth interviews, and phone surveys of Hong Kong residents to examine the individual resident sentiment. In building a model of the determinants and consequences of resident sentiment, this study attempts to break new ground in tourism impact studies. Meanwhile, media sentiment is detected via news and online social media using content analysis and text mining algorithms. By incorporating media sentiment in the conceptualization, this study transcends traditional individual-based, self-reported resident attitude studies, and avoids some of the methodological bias plagued tourism studies in the past. Combined, this study attempts to make a theoretical breakthrough in existing resident attitude literature and provides a new perspective in understanding resident responses to tourism development. 了解居民如何看待當地旅遊開發以及他們對此的反應，是旅遊文獻中最重要的話題之一。迄今為止，大多數研究集中於當地居民對旅遊開發態度之形成和變化，其對行為反應的預測能力仍具有爭議。本研究提出了“居民情緒”的概念，此概念內涵廣泛，描述了當地居民對旅遊開發的總體觀點與看法，而態度是情緒的一個組成部分。研究小組進一步提出，情緒有兩個層次：個人情緒和公眾情緒。前者是廣義與總體的內部處理系統，主要由私人接觸形成；而後者是指由於人際間動態且多邊互動形成的共有感情。根據社會表徵理論和現存旅遊研究，研究小組提出：個人體驗、社會互動，以及特定目的地之外在特徵，是居民個人情緒之來源。研究小組進一步概念化媒體情緒，認為它代表了一個社區的公共情緒；由此對大眾和社會媒體內容進行分析，揭示社區的許多集體情感。在此提出一個模型，旨在說明居民情緒之影響因素與後果，以及主要變量之間相互關係。為了實證檢驗此模型，研究小組提出利用香港作為研究背景，研究香港居民對於旅遊和中國內地遊客的情緒。為此，研究小組將採用多學科的，混合研究方法，整合了應用於旅遊、社會學、社會心理學與信息管理領域的概念和方法。具體來說，開發了一個分為五階段的研究方案，包括全面文獻回顧、訪談和電話調查的香港居民，了解居民情緒。在構建居民情緒之決定因素與後果的模型時，本研究試圖在旅遊影響研究方面有所突破。與此同時，通過新聞與網絡社交媒體並利用內容分析和文本挖掘算法，檢測媒體情緒。本研究把媒體情緒整合於概念化中，超越了傳統的以個人為基礎的自我報告的居民態度研究，避免了過去困擾旅遊研究的一些方法論偏見。本研究試圖在現有的居民態度文獻理論上有所突破，提供了新的角度了解居民對旅遊業發展的反應。

15502414.label: Realisation of objectives
15502414.value: All proposed research objectives have been 100% achieved. A comprehensive review of literature was conducted in psychology, sociology, economics, marketing, and tourism studies. Interviews were conducted with permanent residents of Hong Kong on their attitudes and mentalities toward Mainland Chinese tourists, revealing their underlying psychological mechanism. A total of 39 semi-structured interviews demonstrated that unfavourable attitudes toward Mainland Chinese tourists have exceeded neutral or positive attitudes. Moreover, Hong Kong residents share two intertwined mentalities: a sense of superiority and feeling of deprivation. Based on the interviews and literature review, Hong Kong residents’ sentiment toward Mainland Chinese tourists is conceptualized as a formative construct made up of five different indicators that are not interchangeable – cognitive and affective impressions of Mainland Chinese tourists, identification with Mainland Chinese tourists, feeling of superiority, and feeling of deprivation. A questionnaire was developed based on the literature review and interview results. A pilot test was conducted with a convenience sample of Hong Kong residents (n = 199) to check the appropriateness of wording, clarity of instruction, and other design issues. The formal data collection was conducted online with a quota sample of Hong Kong residents. One thousand questionnaires were completed by a representative sample in terms of age, gender, and household income. Data were imported into Smart-PLS 3.2 for further analyses. Exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses were used to identify the measurement structure of resident sentiment. Then, the relationships between resident sentiment and its antecedents and consequences were examined and a refined structural model based on the framework presented in the proposal was derived. In addition to survey based research in identifying individual sentiment, we conducted a large-scale longitudinal news sentiment analysis to track and unveil the evolving patterns of community perception (i.e., public sentiment), in the context of Hong Kongers’ view of Mainland Chinese tourists, and to examine its relations with typical socio-economic factors. Specifically, we collected data from WiseNews database, the largest newspaper collection in the Greater China region, deriving a news dataset containing 72,755 news articles related to the subject of interest from major Chinese language newspapers. We applied the optimized model to classify news articles into positive and negative polarity and computed the overall community sentiment score for 156 calendar months since 2003. Finally, the Resident Sentiment Indicators were aggregated across the polarity of news articles by different time intervals. Results show that the overall Hong Kong news sentiment score fluctuated between 0.30 and 0.98, where 0 = negative and 1 = positive.

15502414.label: Major findings and research outcome
15502414.value: The study of attitudes and mentalities of Hong Kong residents toward Mainland Chinese tourists via a qualitative study found that Hong Kong residents share two intertwined mentalities: a sense of superiority and feeling of deprivation. Findings are discussed under the social identity meta-theoretical framework, and a cyclic psychological mechanism of “social categorization – social identity – social comparison” is identified underlying resident attitude and community mentality formation. This is discussed in the article, “Feeling Superior or Deprived? Attitudes and Underlying Mentalities of Residents towards Mainland Chinese Tourists,” published in Tourism Management. Hong Kong residents’ sentiment toward Mainland Chinese consists of five dimensions: cognitive and affective impressions of Mainland Chinese tourists, identification with Mainland Chinese tourists, feeling of superiority, and feeling of deprivation. Consequences of resident sentiment include interacting more with Mainland Chinese tourists, talking with acquaintances about positive news on Mainland Chinese tourists, and supporting Hong Kong to attract more Mainland Chinese tourists. Details of the model and testing procedures are discussed in a paper under preparation for journal submission. Public sentiment analysis result shows that the overall news sentiment score of the Hong Kong community fluctuated between 0.30 and 0.98 with an average of 0.70, which demonstrates a generally positive perception of Mainland Chinese tourists. Our analysis also shows that the overall sentiment score is significantly correlated with Mainland Chinese tourist density (as compared to local population), local unemployment rate, and news volume. The methodology of the sentiment analytics is explained in the paper, “Predictive Accuracy of Sentiment Analytics for Tourism: A Metalearning Perspective on Chinese Travel News”, published in the Journal of Travel Research. The public sentiment analysis results and their explanations are illustrated in the article under review by Journal of Travel Research, “Reading a Community’s Mind: A Longitudinal News Sentiment Analysis in Hong Kong.”

15502414.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15502414.value: The research team is interested in building the current project into a longitudinal research program, to regularly track the evolvement of Hong Kong resident sentiment of tourism. The sentiment model developed by this study could be validated in other populations (e.g., Hong Kong residents’ sentiment toward other tourist groups, other destinations’ resident sentiment toward different tourist groups). It is also anticipated that several subsequent publications will be prepared in the next two years as the project collected a wealth of data yet to be fully explored within the project period. The research team will prepare a follow-up study proposal for funding from GRF, and possibly from the Public Policy Research Funding Scheme.

15502414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15502414.value: Understanding how residents view and react to tourism development is important. To date, most studies focused on locals’ “attitudes”, whose accuracy in predicting behavior remains inconclusive. This study investigated HK residents’ “sentiment,” a more comprehensive concept, of Mainland Chinese tourists through a variety of research methods. Local residents reported that Hong Kongers have a sense of superiority and, at the same time, a feeling of deprivation when it comes to their views of Mainland Chinese tourists. Further, the overall sentiment includes residents’ impressions of (what do they think and feel of Mainlanders) and identification with (extent of respect and commonality) Mainland Chinese. When residents have more positive sentiment, they interact more with Mainland Chinese tourists, talk with acquaintances about positive news on Mainland Chinese tourists, and support HK to attract more Mainland Chinese tourists. Analysis of local newspapers published since 2003 show that news reporting is generally positive, and the tone of reporting is correlated with Mainland Chinese tourist density, local unemployment rate, and news volume. The study could help the government monitor sentiment changes, and develop/adjust policies accordingly. Further, the business community needs to be aware of the public sentiment, which will inevitably affect business plans and strategies.

15502514.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502514.value: There is widespread evidence that informed agents such as institutional investors are active before corporate events. However, little is known about how institutions gain their informational advantage and exploit it in short-term trading. In this study, we will employ transaction-level trading data to examine whether institutions trade on private information around financial restatement announcements. Specifically, we will first examine whether institutional investors earn more profits by trading ahead of general investors before restatement announcements. We will then infer whether the advanced trading is consistent with institutions gaining information through private connections with auditors and executives of restating firms. Finally, we will study the information leakage through such connections. Prior studies provide mixed evidence on informed trading by institutions. Some studies suggest that institutions overall do not generate returns higher than the market, while others suggest that institutions are able to execute profitable trades based on private information. In this study, we will use unique intraday trading data to assess the informational advantage of institutions around public disclosure of financial reporting failures. We choose the restatement announcement setting because restatement is a significant, negative event. Moreover, we will focus on restatements initiated by firms and auditors. For these restatement cases, the arrival and nature of information is largely uncertain for investors with no access to corporate insiders. Therefore, advanced trading by institutions, if detected, would likely to be driven by private information. Our first hypothesis is thus stated (in alternative form) as: Institutional investors earn profits by trading ahead of other investors before the public disclosure of restatements; the advanced trading is associated with private connections. Institutions often have access to corporate inside information through their connections with experts, including executives and auditors. Anecdotal evidence suggests that insider trading is rampant in financial markets. For example, U.S. authorities have recently filed criminal and civil charges against a former partner at KPMG, who allegedly passed confidential information to his friend regarding upcoming corporate announcements by KPMG’s clients. But, it is by no means obvious that the benefits of sharing confidential information exceed the litigation and reputation costs. Ultimately, it is an empirical question. Our second hypothesis is thus stated (in alternative form) as: Institutional investors are likely to receive private information from auditors and/or executives. Full and fair disclosure of information is essential in creating robust capital markets. Our study will provide important evidence for institutional trading on connections around restatement announcements. 有广泛的证据表明，知情者，如机构投资者在公司事件之前较活跃。然而，鲜为人知的是，机构是如何获得他们的信息优势，并利用它的短线交易。在这项研究中，我们将采用交易层面的交易数据，研究围绕财务重述公告的私人信息机构是否交易。具体来说，我们会先研究是否机构投资者通过交易提前广大投资者的重述公告之前赚取更多的利润。然后，我们将推断先进的交易是否与机构通过与核数师，并重申公司高管专用连接获得的信息是一致的。最后，我们将研究通过这种连接的信息泄漏。 此前的研究提供了体制上的知情交易混合的证据。一些研究表明，机构整体不产生收益高于市场，而其他人认为，机构可以基于私人信息，以执行有利可图的行业。在这项研究中，我们将使用独特的盘中交易数据，以评估各地公开披露的财务报告故障机构的信息优势。我们选择了重述公告的设置，因为重述是一个显著，负面事件。此外，我们将侧重于公司和审计师发起的重述。对于这些重述的情况下，信息的到来对于没有企业内部消息的投资者是不确定的。因此，机构先进的交易，如果检测到，很可能是由私人信息驱动的。因此，我们的第一个假设是说（以另一种形式）为：机构投资者的交易领先于其他投资者公开披露重述前赚取利润;先进的交易与专用连接相关联。 机构往往通过与专家，包括管理人员和审计师的连接获得企业内部信息。有证据表明，金融市场内幕交易猖獗。例如，美国当局最近提出刑事和民事指控毕马威前合伙人，据称他把毕马威会计师事务所的客户即将公布的企业机密信息给他的朋友。但是，这绝不是显而易见的共享机密信息的利益超过了诉讼和信誉成本。归根结底，这是一个经验问题。因此，我们的第二个假设是说（以另一种形式）为：机构投资者可能会收到审计师及/或管理人员的私人信息。 充分和公平的信息披露是建立强大的资本市场是必不可少的。我们的研究将提供围绕重述公告的连接机构交易的重要证据。

15502514.label: Realisation of objectives
15502514.value: The paper has successfully achieved the objective by examining institutional investors' trading around an adverse corporate event and the persistence of their trades. We find that some institutions indeed make profits on pre-event-announcement trading. Our analyses show that the information advantage of these institutions are likely due to private connections with the firms, and their trading performance deteriorates once the fund-firm connections are cut off. The findings provide a reasonable answer to the general question of the source of institutional investors’ information advantage. On a separate note on the budget expenditure, the main reason I spent less than originally proposed is because a significant amount of the funding was originally set aside to purchase the Abel Noser (formerly known as Ancerno) data on institutional trades. However, the data provider has decided to permanently discontinue the program with academia for confidentiality reason. This is unexpected and completely out of our control, therefore, we are unable to use the funding to purchase the data originally intended for.

15502514.label: Major findings and research outcome
15502514.value: This article uses transaction-level fund trading data from the United States to study the information advantage of institutional investors. Our research design follows a two-step procedure. In the first step, we identify funds that sell shares in firms before their unexpected revelation of stock option backdating (BD) investigations, and thus establish fund–firm pairs of interest. In the second step, we focus on trading that takes place at other times and find that the funds are more likely to make correct trades before the earnings announcements of their paired firms and that their trading performance for paired firms is better in general. This superior performance, however, is more evident in the pre-BD announcement period and for firms whose BD investigations are initiated internally. The results imply that although institutions have access to private information on certain firms, this advantage disappears after the BD revelation, possibly due to reduced information leakage. The paper was presented at the plenary session of the 2017 Journal of Accounting, Auditing, and Finance (JAAF) Conference. Both the editor and referees think that our paper is clever and make an interesting contribution to the literature. Our paper is now forthcoming at JAAF. At the time of this completion report, the paper is with the SAGE publisher at the page proof stage (please see the full file attached with this report).

15502514.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15502514.value: Our fund-firm level analysis provides a powerful test of informed trading by institutions and our transaction-based measure captures a fund’s aggregate information advantage relative to a traded firm from all possible information channels. This fund-firm pair measure differs from those in prior studies in the information networks literature because those measures typically focus on explicit forms of networks. The novel methodology we develop in this paper can be applied to various other settings to examine informed trading around a corporate event.

15502514.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15502514.value: This article uses transaction-level fund trading data from the United States to study the information advantage of institutional investors. Our research design follows a two-step procedure. In the first step, we identify funds that sell shares in firms before their unexpected revelation of stock option backdating (BD) investigations, and thus establish fund–firm pairs of interest. In the second step, we focus on trading that takes place at other times and find that the funds are more likely to make correct trades before the earnings announcements of their paired firms and that their trading performance for paired firms is better in general. This superior performance, however, is more evident in the pre-BD announcement period and for firms whose BD investigations are initiated internally. The results imply that although institutions have access to private information on certain firms, this advantage disappears after the BD revelation, possibly due to reduced information leakage. These findings provide an answer to the general question about the source of institutional investors’ information advantage, they also have important implications for financial market regulators on how to level the playing field for investors.

15502614.label: Project Objectives
15502614.value: We will examine the change of corporate hedging policy, in terms of the notional value of derivatives used by the firms, after a damage of financial reporting credibility. We will focus on the event of accounting restatement due to irregularities. We will examine the cross-sectional variations in the effect of the financial reporting credibility damage on corporate hedging policy. 15502614.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502614.value: A large body of accounting research concludes that high quality financial reporting helps mitigate financial constraints and underinvestment problems. Recent finance literature suggests that hedging has become increasingly important in corporate risk management, and easing access to credit and relaxing financial constraints is one of the main motivations of hedging activities. However, it is not clear how financial reporting quality and hedging activities interact. In this project, we will investigate how financial reporting quality affects corporate hedging activities. In particular, we will examine the change in corporate hedging activities after a damage of a firm’s financial reporting credibility, as captured by accounting restatement due to irregularities. We will also examine whether hedging can mitigate the negative impact of accounting restatement on the firm’s access to external financing and investment. Our project is expected to make significant contribution to the literature of the real effect of financial reporting quality. 許多會計研究表明高質量的財務報告可以緩解公司的財務困境和投資過低的問題。 而在公司理財領域, 公司的對沖行為也可以起到緩解財務壓力和增加信貸資金的作用。但是, 現有的文獻並沒有研究財務報告的質量與公司對沖行為是如何互相影響的。 在本課題中, 我們試圖研究, 在財務報告可信性受到破壞後 - 即發生會計重述(特別是會計舞弊)事件後, 公司的對沖行為將產生怎樣的變化。 我們也會檢驗公司的對沖行為將怎樣緩解會計重述事件對公司融資的負面影響。 通過本研究, 我們將更好的了解財務報告行為是如何影響公司財務決策的。

15502614.label: Realisation of objectives
15502614.value: The project attempts to examine how the corporate hedging activities change around the accounting restatements. To implement the test, I have taken different approaches in measuring the magnitude of hedging activities. For example, I have defined a dummy variable that equals one if a firm has undertaken any hedging activities and zero if a firm hasn't undertaken any hedging activities, and test if and how the dummy variable changes around the event of accounting restatements. I didn't find strong evidence consistent with my conjecture. I alternatively tried to produce a large sample measure for hedging activities with textual analysis tools. I measure the hedging intensity with the counts of hedging-related words in an annual report. I composed a paper testing if and how the hedging intensity varies for firms with different financial reporting quality. A working paper was constructed and presented in an international conference in 2017. I have tested all the research objectives initially laid down, and obtained some results. When implementing my proposal, I read more papers related with accounting restatements and developed new thoughts that were not incorporated in the proposal. In particular, it was doable to test alternative real decisions made by the firms that made accounting restatements. I examined how firms' liquidity policies change around the event of accounting restatements, an issue not well explored in current studies.

15502614.label: Major findings and research outcome
15502614.value: I, together with my co-authors, composed a paper titled "Accounting Restatements and Corporate Cash Policy". Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the cash holdings of firms increase significantly after announcements of irregularity-related restatements. The increase is more pronounced for firms with a higher precautionary saving demand. In contrast, the cash holdings increase is smaller for firms that have less pronounced increase in shareholder control after the restatements. Investments and repurchases of irregularity firms also become more sensitive to excess cash after the restatements. In addition, we find that the market value of cash holdings increases after restatements. Overall, the evidence suggests that strengthened shareholder control reduces cash holdings but the effect is weaker than the increase in cash holdings due to exacerbated precautionary saving concerns. Our study contributes to the literature on the effect of financial reporting credibility on real corporate decisions. An earlier draft of the paper has been presented in two international conferences in 2016 and an updated version of the paper has been accepted for publication at the Journal of Accounting, Auditing and Finance.

15502614.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15502614.value: Because of the time constraint, I have only found mixed evidence in corporate hedging activities around the event of accounting restatements upon the completion date of the funding exercise. I believe the financial decision on corporate hedging is interesting and important, given the increasingly volatile product market and capital market. I'd like to further investigate relevant issues in other settings.

15502614.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15502614.value: A firm retains more cash after it restates its accounting numbers. This is because a restating firm potentially loses its financial credibility to the external investors and has to pay a higher financing cost when it borrows from the capital market, giving rise to a larger benefit to hold more cash within the firm. This phenomenon is more commonly seen in the firms with a higher need for saving cash and less in firms that have less increase in shareholder control after the restatement. The evidence suggests that strengthened shareholder control reduces cash holdings but the effect is weaker than the increase in cash holdings due to exacerbated precautionary saving concerns. The market value of cash holdings increases after restatements, implying the increased importance of cash holdings for firms. The findings helps us understand the effect of financial reporting credibility on real corporate decisions so have implications to investors and policy makers.

15503014.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503014.value: When Steve Jobs came back to Apple at 1997, one of the few first moves he made is to change the original rainbow colored apple logo to a monochrome one; not just to match the new look of the MacBook computer, the new Apple logo was also intended to convey the image of “getting serious” (Sauer 2011). While Apple cut back the colors in its logo, its major competitor, Microsoft, was doing exactly the opposite. In 2012, withdrawing from a 25 years of use of black and white logos, Microsoft announced its new four-colored logo intended to “express the company’s diverse portfolio of products” (White 2012). Our question is will the number of colors used in a brand logo really matter when it comes to consumer perceptions of the company and its products? And if so, how? The overall goal of the current research project is to provide answers to these questions. Color has been used widely in corporate and marketing communications, especially in the corporate identity of a firm – brand logo. The color(s) used in a brand logo nowadays are often used with the strategic intention of altering consumer perceptions about the brand and its products. In this project we investigate the impact of the number of colors used in a brand logo on consumers’ product and brand perceptions. Drawing on literature in psychology, marketing, and other areas, we investigate 1) whether using multiple (vs. single) colors in a company logo activates the concept of variety/ diversity in consumers’ mind, and thus lead them to believe that the company and/or products of this company possess such characteristics, 2) whether using different shades of the same hue in a logo will have a different or similar effect as using different colors used in the logo, and 3) whether the effect of the number of colors used in a brand logo on brand evaluation is moderated by arousal, shopping goal, need for specialization, and knowledge about the product category. Given the rather limited research on color in our area, the current project should not only be able to make a contribution to color research in general, but also importantly it should contribute to our understanding of logo design, branding, and consumer behavior. Our findings should have significant implications for marketers, and should help companies strategically manage their visual identities. 色彩已經被廣泛應用于商業及市場營銷領域，尤其是在品牌商標中。商家經常戰略性的在商標中使用不同顔色以影響消費者對品牌及其產品的印象。在本研究中我們測試商標設計中使用顔色的種類和數量是否會意嚮消費者對產品和商家的印象。基於心理學，市場學，設計學，及其他領域的研究文獻，我們研究：一，多色商標（對比單色商標而言）是否會于消費者們頭腦中激發（商品或服務）多樣性的概念， 然後使他們覺得該產品或商家具有同樣的特性，二，使用同一色系的不同色彩所造成的效果是否等同於使用完全不同的色彩，以及三，商標色彩對消費者的影響是否會被購買目的，產品需求，產品知識等不同因素所調節。考慮到過去市場學研究文獻對顔色所涉不深，本研究將不僅增進我們對顔色的瞭解，而且將加深我們對商標設計，品牌管理，和消費者心理學等各研究領域的認知。本研究同時對市場營銷從業人員和商家們具有顯著的實踐意義。

15503114.value: 在這項研究中，我們使用大量對沖基金經理樣本探討過往經驗在投資組合選擇中的作用。我們參考以下三種獨特的過往經驗：行業經驗，地域經驗以及與其他基金經理共同的過往經驗。我們謀求解決以下三個研究問題，每個問題都側重不同維度的經驗： 首先，我們研究這樣一個命題：基金經理是否過度偏重於投資自己曾經有過工作經驗的行業的公司，以及這些投資是否可以帶來更高的異常回報。我們從每個經理的簡歷中工作經歷部分（例如該經理曾從事投資經理、研究主任、分析師、交易員或者企業家）找出他們曾經專門從事或負責的行業（如有）。如果這些過往經驗能夠讓他們更好獲取和（或）處理關於某個行業的信息，那麼我們預期這些經理會集中投資該行業之公司並繼而取得異常高的盈利。 其次，我們研究這樣一個命題：基金經理是否過度偏重於投資自己曾經有過地域經驗的同地域的公司，以及這些投資是否可以帶來更高的異常回報。我們通過經理目前和過去僱主以及其就讀大學的地理位置來確定該經理的地域經驗。作為一個推論，我們也研究當地傾向和信息優勢（如Coval和Moskowitz在1999和2001的研究，基金偏重投資附近的公司並且獲得更高的回報）是否會因基金經理過往在基金總部附近的地域經驗而變化。 為解決這些問題，我們圍繞最近關於對沖基金13F報表表現及信息內容的爭論來研究。我們通過對比經理專長持股和非專長持股的表現，為對沖基金股票選擇技巧提供新的證據。據我們所知，我們是第一個分析經理個人履歷是否對檢測對沖基金持股子集很可能是消息靈通的這一命題是有用處的。 最後，我們研究這樣一個命題：組合型基金是否通過把更多資金押在有共同過往經歷（即他們就讀于同一間大學）的經理所管理的對沖基金上而創造價值。具體而言，我們測試組合型基金偏重于投資此類對沖基金的程度是否與他們其後的收益有關聯。這樣一來，我們力求闡明組合型基金是如何或從哪兒得到產生α所需的信息。

15503114.label: Realisation of objectives
15503114.value: The overarching objective of the project was to uncover hedge fund skill from a select subset of hedge funds' portfolios that we expect to be information-driven based on hedge fund managers’ biographical information. This was motivated following Griffin and Xu's (2009) questioning about the perceived superior skill of hedge fund managers after they find little evidence from overall (as opposed to a subset of) hedge funds' stock portfolios. Those stated above in 5.1 were intended to exemplify possible cuts of hedge funds’ (or funds of hedge funds’) portfolios to achieve this overarching objective. Overall, we have achieved this main objective of the project by finding evidence for hedge fund skill from the portfolio holdings in industries where their managers have prior work experience. Using manager-level biographical data that we have hand-collected during the course of the project, we have also come to discover some interesting interplay between hedge fund managers’ education and work experience in impacting hedge fund holdings and performance. This resulted in another working paper, which we have presented in multiple international conferences. Finally, various biographical data collected for this project has also benefited a PhD student’s thesis, which examines the effect of management structure on hedge fund performance and misreporting. In particular, our data helped the student construct a measure of team congruence among hedge fund managers in a fund based on their educational background. The PhD student, who is under the PI’s supervision, has successfully defended her thesis in June 2018 with relatively minor revisions suggested.

15503114.label: Major findings and research outcome
15503114.value: We examine whether hedge fund managers’ industry expertise affects their portfolio choices and investment performance. We find that hedge funds hold more concentrated portfolios than non-hedge funds. The Industry Concentration Index (ICI) of Kacperczyk, Sialm, and Zheng (2005) for hedge funds is about twice as high as that of investment companies and investment advisors, and more than three times that of banks and insurance companies. Using fund managers’ prior work experience as the main source of their industry expertise, we show that hedge funds concentrate their portfolios in a few industries where they have an industry expertise. The average hedge fund has about three different industries where its fund managers have industry expertise and invests almost 35.87% of its assets in these industries, even though only 19.10% of the market of securities is in the corresponding industries. We also find that hedge funds earn substantial abnormal returns in these holdings. Our results suggest that hedge funds create value by concentrating their portfolios in industries where they have industry-specific skill. In a by-product paper of this project, we examine, for various educational characteristics of hedge fund managers, the performance profile of hedge fund portfolios along their managers’ professional experience path. We find that during the initial years following their graduation, hedge fund managers who majored in business or economics outperform other managers. However, in subsequent years, hedge fund managers who studied science or engineering improve their performance and eventually outperform all other managers. These results are consistent with the view that business education is a substitute for, while science education is a complement to, job experience in acquiring the skills that help hedge fund managers generate excess returns. Consistent with Chevalier and Ellison’s (1999b) findings for mutual fund managers, we find a positive and significant relation between the academic ability of hedge fund managers (as measured by the average SAT scores of the students in the school that the managers attended) and their fund performance. However, a significant positive relation does not exist between fund performance and other school characteristics such as tuition, school ranking, and student-faculty ratio.

15503114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15503114.value: Our painstakingly collected data on hedge fund managers’ biographical information can facilitate future studies that need such information. For example, in a separate project, we use an extended version of this dataset and explore if hedge fund managers with the same education background trade similarly.

15503114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15503114.value: In this project, we explore the role of past work experience in portfolio choice using a large sample of hedge fund managers. We ask whether hedge fund managers overweight firms in industries where they have prior work experience and earn higher abnormal returns on these investments. From managers’ biographies, we identify industries in which their past positions (e.g., as a portfolio manager, director of research, analyst, trader, or entrepreneur) specialized, if any. Consistent with the notion that such prior experience equips them to better access and/or process information about an industry, we find that hedge fund managers concentrate their holdings in the industry and subsequently generate positive abnormal returns from the holdings. In so doing, we speak to the recent debate about the performance and information content of 13F holdings of hedge funds. We provide new evidence of the stock-picking skill of hedge funds by comparing the performance of their holdings within and outside managers’ expertise. To our knowledge, our work is the first to examine whether managers’ biographical information is useful for detecting a subset of hedge fund holdings that is likely to be informed.

15503214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503214.value: Today, many young boys grow up imitating famous actors from Kung Fu movies such as Bruce Lee, Jacky Chan, Chow Yun Fat, Donnie Yen and Zhang Ziyi. Fifty-six local films were produced and released in Hong Kong in 2012, contributing about HK$288 million to the economy (Film Service Office, 2013). However, although Hong Kong is still one of the major cinema exporters in the world, its film industry is facing new challenges such as the immigration of Hong Kong movie stars, the relocation of film settings to mainland China, and new competitors in Asia such as Japan and Korea (Hsu & Song, 2013; Pan & Ryan, 2013; Weng, 2008). This study of film-induced tourism in Hong Kong has six objectives, including using cultural proximity theory to examine the reasons for the popularity of Hong Kong films and the desire to visit on-screen destinations, studying the segmentation of cinema tourists and their expenditures, and developing a Hong Kong film tourism program. In this study, film tourism refers to the phenomenon of international viewers who have watched Hong Kong films or dramas making actual visits to Hong Kong because of these viewing experiences. The study will compare three major foreign tourist groups: mainland Chinese, Japanese, and North American. These three groups dominate the inbound tourism market and have high travel expenditures (Hong Kong Tourism Board, 2013). Consequently, this study will analyze the status quo of film tourism in Hong Kong, identify its advantages over its rivals, and develop an optimal film tourism program that will benefit the inbound film tourism market. Specially, it is interesting to explore expenditure of film-induced tourists and their determinants. This topic relates to Hong Kong’s celebrity marketing, as film stars are highly significant in the sales of Hong Kong luxury products and hospitality businesses. This study will also benefit the Hong Kong government, which is struggling to enhance its city brand and promote itself worldwide. Finally, the results of this study will identify methods for establishing Hong Kong as a global film tourism destination. Consequently, results of this study offer benefits to Hong Kong government and its agencies in establishing marketing strategies to gain economic wealth from a new tourism sector. Academically, this study fills a void, as few efforts have been made to understand Hong Kong film tourism and there are few Hong Kong film tourism case studies. 如今，很多年輕的男孩都已從模仿來自功夫電影中的著名演員例如李小龍，成龍，周潤發，甄子丹和章子怡等開始慢慢長大。在2012年，共有五十六個本地製作的電影在香港上映，對經濟的貢獻達到了2.88億港元 (Film Service Office, 2013)。然而，儘管香港仍是世界上主要的電影出口國之一，其電影業正面臨著新的挑戰，如香港影星的移民，電影片場向中國大陸的轉移，以及亞洲的新競爭者例如日本和韓國 (Hsu & Song, 2013; Pan & Ryan, 2013; Weng, 2008)。 本次關於香港影視旅遊計劃實現以下六個目標， 包括使用文化相似理論來探究香港電影受歡迎以及遊客訪問拍攝現場的願望的原因；研究影視旅遊者的細分以及他們的旅遊支出，並發展香港的影視旅遊項目。在本次研究中，影視旅遊是指觀看過香港電影或者電視劇后因視覺體驗而引發的到訪香港的旅遊。本研究將比較三個主要旅客觀光團：分別來自中國大陸，日本以及北美因為這三個香港旅遊觀光團主導香港旅遊市場並且有很高的旅遊支出 因此，本研究將分析香港影視旅遊業的現狀， 挖掘出不同於競爭對手的優勢，並發展有利於本地影視旅遊市場的最佳影視旅遊項目。具體來說，探索影視旅遊遊客的開支及其決定因素很有意義。這個話題與香港的名人營銷有關，正如影視明星對於香港奢侈品及酒店的銷量有非常顯著地提高。本研究也將有利於正在努力提升其城市品牌及在世界各地推廣自身的香港政府。最終研究結果將給出把香港建立成全球影視旅遊目的地的方法。因此，本研究將會使香港政府以及有關機構建立新旅遊方向的營銷策略并促進香港經濟繁榮， 及使政府及有關機構從中受益。在學術方面，這項研究填補了關於香港影視旅遊的一項空白因為很少有研究探究了香港的影視旅遊， 另外，關於香港影視旅遊的案例研究也很少。

15503214.label: Realisation of objectives
15503214.value: 1. The first objective has been completed using those who were exposed to Hong Kong films from the 1970s to the early 2000s. They were exposed to Hong Kong films and become nostalgia tourists. 2. To achieve Objective 2, segmentation of film tourists was conducted. Research activities Extensive literature relating to film tourism, Hong Kong film tourism, nostalgia was conducted. Nostalgia was selected as a key motivator of travelling to Hong Kong with a main purpose of film tourism. It was coined nostalgia film tourism. Hong Kong films were very sensational to Asian society from the 1970s to late 1990s. Those who were exposed to Hong Kong films became those in their 40s or older. They reflect “good old days”. They have economic capability to travel and trace their reminiscence through visiting film destinations in Hong Kong. After pre-test and pilot test, a main survey was conducted from October 1 to 15, 2015. The respondents were exposed to Hong Kong films from the 1970s to the late 1990s. As mentioned in the introduction and the literature review, because watching Hong Kong films had become a societal syndrome during those days, the sample group did not represent the impossible rationales of that group’s interest in pursuing film tourism in Hong Kong to seek their memories of the past days. Of the 620 questionnaires completed in the survey, 610 were used for further data analyses; the other 10 had multiple missing values. For the data analyses, descriptive analysis was conducted for demographic features, the number of Hong Kong films released from the 1970s to the late 1990s, and the famous stars at the time. Methods and Data Analyses: To develop items pertaining to nostalgia, specifically about Hong Kong films, an extensive review of journals, magazines, and books relevant to critiques of films, social culture and film, social trends and motives, and the characteristics of films between the 1970s and the late 1990s was conducted (e.g., Lee F.L., 2006; Lee H., 2006; Pan & Ryan, 2013; Robinson, 2015; Suni & Komppula, 2012; Wong & McDonogh, 2001). On the basis of this literature review, a preliminary questionnaire was developed. In-depth interviews were then conducted to identify whether the items were consistent with the results of the literature review. Twenty Korean residents who reported enjoying Hong Kong movies made from the 1970s to the late 1990s participated in the in-depth interviews. Given the significance of audience involvement in the context of film tourism suggested by Kim (2012a), the topics covered included the respondents’ emotional and behavioral involvement, the effects of the films on the respondents and their lives, the social motifs, the circumstances of the domestic film industry, the respondents’ intention to engage in film tourism in Hong Kong, and their preferred activities and film tourism programs. Based on the above, the items chosen to measure nostalgia after watching Hong Kong films included remembering scenes or backdrops; images of Hong Kong featured in the films; the films’ stories, feelings, music, and background images; the visual effects of kung fu films (e.g., flying in a Kung Fu movie); mimicking or gossiping after watching films; and interest in Hong Kong’s culture or history. To develop the film nostalgia items previous studies in consumer behavior were reviewed (Holak, 2013; Holbrook, 1993; Marchegiani & Phau, 2013). The items chosen to measure preferred tourism products for attracting nostalgia-driven film tourists included film destination tour programs, visual or mobile programs, and special event programs. The items chosen to measure preferred tourism activities in the nostalgia-driven film tourism program included visiting film sites, fan meeting events, and tasting Cantonese food (e.g., visiting the restaurants or cafes featured in the Hong Kong films). The items chosen to measure perceived cultural proximity, after revising those used in previous studies, included similarity of tradition, organizational culture, customs, food, and film stories between Hong Kong and Korea (e.g., Burch, 2002; Huang, 2011; Lee F.L., 2006; Su et al., 2011). Questions pertaining to fandom included level of fandom for Hong Kong films in the 1970s to the late 1990s and level of current fandom for Hong Kong films. The items used to describe familiarity with Hong Kong from watching Hong Kong films measured an increase in the respondents’ sense of closeness or friendliness toward Hong Kong after watching Hong Kong films, as adapted from previous studies (Chen & Lin, 2012; Horng, Liu, Chou & Tsai, 2012). Six items of perceived cultural proximity indicating similarity of culture were used. The items mentioned above (with two exceptions mentioned below) were measured on a 5-point Likert scale (1 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree). Gender, age, and occupation were measured as categorical data, while the number of films that a respondent watched (from a list of 30) and the number of movie stars that a respondent could recognize (from a list of 11) were measured as yes (recognize) or no (don’t recognize) questions. The questions were then revised using pilot testing among 50 Korean residents who were familiar with Hong Kong films in the past days. Data were collected from October 1 to 15, 2015, using an online company with 1.12 million panelists. Based on their comments on the questionnaires, a small modification was made to some nostalgia items. A main survey was then conducted using an online survey tool chosen for its advantages, such as rapid collection of samples from a targeted population, the ability to control sample selection using planned quotas, and the user-friendliness of the website (Grönlund & Strandberg, 2014). The restrictions for the selection of a targeted sample included individuals who were 40 years of age or older, had not visited Hong Kong, had watched at least 2 of a list of 30 Hong Kong films released between the 1970s and the late 1990s, and recognized at least 1 of a list of 11 film stars from that time. The respondents were exposed to Hong Kong films from the 1970s to the late 1990s. As mentioned in the introduction and the literature review, because watching Hong Kong films had become a societal syndrome during those days in Korea, the sample group did not represent the impossible rationales of that group’s interest in pursuing film tourism in Hong Kong to seek their memories of the past days. Of the 620 questionnaires completed in the survey, 610 were used for further data analyses; the other 10 had multiple missing values. For the data analyses, descriptive analysis was conducted for demographic features, the number of Hong Kong films released from the 1970s to the late 1990s, and the famous stars at the time. To cross-validate the data, exploratory factor analysis (EFA) was conducted on a randomly selected half the sample (N = 305) to better understand resultant dimensions of the constructs studied and the other half of (N = 305) the data was later examined via confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). To identify whether the hypothesized conceptual model was consistent with the measured data, structural equation modeling using maximum likelihood estimation was employed on the entire sample (N = 605).

15503214.label: Major findings and research outcome
15503214.value: Nostalgia has been reported as an increasingly important tourist motivator, however, in the context of film tourism at least, little evidence exists to support this. This study sought to identify the role of nostalgia in film tourism, specifically in relation to the development of preferred film tourism products and activities for potential Korean film tourists visiting the shooting locations of Hong Kong films made from the 1970s to the late 1990s. The findings suggest that the concept of nostalgia in the context of film tourism is multidimensional and consists of five identified domains. Of these domains, “reminiscence of mimicking”, “memory of film backdrops”, and “memory of Hong Kong history and culture” were highly significant in explaining familiarity with film destinations and the intention to engage in nostalgia film tourism. According to the results of the regression analyses, film nostalgia was efficacious in explaining the intention to engage in film nostalgia tourism. Cluster analysis was adopted to explore the distinctiveness of the film nostalgia market segments. Figure 2 exhibits the results of the K-means clustering analysis, which used the mean values of the five factors as the results of explanatory factor analysis for film nostalgia. The four-cluster solution was most interpretable and acceptable in the even distribution of membership in each cluster. Clusters 1, 2, 3, and 4 included 26.7 percent, 19.8 percent, 23.8 percent, and 29.7 percent, respectively. To identify differences in characteristics of respondents’ profiles according to clusters generated using extracted domains. Among the four extracted clusters, a high film nostalgia group (Cluster 2) and a low film nostalgia group (Cluster 3) showed completely different results, including preferred activities or tour programs and socio-demographics. As a result, this study found film nostalgia as a segmentation variable. The results of this study can be prudently used by film destination marketers to develop new products or programs and to satisfy their on-site experiences.

15503214.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15503214.value: Future studies should apply the approach used in this study in cross-cultural examinations of other countries; that is, the film’s country of origin and the audience’s country (Hudson, Wang & Gil, 2011; Kim, Agrusa & Chon, 2014; Kim & O’Connor, 2011). In addition, this study was limited to subjects who were exposed to Hong Kong films in the 1970s to the 1990s Although watching the films in those days was a collective boom phenomenon, there are those who did not follow the societal mainstream. A future study could explore the responses of respondents who were not actively exposed to films in those days. In addition, the number of nights that potential nostalgia film tourists want to stay in Hong Kong was 1-2 nights. Thus, there is a need to study how to extend their stay.

15503214.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15503214.value: The findings of this study are meaningful because few studies have attempted to empirically identify the dimensionality of nostalgic emotions in a film tourism setting, although the multidimensionality of experiences at film tourism destinations has been mentioned anecdotally.This study thus confirmed that the nostalgic sentiments are diverse and thus multidimensional in the context of film tourism. Because four film nostalgia segments are derived, there is a need to analyze their characteristics overall and to select their target markets. In this study, the “group with a high level of film nostalgia” (Cluster 2) was revealed to be the most appropriate target market of film nostalgia tourism because its members showed the highest agreement on all items of preference for activities or products/programs and psychological and behavioral involvement. Destination stakeholders should develop products or programs to cater to the specific needs of the target market (Kotler, Bowen & Makens, 2014). This attempt contributes to the film tourism literature because it is the first to adopt film nostalgia as a segmentation tool. With follow up of results of this study, a future study is expected to receive benefits by using it as segmentation variable for film tourists.

15503614.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15503614.value: In this project, we examine why and how teams/employees develop identification and close relationship with new leaders as well we their subsequent receptiveness to the new leaders' change initiatives. Specifically, in our first study, we found that a highly transformational former leader constrains the potential effectiveness of the new leader, but a former leader low in transformational leadership enhances this potential effectiveness. Further in our second study, we found that the "match" between the new leaders’ and their teams’ proactive personalities foster new leader identification, as well as the team’s behavioral responses to the new leader’s change agenda. This effect is strongest when the new leader’s proactive personality is higher than that of the former leader’s proactive personality (positive contrast). Essentially, we found that the congruence between a new leader’s and his/her team’s proactive personalities and the positive contrast between a former leader’s and the new leader’s proactive personalities enhanced new leader identification and the team’s shared identification with the new leader’s change agenda, and, thereby led the team to exhibit more behavioral engagement with, and voice behavior about, the new leader’s change agenda.

15503814.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503814.value: At present, smart mobile devices such as iPhone are prevalent. Usually, a smart mobile device is equipped with abundant sensors. By analyzing the data produced by the sensors of the smart mobile devices, the context of mobile carrier can be inferred. GPS is one of the primary data that can be caught from mobile device. With GPS data, we can easily know the carriers' mobility behavior and infer the corresponding context, such as visiting scenic spot and shopping mall. Meanwhile, the phenomenal advent of photo-sharing services such as Flickr, has encouraged people to contribute rather than just obtain information. Those publicly available travel photos, together with their time and geographic information, provide a channel to collect reliable and abundant travel information, which also enables the possibility to discover the travel behavior patterns of tourists at a particular destination. Accurate tourist travel behavior patterns provides crucial information for tourism policy making in both government and business sectors, though it remains a difficult task to collect reliable travel information from tourists by traditional surveys or opinion pool methods. On the other hand, the recent prevalence of photo-sharing services serve as an important repository for travel photos, together with their time and geographic information, and provide a channel to collect reliable and abundant travel information. This enables the possibilities to discover the travel behavior patterns of tourists in a particular destination. In view of the arising opportunity, this project aims to achieve a breakthrough in discovering travel behavior patterns and utilizing them for customized travel recommendations, by exploiting those socially generated and user-contributed geotagged photos that are publicly available on the Internet. 準確的旅行者移動模式信息可以提供給政府部門和旅遊管理部門精確的信息來進行決策，但是，傳統的Survey方法難以收集到足夠數量的旅遊者移動數據。隨著配備各種傳感器的發展，智能移動設備，例如IPHONE等，可以被利用來收集其使用者的位置信息以及行為模式。此外，隨著在綫照片共享網站的流行，越來越多的旅行者上傳他們的旅遊照片到這些公共網站。由於這些網路照片大多內含了時間和地理位置信息，這使得研究人員可以收集可靠的旅遊者移動信息，並加以利用來發現特地旅遊目的地的旅遊者移動模式。 本項目致力於利用這些旅行者共享的公開網路圖片，發現旅行者的典型移動模式，並提出策略來推薦並定製適合於不同旅行者的旅行產品。

15503814.label: Realisation of objectives
15503814.value: The stated objectives have been achieved satisfactorily. Empirical findings show a breakthrough in discovering travel behavior patterns from enriched online multimedia resources in terms of geotagged photos. The developed systematic method can capture travel footprints, identify travelers’ spatial and temporal behaviors, and recommend the most relevant travel attractions and sequences. Specifically, the first objective was achieved by building a data set which contains more than 29,000 photos from Flickr that were posted by inbound travelers. In addition, travel diaries, which constructed from the photo sequences and can capture comprehensive travel information from outbound tourism with nearly 900,000 photos were constructed. Using the data sets, the research team identified the attractions of interest to tourists with different profiles who are visiting a travel destination. The second objective was achieved with very useful and interesting findings. For instance, in Hong Kong, Western tourists showed more interest in the Peak Tower (third) and Center Mong Kok (fourth) than in Times Square Towers (fifth) and Hong Kong International Airport (sixth). Asian tourists showed the opposite trend, as indicated by their ranking of Times Square Towers and Hong Kong International Airport as more popular than the Peak Tower and Center Mong Kok. In addition, It is interesting to know that the Tian Tan Buddha Statue was identified as an area of interest for Western but not Asian tourists. A possible explanation is that most Asian countries are likely to have somewhat similar cultural or religious sites such as temples, shrines, or Buddha statues. Asian visitors may, therefore, not be interested in seeing similar things when visiting Hong Kong. On the other hand, Western people are likely to be interested in exploring Asian culture, and the Tian Tan Buddha Statue is one such symbol. Such findings are somewhat different from, or not previously analyzed by, the statistical data published by the DMO. Besides, findings of tourist movement analysis showed that Asian tourists are likely to flow to Hong Kong Central from the surrounding areas. Tourists in Center Mong Kok tended to visit Tsim Sha Tsui next, while some tourists chose to travel on directly to Hong Kong Central. Considerable tourist flow is found from Hong Kong Central and the Times Square Towers to Tsim Sha Tsui. Moreover, findings showed some differences between Western and Asian tourists. Namely, Tourists from Asian countries tended to visit Hong Kong Central right after Center Mong Kok, while some traveled in the opposite direction.Western tourists are more likely to visit Tsim Sha Tsui than Hong Kong Central after Times Square Towers. Some tourists visited Tsim Sha Tsui immediately after the Peak Tower. The third objective was achieved by the integration of extracting geographic data from geotagged photos, which is followed by density clustering for tourism attraction identification, and travel pattern mining using the Markov Chain. Additionally, sequential rule mining was used to discovery travel patterns from travel diaries. As a whole, we leveraged on the venue check-in from a social media platform, Foursquare, for the behavior analysis of tourists, because of its comprehensive venue database with meta data about venue type and categories, which is convenient determine activities of travelers. The venue check-ins on those platforms such as Foursquare are deemed reliable to capture traveler activities closely to the real-world situation, because they encourage genuine check-ins by rewarding points to users if they were staying in or close to the selected venue. Our approaches consisted of three steps presented below: Our first step is to identify users belonging to a group of interest, such as users in a specific country, who traveled to overseas destinations. One issue with Foursquare platform is its unavailability of function to identify specific users and directly extracting their check-ins. Fortunately, it has integrated its system into other social mediate platform, such as Twitter. Once users link their Foursquare accounts to their Twitter accounts, their venue check-ins using a Foursquare application, called Swam (www.swarmapp.com), will appear on their Twitter time line. Swarm is the most popular check-in application linked to Twitter (Cheng et al., 2011). Twitter’s Application Programming Interface (API) provides Streaming function (dev.twitter.com/docs/), which allows for extracting random tweets being generated in real time, including check-in tweets. Having obtained userIDs belonging to travelers of interest, we extract their entire Twitter time line for all possible check-ins to capture comprehensive travel behavior. A function of Twitter’s API, called Search User Timeline, was employed to perform this task. We extract meta data about each check-ins including local date and time of check-in, check-in location (GPS coordinates, city and country name), venue name, venue type (e.g. restaurant, shopping mall and attraction) and GPS location of venue (latitude and longitude). Venue type is useful to determine the activities being anticipated such as dinning for restaurant venues, or shopping for shopping mall venues. Foursquare classifies venue types into 10 venue categories (https://developer.foursquare.com/docs/ resources/categories), including Art & Entertainment, College & University, Event, Food, Nightlife Spot, Outdoors & Recreation, Professional & Other Places Residence, Shop & Service, and Travel & Transport. Venue type can have sub type such as Asian restaurant venue type can cover Chinese restaurant and Japanese restaurant. Based on the location of the venue check- ins, we can identify the destination countries of the targeted travel group. Popularity of activities accord all visited destinations are then computed by the proportion of tourists checked-in at the corresponding venues. The popularity of activities can also be computed for at some popular destinations to determine if such activities are preferred across different countries or at specific destinations. Differences between activity likelihood between different travel groups can be computed with statistical test to identify their preference differences. Likelihood of activities can also be computed by hour of the day to examine temporal preferences. Correlation test can be used to determine if temporal patterns between travel groups are similar or have low correlation. A low correlation of temporal patterns reflect different temporal behavior for the same activity between travel groups. When comparing different travel groups we only consider their activities at popular destination countries for all groups for a fare comparison.

15503814.label: Major findings and research outcome
15503814.value: The existing studies in tourism research usually face a significant barrier in data collection for travel behavior. Survey and opinion pool are usually time consuming and unable to reflect closely travel behavior of tourists. Even with support of technology such and GIS and mobile devices for capturing movement information, the collected data are limited in terms of number of responses or in the scale of geographical areas. These are significant challenges which prevent tourism researchers from exploring fully and comprehensively the behavior of travelers. In this project, the research team developed new techniques to analyze geo-tagged photos, which in turn, presents a new direction to capture movement data of travelers in an efficient and timely manner. With millions of geo-tagged and time-stamped photos available on a global scale, photos sharing sites are repositories for researchers to extract data and study travel behavior. Thus, the developed techniques to capture the travel footprints, and to identify the travelers’ spatial and temporal behaviors, make a meaningful contribution to the existing literature.

15503814.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15503814.value: It would be great if future research can be carried out in a longitudinal way. This would enable researchers to better understand the change of travelers' behavior. Two other directions for future research are to conduct: 1. travel behavior contrast analysis and cross culture analysis; and 2. cross country travel behavior analysis. Prior studies are primarily on analyzing tourist behavior in one region or country, and there is no existing work with adequate data on cross country trips.

15503814.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15503814.value: Tourist travel behavior is indeed an important research topic, and in the past decade, there have been different attempts at studying tourist travel behaviors. Despite the considerable effort made, tourism practitioners and policy makers still find it difficult to fully capture and understand the travel behaviors of international tourists. The difficulty is largely due to the essential barrier in collecting tourist travel information. Most existing work use survey, questionnaire and opinion pool methods to collect travel information from tourists, and this approach is usually costly, time consuming, and limited in the number of responses. Hence, it is challenging to capture the information that can closely reflect the travel behavior patterns to the real situation. As such, the innovative approach that this project has introduced would enhance the knowledge development in the field. The advantages and long term significance that are offered by the outcomes of this research are multi-fold. First, this research can benefit tourism policy makers, industry practitioners, and researchers worldwide. With the accurate understanding of the travel behavior patterns in different tourism attractions and among travelers with different cultural backgrounds, practitioners could then carry out different business activities such as assessing the current and future positions of the tourism market, identifying potential opportunities and risks, identifying priorities, and earmarking resources. More importantly, new revolutionary techniques can further enhance the travel behavior patterns analysis. By shifting the research focus from manually collecting more reliable and high quality travel behavior information to automating the information collecting process and the followed travel behavior analysis, this research would benefit all existing tourism operation and planning businesses.

15504214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15504214.value: 本實驗研究探討影響投資者對公司董事會的獨立性的看法和外部董事的有效性獨立性三個變量個別及連帶效應。具體而言，三個變量研究為（i）外部董事或獨立非執行董事（獨立非執行董事）的比例; （二）獨立非執行董事的職權;及（iii）委任獨立非執行董事的方法。當投資者投資和/或定價決策時，他們會考慮這三個變量，無論是單獨或共同考慮。他們的集體投資決策會影響資產定價和市場效率。關鍵是要在影響投資者的認知獨立非執行董事及董事會有效性的獨立研究這些變量。 獨立非執行董事應該獨立於管理層，他們代表股東利益，負責監測和諮詢作用。這與代理理論的獨立董事將防止管理層尋求自我利益而損害股東的利益。這樣一來，世界各地的許多監管機構已規定或提議要求增加獨立非執行董事在公司董事會中的比例。然而，目前還沒有統一規定。一些國家要求多數的董事會是獨立非執行董事，而某些司法管轄區有三分之一的要求。有支持的規定比例沒有理論或經驗證據。一本研究的目的是調查這個問題。 有關獨立非執行董事的兩個重要要素也影響他們的獨立性和有效性，也就是他們的能力和委任方式。僅僅由於在公司董事會獨立非執行董事並不能保證董事會的獨立和有效的治理比例較高。為了監督和促進戰略的制定和決策，獨立非執行董事應具備相應的管理能力和專業知識。他們不得不花時間和精力來獲得相關企業特有的知識和技能，使他們能在董事會會議上提出複雜的問題，並決定處理。另外，該非執行董事被選擇並指定的方法對它們的獨立性的影響，至少在外觀上。如果他們是由首席執行官選定，並在股東大會上委任，他們的獨立性，至少在外觀上，可能會被削弱。在特別的情況下，如果老總或董事持有控制投票權，因為在許多國家的情況。 這三個相關變量會影響投資者對公司治理和公司董事會的獨立性和有效性的認知。然而，對比檔案研究方法投資者對公司治理的看法並未引起同樣的關注。這項研究有助於公司治理文獻中理解（i）調查的個人以及共同作用（如替換或放大效應）的三個關鍵變量在影響知覺投資者的獨立性和公司治理的有效性; （ii）提供理論和實證依據公司治理的文獻;及（iii）配套設置相關的管理法規和政策的經驗證據。

15504914.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15504914.value: 近年来，有法律背景的董事在董事会的构成当中呈显著上升趋势。然而法律背景董事对于公司价值之影响及其影响渠道尚未有系统性的研究。一种理论认为法律背景董事由于其对诉讼风险的敏感性会更加严格地履行董事对公司管理层的监控职责。除此之外，法律背景董事能够利用他们的法律经验帮助公司应对更加复杂的合规环境以及与公司相关的诉讼。该两种渠道均有助于提升公司价值。本课题通过对美国和中国大量上市公司诉讼披露信息的实证分析，旨在检验法律背景董事对于公司的诉讼信息披露行为以及公司价值的影响。本课题的研究发现将加深我们对于公司诉讼信息披露行为及其影响因素的认识。与此同时我们通过市场对于外生的诉讼信息披露的反应亦可检验法律背景董事能够在应对复杂诉讼时为公司创造的价值。

15504914.label: Realisation of objectives
15504914.value: This project studies motivations of firms to hire lawyer-directors and how lawyer-directors affects firms’ propensity to be sued in class action lawsuits, financial reporting quality, and other economic outcomes. We make distinction between executive lawyer-directors and non-executive lawyer-directors. Whilst executive lawyer-directors are more likely to perform an advisory role, non-executive lawyer-directors are expected to perform a monitoring role. Both of the two research objectives are 100% achieved. The project generated two working papers and one supervised Ph.D thesis that passed confirmation on Feb 17, 2017. In short, we find lawyer-directors affect firms' litigation risk and disclosure quality, and there are marked differences on the role played by executive and non-executive (independent) lawyer directors. We also find the capital market (both stock and bond market) react negatively to firms' litigation, yet no significant market reaction differences for firms with and without lawyer-directors. Our scope of investigation and empirical findings are illustrated below: Working Paper I: The Value of Lawyer Directors (co-authored with my Ph.D student Lei Zhen, a first draft with full sets of results is available, preparing for conference submission) [Summary of Findings]: Based on a large sample of firms from 2001 to 2014, we find firms with high leverage, foreign sales, high ROA, high sales growth and high book-to-market ratio tend to avoid hiring independent lawyer-director, and firms with large size and high book-to-market ratio tend to hire more executive lawyer-director. After controlling for the selection bias with Heckman’s correction, we find the impact of executive lawyer-directors and independent directors are different. Firms that hire executive lawyer-directors or hire more executive lawyer-directors are less likely to be sued in a class action lawsuit and have no difference in the readability of annual reports in language ease; however, firms that hire independent lawyer-directors or hire more independent lawyer-directors are more likely to be sued in a class action lawsuit and have lower Fresch score (lower language ease) for their annual report. In terms of earnings quality, we find marginal evidence that firms hiring more lawyer-directors have lower discretionary accruals in absolute value. Overall, the results suggest that executive lawyer-directors function more in advisory purpose and independent lawyer-directors serve more in the monitoring role. Working Paper II: Trust in the Corporate Bond Market: Evidence from Lawsuits available on SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2872705 (status: presented at the 2017 FMA (Boston), 2017 ASSA Annual Meeting (Chicago), Bank of Finland; HKU; Renmin Univ; Nanjing Univ; CUFE; Shanghai Jiaotong; UIBE, submitted to Journal of Financial Economics in early 2017, received rejection with detailed comments in July 2017. Using evidence from China, we find all else being equal, investment grade bonds of litigated issuers have a 4.9 percent higher yield spread, 11-month shorter maturity, and $14.7 million less issuance volume than propensity-score-matched bonds of non-litigated issuers. The tightening effect is more pronounced when issuers are defendants in lawsuits or lose their cases, when their relationship circles are close-knit, or they are headquartered in high-trust regions. (PI is the chief supervisor of Ph.D candidate Lei Zhen at PolyU School of Accounting and Finance, the candidate passed the confirmation and registered in the PhD program on Feb 17, 2017) [Summary of Findings]: This thesis examines how lawyer-directors affect their employer firm’s propensity to admit accounting mistakes. Based on a sample of firms that are matched with restating firm by discretionary accruals. We find hiring lawyer-directors prompts firms to make restatement. However, the preemptive disclosure prompted by lawyer-directors does not appear to reduce the likelihood of their firms being sued, or increase the chance of dismissal rate, or reduce the settlement amounts. These results suggest that lawyer-directors maybe good gatekeepers rather than legal astute opportunists that promote restatement in order to reduce firms’ litigation risk. The results are robust after addressing self-selection bias.

15504914.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15504914.value: This project has given rise to a broader academic interest to study the effect of lawyer-directors on different aspects of corporate behavior and economic outcomes. Prior work focuses on the role of General Counsel (GC, i.e. lawyers in the top five highest paid executives) on firms’ disclosure choices (Kwak et al. 2012 JAE; Hopkins et al. 2014 MS; Ham and Koharki 2016 JAE). Our contribution, however, is that we focus on the role of lawyer-director and make distinction between executive lawyer director and independent lawyer-director. This allows us to disentangle the advisory versus monitoring role played by lawyer-directors in a richer setting, thus reconcile the findings in prior literature. Further development of this research project include PI’s supervision of Ph.D candidate to complete a comprehensive review on the effect of lawyer-directors on firms’: (1) disclosure choices; (2) tax aggressiveness; (3) crash risk; (4) lawsuit incidence; (5) lawsuit outcomes; (6) restatement decisions; (7) cost of capital. This investigation shall generate richer insights on the motivation and consequences of lawyers on corporate boards.

15504914.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15504914.value: Lawyers on corporate boards are on the rise. However, less is known on firms’ motivation to hire lawyer-directors and the effect of these directors on corporate lawsuit and disclosure quality. This project hypothesizes and empirically test two essential roles played by lawyer-director: legal advisory by executive lawyer-director (ELD); gate-keeping by independent lawyer-director (ILD). Consistent with our hypotheses, on the determinants of hiring lawyer-director(s), we find firms with high leverage, foreign sales, high ROA, high sales growth and high book-to-market ratio tend to avoid hiring ILD, and firms with large size and high book-to-market ratio tend to hire more ELD. On the consequence of lawyer-director(s), we find firms with ELD are less likely to be sued in a class action lawsuit; however, firms with ILD are more likely to be sued in a class action lawsuit and have lower Fresch score (lower language ease) for their annual report. This is so because firms with ILD make more litigation sensitive disclosures. Our result advance people's understanding on the value of lawyer directors. Finally, focusing on the effect of corporate lawsuits we find lawsuits tightened firms’ subsequent debt terms, and that lawsuits reduce the value of corporate bond.

15505414.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505414.value: 企业社会行为的配置理论研究

15505414.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15505414.value: Prof Dyck, Bruno Dr Walker, Kent

15505414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505414.value: Scholars in the research areas of corporate social responsibility (CSR) and stakeholder management propose that firms can achieve high financial performance through social actions, which build affinity and coherence among potentially competing stakeholders. However, CSR practices are costly and usually are constrained because of firms’ limited financial resources (Wang et al. 2008). Numerous efforts have demonstrated no universal link between CSR and firm value (Margolis and Walsh 2003). We argue that such lack of a universal relationship is due to two reasons. First, most empirical research still continues to treat CSR in a largely unidimensional fashion by attempting to aggregate these different elements of CSR into a single construct. Second, corporate social irresponsibility (CSiR) is often treated as being symmetrically and inversely related to CSR. Thus, most empirical research has adopted a one-size-fits-all logic in understanding the relationship and CSR activities of firms. To address these research gaps, we aim to investigate the question of what combinations of CSR and CSiR practices across different stakeholder domains influence financial performance. In contrast to other scholars following contingency research traditions, we develop a configurational framework in which firms mix their CSR and CSiR activities in different ways across stakeholder groups and thus present four profiles of social actions: (i) Pure CSR (i.e., presence of CSR and absence of CSiR); (ii) Pure CSiR (i.e., presence of CSiR and absence of CSR); (iii) Balancing (i.e., presence of both CSR and CSiR); and (iv) Conformity (i.e., absence of both CSR and CSiR). In each profile, we argue that firms weigh between gains/losses of reputation and economic costs as related to doing CSR and CSiR, which leads them to be selectively focused on developing relationships with certain stakeholder groups. We also argue that such configurations are similarly associated with high corporate financial performance, and this is consistent with the notion of equifinality (i.e., the presence of different solutions leading to the final outcome). Nevertheless, we argue that there is also a time difference (i.e., short-term vs. long-term) between the proposed configurations and corporate financial performance. Using multiple-firm-year data on firms’ social actions and financial statements, we empirically test the presence of the proposed typology of CSR and CSiR activities and their relationship with corporate financial performance. 企业社会责任(CSR)被认为是企业吸引利益相关者并提升财务绩效的有效途径。然而，在企业财务资源有限的情况下，执行企业社会责任的成本是高昂的。现有的研究成果没有对其与企业绩效之间的关系有统一结论，一方面因为实证研究经常把各个CSR维度简单加总成为单一CSR概念，另一方面因为企业社会负责任(CSiR)通常被简单处理为CSR的对立概念。 该研究通过运用配置理论研究企业如何通过不同对待各利益相关者来分组配置CSR和CSiR以实现高的财务绩效。我们强调在每个配置组中，企业需要权衡经济成本和声誉得失，以此提高财务绩效。我们还强调社会行为的配置同财务绩效之间的关系有长短期之分。我们将通过实证数据来检验提出的理论模型。
