17105114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17105114.value: Liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma, HCC) is one of the most prevalent malignancies worldwide and in Hong Kong. The prognosis of HCC is considerably poor as patients are often diagnosed at the late stage of the disease. Despite the well characterisation of the etiological factors of HCC, including hepatitis B and C virus infection, liver cirrhosis and aflatoxin B1 intake, details of the genetic alterations involved in the formation and development of HCC, particularly in HCC metastasis, remain poorly defined. The centrosome, also called microtubule organizing center, is a subcellular organelle which has been implicated in the regulations of cell movement, adhesion, polarity and cell cycle progression. Although compelling evidences have shown that supernumerary centrosome is closely linked to cancer formation, the molecular mechanism of how centrosome over-amplification occurs during carcinogenesis remains elusive. Recently, the PI has identified and characterised a novel centrosomal protein, TAX1BP2 that suppresses centrosome over-amplification. Further studies showed that TAX1BP2 is a putative tumor suppressor in HCC, suggesting that centrosomal proteins play a significant role in hepatocarcinogenesis. The centrosomal kinase, Never-in-Mitosis-A (NIMA)-related kinase 2 (Nek2), is a crucial regulator in centrosome splitting and duplication during cell cycle progression. It has been reported that Nek2 was overexpressed in several cancers, but the molecular mechanism by which Nek2 induces cancer formation is far from clear. To corroborate the involvement of Nek2 in HCC, we examined the mRNA and protein expression levels of Nek2 in clinical HCC samples. Overexpression of Nek2 at both transcripts and protein levels was frequently observed in HCC as compared to their corresponding non-tumorous liver tissues. Notably, Nek2 overexpression significantly correlates with clinicopathological features that represent more aggressive tumor behavior and higher incidence of metastasis. Consistently, stable Nek2 knockdown HCC cells exhibited drastically reduced motility and invasiveness, indicating that Nek2 enhances the metastatic potential of HCC cells. Taken together, our data showed clearly that Nek2 plays an unequivocal role in the HCC development, particularly in metastasis. Here, we propose to investigate the molecular mechanism(s) underlying the tumorigenic activity of Nek2 in HCC. We will define how Nek2 enhances HCC cell growth; investigate which molecules are important for Nek2-induced HCC formation and unravel how Nek2 potentiates HCC metastasis. Lastly, we will confirm our findings in a genetic modified animal model. Thus our work will definitely gain novel insight into the pathogenesis of HCC, and potentially reveal novel molecular targets for new therapeutic intervention. 肝癌(肝細胞癌, HCC) 是在世界各地包括香港最常見的惡性腫瘤。患者常在此病已達晚期才發現患病，以致疾病的預後結果往往不理想。雖然在醫學方面肝癌的病因已相當清晰，其中包括乙型肝炎病毒感染、丙型肝炎病毒感染、肝硬化和攝取黃曲霉毒素B1，但對於肝癌的形成和發展在基因層面的改變，特別是在肝癌擴散方面的基因因素，仍然是不解之謎。 細胞內的其中一個細胞體稱為中心體，也被稱為微管組織中心， 主要負責調控細胞的移動、粘附性、極性和細胞週期進展。雖然現今已有許多科學證據指出含有超出正常額的中心體數目和癌症的形成有相當強的關聯，但是其實際的分子機制仍有待詳細的研究。最近此申請書的首席研究員發現了一個全新的中心體蛋白，稱為TAX1BP2。此蛋白可以抑制中心體不正常增生，同時具有抗癌作用，這些結果引證了中心體蛋白在肝癌的形成過程扮演一個重要的角色。 中心體的其中一個激活酶蛋白稱為Nek2，名字來自Never-in-Mitosis-A (NIMA)-related kinase 2，是調控中心體分裂及複製過程中一個關鍵的蛋白。不少文獻指出Nek2在不同癌症中的表達量增加，但是有關分子機制至今仍不清晰。為了進一步研究Nek2在肝癌的角色，我們分析Nek2在肝癌(HCC)病人樣本的mRNA及蛋白表達量。Nek2在肝癌樣本中的表達量比在相應的非腫瘤肝組織中的表達量高。值得注意的是，Nek2表達顯著與臨床病理特徵相關，包括更具侵害性的腫瘤和更高的癌擴散率。另一方面，在肝癌細胞穩定表達Nek2基因沉默RNA顯著減少細胞移動及其侵害性，這表明Nek2能增強肝癌細胞的擴散能力。 總括而言，我們的數據清楚表明Nek2在肝癌發展，特別是在細胞擴散方面起著明確的作用。在此，我們提出研究Nek2在肝癌的致癌活性的分子機制。我們將研究Nek2如何增加肝癌細胞的生長，分析誘發肝癌形成的分子，並解開Nek引致癌細胞擴散的機制。最後，我們會進一步在基因改造的動物模型驗證我們的實驗結果。我們的工作將會在洞察肝癌的發病機制作出貢獻，同時亦可能發現治療肝癌的新的分子靶點。

17105114.label: Realisation of objectives
17105114.value: For objective 1, we have completed all the proposed experiments. We performed the tumorigenic assays, including the soft agar growth, BrdU incorporation and nude mouse xenograft, using the stable NEK2 knockdown HCC clones established in two different HCC cell lines, PLC/PRF/5 and MHCC-97L HCC cells. The result showed that knockdown of NEK2 significantly reduced the number and size of colonies formed in soft agar growth assay, indicating a decrease in the anchorage-independent growth property. Consistently, knockdown of NEK2 significantly delayed the S-phase progression assayed by BrdU incorporation rate. The result of nude mice xenograft experiment demonstrated that knockdown of NEK2 drastically reduced the volume and weight of tumours as compared to control. To examine the role of NEK2 overexpression in HCC, we attempted to establish stable clones overexpressing NEK2. However, massive cell death was observed starting from Day 3 upon antibiotic selection. The previous report has suggested that such technical difficulty that long term exposure to NEK2 was lethal. Thus, the inducible NEK2 expressing clones in HCC HepG2 cell line was established instead. Surprisingly, induction of NEK2 in the stable clones also suppressed HCC cell growth. The reason for the tumour inhibition by NEK2 is not clear, but one possible explanation is that prolonged expression of NEK2 may cause cell death due to cell cycle arrest. Therefore, this data suggests that the tumour-promoting activity of NEK2 can only operate in a narrow expression range of NEK2. For the study of the role of NEK2 in apoptosis, we challenged the stable NEK2 knockdown clones with apoptotic inducers, TNFalpha and cisplatin, and subjected the treated cells for the apoptotic assay. Although we observed significant cell death, there was no significant difference in the survival rate of the stable knockdown clones as compared to the control. We also probed for cleavage form of PARP and caspase 3, Bcl-2, and there was no observable change in levels, suggesting that the effect of NEK2 on apoptosis is not significant. With regard to the mapping of the structural features that are important for NEK2 oncogenic activity, we have constructed several deletions and the kinase dominant negative (K37R) mutants. However, most of the mutants either did not retain the tumour promoting activity or expressed at a very low level, indicating that the full-length protein is essential for the tumorigenic activity of NEK2. We have also examined the mechanisms by which NEK2 promote cancer formation using the inducible clones. Our results showed that induction of NEK2 led to a higher rate of premature centrosome splitting and supernumerary centrosomes assessed by immunofluorescence staining. Furthermore, flow cytometry analysis revealed that the expression of NEK2 contributed to DNA content increase in inducible NEK2 expressing cells, suggesting that NEK2 may promote aneuploidy in HCC cells. For objective 2, we attempted to map the NEK2 phosphorylation site on TAX1BP2 but was not very successful. One of the main reason is that the commercial source of NEK2 kinase was not very specific. We have generated more truncation mutants to narrow down the NEK2 phosphorylation site, but most of the TAX1BP2 deletion mutants could still be phosphorylated by NEK2. Our multiple trials to bacterially purify the full length and kinase domain of NEK2 protein was also not successful. Using the mass spectrometry approaches, we identified several potential phosphorylation sites on TAX1BP2, but none of them turned out to be the NEK2 phosphorylation sites. Now, we decided to take another approach. We have synthesized a peptide array that covers the whole primary sequence of TAX1BP2 in a serious of 15 amino acids overlapping peptides. This peptide array will be used for kinase assay to determine the NEK2 phosphorylation site on TAXBP2. Using the stable knockdown NEK2 clones, we observed that the degradation of TAX1BP2 was slowed down in the absence of NEK2, suggesting that NEK2 may impair the stability of TAX1BP2. To examine if TAX1BP2 acts downstream of NEK2, we transfected TAX1BP2 into inducible NEK2 HepG2 cells and examined for centrosome splitting. Interestingly, the population of cells with premature centrosome splitting was dramatically reduced when TAX1BP2 was transfected into the cells. Subsequently, different truncation forms of TAX1BP2, including 1-516 a.a., 401-700a.a., 701-1013a.a. and C-terminal domain (CTD, 1014-1314 a.a.), were tested for the inhibition of centrosome splitting. Although the effect of truncation mutants on rescuing centrosome splitting is not comparable to full-length TAX1BP2, CTD exhibits the strongest ability to prevent centrosome separation among all the truncation forms of TAX1BP2. Our data also showed that knockdown of NEK2 decreased YAP expression. As for the effect of NEK2 on the Hippo pathway, we examined the phosphorylation of the upstream kinases of YAP, including LATS1/2 and Mammalian STE_20 kinase 1 and 2 (MST1/2) in stable NEK2 knockdown clones. To our surprise, our findings suggested that NEK2 regulates YAP in a LATS-independent manner as the phospho-YAP Ser127/Total YAP ratio did not differ much among the stable clones, and that phosphorylation of LATS1/2 and MST1/2 was not detectable. This data suggested that regulation of YAP by NEK2 is not through the canonical Hippo signalling. Thus, the notion that NEK2 may directly phosphorylate and regulate YAP functions warrant further investigation. To gain insight into the regulation of YAP activity by NEK2, the transcriptional analysis was performed using qRT-PCR to examine the mRNA expression of YAP, and YAP target genes including connective tissue growth factor, platelet-derived growth factor-beta and bone morphogenetic protein 2 in the stable Nek2 knockdown clones. Differential expression of transcripts was observed consistent with the activation of YAP transcription activity. To further examine the interaction of NEK2 with the Hippo pathway, we performed the co-immunoprecipitation experiments of NEK2 with YAP, LATS1/2 and MST1. However, our result suggested no interaction between NEK2 and LATS/YAP/MST1. To examine if NEK2 affects the protein stability of YAP, the stable NEK2 knockdown clones were treated with the translation inhibitor cycloheximide for protein stability assay. Knockdown of NEK2 significantly impaired the stability of YAP protein, as indicated by the higher degradation rate. Though the exact mechanisms by which NEK2 regulates YAP expression remains elusive, we demonstrated the physiological relevance of NEK2 and YAP upregulation in HCC samples. Liver tumours harvested from our animal model also displayed differential YAP expression among the stable clones, corroborating the in vivo significance of NEK2 regulation of YAP. In essence, we found that NEK2 regulates YAP expression, which may mediate its oncogenic functions. For objective 3, we have completed all of the studies. We performed the migration assays, including wound healing, transwell migration and matrigel invasion, using the inducible NEK2 expressing clones. Our data revealed that NEK2 promoted metastatic cell motility and invasiveness. To corroborate the metastasis-promoting role of NEK2 in vivo, we injected the stable NEK2 knockdown MHCC-97L clones into the liver of nude mice and allowed tumours to form and metastasize to the lung. Diminution of NEK2 markedly impaired the metastatic ability of MHC-97L cells, as reflected by the reduced liver tumour size and plummeted incidence of lung metastasis. In terms of the chemo-resistance, we treated the stable NEK2 knockdown cells with chemotherapeutic agents, including Cisplatin and Etoposide, and assayed for cell survival. However, no significant difference in the cell survival rate was observed in stable NEK2 knockdown clones and vector control under the drugs treatment.

17105114.label: Major findings and research outcome
17105114.value: To characterize the effect of NEK2 in HCC tumorigenicity, we have performed the soft agar growth, BrdU incorporation and nude mouse xenograft assays using the stable NEK2 knockdown clones established in HCC cells, PLC/PRF/5 and MHCC-97L. Our data demonstrated that loss of NEK2 significantly reduced the proliferation, anchorage-independent growth and in vivo growth of the HCC cells. To examine the role of NEK2 in HCC metastasis, we have performed wound healing, transwell migration and matrigel invasion assays using the stable knockdown and inducible clones. Our data revealed that suppression of NEK2 impeded, whereas overexpression of NEK2 enhanced, the metastatic potential of HCC cells. To corroborate the metastasis-promoting role of NEK2 in vivo, we injected the stable luciferase-labelled NEK2 knockdown MHCC 97L clones into the liver of nude mice and allowed tumours to metastasize to the lung. Diminution of NEK2 markedly impaired the metastatic ability of HCC cells, as reflected by the reduced liver tumour size and plummeted incidence of lung metastasis. Collectively our data demonstrated that NEK2 confers advantageous characteristics for HCC cell proliferation, migration and invasion in vitro and in vivo. Our current study has also provided evidence on the crosstalk between NEK2 and Hippo pathway in HCC. Our data showed that knockdown of NEK2 decreased YAP expression in a LATS-independent manner. YAP mediates its oncogenic functions via the TEAD family transcription factors by promoting the expression of multitudinous genes that favour oncogenic transformation. In this perspective, we found that transcript expression of YAP target genes, including CTGF, PDGFβ and BMP2, was indeed affected upon NEK2 suppression. Therefore, NEK2 not only suppressed YAP expression, but also its transcriptional activity, resulting in target genes expression changes that functionally affect the behaviour of HCC cells. Interestingly, our result showed that ectopic expression of TAX1BP2 blocked the function of NEK2 to induce centrosome splitting. Our recent data showed that Hepatitis B virus oncoprotein HBX suppresses TAX1BP2 to promote microtubule dynamic and aneuploidy. Consistently, in inducible NEK2 expressing clones, aneuploidy is one of the phenotypes when NEK2 is overexpressed. This raises the possibility that NEK2 regulates, possibly by phosphorylation, TAX1BP2 to enhance aneuploidy in HCC cells. Therefore, a better understanding on how NEK2 governs the transcriptional and translation regulations of YAP expression and regulates TAX1BP2 would be of great interest, interfering such regulation might be envisioned as a potential therapeutic approach against HCC progression and metastasis.

17105114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17105114.value: In our study, we observed that TAX1BP2 could block the NEK2-induced centrosome splitting. However, how NEK2 regulates the centrosome linker during centrosome splitting is not known. To address this, we propose to use super-resolution microscopy (STORM and 3D-SIM) to study the ultrastructure of centrosome linker using the stable NEK2 overexpressing and knockdown clones. We also observed that NEK2 has a significant effect on cancer metastasis and aneuploidy in HCC, but the mechanism remains uncharacterized. To dissect the signalling pathways that NEK2 promotes aneuploidy and metastasis in HCC, we have employed both co-immunoprecipitation and biotin ligase (BioID) affinity pulldown assays to look for potential NEK2 interacting partner. For the co-immunoprecipitation assay, we used the inducible NEK2 expressing clones to obtain a high level of NEK2 expression in cells. After co-immunoprecipitation, we have identified some partners, including CP110, centromere protein K/M and MAD2B, which are involved in centrosome elongation, centromere function and mitotic checkpoint respectively. In BioID affinity pulldown assay, we have isolated several potential binding partners, e.g. NADH dehydrogenase (mitochondria), Nebulin (Cytoskeleton) and death adaptor molecule RAIDD2 (apoptosis). These novel binding partners suggest that NEK2 may play a role in centromere function, apoptosis and centrosome structures, and further investigation is warranted.

17105114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17105114.value: Cancer is a major health problem globally. In Hong Kong, liver cancer is the fourth most common cancer and the number three killer of all cancers. Although surgery, radiotherapy ablation and liver transplantation are curative treatments for early HCC patients, these therapies will not be viable for advanced stage patients. Unfortunately, HCC is notorious for being chemo-resistant to drug treatment. Therefore, there is an urgent need to identify drugs, which can impede the defence of HCC. Cancer can be caused by excess expression of some genes. If we can identify these genes, it will be extremely useful in curing cancer. Here, we have found one of these genes, called NEK2. NEK2 is an enzyme that can change the rate of cell division. We found that the level of NEK2 was abnormally high in liver cancer. Furthermore, we demonstrated that by reducing the level of NEK2 in cancer cells, it slowed down the cancer growth and cancer migrates to other organs. Therefore, our study suggests that elevation of NEK2 level is a causative reason for liver cancer growth and restoration of the normal level of NEK2 may potentially be a good strategy for cancer therapy.

17105214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17105214.value: 人类的精子离开睾丸后只有经过睾丸后成熟和获能才能完成受精。这些过程中包含精子膜上分子的改变和重组，最终让精子获得与卵母细胞外壳（透明带）的结合能力。虽然精子与透明带结合这个步骤很重要，但它的调节机制到目前为止还不清楚。越来越多的证据显示，精子通过受体复合物同透明带结合，比如一些分子一起工作组成的单元。这些复合物在睾丸后成熟及获能的过程中形成。 半乳凝素-3(Galectin-3)是一种分泌的可以交叉连接糖蛋白使其形成复合物的凝集素。它的作用在细胞粘附，表面受体交互和聚集中都有体现。在男性生殖道中, 半乳凝素-3在附睾，精浆和射出的精子中被检测到，但是在睾丸干细胞中并未发现，这说明精子在睾丸后成熟过程中才获得半乳凝素-3。然而半乳凝素-3对精子功能所起的作用还有待研究。 我们之前的实验数据可以证明半乳凝素-3在人精子与透明带结合中发挥作用。这些发现包括：（1）半乳凝素-3被发现位于精子的顶端，而这个位置正是精子与透明带结合的位置；（2）阻止半乳凝素-3发生作用会抑制精子与透明带的结合在90%左右；（3）外源性半乳凝素-3可以与人类透明带结合；（4）打破精子表面半乳凝素-3的分子结构会造成精子的凝集。 因此我们猜想半乳凝素-3在睾丸后成熟的过程中被转移至精子。移居过来的半乳凝素-3在获能后可以直接起到透明带与精子表面糖蛋白之间的桥梁作用从而调节精子与透明带的结合还有（或者）间接地使透明带受体凝集从而提高精子与透明带结合的活性。这个猜想要通过研究睾丸后成熟、获能，半乳凝素-3活性与精子透明带结合之间的关系来验证，之后还会放在临床辅助生殖中加以验证。 这个课题的结果会让我们对精子与透明带间的相互作用有一个更深的认识。它会为男性生殖道中蛋白很重要这个观点提供一手直观的证据。对半乳凝素-3形成复合物的认识也可以解释精子上透明带受体的聚集机制。为精子膜表面分子动力学研究打开一条新的道路。对于临床来说，这个课题的结果也会揭示检测精液中和精子表面半乳凝素-3含量这种方法是否有用，从而为精液样本能否预测生育能力提供有力证据。

17105214.label: Realisation of objectives
17105214.value: Human spermatozoa leaving the testis can fertilize an oocyte only after post-testicular maturation and capacitation. These processes involve modification and reorganization of molecules on the sperm plasma membrane, resulting in acquisition of the binding ability of the spermatozoa to the outer coat (zona pellucida, ZP) of the oocyte. Despite the importance of spermatozoa-ZP binding, its regulatory mechanisms are unclear. Galectin-3 is a secretory lectin that can cross-link glycoproteins together as a complex. It is known for its action on cell adhesion, surface receptor trafficking and clustering. The role of galectin-3 in sperm functions is unknown. We hypothesize that galectin-3 is transferred to the spermatozoa during post-testicular maturation. The resided galectin-3 can modulate spermatozoa-ZP binding after capacitation by trafficking and clustering the ZP-binding proteins to increase ZP-binding avidity of spermatozoa. The hypothesis will be tested by studying the relationship between maturation/capacitation, galectin-3 activity and spermatozoa-ZP binding, and by correlating them with fertilization in clinical assisted reproduction. The outcome of this project will give a better understanding on spermatozoa-ZP interaction. It will provide the first direct evidence that protein from the male reproductive tract is critical for fertilization. Clinically, the result will indicate the possible use of galectin-3 content in seminal plasma and sperm surface as test for prediction of fertilization potential of semen samples. OBJECTIVE 1: To determine the origin and cellular localization of sperm galectin-3 Galectin‐3 immunoactivity was localized to the apical region of capacitated spermatozoa, a region known to bind ZP. Three major staining patterns of galectin‐3 were characterized on sperm surface. The result was supported by Western blotting. The amount of galectin-3 in the ejaculated and capacitated spermatozoa were 456.1 ± 51.1% and 435.7 ± 56.6%, respectively, compared to that in the epididymal spermatozoa (100%) (P < 0.05; N = 5). The lower galectin-3 immunoreactivity on the epididymal spermatozoa was also confirmed by immunostaining, suggesting that galectin-3 might be acquired during epididymal transit and/or ejaculation. Extracellular membranous vesicles (EVs) were purified from human seminal plasma. Galectin‐3 immunoreactivity can be detected in the extracellular membranous vesicles from human seminal plasma as demonstrated by electron microscopy and Western blotting. To demonstrate the transfer of galectin-3 on seminal plasma-derived EVs to human spermatozoa, epididymal spermatozoa with low galectin-3 expression were incubated with seminal plasma or seminal plasma-derived EVs followed by flow cytometric analysis of galectin-3 expression. Our results showed that both treatments significantly (P < 0.05; N = 5) increased the galectin-3 content on the epididymal spermatozoa with similar magnitude. Consistently, seminal plasma-derived EVs could replenish the galectin-3 immunoreactivites on galectin-3 depleted ejaculated spermatozoa. OBJECTIVE 2: To establish the relationship between galectin‐3 and sperm‐ZP binding Treatment of capacitated spermatozoa with anti-galectin-3 functional blocking antibody at concentration 1 μg/mL significantly (P < 0.001; N = 5) reduced the ZP-binding ability of the treated spermatozoa by ~ 60% when compared to the control with mouse IgG. Consistently, LacNAc (a galectin-3 substrate) treatment significantly (P = 0.018; N = 5) decreased the HZI by ~ 40% when compared to the mannotriose control. The inhibitory effects of the anti-galectin-3 antibody and LacNAc were not due to effects on viability, motility or acrosomal status of spermatozoa. Consistently, the binding capacity of capacitated spermatozoa to solubilized ZP was significantly (P < 0.05; N = 5) reduced by the removal of sperm surface galectin-3. Furthermore, fluorescence-labeled galectin-3 bound to the ZP of human oocytes, and the binding was significantly reduced in the presence of LacNAc (N = 3). OBJECTIVE 3: Study the mechanism underlying the role of galectin-3 in sperm-ZP binding In this Objective, native plasma membrane protein complexes in capacitated spermatozoa with or without galectin-3 depletion were extracted and separated by blue native-gel electrophoresis (BNG). BNG is a technique for separation of biologically active, native protein complexes. The galectin-3-associated complexes or complexes was confirmed by Western blot after BNG. Our results showed that there was no difference on the formation and ZP affinity of the isolated protein complex extracted from capacitated spermatozoa with or without galectin-3. Carbohydrate recognition is required for spermatozoa-ZP binding. Galectin-3 has its C-terminal carbohydrate recognition domain (CRD) linked to an atypical N-terminal aggregating domain (NAD), which enables pentamerization of galectin-3, and thus multivalent binding or even lattice formation of glycoprotein ligands. Therefore, galectin-3 may serve as a cross-linking bridge between ZP glycans and surface glycoproteins on capacitated spermatozoa to promote spermatozoa-ZP interaction. Our results demonstrated the binding of purified galectin-3 to ZP and the capability of sperm surface galectin-3 to bind LacNAc support this possibility. Lipid rafts are heterogeneous, dynamic, sterol‐ and sphingolipid‐enriched membrane microdomains that may serve as platforms for cell adhesion and signaling. Changes in lipid rafts in spermatozoa is associated with ZP binding. To determine whether galectin‐3 is in the lipid raft, lipid raft fraction were extracted from human spermatozoa using the ultracentrifugation with the Caveolae/raft isolation kit (Sigma). The anti‐flotillin‐2 (positive marker, BD Science) and anti‐CD71 antibodies (negative marker, Abcam) were used to confirm the presence of lipid rafts. The colocalization of galectin‐3 and lipid raft marker was demonstrated by the confocal microscope. Therefore, the expression of galectin-3 in sperm lipid raft plays a regulatory role on spermatozoa-ZP interaction. OBJECTIVE 4: To establish the relationship between capacitation and galectin-3 functions Galectin-3 exists on both ejaculated and capacitated sperm surface (see Objective 1) with similar level. However, it is well known that capacitated spermatozoa have a higher ZP-binding capacity when compared to the ejaculated one. Therefore, the identification of similar levels of galectin-3 on the surface of both ejaculated and capacitated spermatozoa may appear paradoxical. By using a fluorescence-labeled galectin-3 substrate, LacNAc-BSA, we demonstrated that capacitated spermatozoa actually have a higher affinity (P < 0.05; N = 5) to galectin-3 substrate when compared to ejaculated spermatozoa. The inclusion of 1 μg/mL anti-galectin-3 functional blocking antibody suppressed the LacNAc-BSA binding on both ejaculated and capacitated sperm to a similar extent with no statistically significant difference. Therefore, our results indicated that although both ejaculated and capacitated spermatozoa express galectin-3 on their surface, capacitated spermatozoa have a significantly higher binding capacity to LacNAc. It is possible that surface galectin-3 on capacitated spermatozoa has more unoccupied CRDs, and thereby more readily binds LacNAc or ZP when compared to that of ejaculated spermatozoa. We have also studied the galectin-3 expression on acrosome reacted spermatozoa by immunostaining. After A23187 induction, the percentage of acrosome reacted spermatozoa was 76.8 ± 5.4% (N = 5), as determined by FITC-PSA staining. The galectin-3 immunoreactivity on the head of human spermatozoa was significantly reduced after the acrosome reaction in vitro. OBJECTIVE 5: To determine the relationship between galectin-3 content and fertilization rate in vitro To establish the relationship between galectin-3 content and fertilization rate in vitro, we analyzed galectin-3 expression in seminal plasma-derived EVs and EVs-free seminal plasma. A total of 97 semen samples with normal semen analysis according to World Health Organization (2010) were analyzed. Our results showed that there was no linear relationship between galectin-3 concentration in EVs-free seminal plasma and all the clinical parameters concerned. There was also no correlation between galectin-3 expression in seminal plasma-derived EVs and sperm concentration, motility, viability and morphology. On the other hand, a significant positive correlation (P = 0.008; N = 97) was found between IVF successful rate and galectin-3 concentration in seminal plasma-derived EVs. Consistently, galectin-3 levels in seminal plasma-derived EVs were significantly higher in men in the above 75th percentile fertilization rate than those in the other percentile groups.

17105214.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17105214.value: Infertility is affecting 15% of the couples at reproductive age. Assisted reproduction treatment (ART) is an effective treatment of infertility. Defective spermatozoa-ZP binding causes infertility, and is a major cause of low fertilization rates in assisted reproduction. The defect occurs in ~80% of oligospermic men. While intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) is very successful in treatment patients with defective spermatozoa-ZP binding, there is no easy method of identifying these patients. The choice between conventional insemination and ICSI is generally based on semen analysis. However, standard semen analysis in ART provides only limited information on the sperm fertilizing ability and defective ZP interaction can occur in 13% men with normal semen parameters. There is no easy method of identifying these patients. To improve the clinical management, it is important to diagnose defective ZP interaction by reliable test before commencing ART. We demonstrated that galectin-3 in seminal plasma is transferred to sperm surface by EVs during post-testicular maturation and plays a critical role in spermatozoa-ZP binding after capacitation. Reduction in galectin-3 expression in seminal plasma-derived EVs may be a cause of low fertilization rates in ART. Our results indicate the possible use of galectin-3 expression as clinical test for prediction of the fertilization potential of semen samples. The clinical value of our results can be evaluated in the future using more clinical samples.

17105214.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17105214.value: Human spermatozoa can fertilize an oocyte only after post-testicular maturation and capacitation. These processes involve dynamic modification and reorganization of the sperm plasma membrane, which allow them to bind to the zona pellucida (ZP) of the oocyte. Defective sperm-ZP binding is one of the major causes of male subfertility. Galectin-3 is a secretory lectin in human seminal plasma well known for its action on cell adhesion. Our studies revealed that the acrosomal region of ejaculated and capacitated spermatozoa possess strong galectin-3 immunoreactivity, which is much stronger than that of epididymal spermatozoa. Expression of galectin-3 can also be detected on seminal plasma-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) and can be transferred to the sperm surface. Blocking of sperm surface galectin-3 function by antibody or carbohydrate substrate reduced the ZP-binding capacity of spermatozoa. Purified galectin-3 is capable of binding to ZP, indicating that galectin-3 can serve as a cross-linking bridge between ZP glycans and sperm surface glycoproteins. Galectin-3 levels in seminal plasma-derived EVs were positively associated with fertilization rates. Reduced galectin-3 expression in seminal plasma-derived EVs may be a cause behind a low fertilization rate. Further studies with more clinical samples are required to confirm the relationship between galectin-3 levels and IVF outcomes.

17105314.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17105314.value: 膝骨性關節炎(Osteoarthritis，OA)是一種常見的退行性關節疾病，是老年人疼痛和致殘的主要原因。OA不僅僅是關節軟骨的磨損，軟骨下骨的改變在OA病理改變的發生發展過程中扮演重要角色。比如在前十字韌帶斷裂導致的關節不穩和OA中，軟骨下骨水腫樣病變出現於軟骨改變之前；而且臨床上發現軟骨下骨水腫樣病變可預測OA病人疼痛和軟骨磨損的嚴重程度。因此，調控軟骨下骨水腫樣病變中的關鍵因子有可能治療OA。內皮素是一種內皮細胞分泌的類細胞因數多肽，俱有收縮血管的功能，通過A和B型受體起作用。我們通過轉基因技術構建小鼠模型，在內皮細胞中特異性過表達內皮素。過往，我們發現內皮素增加血管的通透性，可令損傷組織水中加劇。近來，我們進一步發現這種過表達還導致軟骨細胞的肥大樣變和軟骨基質降解酶的增加。因此，我們提出研究假設內皮素是導致軟骨下骨水腫樣變和軟骨退化的一種關鍵因子，阻斷內皮素信號通路可以減緩或逆轉OA的病程。在本課題中，我們擬比較內皮素過表達轉基因小鼠和野生型對照組在前十字韌帶橫斷後軟骨下骨和關節軟骨的改變，並檢測是否內皮素受體阻斷劑能否有效減輕OA。

17105314.label: Realisation of objectives
17105314.value: The project objectives have been fully achieved as what we proposed. Previously, we reported that hypertensive knee OA patients exhibited worse subchondral bone architecture than normotensive patients[1]. We speculate that hypertension may induce subchondral ischemia and contribute to subchondral cystic lesion formation in OA from a clinical perspective[2]. We therefore explored the phenotype of knee joints of two well-validated rodent models of hypertension[3-5]: one is spontaneous hypertensive rat (SHR) with elevated renin but not ET-1[3, 6]; the other is transgenic endothelial endothelin-1 overexpression (TET-1) mouse using tyrosine kinase-1 (tie-1) promoter[4, 5]. SHR developed much more chaotic subchondral bone change, e.g. a cyst-like void near ACL enthuses, than normotensive Wistar Kyoto rat; yet its articular surface remained intact without any obvious proteoglycan loss till 9-month-old[3]. While 9-month-old TET-1 mice exhibited OA-like phenotypes compared to their littermates: disturbance of subchondral bone, depletion of proteoglycan and disruption of articular surface[4, 5]. Our pilot data therefore highlight the importance of ET-1 as well as renin-angiotensin system in the homeostasis of bone-cartilage functional unit[7]. To study the in vitro expression pattern of ET-1 during chondrocyte differentiation, we cultured ATDC5 cell in DMEM/F12 (1:1) medium with 5% FBS. Time course of related genes during differ- entiation was tested via real-time PCR. Histological and immunohisto- logical analysis was performed using the growth plate from mouse fetus (E18.5) to identify the expression of ET-1 in vivo. Transgenic mice overexpressed ET-1 (TET-1) were maintained in a C57BL/6xCBA background with a standard diet. New born mice (P0) cadavers were collected for whole skeleton staining. Growth plate from P0 mice were collected for histological analysis. Knee joints from 8, 20 and 40 weeks old mice were harvested and the cartilage morphology were studied via Toluidine blue staining. Immunostaining for Col Х was also performed to quantify the number of hyperthrophic chondrocytes in TET-1 and control mice. In chondrogenic ATDC5 cells, Edn1 expression increased in accordance with the hypertrophic marker Col10a1 from Day 7 to Day14 and decreased thereafter. In tibial growth plate of E18.5 mouse fetus, the location of ET-1 was similar to Col Х, predominantly in the hypertrophic zone. Compared to control mice, newborn TET-1 exhibited growth retardation. Length of long bones and vertebrae were found reduced in transgenic group using Alcian blue and Alizarin red whole skeleton staining. H&E staining of whole tibia limbs demonstrated higher percentage of hyperthrophic zone in P0 TET-1 mice. Mild and severe cartilage degradation was found in 20 and 40 weeks old TET-1 mice respectively, while the cartilage of age- matched control mice maintained intact. Furthermore, more Col Х positive chondrocytes were found in 8 weeks old transgenic group. The expression of ET-1 in cultured chondrocytes and growth plate was in accordance with hypertrophy. Overexpressed ET-1 in newborn mice modulated the physiological endochondral ossification and caused growth retardation of tibial limbs. Overexpressed ET-1 in adult mice lead to spontaneous osteoarthritis phenotype, such as cartilage degeneration and increased expression of hyperthrophic chondrocytes. We concluded that ET-1 signaling affected physiological endochondral ossification and osteoarthritis development, which suggested a potential therapeutic target of osteoarthritis. We have checked the well-received destabilization of medial meniscus (DMM)-induced knee OA mouse model. In this post-traumatic OA (PTOA) rodent model, the deterioration of knee joint post injury was accompanied by an increase of plasma ET-1 level, which correlated with the severity of articular cartilage damages. Our study further demonstrated that selective blockade of endothelin receptor type A or B could ameliorate the severity of PTOA, restoring subchondral bone mass and morphology and protecting articular cartilage, in rodents. 1. 17105314.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17105314.value: Others’ and our data showed the chondroprotective effects of selective ETAR or ETBR antagonists in the posttraumatic OA models. Although ACLT rodent model is widely used for investigating disease pathways and for preclinical of novel therapies, the therapeutic efficacy demonstrated in such posttraumatic murine OA model cannot be generalized to human OA with multi-etiologies, and poorly translated to clinical trial. Therefore, we will test the efficacy of Bosentan in both posttraumatic and multifactorial OA rodent models, which will provide us a whole picture for ERA in treating OA with different etiologies. In addition to the bio-imaging and histological assessments, functional assessments of gait and pain will be conducted.

17105314.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17105314.value: Hypertension and OA seem to appear coincidently after the age of 65 and are usually treated separately. If successful, this project will lead to discovery of ET-1 signaling as the shared molecular pathomechanism between hypertension and OA, which will bring a paradigm shift in the management of two different diseases using a unified strategy. It will open a new avenue for repurposing hypertension medications, targeting ET-1, for OA treatment.

17105414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17105414.value: Background Young infants have the highest rates of hospitalization for influenza. WHO recently recommended pregnant women as the most important risk group for seasonal influenza vaccination to protect young infants, but there is a paucity of good data directly linking maternal antibodies to protection from influenza infection in infants. Hypothesis. Our hypothesis is that maternal antibodies(Hemagglutination inhibition, HAI) against influenza A and B protect young infants from the respective infections. Objectives. We aim to estimate the incidence of influenza A and B infection in the first 6 months of life in Hong Kong, to correlate the primary outcome of influenza A or B infection in infants during the first 6 months of life with the level of antibodies against the respective strains and subtypes of the virus in their cord blood and to compare the influenza A or B antibody titres in cord blood of infants who had influenza A or B infection in their first 6 months of life with the respective titres of infants who had no influenza infection. Methods We plan to recruit infants born over a 24 months period from September 2014 through August 2016. A total of 1440 infants (representing 8% of the monthly birth cohort on Hong Kong Island) will be followed from birth until 6 months of age. The cord blood of the newborn will be retrieved from the Clinical Genetic Laboratory and tested for antibodies against the influenza strains and subtypes that have circulated at the end of the 6 month followup period. Active followup will be conducted in the 6 month period by weekly contact alternating phone calls with SMS to elicit sickness event (fever or respiratory symptoms) whereby a home visit will be conducted and a nasal swab for influenza A and B testing by PCR will be performed. Correlation of cord blood antibody titres with the outcome of influenza A or B infection and time of infection in individual infants will be made. Comparison will also be made between cord blood HAI titres and rates of protective HAI titres between infants with and without influenza A or B infection. 背景 流行性感冒(簡稱流感)的住院率以幼嬰為最高。世界衛生組織最近建議孕婦是最需要接種季節性流感疫苗，以保護幼嬰，但母源抗體保護幼嬰免受流感感染的直接關聯證據卻極之貧乏。 論證假設 我們假設對抗甲、乙型流感病毒的母源抗體，具保護幼嬰免受相關病毒的感染。 目的 我們調查香港嬰兒在出生後首6個月的甲、乙型流感感染率和臍帶血內對抗甲或乙型流感病毒的母源抗體水平的關係，以及比較出生後六個月內受甲或乙型流感感染的嬰兒與沒受感染的嬰兒的臍帶血內甲或乙型流感抗體水平。 研究方法 我們計劃招募由2015年3月至2017年2月出生的嬰兒，為期24個月。共有960位嬰兒(相當於香港島每月5.3%的出生率)將會在出生後首6個月被追蹤。初生嬰兒的臍帶血將從臨床遺傳化驗所(Clinical Genetic Laboratory)取得，並測試在跟進期6個月內流行的對抗流感病毒抗體。在6個月的研究期內會每一至兩星期以電話或手機短訊緊密跟進嬰兒有否生病，如有發燒或呼吸道症狀，我們會進行家訪以拭取鼻分泌樣本作甲、乙型流感病毒聚合脢連鎖反應測試(PCR)。臍帶血的抗體水平與個別嬰兒感染甲或乙型流感的時間之相關性將被研究。對受甲或乙型流感感染的嬰兒與沒受感染的嬰兒臍帶血的血凝抑制抗體水平與具保護力水平血的凝抑制抗體率也同時進行比較。

17105414.label: Realisation of objectives
17105414.value: Objectives: 1. To estimate the incidence of influenza A and B infection in the first 6 months of life in Hong Kong 2. To correlate the primary outcome of influenza A or B infection in infants during the first 6 months of life with the level of antibodies against the respective strains and subtypes of the virus in their cord blood 3. To compare the influenza A or B antibody titres in cord blood of infants who had influenza A or B infection in their first 6 months of life with the respective titres of infants who had no influenza infection We planned for following 960 infants (480 per year for 2 years) from birth until 6 months of age. Since the seasonality and activity of influenza B can vary from year to year, we planned to conduct a 2-year study to minimize the chance of not encountering Influenza B that would cover at least 2 winter peaks and 2 possible second peaks of influenza A, as well as 24 months of coverage of the less predictable influenza B season. We planned to recruit 50 pregnant women each month (to follow 40 infants born each month allowing for attrition) for 24 months. The estimated annual number of births on Hong Kong Island is 9000 (750 per month) with 40 per month representing 5.3 % of the total monthly delivery. We proposed to actively followup of infants for 6 months for any respiratory illness by contacting parents via alternating weekly telephone calls with SMS to enquire about illness in addition to parents initiated reporting. A study nurse would make a home visit to perform a nasal swab collection for the infant. Parents were asked to notify research personnel if their infant was hospitalized and this would also be cross-checked at the Hospital Authority computerized Clinical Management System. The collected nasal swabs were tested for influenza A and influenza B by RT-PCR. Specimens positive for influenza A or B virus would then be subtyped for seasonal influenza A H1 and H3 or influenza B Yamagata and Victoria. Cord blood of recruited newborns were also retrieved from the Clinical Genetic Laboratory and tested at the end of the 6 month followup for HAI against the influenza strains and subtypes that had circulated during the first 6 months of their lives. We successfully recruited and completed the 6 months followup of 1092 infants and excluding the initial run-in month (March 2015) and final straggling month (April 2017), in 19 out of the 24 months, there were at least 40 infants born as proposed. This result slightly deviated from our plan because we could not recruit pregnant women by their dates of last menstrual period and we cannot schedule infants to be born. However, since the number of monthly births was around 30 in the other 5 months and these months were scattered through the 24 month period, the number of infants at any one time during the study period was not compromised. Amongst the 1092 infants, 843 (77.2%) had at least one episode of respiratory infection resulting in 1423 home visits and 66 hospitalizations. We documented the incidence of infection was 183 per 10,000 infants < 6 months of age for influenza A and 64 per 10,000 for influenza B. Thus, we were able to achieve the first objective 100%. We encountered some problems with the second and third objectives. We were unable to lineage-type 3 out of 7 influenza B infections. One was because the infant was hospitalized and the specimen could not be retrieved, the other two were because the viral load was too low. The low influenza viral load may be due to suboptimal specimen collection or a low viral burden in these infected infants. The very mild symptoms in these infants seem to provide support for the latter. To overcome the problem, the non-lineage typed influenza B were assigned to the lineage based on the dominant circulating virus lineage at the time, as assessed from influenza virus detection data across all of Hong Kong. Thus, a further 2 influenza B/Yamagata were assigned according to viral circulation at the time when the virus was detected since that was the only lineage circulating at the time of infection these infants. One influenza B infection could not be assigned a lineage because both lineages were in circulation at the time of infection. Therefore, we were able to analyse viral antigen-specific infections and their respective cord blood antigen-specific cord blood titres as listed in objectives 2 and 3. (755)

17105414.label: Major findings and research outcome
17105414.value: 1. There were 1423 home visits and 66 hospitalizations in the 843 infants who had one or more episodes of respiratory illnesses. A total of 27 (2.5%) influenza infections were identified: 20 influenza A and 7 influenza B, including 3 hospitalizations for influenza A (H3) and 1 for influenza B. The overall incidences of infection were estimated to be 183 per 10,000 infants < 6 months of age for influenza A and 64 per 10,000 for influenza B. The annual hospitalization incidences for these infants were 13.7 per 10,000 for influenza A and 4.6 per 10,000 for influenza B. All the influenza A hospitalization in this cohort was due to H3. (Objective 1.) 2. There were very few hospitalizations and there was no difference in HAI geometric mean titre (GMT) between infected infants who were hospitalized and those who were not since the disease was very mild. (Objective 2). 3. 36%, 46%, 43% and 23% of cord blood specimens did not have detectable HAI antibodies against Influenza A/California (H1N1)-like, Influenza A/Hong Kong 4801 (H3N2)-like, Influenza B/Brisbane (Victoria)-like and Influenza B /Phuket (Yamagata)-like virus, respectively. These were the vaccine strains thought to be in circulation during the followup period of the study. There were more cord bloods with detectable HAI and with higher titres against influenza B (Yamagata). Out of the 27 infants infected with influenza, 13 (48%) did not have detectable antigen specific HAI antibodies in their cord blood. In those with higher HAI titres, infection occurred at an older age. No Influenza B infection occurred in infants ≤ 60 days of life. Statistically significant protection in cord blood HAI titres ≥ 40 was seen for influenza B/Yamagata (p= .019).A lack of association between cord blood HAI titre against influenza A/Hong Kong (H3N2)-like virus was seen in influenza A (H3N2). (Objective 3) We only managed to sequence 13 isolates from the cohort but found that 6 were influenza A/Hong Kong (H3N2)-like viruses while 7 were influenza A/Singapore (H3N2)-like viruses, with 4 isolates collected in 2016 and as early as July 2016. There is evidence that the 2 strains were co-circulating in our study period and this may explain the lack of protection seen when the antigen used for HAI was an influenza A/Hong Kong 4801 (H3N2)-like virus. Co-circulation of both strains made it impossible to assign protection even if HAI titres against influenza A/Singapore (H3N2)-like virus were repeated.

17105414.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17105414.value: Testing for HAI as a marker of protection in the influenza H3 subtype may have limitations. Continuous accumulation of amino acid substitutions in hemagglutinin may have affected the HAI assay as a correlate of protection since these substitutions in or around the receptor binding site of the HA molecule have been shown to affect the capacity of the virus to agglutinate red blood cells in influenza A (H3N2). This was not seen in influenza A (H1N1) or influenza B. Future studies should include microneutralization assays for influenza A (H3N2).

17105414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17105414.value: We successfully followed 1092 newborns through the first 6 months of life and documented influenza A and B infections that calculated to be xxx per 10,000 infants < 6 months of age for influenza A and xxx per 10,000 for influenza B. We found that infection with influenza B was much less common than influenza A in this age group. There has not been a reliable documentation of influenza infection in this age group before in Hong Kong. We also found that up to > 40% of cord bloods did not have HAI antibodies against influenza A or B and 48% of infections occurred in infants without HAI antibodies against the specific strain of influenza. Statistically significant protection in cord blood HAI titres ≥ 40 was seen for influenza B/Yamagata. Findings of this study showed that cord blood with high levels of antibodies against influenza can protect infants in the first 6 months of live, but cord bloods of Hong Kong infants lack these antibodies. This study provides support that pregnant women should receive influenza immunization to protect their newborn infants.

17105514.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17105514.value: 衆所周知，能量平衡的調節和維持十分重要，當能量攝取和消耗之間的平衡被打破時會出現肥胖、糖尿病、惡病質和厭食症等病理狀况。因此體內能量平衡的調控是一個及其複雜嚴密的過程，受到神經和體液信號的調節，而最終該過程可以精准控制食欲以及脂肪和葡萄糖代謝的平衡。對于快速食欲控制，餐後胃腸激素分泌會阻礙進一步的食物攝取，這也是餐後我們爲何不會感到饑餓的原因之一。最近我們研究發現，胰泌素這種腦腸肽可以作爲一種降食欲劑，在進食後會被釋放，從而抑制食物攝取。爲了證明胰泌素在脂肪代謝中的作用，我們已經研究表明胰泌素可以在體內控制肝臟膽汁生成。在這份計劃的初步研究中， 我們在三個月的慢性期內給胰泌素受體敲除的小鼠提供高脂肪飲食，從而致使小鼠負載高脂肪量。有趣的是這些受體敲除小鼠體重明顯少于野生型對照組小鼠，這一結果可能是由于小鼠受體敲除後小腸的脂肪吸收效率降低所致。除此，我們還觀察到受體敲除小鼠的小腸中脂肪酸轉運體的表達水平下調，更重要的是在葡萄糖和胰島素耐受測試中，這種高脂飲食的受體敲除鼠與正常個體表現一致，說明胰泌素/胰泌素受體軸的阻斷具有臨床相關性。在禁食導致能量不足情况下，血漿中胰泌素水平及其白色脂肪細胞中胰泌素受體表達都有所升高。另外胰泌素在體內和體外均可以劑量依賴性地刺激脂肪分解，而在胰泌素受體敲除鼠的白色脂肪細胞中觀察不到這種現象，說明胰泌素的脂解作用具有特异性。基于這些初步研究結果及其他研究發現，我們有理由推測在能量過度和不足情况下胰泌素可以調節脂肪代謝。本實驗計劃對胰泌素在脂肪吸收和利用中的作用及其機制進行研究，可以爲肥胖、高血脂、動脉粥樣硬化和二型糖尿病等常見代謝病的治療提供新的發展方向。

17105514.label: Realisation of objectives
17105514.value: Objective 1) Role of SCT in intestinal lipid absorption: 1) Reduced body weight gain in SCTR-/- mice under high fat diet (HFD) feeding: To initially investigate the role of SCT in lipid absorption, SCTR+/+ and SCTR-/- littermates were challenged with chronic excess of energy by feeding HFD for 3 months. Weekly weight recording for 12 weeks revealed that SCTR-/- mice gained significantly less weight under HFD. The difference in weight was partially due to reduction of white adipose tissue. Analysis for cell size of histological WAT sections from HFD-SCTR+/+ and HFD-SCTR-/- mice showed that SCTR-/- mice had developed less hypertrophy as well as less hyperplasty in this tissue. More interestingly, consistent with its reduced weight gain, an improvement in obesity-associated metabolic responses was seen in glucose and insulin tolerance tests in HFD-SCTR-/- mice. We rationalized that the differences in fat deposition could be due to reduced: 1) TAG chylomicrons production from the intestine, or 2) FA uptake at specific fat tissues. 2) Reduced postprandial TG release in SCTR-/- mice: To test for reduction in TAG chylomicron release into circulation after lipid intake, gastric gavage of olive oil at 10µl/10g body weight was given to HFD-SCTR+/+ and HFD-SCTR-/- mice along with i.p.-injection of Triton-WR 1339, an lipoprotein lipase (LPL) inhibitor to eliminate uptake of TAG into peripheral tissues such as adipocyte, heart and liver. TAG content in circulation in HFD-SCTR-/- mice 3 hours after gavage of olive oil was significantly reduced compared to their WT littermates indicating a compromise in the postprandial TAG release from intestines of SCTR-/-. 3) Body composition analysis and indirect calorimetry measurements : The difference in body weight and fat distribution in HFD-fed SCTR-/- and SCTR+/+ and changes in body composition (fat and lean body mass) were monitored by NMR measurements. Body composition measurements through NMR studies further confirmed that after 12 wk of HFD, SCTR−/− had reduced body fat content compared to SCTR+/+mice. In addition, all mice were placed in the cages of the indirect calorimeter system oxygen consumption, CO2 production, heat production, ambulatory movements and energy expenditure measurements45 (Oxymax Comprehensive Lab Animal Monitoring System or CLAMS). Overall respiratory ratio and energy expenditure did not differ significantly between LFD- or HFD-fed SCTR+/+ and SCTR−/− mice. Knockout of SCTR did not affect the locomotor activity or food intake in the dark or light phase. 4) Reduced intestinal FA absorption in HFD-SCTR-/- mice as observed by non-invasive intestinal FA absorption method: Intestinal FA absorption through measurements from the fecal matter were analyzed by giving mice a feed containing 16% fat, 45% nonfat dry milk, and 39% sucrose. Fecal pellets were collected after consumption of the feed for 4 days, and analyzed by gas chromatography. Total fat absorption in SCTR−/− mice was significantly lower than in SCTR+/+ mice. When analyzed for individual FA absorption, both saturated and unsaturated FA absorption were lowered in SCTR−/− mice compared to SCTR+/+ mice. SCTR−/− mice had reduced absorption of oleic acid, palmitic acid, and stearic acid relative to SCTR+/+ mice. These results, taken together, show that resistance to HFD-induced obesity in SCTR−/− was due to reduced absorption of saturated and unsaturated FAs that subsequently led to reduction in total fat absorption. 5) Plasma Lipoprotein profiling reveal reduced chylomicron in HFD-SCTR-/- mice: lipoprotein particle size and concentration in plasma examined 3 h after gavage with olive oil in the presence of tyloxapol revealed a significant reduction in VLDL and chylomicron particle concentration in SCTR−/− mice consistent with the results from fat tolerance test. A reduction in the average VLDL particle size was observed in SCTR−/− mice, but the difference did not reach statistical significance. 6) SCTR deficiency reduces transcript and protein levels of CD36 and MTTP: qPCR analysis of FA transport proteins in the small intestine revealed significant reduced transcript levels of CD36 and its downstream regulators MTTP and ApoB with no differences in FATP4, and intestinal- and liver-fatty acid binding proteins (i-FABP, l-FABP). In line with this, CD36 and MTTP protein levels were significantly lowered in SCTR−/− mice relative to SCTR+/+ mice w hile the protein levels of FATP-4 did not differ between the two genotypes. An up-regulation of Cd36 and i-Fabp was observed in jejunal cells incubated with 1 μM SCT for 40 min, isolated from the intestine of mice with no prior treatment of HFD or oral oil gavage. Levels of Fatp4 and l-Fabp were observed to be unaltered. Incubation of jejunal cells from SCTR−/− mice, as negative control, with 1 μM SCT had no effect, although the expression levels of some FA transporters were significantly lower than in SCTR+/+mice, as expected. 7) SCT induces fatty acid uptake in enterocytes: Direct effect of SCT was confirmed, as SCT was found to stimulate a significant increase in FA uptake in isolated jejunal cells beginning from around 600 s (10 min) when recorded in real time. Objective 2) Mechanism of lipolytic actions of SCT Preliminary studies: 1) SCT stimulates acute lipolysis: Adipose cells isolated from epididymal WAT of C57 wildtype (WT), SCTR-/- and SCT-/- mice were treated with graded concentrations of SCT a time- and dose-dependent glycerol release from WAT of WT and SCT-/- mice but not in SCTR-/- mice, clearly indicating that the observed effect is SCT/SCTR-specific. The in vivo lipolytic action of SCT was confirmed by an elevated free FA level in circulation 15 min after i.p.-SCT in WT and SCT-/- but not in SCTR-/-. Pretreatment of isolated white adipocytes from these animals with 10 µM H-89 (PKA inhibitor), 1 µM R0-31-8220 (PKC inhibitor) or 10 µM SP 600125 (JNK inhibitor) in the presence or absence of 1 µM SCT revealed the PKA-dependence of SCT in carrying out its action, which is further confirmed by in vivo activation of PKA after i.p.-SCT but not i.p.-PBS. Taken together, our results confirm that SCT is able to stimulate lipolysis in vitro and in vivo. 2) SCT activates phosphorylation of 660ser and 563ser in HSL and translocation of HSL from cytosol to lipid droplets in adipocytes: To confirm the involvement of HSL as a downstream regulator, we measured changes in the phosphorylation of the serine residues at positions 660, 563, and 565 of HSL after SCT stimulation. While the protein levels of GAPDH and total HSL of the WT adipocytes were similar with or without SCT stimulation, SCT incubation led to an increase in phosphorylation at positions 660 and 563, respectively, but not Ser565. Additionally, stimulation with Sct did not have any effect on the triglyceride lipase, ATGL, and its positive and negative regulators ABDH5 and G0S2, respectively. Through immunofluorescent imaging, SCT stimulation in isolated adipocytes clearly resulted in the translocation of HSL from the cytosol to the phospholipid monolayer surface of the lipid droplet. 3) Continuous SCT infusion does not increase circulating FFA levels: SCT infusion for 18 to 24 h was found to be unable to significantly change levels of circulating FFAs. 17105514.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17105514.value: In this project, we have successfully established a clear role of SCT in regulating lipid metabolism. Our lab has further demonstrated that multiple mechanisms exist underlying the role of SCT in the control of lipid homeostasis, including dietary fat absorption across intestinal cells and breakdown of fat in adipose cells. From High Fat Diet Feeding of SCTR-/- and SCTR+/+ mice, a working model for SCT-facilitated uptake of fat by intestinal absorptive cells involving a positive feed-forward loop with CD-36 has been proposed. In brief, SCT binds to SCTR to release CD36 in intestinal cells which further enhances the absorption of fatty acid across intestinal cells. Possible co-agonistic action of SCT along with other entero-endocrine hormones such as GLP-1 in combating type-2-diabetes has been proposed. In addition, SCT has been shown to stimulate acute lipolysis in epididymal adipose cells through phosphorylation and translocation of HSL protein. Taken together, the effects of SCT on modulating lipid homeostasis via uptake and breakdown of fatty acids in various cell types have helped to explain one facet of SCT's role in modulating whole body metabolism.

17105814.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17105814.value: Gastric cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer death worldwide. The incidence is particularly high in Asia, including countries like China, Japan, and Korea. Surgery remains the mainstay for curative treatment. Apart from improvement in surgical results, early diagnosis and effective chemotherapy are important measures to reduce the overall mortality. Platinum-based anticancer drugs are commonly used to treat gastric cancer. However, many patients develop drug resistance or systemic toxicity during treatment. Though the initial response to platinum-based therapy is high, majority of patients will develop drug resistance. Thus, novel approaches to potentiate chemotherapy are urgently needed. In recent years, ECF based regimen (epirubicin, cisplatin, 5-fluorouracil) is the standard first-line chemotherapy for patients with advanced gastric cancer. Chemotherapeutic drug enters the cell by passive diffusion and facilitated transport by solute carriers (SLC). These carriers bring platinum into the cells and help regulate copper homeostasis. Overexpression of SLC19A3 (solute carrier family 19, member 3) has been shown to increase apoptosis in response to doxorubicin in breast cancer cells. Moreover, SLC19A3 was found to alter prostaglandin metabolism through cytochrome P450 isoform and 15-hydroxyprostaglandin dehydrogenase. Hypermethylation of SLC19A3 promoter was detected frequently in gastric cancer. Recently, our group has developed a robust and sensitive method to detect SLC19A3 methylation in gastric cancer. Cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) inhibitors have been shown to enhance the chemosensitivity to anti-cancer drug in various cancers. Despite the promising effect of COX-2 inhibitors against cancers, the increased cardiovascular risk cannot be ignored. Prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) and its receptors (EP receptors) were implicated in the carcinogenesis of gastric cancer. Interestingly, blocking EP4 receptor suppressed the intrinsic multidrug resistance gene in hepatocytes. Our laboratory has, for the first time, demonstrated that EP2 and EP4 receptors were involved in gastric cancer growth, which prompted us to propose the hypothesis that EP antagonism could inhibit gastric tumour growth and restore the chemosensitivity to platinum-based therapy through drug transporters. The aim of the present study is to examine the efficacy of EP2 antagonism on drug transporters in response to ECF treatment in vivo and in vitro. To the best of our knowledge, this is a novel study on the impact of EP2 receptor and SLC19A3 in the sensitization of chemotherapeutic drugs in gastric cancer. This study will have the significant potential of improving treatment results in one of the most deadly and common cancer in the world and in Asia. 胃癌是全球最致命的癌症之一。胃癌發病率在亞洲是特別高，其中包括像中國，日本和韓國的國家。外科仍然是主要的根治性治療。對於減少整體死亡率，除了改善手術成效，及早診斷和有效的化療都是重要的因素。胃癌化療通常都是用基於鉑的抗癌藥物。然而，很多患者在治療過程中出現耐藥性或毒性副作用。雖然以鉑類為基礎的化療的初期反應是良好的， 大多數患者會出現耐藥性。因此，有迫切需要發展新的方法促進化療的效用。 近年來，ECF基礎的藥物（epirubicin, cisplatin, 5-fluorouracil）是治療晚期胃癌的標準 一線化療。化療藥物是由被動擴散及溶質載體（SLC）促進運輸進入細胞。這些溶質載體帶鉑進入細胞，並有助於調節銅在身體內的平衡。在乳腺癌細胞，SLC19A3（溶質載體家族19，成員3）的過度表達已被證明提高多柔比星 (epirubicin) 導致的細胞凋亡。此外，研究發現，SLC19A3能通過細胞色素P450亞型和15 - hydroxyprostaglandin脫氫酶改變前列腺素 (prostaglandin) 的代謝。 SLC19A3子的高甲基化在胃癌中經常發現。最近，我們小組已經開發了一個強大的和靈敏的方法來檢測胃癌的SLC19A3甲基化。 在多種癌症，研究顯示環氧合酶-2（COX-2）抑製劑能增加癌細胞對抗癌藥物的反應。儘管COX-2抑製劑對癌症治療的新希望，它增加心血管疾病的危險是不可忽視。前列腺素E2 （PGE2）及其受體（EP受體）都與胃癌的形成有關。有趣的是，阻斷EP4受體能抑制肝細胞中的內在耐藥 抗性基因。我們的實驗室已首次証明 EP2和EP4受體與胃癌的增長有關，這促使我們 提出假設EP對抗可抑制胃腫瘤的生長和 通過藥物轉運載體恢復對以鉑類為基礎抗癌藥物的反應。本研究的目的是在體內和體外探討在ECF化療過程中，EP2對抗對藥物轉運載體的影響。我們相信，這是一個EP2受體及SLC19A3對胃癌化療藥物反應的影響的全新研究。本研究將具有顯著潛力提高在世界及亞洲最致命和常見的胃癌的治療效果。

17105814.label: Realisation of objectives
17105814.value: We showed that EP2 receptor was highly expressed in primary gastric cancer tissues and was associated with advanced stages of tumour. Silencing of EP2 receptor by siRNA or AH6809 (EP2 receptor antagonist) markedly repressed cell proliferation and invasion in AGS and MNK45 cells. More importantly, cells transfected with EP2 siRNA enhanced the sensitivity to ECF (Epirubicin, Cisplatin and Fluorouracil 5FU) treatment in the cells. Reduced cell proliferation was due to increased apoptosis through caspase-3 and PARP. Mice xenograft with EP2 siRNA has a significant reduction in tumour size when compared with control mice. In order to delineate the molecular mechanism of cellular sensitization to ECF, EP2 siRNA transfected MKN45 cells were subjected to drug transporters array. It was found that SLC19A3 (solute carrier family 19 member 3) was significantly upregulated upon EP2 silencing when compared to the control. Solute carriers (SLC) are membrane proteins that control the influx and efflux of therapeutic drugs. The inhibitory effect of SLC19A3 on gastric cancer growth was also seen in ECF-treated gastric cancer cells. Our data also showed that CTR1 (copper transporter 1) expression was reduced upon ECF treatment, and was restored by SLC19A3 overexpression. On the other hand, SLC19A3 abrogated the induction of ATP7B (ATPase copper transporting beta) and MDR1 (multidrug resistance gene) expression by ECF treatment. In particular, there was a negative correlation between EP2 receptor expression and SLC19A3, and yet the levels of SLC19A3 could be detectable in the circulation, hence it might a good marker for treatment monitoring. In addition, we compared the expression profile between control and EP2 siRNA transfected cells by RNA-sequencing. 281 genes were significantly dysregulated in EP2-depleting cells, in which top upregulated genes include FILP1L, MINOS1-NBL1, PGM2L1, EIF3CL and ARRDC3. IPA analysis suggested that these genes were associated with cellular movement, cell death and survival, as well as cell-to-cell signalling and interaction. These molecular and cellular functions play important roles in cellular response to anticancer drugs. Taken together, a novel therapeutic treatment targeting EP2 receptor was shown to be effective in reducing tumour size and enhanced treatment response in gastric cancer. This study provides the basis for the development of a new treatment to improve the outcome of gastric cancer patients.

17105814.label: Major findings and research outcome
17105814.value: We evaluated the effect of blocking EP2 receptor on the response to ECF treatment in two gastric cancer cell lines AGS and MKN45. We demonstrated that both EP2 siRNA and EP2 antagonist (AH6809) significantly inhibited cell proliferation, migration and more importantly, sensitized the cells to ECF treatment. The retardation of cell proliferation was due to apoptosis through increased cleaved caspase-3 and reduced total PARP expression levels. On the other hand, evaluation on the effect of EP2 receptor on tumour growth was examined using xenograft mice model. MKN45 cells were transfected with EP2 receptor siRNA and injected into the flank of nude mice, tumour volume was compared with the control cells. We showed that silencing of EP2 receptor suppressed tumour growth from Day 21 onwards. These findings suggested EP2 receptor is crucial in gastric cancer development and progression. In order to delineate the molecular mechanism of gastric cancer cellular sensitization to ECF, EP2 siRNA transfected MKN45 cells were subjected to drug transporters array. The drug transporter genes between control and EP2 siRNA transfected cells were compared in 3 independent experiments. SLC19A3 was significantly upregulated (>2-fold) in EP2 siRNA transfected cells when compared to the control. The upregulation of SLC19A3 was validated by real-time RT-PCR. The expression level of SLC19A3 was restored to 4 folds in EP2 siRNA transfected cells in comparison with control. Interestingly, a negative correlation between EP2 receptor and SLC19A3 was observed in the primary tumours of patients. The level of SLC19A3 could be measured in the blood, which makes it feasible to be used as a predictive marker for treatment monitoring. The inhibitory effect of SLC19A3 on cell growth was also seen in ECF-treated gastric cancer cells. Due to the fact that solute carriers (SLC) are membrane proteins that regulate the influx and efflux of therapeutic drugs, the expression levels of copper transporters CTR1 and exporters ATP7B in the cells with SLC19A3 overexpressed were evaluated. We showed that CTR1 expression was reduced upon ECF treatment, and could be restored by SLC19A3 overexpression. On the other hand, SLC19A3 abrogated the induction of ATP7B and MDR1 expression by ECF treatment, implicating a novel EP2/SLC19A3-axis drug resistant pathway in gastric cancer. Lastly, MKN45 cells with or without knockdown of EP2 with specific siRNA was subjected to next-generation sequencing. The rRNA-depleted RNA sequencing was conducted on an Illumina HiSeq 1500 at the Centre of Genomic Sciences of The University of Hong Kong. The quality and analysis of the sequencing data was monitored by the bioinformatics team associated with the sequencing core. By comparing the expression profiles between control and EP2 siRNA transfected cells, 281 genes that were significantly dysregulated were released (false discovery rate FDR<0.05). IPA analysis of these dysregulated genes suggested that they were associated with cellular movement, cell death and survival, as well as cell-to-cell signalling and interaction. Further studies are warranted to investigate the molecular and cellular functions in cell response to anticancer drugs in gastric cancer.

17105814.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17105814.value: This study provided evidence that EP2 receptor was crucial in gastric carcinogenesis. Antagonizing EP2 receptor reduced cell proliferation and increased apoptosis, and yet this was regulated by SLC19A3. The expression of EP2 receptor can only be detected in tissues, which is not an ideal marker for disease monitoring. However, we successfully detected the expression of SLC19A3 in the circulation, and found that it was negatively correlated with EP2 expression. Therefore, detection of serum SLC19A3 could be useful in predicting the treatment response in patients with gastric cancer. The prognostic value of this marker warrants further investigation. Furthermore, understanding the mechanism of gene regulatory network could shed light on the development of targeted therapy in this deadly disease.

17105814.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17105814.value: Gastric cancer is one of the most common cancers in the world. Early disease is usually asymptomatic. Hence, many patients with gastric cancer present late with advanced diseases beyond surgical resection. Today, systemic chemotherapy is the only effective treatment available for such patients with unresectable diseases or systemic metastases. However, patients often harbour intrinsic drug resistance or acquired resistance to chemotherapeutic drugs during treatment. This project demonstrated the functional role of EP2 receptor on cancer suppression in cell line and mouse model. The use of EP2 receptor blocker not only inhibited the proliferative and invasive potential of gastric cancer cells, but also synergistically improved the action of chemotherapeutic agent in gastric cancer. Patients with high expression level of EP2 receptor may benefit from antagonizing the receptor to reduce the tumour growth. This study illustrated a novel therapeutic strategy, namely to target EP2 receptor, to improve the treatment outcome of patients with gastric cancer.

17106314.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17106314.value: One of the primary staple grains, rice feeds half the world’s population, and is particularly important in Asia. China is the largest rice producer in the world with some 200 million tonnes per year. In addition to yield, eating quality is increasingly accepted as an important objective in rice breeding. Starch, which accounts for ~90% of the rice grain, has diverse characteristics, e.g. amylose content, gelatinization temperature, pasting viscosity, retrogradation behavior and amylopectin structure, which contribute in complex ways to its texture. Direct measurement of rice texture in relation to human sensory preferences has generally been limited to methods such as texture profile analysis, which lack nanoscale precision and have limited correlation with sensory panel results. Development of rice varieties with precisely understood and targeted textural parameters related to eating quality will offer more choices to consumers. In order to effectively transfer desired textural attributes traits into improved Chinese-adapted breeding populations, we require more information on relevant traits that should be selected. We also require genetic markers that can be used to select for these traits on a large scale at the seedling stage. The genetic basis for surface nanotexture of rice grains and gels, and blunt indentation and fracture of rice starch gels is not yet well enough established to enable effective selection on Chinese breeding material. We aim to: 1. Conduct AFM, blunt indentation and fracture testing as appropriate on cooked rice grains and on starch (flour) gels 2. Carry out genome-wide association study (GWAS) for these rice grain and starch gel textural attributes. 3. Dissect genetic factors contributing to the sensory profiles of rice grain and gels.. 4. Develop a protocol for marker assisted selection to effectively manage multiple component selection contributing to desired rice texture profiles. 稻米是全球一半以上人口、特别是亚洲人民的基本主食之一。中国是世界上最大的水稻生产国，年产稻谷2亿吨以上。除了产量性状外，稻米食用品质也是重要的育种目标。稻米中90%以上是淀粉，淀粉有许多特性，如直链淀粉含量、糊化温度、粘度、回生特性已及支链淀粉结构等，对米饭的质构有重要影响。直接用质构谱仪测定米饭质构，寻找与感官品质的关系，有一定的局限性，因为缺少纳米尺度的精度，很难建立与专家测定的感官品质的关系。 利用精确测定的质构参数培育水稻新品种可以为消费者提供多种选择。为有效地将一些质构参数转化到内地新品种中，我们急需质构相关性状的更多信息。我们也需要利用分子标记在幼苗期进行更大规模的筛选。米饭及凝胶表面的纳米结构、钝状压陷与断裂的遗传基础并没有充分建立起来，这些特性有助于水稻育种材料的有效筛选。 我们的目标是： 1. 测定米饭与淀粉凝胶的纳米结构、钝状压陷与断裂; 2. 米饭与淀粉凝胶这些性状的全基因组关联分析; 3. 米饭与淀粉凝胶感官品质谱的遗传解析; 4. 建立理想质构谱多个参数的分子标记辅助选择体系。

17106314.label: Realisation of objectives
17106314.value: Objective 1: Whole genome sequencing of 100 rice accessions carefully selected from our own rice association mapping panel comprising 416 accessions. The whole genome sequencing of over 100 rice accessions was performed. The USDA rice mini-core collection consists of 217 accessions representative of a world-wide Germplasm Bank. We investigated its genotypic diversity in starch physicochemical properties and the effects of genotype, environment and G  E interaction in this study. High diversity in all 18 parameters of starch physicochemical properties was found in 163 rice accessions grown in Hainan and 155 grown in Hangzhou. Genotypic and environmental effects on these starch quality parameters were analysed for 115 accessions that were successfully produced in both environments. Genotype was the main factor in determining apparent amylose content (AAC), textural and most thermal and retrogradation properties, whereas most of pasting viscosity parameters were largely affected by the environment. G  E interaction played a much less but still significant role in determining starch quality traits. These findings will help guide targeted selection from diverse genotypes in the USDA rice mini-core collection for developing cultivars with desirable starch quality traits. This work has been published in Food Chemistry. Objective 2. Genome wide association study (GWAS) relating SNPs with rice starch gel and grain textural and surface nanostructural traits. We determined the relationships among the structural properties, in vitro digestibility, and genetic factors in starches of 14 rice cultivars. Weight-based chain-length distributions in amylopectin ranged from 18.07% to 24.71% (fa, DP 6-12), 45.01% to 55.67% (fb(1), DP 13-24), 12.72% to 14.05% (fb(2), DP 25-36), and 10.80 to 20.72% (fb(3), DP > 36), respectively. The contents of rapidly digestible starch (RIDS), slowly digestible starch (SIDS), and resistant starch (RS) ranged from 78.5% to 87.5%, 1.2% to 6.0%, and 10.1% to 18.0%, respectively. AAC was negatively correlated with RIDS content but positively correlated with RS content in rice starch. The proportion of short chains in amylopectin, i.e. the amount of fraction IIa (FrIla) fractionated by gel permeation chromatography (GPC), was positively correlated with RIDS. Starch synthase IIa (SSIIa) gene controlled the degree of crystallinity, the amount of fa chains of amylopectin. SSIIIa gene controlled the amount of fb(1) chains. Wx gene controlled the FrI, FrIIa, RDS, and RS. Starch debranching enzyme isoamylase II (ISA2) gene also controlled the RDS, which may suggest that RIDS was also affected by amylopectin structure, although no correlation between them was found. This study indicated that genetics (i.e., starch biosynthesis related genes) controlled the structural properties of starch, and both amylose content and amylopectin fine structure determined functional properties of rice starch (Le., the digestion), each in a different way. Understanding the "genetics-structure-function" relationships in rice starches will assist plant breeders and food processors in developing new rice varieties and functional foods. This work has been published in Journal of Agricultural and food Chemistry. Objective 3: A generalized physical definition for textural assessments by consumers of the cooked state rice starch gel and grain; which in addition to its basic research significance will lead to new sensory-panel independent protocols for use in quality control and product development. We investigated the relationship between physicochemical properties and cooking properties of brown rice and white rice. Brown rice samples generally are found to have higher thousand kernel weight, and minimum cooking time, but lower length/breadth ratio, pasting viscosity values (except setback), swelling power, water uptake ratio, gruel solid loss, cooked length/breadth ratio, and elongation ratio than white rice. Brown and white rice from the same cultivar show some differences regarding their gelatinization proper-ties. The cooking property differences between brown and white rice may be explained by impact of embryo and protection by bran layers. Correlation analysis indicates that cooking properties are little correlated to the flour physicochemical properties, except minimum cooking time. Although apparent amylose contents show strong correlations with most flour physicochemical properties, gelatinization temperature may be preferred to be used for prediction of minimum cooking time in both brown and white rice. The work has been published in Starch – Stärke. Objective 4. Development of a protocol for marker-assisted selection to most effectively simulate multiple components contributing to fundamental texture and surface properties of rice starch gels and rice grain for Chinese rice breeding, and therefore with direct applicability to economic development in China. To identify signiﬁcant trait-marker associations that can be utilized in rice breeding programs for improved starch quality, we conducted two association analyses between 26 molecular markers derived from starch biosynthesis related genes and 18 parameters measured of starch physicochemical properties in two sets of the mini-core accessions successfully grown in two environments in China. Many signiﬁcant trait-marker associations (P < 0.001) were detected in both association analyses. Five markers of Waxy gene, including the (CT)n repeats, the G/T SNP of intron 1, the 23 bp sequence duplication (InDel) of exon 2, the A/C SNP of exon 6, and the C/T SNP of exon 10, were found to be primarily associated with starch traits related to apparent amylose content (AAC), and two markers targeting the 4,329–4,330 bp GC/TT SNPs and 4,198 bp G/A SNP of SSIIa gene were mainly associated with traits related to gelatinization temperature (GT). Two new haplotypes were found in the mini-core collection based on the combinations of the 23 bp InDeland three SNPs (G/T of intron 1, A/C of exon 6, and C/T of exon 10) of Waxy gene. Furthermore, our analyses indicated that the (CT)n polymorphisms of Waxy gene had a non-negligible effect on AAC related traits, as evidenced by signiﬁcant variation in AAC related traits among rice accessions with the same Waxy SNPs but different (CT)n repeats. As the ﬁve Waxy markers and the two SSIIa markers showed consistent major effects on starch quality traits across studies, these markers should have priority for utilization in marker-assisted breeding. The work has been published in Frontiers in Plant Science.

17106614.label: Project Objectives
17106614.value: Specific Aim 1: Elucidate the effects and underlying molecular mechanisms responsible for modulation of mucin synthesis and secretion induced by Fusarium toxins. Experiments will test predictions of our hypothesis that the modulation of mucin biosynthesis and secretion following exposure to Fusarium toxins is associated with several signalling pathways associated with mucins synthesis. For that purpose, MAPK Signaling RT2 Profiler PCR Array will be performed, which is trying to decipher a focused panel of genes involved in the observed changes and MAPK signaling pathways affected by those observed changes. These studies will provide mechanistic understanding of intervention studies with probiotics (Specific Aim 2). Specific Aim 2: Assess the ability of probiotics to beneficially modulate the toxic effects induced by Fusarium toxins on mucin secretion and other important components of the enterocyte-mediated defense responses. The protective capacity of probiotics against the effects of the Fusarium toxins on mucus secretion, intestinal bacterial populations, mucosal permeability and bacterial translocation induced by Fusarium toxins will be evaluated using mouse as an animal model and utilizing the best candidate probiotic strain (selected from our ongoing project). We will design an exposure regimen to stimulate the human exposure experience. We will use two different protocols that vary the time-points of oral administration of probiotic bacteria to determine whether probiotic bacteria could prevent and treat unwanted effects induced by Fusarium toxins.
