To investigate various versions of the problem on hypergraphs, which have applications in combinatorial auctions.

17200214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17200214.value: This project will investigate the classical maximum matching problem of finding a maximum subset of non-intersecting edges, in the case where the graph structure is unknown. The existence of an edge between two nodes remains unknown until the pair is probed; when an edge is found, the corresponding pair must be matched up and removed from the graph. Our goal is to investigate various versions of the problem, and design algorithms to maximize the size or the weight of the matching. The project will bring about technical breakthroughs, and the problem has real-world applications such as online advertising, online dating, and the kidney exchange problem. More specifically, in the oblivious matching problem, the graph is fixed in advance but unknown to the algorithm. The algorithm knows only the set of nodes, and specifies an order of node pairs to probe the graph. The performance ratio is the size of the matching produced to that of a maximum matching. A ratio of 0.5 can be achieved trivially and is tight for deterministic algorithms. Since the mid-1990s, theoreticians such as Fulkerson Prize winners Dyer and Frieze, and two-time Goedel Prize winner Szegedy used sophisticated arguments to prove that several randomized algorithms can achieve ratios marginally (around 0.004) above 0.5. In large-scale applications, this could mean a huge increase in utility. We will develop novel mathematical techniques to produce significant results. In our preliminary work, we use sophisticated combinatorial analysis and mathematical programming techniques to achieve the currently best proven ratio of 0.523. This is a major breakthrough, and provides an encouraging start for the design of algorithms for more general versions of the problem in which the nodes or edges of the graph are weighted. Our techniques also offer us important insights for investigating different versions of the problem on hypergraphs. For instance, the analogous result for 3-uniform hypergraphs would be breaking the 1/3 barrier. This has important application to combinatorial auctions under settings in which complete information is unavailable. In conclusion, there is no doubt that oblivious matching is an important problem for theoreticians and practitioners alike. The proposed project will bring new insights to the problem and the technological breakthroughs will have a significant impact on the wider theoretical community. 本項目將研究在未知圖結構情況下的經典最大匹配問題，即尋找最大不相交邊集合。一條邊存在與否只有當相應的點對被探測時才可獲知；當一條邊被探測並已知存在時，相應的點對必須被匹配並移出該圖。我們的目標是研究該問題的多個版本，並設計最大化匹配大小或權值的算法。本項目將帶來技術上的突破，並且該問題對在線廣告、在線約會及腎臟交換問題中具有實際應用。 具體地講，在該無識匹配問題中，所研究的圖已預先確定，但算法並不知道其結構。算法只知道該圖的點集合，並製定一個點對順序來探測該圖。性能比是指算法產生的匹配的大小與最大匹配大小之間的比值。簡單的算法即可獲得0.5的性能比，並且該數值對確定算法來說是緊緻的。從上世紀九十年代以來，包括Fulkerson獎獲得者Dyer和Frieze以及兩次哥德爾獎獲得者Szegedy在內的理論家，利用複雜的論證證明了某些隨機算法可以達到略微（幅度約0.004）大於0.5的性能比。在大規模應用中，這或許會帶來效用的巨大提升。 我們將開發全新的數學工具以獲得重大成果。在前期工作中，我們利用複雜的組合分析和數學規劃工具獲得了當前可被證明的最好性能比0.523。這是一個重大突破，並鼓勵我們開始針對帶權值點或帶權值邊等普適模型設計算法。 我們開發的工具也使我們對該問題在超圖上的各種版本有了重要的深刻的理解。例如，在3-均勻超圖上的類似結果將打破性能比1/3的壁壘。該結果在無法獲知全部信息情況下的組合拍賣問題中具有重要應用價值。

17200214.label: Realisation of objectives
17200214.value: Objective 1: We have considered the oblivious matching problem on unweighted graphs, where an adversary commits to a simple undirected graph G=(V, E), and reveals the node set V to the randomized algorithm, while keeping the edges E secret (and hence the algorithm is initially oblivious to the edge set). The algorithm returns a list L that gives the order of probing unordered pairs of nodes. Matching is done in a greedy manner. When a pair of nodes are probed, if both are currently unmatched and an edge exists between them, then the two nodes will be matched together; otherwise, we skip to the next pair in the list L, until all pairs in L are probed. The goal is to maximize the performance ratio of the (expected) number of nodes matched by the algorithm to the number of nodes in a maximum matching in G. Our approach is to analyze the well-known Ranking algorithm. The idea is to express the performance ratio has the objective of a linear program, and form linear constraints that capture the structure of the Ranking algorithm. For example, a node that receives higher rank in the algorithm is more likely to be matched; another property is that if a node is unmatched, then demoting its rank will not change the resulting matching. Hence, the minimization LP gives a lower bound on the performance ratio of the Ranking algorithm. Since the objective value of the LP is a decreasing function of the number of nodes, we need to consider the asymptotic behavior as n tends to infinity. Our insight is to replace the primal variables with a continuous primal function and consider the continuous variant of the LP. By analyzing the continuous LP and its dual, we show that the objective value of the LP is at least 0.523, which is our first theoretical guarantee on the performance of the Ranking algorithm on unweighted graphs. This result appears in the SIAM Journal of Computing 2018. We next further improve the analysis of the Ranking algorithm by exploring more structural properties. Another observation we made is that if in some instance, a matched node has two unmatched neighbors, then even if the node is demoted to have lowest rank, it will still be matched. This allows us to formulate new LP constraints. Furthermore, in our continuous LP framework, we allow the function to have jump discontinuities. Using these techniques, we have improved the analysis of the performance ratio to 0.526. This result appears in the ACM Transactions of Algorithms 2018. Based on the techniques we achieved for the oblivious problem, we consider similar problems on unweighted graphs in which the algorithm does not have complete information. In particular, we develop a dynamic data structure to maintain the hop-diameter of a tree with unweighted edges such that the increase of the degree of each node is constant. The result has been published in COCOON 2015. Objective 2: We have investigated the node-weighted variant of the oblivious matching problem. In addition, the algorithm also receives the weight of each node, and the performance ratio is the expected sum of the weight of matched nodes to the sum of node weights in an optimal matching. By analyzing graceful instances in which both a node and its partner in the optimal matching are matched, we can formulate new LP constraints. Since the finite LP is characterized by the granularity of the adjustment function, the best possible performance ratio using this approach can be obtained by analyzing the corresponding continuous LP, which has value at least 0.5015. This result appears in the ACM Transactions of Algorithms 2018. We have also studied the edge-weighted variant, which incorporates the node-weighted variant. Our idea is to partition the edges carefully according to the weights, and run the (unweighted) Ranking algorithm on each part. We analyze this approach using a new primal-dual framework known as matching coverage, in which dual feasibility is bypassed. Instead, only dual constraints corresponding to edges in an optimal matching are satisfied. When the number of distinct edge weights is bounded, and our techniques can lead to a performance ratio better than 0.5. The result has been published in the European Symposium on Algorithms 2016. For edge-weighted directed graphs, we also considered spectral techniques to decompose the input graph such that each piece has small edge expansion. We achieve this by considering a stationary probability distribution of an augmented graph. We show a relationship between the spectral properties of the augmented graph and the original graph. The result has been published in COCOON 2015. Objective 3: Based on the linear program techniques we develop on the oblivious matching problem, we have devised efficient LP-based algorithms for locating densest subsets. In most such applications, one typically aims at finding several dense subgraphs which might correspond to communities in social networks or interesting events. We have defined and studied a natural generalization of the densest subgraph problem, where the goal is to find at most k subgraphs with maximum total aggregate density, while satisfying an upper bound on the pairwise Jaccard coefficient between the sets of nodes of the subgraphs. After showing that such a problem is NP-Hard, we have devised an efficient algorithm that comes with provable guarantees in some cases of interest, as well as, an efficient practical heuristic. Moreover, we have performed extensive evaluations on large real-world graphs, which confirm the efficiency of our algorithms. The results have been published in the ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (WSDM) 2015. We have extended the densest subgraph problem to hypergraphs, which generalizes the problem to a wider class of networks in which edges might have different cardinalities and contain more than 2 nodes. This has applications in combinatorial auctions, in which a densest subset corresponds to a group of desirable items. We have developed two exact algorithms and a near-linear time r-approximation algorithm for the problem, where r is the maximum cardinality of an edge in the hypergraph. Furthermore, we have also considered the dynamic version of the problem, in which an adversary can insert or delete an edge from the hypergraph in each round and the goal is to maintain efficiently an approximation of the densest subgraph. We have designed two dynamic approximation algorithms with amortized poly-logarithmic update times, for both the insert-only scenario and the fully dynamic scenario. Extensive experiments are performed on large real datasets to validate the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithms. The results have appeared in the ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM) 2017. Finally, we also considered other practical applications on hypergraphs such as semi-supervised learning. We used the convex program approach whose objective function is not everywhere differentiable. Exploiting the non-uniqueness of the optimal solutions, we defined the concept of confidence intervals which give the exact ranges that unlabeled vertices take in any optimal solution. Moreover, we give a much simpler approach for solving the convex program based on the subgradient method. Our experiments on real-world datasets have confirmed that our confidence interval approach on hypergraphs outperforms existing methods, and our sub-gradient method gives faster running times when the number of vertices is much larger than the number of edges. The results have appeared in ICML 2017.

17200214.label: Major findings and research outcome
17200214.value: In this project, we give an improved analysis of the Ranking algorithm for the oblivious matching problem. For the unweighted case, we have given a novel LP formulation and analyzed its asymptotic behavior using continuous LP. Our improved results have appeared in the SICOMP 2018 paper “Ranking on Arbitrary Graphs: Rematch via Continuous Linear Programming” and TALG 2018 paper “Analyzing Node-Weighted Oblivious Matching Problem via Continuous LP with Jump Discontinuity”, the latter of which also gave the first analysis for the node-weighted variant of the problem. We have also achieved a non-trivial performance ratio for the edge-weighted variant of the oblivious matching problem. When the number of distinct edge weights is bounded, and our techniques can lead to a performance ratio better than 0.5. The result has been published in the ESA 2016 paper “Beating Ratio 0.5 for Weighted Oblivious Matching Problems”. For edge-weighted directed graphs, we also considered spectral techniques to decompose the input graph such that each piece has small edge expansion. The result has been published in the COCOON 2015 paper “Cheeger Inequalities for General Edge-Weighted Directed Graphs”. We have also considered similar problems on unweighted graphs in which the algorithm does not have complete information. For instance, we have developed a dynamic data structure to maintain the hop-diameter of a tree with unweighted edges such that the increase of the degree of each node is constant. The result has been published in COCOON 2015 paper “Dynamic Tree Shortcut with Constant Degree”. Based on the LP techniques we develop on the oblivious matching problem, we have devised efficient LP-based algorithms for locating densest subsets. The results have been published in the WSDM 2015 paper “Finding Subgraphs with Maximum Total Density and Limited Overlap”. We have extended the densest subgraph problem to hypergraphs, which generalizes the problem to a wider class of networks in which edges might have different cardinalities and contain more than 2 nodes. The results have appeared in the CIKM 2017 paper “Maintaining Densest Subsets Efficiently in Evolving Hypergraphs”. Finally, we also considered other practical applications on hypergraphs such as semi-supervised learning. Our experiments on real-world datasets have confirmed that our confidence interval approach on hypergraphs outperforms existing methods, and our sub-gradient method sometimes gives faster running times. The results have appeared in the ICML 2017 paper “Re-revisiting Learning on Hypergraphs: Confidence Interval and Subgradient Method”.

17200214.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17200214.value: We have developed the continuous LP framework to analyze the performance of the Ranking algorithm for the oblivious matching problem. The next step to use this technique to analyze other allocation problems. Moreover, the insights we have developed in this project can be applied to other problems whose inputs are only partially known. For instance, many classical problems have variants in which the inputs are revealed gradually. Towards the end of this project, we have considered some dynamic data structures and algorithms to tackle this setting, which is an interesting future research direction. Furthermore, while analyzing directed graphs and hypergraphs, we have observed some interesting relationships between clustering, graph partition and spectral properties of the underlying Laplacian operators. In future work, we plan to further explore clustering problems in hypergraphs and develop spectral theories to design relevant algorithms. As we have observed, these problems will have applications such as semi-supervised learning.

17200214.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17200214.value: In this project, we have investigated the classical maximum matching problem of finding a maximum subset of non-intersecting edges, in the case where the graph structure is unknown. We have studied various variants (unweighted, node-weighted, edge-weighted) of the problem, and designed algorithms to maximize the size or the weight of the matching. Several technical breakthroughs have been achieved in this project, such as a novel continuous LP framework to analyze the asymptotic behavior of algorithms. Our results have real-world applications such as online advertising, online dating, and the kidney exchange problem. For instance, in the pay-per-click model, the cost for a click on some ad associated with a certain video is given, but whether a user will actually click on the ad is unknown. This corresponds to the node-weighted or the edge-weighted versions of the problem, where the algorithm knows the node weights or the weight of a potential edge if it exists. We have developed new combinatorial techniques, and shown that performance ratios strictly better than the trivial 0.5 ratio can be achieved. In conclusion, we have brought new insights to the problems and the technological breakthroughs have significant impacts for both theoreticians and practitioners.

17200314.value: 有機電子器件的快速發展衍生出很多新穎應用如柔性手機顯示器，透明太陽能電池或可佩戴的壓力傳感器等, 這些器件均不能由無機半導體去執行及實現。在這些柔性電子器件中, 由於寸減小，而在同一時間在工作功率增正在增加,使熱變和局部加熱成為整體性能的關鍵因素。傳統的溫度測量裝置，例如熱電偶, 通常只能適用於單點測量;至於紅外缐相機,一般只能捕捉物體的表面溫度。因些如要獲得封裝和封閉的柔性顯示器或太陽能電池的二維溫度圖仍然是非常具有挑戰性的。在目前的建議書中，我們建議開發一種基於可被直接集成到柔性電子器件的實時原位溫度測量有機半導體新溫度傳感器。 在這建議書中，我們提出使用金屬/有機雜化薄膜的上超柔性基板用作下一代溫度傳感器。通過仔細地調節金屬和有機材料之間的體積比在薄膜熱敏電阻，就可以實現不同的靈敏度和以及不同工作溫度下的各種應用。新的熱傳感器可以用在電子皮膚機器人，手術設備，體熱傳感器，以及健康狀態監測裝置。對於新式感溫器開發會是重要一環。

17200314.label: Realisation of objectives
17200314.value: In this project, we have successfully measured the activation energy of different organic semiconductors including pentacene, DNTT, C10-DNTT and C8-BTBT. For the metal nanoparticles, we have utilized Al, Ni and Ag. Based on the measured activation energy values, we finalized on using the DNTT with Ag nanoparticle as the most suitable organic/metal composite for the thermistor applications. For the thermal conductivity (k) measurements, we have developed the 3-omega setup to measure the k values of different combinations of organic/metal semiconductors. In the measurements, a metal heater/thermometer will be deposited onto the sample and an AC current will pass through the heater. By monitoring the temperature increase of the heater through a lock-in amplifier, we can evaluate the effective thermal conductivities of the metal/organic hybrid materials. We have also developed a finite element heat transfer model and molecular dynamics model to compare the experimental result with the simulation one. For the density of trap states measurements, we have utilized the gate dependence actitation energy to measure the trap state density at different energy levels. The energy level extra trap states induced by the silver nanoparticles in the bulk organic thin film have also been measured. For the thermal boundary resistance, we have used multilayer structures of alternative organic thin films and use a one dimensional heat transfer model, we can evaluate the thermal boundary resistance between the layers. For the array sensor, we have developed a 16 x 16 active matrix array for direct temperature sensing. The temperature resolution of the temperature sensor is 0.2 K. The sensor is operated by three multiplexer which switch among the gate, source and drain electrodes of each sensing element.

17200314.label: Major findings and research outcome
17200314.value: We found that the activation of pure pentacene thin film is 157 meV and this value will change to 613 and 278 meV after embedding 5 or 10 nm thick silver nanoparticles. While the thermally stable OFETs with DNTT as the active layer, the averaged carrier mobility is 0.5 cm2V-s. The devices deposited on Al/AlOx dielectric works well with low leakage current down to 50 pA. The 2D temperature sensor array can map out the thermal information generated by a Peltier heater successfully. As the thermal conductivity of the active layer would directly influence the thermal information being measured by the thermistor. We spent quite a lot of effort to evaluate the thermal conductivity of the DNTT active layer and its contact resistance with various materials such as graphene, self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) and etc. We found the contact resistance between graphene and DNTT is 5 x 10^-8 m^2-KW. For the DNTT itself, we found the thermal boundary resistance to be 0.73, 0.33 and 0.95 W m−1 K−1 along the a, b and c-direction respectively. The detailed information about each of these major findings can be found in the research output in part C.

17200314.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17200314.value: The array fabrication skills and the measurement circuits developed in the current project has high application potentials for other 2D information mapping. The transistor active matrix developed in this project can be further integrated into optical, pressure, or bio-medical sensors for 2D sensing applications. One of the possible further development direction would be 2D optical sensors for the artificial vision. As the substrate is highly flexible, the optical sensor array can be integrated onto the curved surface for direct light sensing on a contact lens or artificial eyeball. The measured signals can also be further converted into electrical impulse for the nerve stimulations.

17200314.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17200314.value: The major challenge for the contact mode temperature sensor is the rigidity of the sensing elements which limits their applications on irregular objects. More importantly, for the electronic device applications, a lot of the temperature sensors required contact mode sensing rather than the remove non-contact sensing because the active layers are usually covered up by other encapsulations layers and etc. To overcome this challenge, here we have proposed to use metal/organic hybrid thin film as the temperature sensor on ultra- flexible substrates. By carefully adjusting the volume ratio between the metal and organic materials in the thin film thermistor, we have achieved the desired different sensitivities and working temperatures. The current devices developed by us can be used as a new thermal sensors for e-skin of robots, surgical equipment, body heat sensing, and health monitoring applications.

17200614.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17200614.value: Electric vehicles (EVs) have been identified to be the greenest road transportation. Because of electric propulsion, the in-wheel motor drive is particularly attractive which not only eliminates lossy and bulky mechanical driveshaft but also provides electronic differential and advanced traction control. As China has become the world’s largest car manufacturing country while Hong Kong Government has identified that automotive technologies especially EV technology is our strategic area for industry, the development of novel in-wheel motor drives for EVs will exert a long-term impact on our society. Between two main kinds of in-wheel motors, the planetary-geared high-speed motor takes the merit of higher overall torque density but suffers from mechanical gearing wear-and-tear, whereas the gearless low-speed motor is free from any gearing problems but suffers from bulky size and heavy weight. With the advent of magnetic gearing, the magnetic-geared motor or vernier permanent magnet motor can achieve physically gearless direct drive, but both of them demand rare-earth permanent magnets. Because of the high cost, unstable supply and temperature sensitivity of rare-earth permanent magnet material, EV makers eagerly promote the concept of magnetless motors, namely the development of advanced doubly salient motors without using permanent magnets for propulsion. In order to simultaneously achieve the magnetless and gearless concepts for the in-wheel motor, the idea of electronic gearing is born. Namely, the magnetless low-speed motor can be fused with the magnetless high-speed motor to form a novel electronic-geared magnetless motor. Hence, the resulting motor runs at the low-speed mode (electronic low gear) for EV launching and hill-climbing, or the high-speed mode (electronic high gear) for EV cruising. The purpose of this proposal is to develop a novel class of magnetless gearless in-wheel motor drives for EV propulsion. The objectives are: (1) develop novel magnetless and gearless in-wheel motor topologies which offer electronic-geared low-speed high-torque mode and high-speed low-torque mode of operation; (2) formulate the design equations and model the torque production of the proposed motors; (3) analyze the electromagnetic, thermal and acoustic performances of the proposed motors; (4) develop new power converter topologies to perform electronic gearing and power regulation for two modes of operation; (5) develop new control strategies to achieve the desired propulsion performances; and (6) evaluate the whole in-wheel motor drive in terms of technical performances and commercial values. 電動車是最環保的交通工具。當她採用輪轂電機系統驅動時，除可免卻機械傳輸時的損耗，也可以減輕驅動系統的重量和體積，還提供了電子差動裝置和先進牽引控制的優點。今天，中國已成為全球最大的汽車生產國，而香港政府也將電動車技術視為重要的發展領域，於是開發新型的輪轂電機驅動系統將對電動車的發展，產生長期和深遠的影響。現今的輪轂電機主要有兩種，其中行星齒輪高速電機擁有較高的轉矩密度，但是其機械傳動會帶來機械磨損與能量損耗；而另一種無齒輪低速電機雖然不會發生損耗問題，卻存在體積笨重的缺點。隨著磁傳動的出現，磁齒輪電機及游標永磁電機可以實現物理上無齒輪直接驅動效能，但她們都需要依賴稀土永磁材料作為原料。因為稀土永磁材料成本高、供應不穩定、對溫度變化敏感度高等缺點，所以當今的電動車製造商熱切地提倡開發無磁鋼電機，例如積極研發一種雙凸極無磁鋼電機，以解決上述難題。為了同時實現用於電動車輪轂電機驅動系統的無磁鋼和無齒輪概念，一種嶄新的電子齒輪概念應運而生。這個新概念稠合了無磁鋼低速電機與無磁鋼高速電機，變成一種嶄新的電子齒輪無磁鋼電機。因此，新電機可以在低速模式（電子低速檔）下運行，滿足電動車所需的啟動和爬坡能力，又能在高速模式（電子高速檔）下運行，讓電動車能發揮其高速巡航效能。本研究項目目的是開發電動車用新型無磁鋼無齒輪的輪轂電機驅動系統。其目標是：（1）開發新的無磁鋼無齒輪輪轂電機的結構，藉此提供電子齒輪的低速高轉矩模式和高速低轉矩模式；（2）制訂新電機轉矩產生機制的公式；（3）分析新電機的電磁、熱學和聲學性能；（4）開發新的功率轉換器結構，從而進行新電機的電子傳動和功率調節；（5）制定新電機的控制策略，以達到理想的驅動性能；及（6）在技術性能和商業價值方面評估整個新輪轂電機驅動系統。

17200614.label: Realisation of objectives
17200614.value: The 1st objective has been fully achieved. A novel class of magnetless gearless in-wheel motor topologies has been developed for electric vehicles (EVs). The key is to incorporate both the magnetless and gearless concepts into the doubly salient reluctance structure, leading to offer low-speed high-torque mode of operation and high-speed low-torque mode of operation for EVs. Specifically, a novel magnetless electronic-geared (EG) motor has been proposed and implemented in which the multi-tooth bipolar-flux (MTBF) operation is used for the low-gear (high-torque low-speed) situation, and the single-tooth unipolar-flux (STUF) operation is used for the high-gear (low-torque high-speed) situation. Hence, it can offer smoother torque at the low-gear situation, and better torque density at the high-gear situation. Meanwhile, by incorporating both the armature winding and DC-field winding in the stator, various stator-DC motors have been developed, namely the doubly-salient DC (DSDC), flux-reversal DC (FRDC) and flux-switching DC (FSDC). Also, their axial-flux morphologies are developed to compensate the loss of torque density due to the use of DC field windings rather than the high-energy permanent magnets. Consequently, the well-known problem of those doubly salient reluctance structures, namely the high torque ripple, is newly tackled by using double stators in which they have mechanical offset. Instead of using double stators, the concept of mechanical offset has also been realized in the cascaded rotor, which takes the definite advantage that it needs only one stator and hence only one set of inverter. The 2nd objective has been fully achieved. The design equations and torque production models of the proposed class of magnetless gearless in-wheel motors have been formulated. In particular, the proposed magnetless EG motor combines the design criteria of the MTBF motor and the STUF motor, which are governed by Nsp = 2mk, Nse = Nsp Nst, Nr = Nse ± 2k, where Nsp is the number of stator poles, Nst the number of stator teeth per pole, Nse the number of equivalent stator poles, Nr the number of rotor poles, m the number of armature phases, and k any integer. The torque production mechanism of this magnetless EG motor is based on the brushless AC (BLAC) conduction scheme which adopts three-phase sinusoidal-like currents for the MTBF operation, and the brushless DC (BLDC) conduction scheme which adopts six-phase trapezoidal-like currents for the STUF operation. Consequently, the key design parameters of the proposed motors can be identified. The 3rd objective has been fully achieved. By performing finite element electromagnetic field analysis of the proposed motors, the corresponding air-gap flux density, no-load electromagnetic force (EMF), developed torque and torque ripple can be accurately assessed. Then, the copper and iron losses resulting from the electromagnetic field analysis are used as the heat sources for thermal field analysis, thus assessing the temperature distribution of the proposed motors and hence avoiding any possible thermal breakdown. Because of the doubly salient feature of the proposed motors, the torque ripple resulting from the electromagnetic field analysis is used as the vibration source for structural analysis, hence assessing the acoustic noise of the proposed motors. Consequently, the overall performances including the efficiency, torque density, temperature distribution and acoustic noise can be optimized by iteratively adjusting the design parameters. The 4th objective has been fully achieved. New power converters have been developed for the proposed motors. In particular, the power converter of the proposed magnetless EG motor is a fusion of the converters for the MTBF motor and the STUF motor. Namely, the multiphase inverter is designed to properly feed the armature windings, hence providing the desired three-phase sinusoidal-like or BLAC currents for the MTBF operation, and the desired six-phase trapezoidal-like or BLDC currents for the STUF operation. To facilitate the functionality of mode switching, a full-bridge inverter is used on each phase. Nevertheless, with the advancement of power device technology, the cost of this multiphase inverter is economically acceptable. On the other hand, the DC-field excitation consists of two major converters, namely the DC-DC converter and the H-bridge converter. The DC-DC converter is used to regulate the excitation level while the H-bridge converter serves to control the direction of excitation, hence offering the desired flux regulation. The 5th objective has been fully achieved. New control strategies have been developed for the proposed motors. In particular, for the proposed magnetless EG motor, the armature controller adopts the dual-closed-loop control scheme, namely the outer speed loop employs a hysteresis speed regulator for speed control and the inner current loop adopts a hysteresis current regulator for current control. In addition to the dual-closed-loop control, the armature controller needs to provide accurate torque control with good dynamic performance. So, the direct torque control (DTC) is adopted for both the MTBF and STUF operations. The seamless transition between two operations can be realized by equating the torque commands for these two operations at a particular speed. Additionally, since the field controller can directly tune the DC field excitation, both high-speed constant-power control and efficiency-optimizing control are achieved. Furthermore, fault-tolerant control of the proposed motors is realized in the presence of open-circuit or short-circuit faults of armature coils. The 6th objective has been fully achieved. Various topologies of the proposed magnetless EG motor are realized, including the DSDC, FRDC and FSDC types as well as the radial-flux and axial-flux morphologies. In particular, the proposed drive system, involving the EG motor, the associated power converters and the electronic controller, is prototyped. Both the MTBF operation from zero to 600 rpm and the STUF operation from 600 rpm to 1200 rpm are realized for experimentation. The technical performances of the whole system are tested and measured, which confirm that the proposed EG motor drive can effectively fulfill the demanding requirement for EVs. Moreover, the corresponding material cost, manufacturing cost and operating cost are calculated based on industrial standards. Hence, the cost-effectiveness of the proposed EG motor drive can be deduced, which confirms that it has high commercial and market values. Additionally, the proposed class of magnetless gearless machine topologies has been further extended to wind power application which desires high efficiency, wide speed range and high reliability. When the proposed machines operate as a generator, their unique advantages of direct-drive with no transmission loss, wide speed range with electronic gearing, low material cost and high reliability with fault-tolerant capability can enable them to offer high potentiality for wind power generation.

17200614.label: Major findings and research outcome
17200614.value: The research outcome is very fruitful, namely 10 international journal papers [J1]-[J10] and 4 international conference papers [C1]-[C4]. Meanwhile, 2 PhD students have been trained. Concerning the design of the proposed motor topologies, we have conducted a critical overview of magnetless machines [J10] and critically discussed the potentiality of magnetless motor drives for electric vehicles [C2]. Particularly, the magnetless double-stator doubly salient DC (DSDC) motor with mechanical offset has been proposed to offer significant torque ripple reduction [J1]. Instead of using two stators, the singly fed DSDC motor with mechanical offset has also been proposed to suppress the torque ripple [J9]. The magnetless axial-flux DSDC motor has been proposed to offer high torque for in-wheel direct-drive [J2]. The magnetless flux-reversal DC (FRDC) motor incorporating high-temperature superconductors (HTS) has been proposed to significantly improve the torque density [J3]. The magnetless flux-switching DC (FSDC) motor has been proposed for outer-rotor in-wheel direct-drive [C3]. Consequently, the magnetless electronic-geared (EG) motor has been proposed to offer both high-torque low-speed operation and low-torque high-speed operation [J7]. Concerning the analysis of the proposed motors, we have derived the design equations and torque production models as well as performed the electromagnetic, thermal and structural analyses. In particular, the use of mechanical offset for reduction of torque ripples [J1], [J9], the use of axial-flux design for high torque production [J2], the use of HTS for high torque density [J3] and the use of electronic gearing for very wide speed range [J7] have been analyzed. Meanwhile, the multi-objective genetic algorithm coupled with finite-element analysis has been developed to suppress the harmonic distortion [C4]. Concerning the control of the proposed motors, the multiphase inverter is controlled to provide three-phase sinusoidal-like currents for high-torque low-speed operation and six-phase trapezoidal-like currents for low-torque high-speed operation [J7]. Furthermore, by controlling a dedicated DC field winding current to interlink the magnetic fields in two rotors, the double-rotor FSDC motor can generate appropriate torque levels for two driving wheels during cornering, thus offering reliable operation even under faulty conditions [J8]. Furthermore, the proposed motors have been extended to wind generators. The magnetless dual-mode FSDC machine has been proposed to accomplish a wide-speed range under different load currents [J4]. The magnetless multiphase FRDC machine has been proposed to achieve better cost-effectiveness than its permanent-magnet counterparts [J5]. Since the FSDC generator inherently possesses the fault-tolerant capability, the corresponding fault signature has been developed [C1], [J6].

17200614.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17200614.value: The project has been focused on assessing the proposed magnetless gearless motors, especially the performances as compared with the permanent magnet (PM) counterparts. Although the axial-flux morphology has been employed to compensate the reduction of torque density due to the absence of high-energy PM material, the resulting torque density of such magnetless motors can at most in par with the PM counterparts. The use of high-temperature superconductors (HTS) in a magnetless flux-reversal DC motor has been preliminarily investigated in this project, which is very promising to significantly improve the torque density of magnetless motors beyond that of PM motors. Although the power level of electric vehicles may not be justifiable to use the HTS motors which desire complicated cooling arrangements and additional facilities, the power level of electric ships will be well justified for further development of the proposed magnetless gearless motors which can incorporate HTS for the DC field windings and even for the AC armature windings though more challenging.

The in-wheel motor drive is particularly attractive for EVs, which can eliminate the lossy and bulky mechanical driveshaft. Between two main kinds of in-wheel motors, the planetary-geared high-speed motor takes the merit of higher torque density but suffers from mechanical gearing wear-and-tear, whereas the gearless low-speed motor is free from any gearing problems but suffers from bulky size and heavy weight. 17200714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17200714.value: Urban renewal has played an important role on regenerate decaying urban areas in modern societies. In densely populated urban areas dominated by multiple ownership properties, redevelopment by private sector is often prohibited by high transaction costs. Public-sector-led urban renewal is one of the most frequently used means of lowering transaction cost of redevelopment. However, despite the potential positive impact on nearby housing prices, there may also be unintended negative impacts. In this study, we investigate how public-sector-led urban renewal project affect the prices of housing units in the vicinity of the urban renewal project. Urban renewal project should benefit nearby housing price and that such impact should increase with the scale of redevelopment and additional amenities provided by redevelopment project. Besides the well-known positive external effect of an urban renewal, we also aim at examining its potential negative impact on nearby older buildings. We conjecture that, other things being equal, the prices of nearby older buildings (that are not included in the public-sector-led redevelopment project) are likely to be lowered. This is because a significant portion of the market value of an aged building is derived from its redevelop potential, or Clapp and Salavei's (2010) term, its real option to redevelop. The value of this redevelopment potential of a building will decline if it has not been included in a nearby public-sector-led urban renewal project for two reasons. First, the left out buildings have lost the opportunity of enjoying the scale effect of being redeveloped together with the nearby urban renewal project. Second, the probability of being redeveloped by a public-sector-led urban renewal initiative will decline substantially since after the redevelopment the vicinity of the urban renewal project will be considered as "improved areas", which will not be strategic targets for another public sector-led urban renewal project. Over the past few decades, there have a number of urban renewal projects initiated by the Urban Renewal Authority (formerly Land Development Corporation) which is a quasi-government organizations set up by the Hong Kong Government under the Urban Renewal Ordinance. This study uses empirical data from Hong Kong to test the positive and negative impacts of these urban renewal projects on the prices of nearby housing units. 市區重建在解決城市老的問題起了重要的作用。在人口稠密的地區，住宅多為多層大廈，由於業權分散，私人發展商主導的市區重建交易費用奇高，以致往往事倍功半。因此大型的市區重建項目多為公營部門主導。然而，這些項目卻可能對附近樓價有意想不到的負面影響。 在這項研究，我們會探討公營部門主導的市區重建項目如何影響附近住宅價格。一般認為市區重建項目有外部規模效應，可惠及附近樓價。除了市區重建的正面影響，我們也著眼於研究其對附近樓價的負面影響。我們推測，在其他條件相同的情況下，舊樓的價格會都因附近的重建項目而受損。這是因為舊樓的價值來自現有的使用價值和重建的真實期權，而後者會因樓宇沒有被納入公營部主導的重建項目而大幅下調。這是因為舊樓一來失去了享受一同重建產生的規模效應。二來公營部門重建後再在同一地區附近進行重建的可能性較低。本研究利用香港的數據，驗證公營部門主導市區重建項目對附近樓宇價格做成正面和負面的影響。

17200714.label: Realisation of objectives
17200714.value: During the research period, we reviewed literature related urban renewal in Hong Kong and other places, the spillover over effects of urban redevelopment, real option theories and redevelopment real option. Most studies suggest that urban renewal has a positive impact on nearby housing prices but the impact depends on the nature of the redevelopment. (Objective 1) We also reviewed literature on real option theory and it its application to real estate. An important point that is relevant to this study is that the value of a property comprises of existing use value and the value of the real option to redevelop. As a building becomes older, the importance of the latter will increase. One important characteristics of the real option value to redevelop is its relationship with the expected volatility of property prices. Higher expected volatility will increase the redevelopment real option value. (Objective 2) We examined the history of the pattern of Urban Renewal Authority (URA) projects in Hong Kong which suggests that once urban renewal project has been carried out in a particular location, the priority of urban renewal in the vicinity become low as otherwise the building in the vicinity could have been included urban renewal project. Under this situation, the implication of the real option to theory is that urban renewal projects would have a negative impact on the value of the nearby older building, other things being equal. Furthermore, the negative impact increases with the age of the building. (Objective 3) We collected transaction record of housing units within 200 meters from the URA redevelopment sites. The transaction records contain data entry errors and some information is missing. We cleaned the data by identifying and outliners due to data entry error. We replaced the missing data and errors using data from the Centadata website, http://hk.centadata.com/ (Objective 4) We developed a computer Eviews routine for analyzing the data using. We performed different testing procedures with different functional forms. We also examine results from different diagnostic statistics and identify problems in different testing procedures. There heteroscedasticity problems in the error terms, we use the White estimation procedures to correct the potential bias in error term. The results are similar to those before correction (using the OLS estimators). The results are also robust across different model specifications. (Object 5) Our results show that the negative impact of URA redevelopment projects on older buildings are significant. However such effect does not exist in private sector redevelopment projects. After controlling this negative impact, both private and public sector urban development projects have similar positive impact on nearby property prices (Objective 6). There are positive and negative externalities of public sector led urban renewal projects. However, the negative externalities are often ignored. Such negative externalities arise from the planned urban renewal program, which does not exists in market driven private sector redevelopment projects. Public sector led urban renewal project are often backed by legislation to compulsorily resume privately owned properties. Such power is often delegated to a government or quasi-government body, which inclined to develop plans for urban renewal. However, such plan is not needed. The power to resume property need not come with an urban renewal plan. Market forces can guide the pattern of urban redevelopment better than a planned program. Therefore, the URA need not have an urban renewal plan and just let the market forces decide the time and locations of urban redevelopment and only need to use its resumption power to facilitate redevelopment of market driven urban redevelopment projects (new added Objective 7).

17200714.label: Major findings and research outcome
17200714.value: Both private and public sector led urban renewal projects in a densely populated areas dominated by high-rise developments have positive external effect on its neighborhood areas, as they help to reduce the negative externalities posed by dilapidated buildings. Besides, urban renewal may create a better environment and introduce new amenities into a community. These positive externalities would be reflected in higher property values in the neighborhood of the urban renewal project. The results of this study confirm such positive external effects. In addition we found such positive impact increases with the size of the redevelopment and commercial areas in the redeveloped project. In this project, we analyze the impact of urban redevelopment on nearby property prices by decomposing the property values into their current uses and redevelopment option values. The empirical results suggest that public sector-led urban renewal projects have both positive and negative impact on nearby property prices. On the one hand, the impact on the current use value is positive. On the other hand, the impact on the redevelopment option value is negative since the nearby buildings are, by definition, excluded from the urban renewal project. Such negative impact arises from the URA's urban renewal plan, which is expected not to be repeated in areas with recently completed urban renewal projects. Therefore the real option value of nearby older building declined after the completion of a nearby public sector led urban renewal project. In addition, the nearby buildings, even if redeveloped by private developers subsequently, would not be able to enjoy the scale effect of being redeveloped together with the nearby urban renewal project. This negative externality of urban renewal has rarely been considered in any economic impact analysis of urban renewal projects; therefore any positive externality of urban renewal might have been overestimated. Our study also provides an economic explanation on why owners of older units may be disappointed when a nearby urban renewal project is announced. Our empirical results suggest that there is no evidence of the aforementioned negative externality exist in private sector led urban redevelopment projects, other things being equal.

17200714.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17200714.value: The empirical research can be extended geographically to other densely populated cities such as Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and other cities with public sector led urban renewal projects to further test the hypotheses in the research. Furthermore, we can compare the results of the public and private sector led urban redevelopment projects. Another extension is to collect detailed empirical data from case studies to examine the decision making processes of the owners and tenants of nearby older properties, URA, developers and other stakeholders before and after the announcement of the urban renewal projects. The case studies should include both private and public sector led urban renewal projects.

17200914.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17200914.value: 此项目的主要目的是推进无源机械网络综合理论的发展，促进其在机电系统设计及悬架系统控制中的应用。 机械网络在许多动态系统中有着广泛的应用，如汽车悬架系统。为满足期望的指标，故需进行很好地设计。通常很大程度上依赖于设计者经验的机械网络设计可由无源网络综合这一系统的方法进行取代。在此项目中，我们主要针对无源网络（不含电源）展开讨论。由于避免了主动控制中的传感器误差及执行器故障等一些可能产生的严重问题，无源机械网络在一些系统中的应用有着更高的可靠性。 传统上，可通过将阻尼器、弹簧及重物类比于电阻、电感及电容来实现机械与电路系统的类比，其中重物并非一类基本的机械元件。剑桥大学的Smith教授近些年设计了一类名为惯容的新元件，其可完全与电容进行类比。从而，机械工程师便可充分利用电路网络综合中的丰富内容。 在电路网络综合理论中最简实现问题远未得到解决。然而，实现的经济性对于机械网络而言远比电路网络重要。由于其重要的应用价值，网络的最简实现为尚待解决的重要问题。 此项目期望将在系统与控制领域有着重要的影响，尤其是无源网络综合及悬架系统控制。长远而言，此项目的成果则有望在微波电路设计、震动能量转换机的设计、量子电路、生物图像处理及弹性材料设计等领域产生深远的影响。 我们计划研究如下理论及技术问题： （1）我们首先针对双二次函数最简实现这一经典但未完全解决的问题展开研究。并将其结果应用于机电系统的设计。 （2）我们将研究可应用于无源悬架装置中的机械网络综合及可应用于一类特殊连接悬架的n端口纯电阻网络实现。 （3）我们将研究基于上述无源网络综合结果的无源悬架系统设计的优化算法。 （4）我们将利用响应解耦方法来构造无源连接悬架系统的多端口框架。进而，推广至半有源悬架系统之中。

17201414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17201414.value: Database is a core component in a cloud’s infrastructure. Amazon RDS [2] and Microsoft SQL Azure [18] are exemplary cloud databases. Data security at a cloud database is a must-solved problem before cloud service can be widely embraced. The notion of secure query computation on cloud database is to support query processing on encrypted data in a database. The user (trusted party) will perform encryption and store the encrypted data at the database of the service provider (SP), which is an untrusted party. The user won’t reveal the key to the SP in order to protect the data. The challenge is to design an encryption scheme that allows the SP to process queries on the encrypted data. In this setup, even if an attacker can break into the cloud, it won’t be able to see the original data. Previous attempts in designing secure query computation have limited success [12, 21]. In those attempts, encryption schemes can handle a few restricted query types with no extensibility. In this project, we aim at providing one scheme that can handle the basic operators required in an SQL-like query. These operators will be “interoperable” so that general queries can be composed recursively and processed on the encrypted data. Our goal is to make queries on a secure database as general as queries on a regular (unencrypted) relational database. The technique we used is Secure-Multiparty-Computation proposed by Yau [29]. It will be a two-party computation involving only the user and the SP. Every data is methodologically divided into two secret shares held by the two parties. The original data can only be recovered when someone has access to both shares. Since the SP has no knowledge about the share held by the user, even if an attacker can break into the cloud, it cannot recover the original data value. The positioning of this work is summarized as the following. (1) The goal is to design an encryption scheme such that general SQL-like queries can be processed on encrypted data stored in a cloud database. (2) The security in the system will attain some defined security level comparable to accepted industry standard like RSA [22]. (3) The performance of the queries will be close to that of running the queries on an unencrypted regular database. Hence, we will achieve a practical balance between generality in queries, query performance and data security in a secure cloud database. 云数据库服务的核心在于提供一个数据库，并将它作为云基础设施的一个组成部分。亚马逊的RDS和微软的SQL Azure 都属于云数据库。当一个用户把数据发送到云端（服务提供商）时，他就失去了对这些数据的控制。因此云端的数据保护是一个极其重要的问题。这个问题需要在云数据库被市场广泛使用之前就要解决。 云安全数据库概念的核心在于，当用户传输数据给云数据库时，用一种加密方案来保护数据。为了实现这项服务，云数据库必须能够支持对加密数据的查询。这项方案的困难之处在于如何为数据设计一个安全的加密方案，同时还要为服务提供商开发一个用来查询加密数据的高效软件。必须关注的是，用户和服务提供商是互不信任的，用户必须独自拥有加密密钥，并不想将它与服务提供商进行分享。 之前的安全数据库设计工作都成效有限。在数据库查询，例如SQL语句，表达式常常是由不同原函数组成，例如加法，乘法，判等，比较和布尔运算。在之前的安全数据库设计中，加密方案只能处理一些具有特殊性的查询类型，这些查询类型都不具有普遍性。在本项目中，我们旨在提供一个方案，该方案可以处理所有SQL式选择查询中需要用到的基础运算符。在这项方案中，不同运算符将由不同的算法来支持，这些算法将能彼此协作，从而能够计算一般性的表达式。 我们使用的关键技术是基于共享秘密的安全双方计算。它是基于姚提出的安全多方计算。双方计算将涉及用户和服务提供商双方。每一个数据值都将被分成两个秘密部分，由两方各自拥有。他们一起合作来计算查询结果，并且每一方只能看见自己的那部分和查询结果。双方各自不能看到另一方那部分。因此，云端的攻击者只能看见云端那部分。这是非常健全的保护方法，它使得数据免受在服务提供商那方的攻击者的入侵。 我们的目标是开发一个基于安全双方计算的云安全数据库。详细的将在下面章节进行介绍。

17201414.label: Realisation of objectives
17201414.value: With respect to the first objective, we designed a secret sharing scheme between cloud user and cloud server to hide user’s data from server. The database is split into two shares so that user and server each holds one share. Without knowing user’s share, the cloud server cannot recover the plain database and thus data confidentiality is enforced. Unlike traditional secret sharing mechanisms, our scheme is asymmetric such that user’s share is much smaller than that in the server. This is an important feature as cloud services are to relieve user’s cost and traditional secret sharing methods incur a high storage cost to user. Based on our secret sharing scheme, we further developed a series of primitives including (i) arithmetic operations (addition and multiplication) between two encrypted attributes; (ii) arithmetic operations between an encrypted attribute and a constant; (iii) arithmetic operations between an encrypted attribute and an unencrypted attribute; (iv) comparison (>, <, >=, <=, =, BETWEEN) operator; (v) Aggregation (COUNT, SUM, AVERAGE); and (vi) relational operation (selection, projection, group by, join). There are two important features of our developed primitive operators: (i) our developed operators are data interoperable - the result of one operator can be used as input of another operator. This property allows us to support complex computation, e.g., distance computation (that can be done by using multiplication and addition), which is common in many applications, e.g., k-nearest neighbor, clustering, etc. (ii) our developed operators are flexible. Take addition, A+B, as an example, A (or B) can be an attribute in the database or a constant. Even if it is an attribute, the user may choose not to “secret-share” it because not all data is sensitive in practice. With the above developed operators, we are able to support a significant portion of querying functionality in a usual DBMS. With respect to the second objective, we used a two layers approach to implement our system. Since the cloud user needs to store and manage the secret shares and perform query translation, a client layer is needed to be deployed at the user side. We explored different options, e.g., developing a client-side program, for catering the above tasks at user. In the end, we used UDF (user defined function) in DBMS for the implementation so that our integration is non-intrusive, i.e., without modifying the codes of underlying DBMS. This also allows the user, who does not have admin right of the database system, to install our security module in an existing cloud database system. As an illustration, we developed a demo system on Hadoop Hive and we are able to install and run our security module on Aliyun (阿里云). The codes of our implementation are open to public. The following is the link to our open source prototype: https://github.com/andyhehk/SecureDB With respect to the third objective, we performed different kinds of optimization to the system, which are mostly implementation level. Our major result is that we developed an innovative indexing method for our system. Our idea is based on the fact that the cloud server is able to know which encrypted tuples in the database satisfy the selection criteria, although the server cannot see the plain values of these tuples. We call this past result knowledge. When the server has accumulated past result knowledge of a small number of queries, we showed that the server can then infer some information about the plain data. To be specific, the server is able to divide the set of encrypted tuples into a few groups. A partial order can be established among these groups so that all encrypted tuples in one group must have smaller plain values than the encrypted tuples in another group. Ordering information has been shown to be vulnerable to inference attack where an attacker is able to recover the plain data when the ordering of all encrypted tuples is known. This raises two issues: (1) is it secure when the server is able to derive partial order information by observing past result knowledge? (2) can we make use of past result knowledge to improve query processing speed at the server? Regarding the first issue, we performed extensive experiments and the results showed that the estimation made by the attacker is erroneous. For example, when the attacker observes at most 500 queries, the attack accuracy is below 10% on real datasets. In order for the attack to be successful, a recent work [1] has shown that the server needs to observe O(D^4) random queries where D is the domain size. Considering a usual data domain, e.g., 4-bytes integer, the number of required queries is impractical. Thus, we consider it secure for the server to observe past result knowledge. Next, we go to the second issue. Since the server is able to observe queries in operations anyway, our idea to build an index is to let the user simulate the attack and use the recovered information from the attack as the index. The user simulates the case the server has observed a small number of queries, say 500 queries, and performs inference analysis to generate estimated data values of each tuple. We call them sanitized data since such information does not allow the server to derive more information about plain data. The sanitized data are sent to the server by the user as an index. Note that sanitized data is just estimated data, which is not encrypted nor secret-shared. Processing over sanitized data is as efficient as processing on plain data. By using the sanitized data, the server can divide the encrypted tuples into three groups without using our developed primitive operators for secret-shared data: (1) winner: this group of encrypted tuples must satisfy the selection criteria; (2) loser: this group of encrypted tuples must not satisfy the selection criteria; and (3) notSure: the selection result of this group of encrypted tuples is not known. Only the group of notSure requires the server to use our (more expensive) primitive operators to confirm whether each encrypted tuples in the group is an actual answer. From our experiments, notSure group is very small, thus a large amount of cryptographic operations can be saved. In average, query processing time by the server is reduced by an order of magnitude. 1. Georgios Kellaris et al. Generic attacks on secure outsourced databases. CCS 2016.

17201414.label: Major findings and research outcome
17201414.value: We developed a two-party secret sharing scheme to protect data confidentiality for cloud database. A series of primitive operators were developed to perform query actions on secret-shared data. An important feature of our solution is that the operators are interoperable. Complex query can be computed by compositing our primitive operators. This allows our system to support a significant portion of querying functionality in a usual DBMS. Details can be found in [1]. We implemented query translator using UDF (user defined function) in DBMS. Our integration is non-intrusive, i.e., without modifying the codes of underlying DBMS. This allows our system to be deployed on existing cloud database platforms. As an illustration, we developed a demo system on Hadoop Hive and we are able to install and run our security module on Aliyun (阿里云). The codes of our implementation are open to public. The following is the link to our open source prototype: https://github.com/andyhehk/SecureDB. Details can be found in [3]. We developed an indexing mechanism by using past result knowledge observed by the server. The index allows the server to reduce the number of encrypted tuples to be processed by the more expensive primitive operators we developed in [1]. From our experiments, our index reduced the query cost by the server by an order of magnitude. Details can be found in [2]. 1. Wai Kit Wong, Ben Kao, David Wai-Lok Cheung, Rongbin Li, Siu-Ming Yiu: Secure query processing with data interoperability in a cloud database environment. SIGMOD Conference 2014. 2. Wai Kit Wong, Kwok Wai Wong, Willy Yue, David Cheung: Non-order preserving index for Encrypted Database Management System. DEXA 2017. 3. Zhian He, Wai Kit Wong, Ben Kao, David Wai-Lok Cheung, Rongbin Li, Siu-Ming Yiu, Eric Lo: SDB: A Secure Query Processing System with Data Interoperability. PVLDB 8(12) 2015.

17201414.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17201414.value: Our study addressed data confidentiality concern while allowing the cloud server to compute queries over secret-shared data. A complete database system also provides other functionalities, e.g., access control, backup recovery. A dishonest cloud server may not perform such tasks properly and a complete secure cloud database system should address such issues as well. Some issues, e.g., access control, is not straight-forward if the user wants to manage the access control of the database instead of handled by the server. Besides, during our study, we observed that there are currently not many work in the research community to discuss the impact of different kinds of information observed by the server. For instance, we studied on past result knowledge and it allows the server to derive partial order information about plain data. Thus, we identified the following two potential future work: (1) database actions (e.g., access control) on an untrusted cloud server; and (2) comprehensive security analysis of secure cloud database model.

17201414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17201414.value: Cloud database is very popular in recent years. Many companies chose to store their valuable data on a database managed by third-party service providers, e.g., Microsoft Azure SQL database. Yet, data confidentiality is a major concern for many users. Our system provides a feasible solution to address the above concern. Our innovative two-party secret-sharing approach hides the data from the cloud server. At the same time, we developed a series of primitive operators to allow the server to compute queries over secret-shared data. An important feature of our operators is that they are interoperable, allowing complex queries to be computed by compositing individual operators. Our system is non-intrusive, which does not require the user to install anything on the cloud system. This makes it easily deployable on existing cloud database system. Finally, we have performed extensive studies to optimize our system. A major result is that we developed an indexing method based on past result knowledge observed by the server. The indexing method reduces the query processing time by 90% on average.

17201614.label: Project Objectives
17201614.value: Fabricating InGaN Quantum Dots from InGaN/GaN Quantum Wells: To overcome the limitations associated with InGaN/GaN QWs, quantum dots (QDs) are generated through a top-down approach by forming conical structures with atomically sharp tips. By ensuring that the QWs are located at the tip region, additional lateral carrier confinement is realized, turning QWs into QD arrays. Nanosphere lithography is adopted for coating hexagonal-closed-packed (HCP) monolayers of nanospheres which serve as templates for the formation of the cones by dry etching. Investigation of optical properties of GaN Quantum Dots: Quantum dots have optical properties distinct from other forms of quantum structures, making them ideal as gain media for LEDs and lasers. Through a series of optical spectroscopic studies including temperature-varying micro-photoluminescence, near-field scanning optical microscopy and spectroscopy as well as time-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy, the spectral characteristics of the QDs will be critically evaluated. Fabry-perot GaN micro-cavities containing Quantum Dots: Fabry-perot type vertical cavities containing QDs sandwiched between a pair of high-reflectivity distributed Bragg reflectors will be fabricated. Laser lift-off technology allows the sapphire substrate to be detached, giving access to the bottom GaN face for depositing the DBR. The optical properties, including resonant frequencies, threshold and quality factor will be determined. Photo-pumped lasing with this resonant structure also constitutes a goal of this study. Integrating Quantum Dots into Whispering-gallery Micro-cavities: Instead of mirrors, the geometry of the resonant provides the optical confinement. Microdisks are fabricated on the QD-embedded wafers to form whispering-gallery resonators, patterned by microspheres. The spheres are dispersed by jet-printing to maintain spacing between microdisk. The superior radiative efficiencies of QDs promises to further enhance resonance characteristics of the of microdisk, as well as the realization of photo-pumped lasing with high Q. Single-dot in a single nano-pillar: towards single-photon emitters By continually shrinking the dimensions of microdisk, it would become possible to form a cavity containing a single quantum dot, when the diameter of the disk is on par with that of the dot. By trapping a single dot in a single disk or pillar, unique physical phenomenon, notably photon antibunching, can be observed. We also aim at observing sharp spectral line from individual dots from photoluminescence.

17201614.label: Realisation of objectives
17201614.value: The objectives of fabrication, characterization and applications of turning 2D quantum wells into 0D quantum dots have been realized. Instead of adopting the typical approach of forming 0D quantum dots by self-assembled epitaxial growth, the quantum dots are fabricated by a top-down dry etch process, whereby conical structures with sharp tips are formed. The quantum wells at the top of the tip structures will exhibit some quantum dot-like behaviour, as demonstrated from the extensive optical characterization that has been carried out. The preparation of nano-cone arrays with controllable distribution density by inkjet-printing and ICP etching is developed and demonstrated. By adopting this method, 2D closed-packed nano-sphere arrays could be printed accurately at the desired location on a wafer with array diameters of less than 20µm. Acting as a hard mask during ICP etching, nanospheres are gradually eroded away at the same time, leading to the formation of structures of different shapes. Nano-pillars, frustums of nano-cone, and nano-cones are gradually formed with increasing etch periods. PL measurements on the fabricated nano-cones show a significant spectral blue shift of up to 18 nm which indicates strain relaxation of MQWs, which would lead to an increase of quantum efficiency, apart from enhancement of light extraction. The fabricated nanodisk are further characterized using micro-photoluminescence (µ-PL) and time-correlated single photon counting (TCSPC). there is a significant blue-shift in the PL spectrum after the fabrication of nanopillar from 539.9 nm of the as-grown to 431.6 nm of the nanopillar sample, i.e., a total of 108.3 nm. This can be attributed to the strain relaxation effect of the quantum wells. The increase in surface area means that the atoms previously compressively-strained due to lattice mismatch and thermal mismatch are now able to be displaced towards the newly formed sidewall. Strain-induced piezoelectric polarization field in quantum wells thus decreases as strain relaxes, causing a reduction in QCSE. A narrowing of the full-width half-maximum (FWHM) of the PL spectrum due to the fabrication of nanopillar can also be observed. There is a total of 25.1 nm decrease in bandwidth as the FWHM goes from 46.4 nm of the as-grown sample to 21.3 nm of the quantum nanodisks. This can be attributed to an increase in quantum confinement in the lateral direction due to the quantum nanodisk geometry that causes a decrease in volume of the quantum wells. As a result, available energy levels become scarce as the energy of states increases, thus causing a narrowing of the PL bandwidth. The PL bandwidth of the nanopillars should further decrease with decreasing diameter and converges with the optical properties of quantum dots. Time-resolved photoluminescence (TRPL) measurements are carried out in conjunction with the µ-PL setup. The room temperature TRPL lifetime of the nanodisk is only 18% that of the as-grown sample. This can be attributed to an increase in the rate of radiative recombination due to better quantum confinement. The actual improvement of radiative recombination rate would be much more than 5.6 times. This is because at room temperature, non-radiative recombination would be dominant in the as-grown sample, thus significantly reducing its average TRPL lifetime. The effects of dimensional downscaling of the quantum wells is further investigated with the aid of Scanning Near-field Optical Spectroscopy (SNOS) that collects near-field photoluminescence spectra with sub-diffraction resolution. A change in spectral shift distribution is detected with different Indium composition of the quantum wells. By characterizing InGaN/GaN micropillars with different Indium compositions, the relative spectral shift at the edge of a micropillar changes from blue-shift to red-shift as Indium composition decreases. This dependency suggests that the strain relaxation mechanism in micropillars changes with Indium composition, evident from a change in lattice parameters determined from calibrated diffraction patterns obtained from transmission electron microscopy (TEM). As indicated by molecular dynamics simulations, the strain of the micropillar is influenced by the competing strain relaxation mechanisms between the lattice mismatch strain from the quantum wells, and residual strain from other layers and their interactions with the edge of the micropillar. First principle calculations of GaN/InGaN/GaN heterostructures confirmed the effect of strain relaxation on the potential profiles, and thus on the spectral shifts from the micropillars. In order to embed the fabricated quantum disks into micro-cavities, a layer of optical material must be grown over the quantum disks. This is achieved using our in-house developed technique of growing GaN by pulsed laser deposition. Using either a crystalline or polycrystalline GaN source (doped or undoped), films of GaN are epitaxially grown over the fabricated quantum dots to form device structures. Either thicker films (>200nm) or thin films (~20 nm) have been grown to realize micro-cavities of either the microdisk or fabry-perot geometries. Additionally, strategies to further improve the optical properties of the fabricated quantum dots have been studied. Due to inevitable damage by the ions in the plasma during plasma dry etching, ways to remove the damage are explored. The various methods studied include wet etching, digital etching and passivation. Good results have been achieved that contribute to the improvement of optical confinement to optical micro-cavities.

17201614.label: Major findings and research outcome
17201614.value: The feasibility of the proposed approach towards turning InGaN/GaN quantum wells into quantum dots has been established. The major findings include: (1) It is possible to fabricated quantum dot-like quantum disks using top-down approaches by dry-etching through planar structures using spheres as etch masks (2) As the quantum disks are formed, the optical spectrum blue-shifts with respect to the size of the quantum disks; spectral blue-shifts exceeding 100 nm has been observed with quantum disks of dimensions of less than 50 nm. (3) Significant spectral narrowing of the quantum disks has been observed, a clear sign of enhanced quantum confinement effects. Spectral narrowing of >25nm (FWHM) has been observed from the smallest quantum disks. (4) A reduction of the time-resolved photoluminescence has also been observed, attributed to an increase in the rate of radiative recombination due to better quantum confinement. (5) The quantum disks can be embedded into optical micro-cavities by growing an epitaxial thin film of a suitable material over the quantum disk arrays. (6) The qualities of the etched quantum structures can be improved by post processing. The technique offering the most significant ion damage recovery is the combination of digital etching (which is a combination of oxidation and wet etching) and passivation.

17201614.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17201614.value: The proposed method offers a feasible way of turning epitaxial planar quantum structures into quantum dot like structures, increasing the extent and degree of quantum confinement. Since the method is based on conventional planar structures and standard fabrication processes, it is potentially a viable method of fabricating nanostructures without the need for complicated growth processes. However, compared to grown quantum dots, the fabricated quantum disks suffer from ion damage from the plasma etching process. As such, caution must be exercised during this step. Further studies may be conducted to study the effects of plasma etching conditions on the optical properties of the fabricated nanostructures. Also, damage recovery is a crucial step towards restoring the optical qualities of the fabricated nanostructures. A systematic study on the effects of various post-processing procedures should also be conducted.

17201614.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17201614.value: InGaN/GaN quantum disks have been fabricated from quantum well structures by top-down processing. Silica nanospheres serve as etch masks for dry plasma etching through the planar quantum wells to form quantum disks which exhibit quantum dot like optical properties due to enhanced degrees of quantum confinement. The optical characteristics of the quantum disks include spectral blue-shifts, spectral narrowing as well as reduced photoluminescence lifetimes. Recovery from ion damage from the plasma etch process proves to be critical for achieving good optical confinement within the nanostructures.
