17305314.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305314.value: The growth and decay of the large ice sheets during the last Ice Age still cause the surface of the earth to deform, land to tilt, rivers to detour, sealevel to change, stress to induce earthquakes and mantle rocks to flow today. The movement of mass in the mantle and ice-water mass on the surface between sea and land changes the earth’s gravity field and rotational motion. All these are part of the Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) process and the numerical modeling of it is very important both practically and academically (see below). Until recently, many models of the GIA process assume that mantle rheology is linear and that material properties only vary in the radial direction. However, surface geology and seismic tomography show that there is lateral heterogeneity. Also, rock physics experiments show that the flow law in the mantle is a combination of both linear and nonlinear creep (i.e. composite rheology). If that is true, then our understanding of the pattern of mantle flow and the rate of deformation in the crust and mantle may be altered. Another important issue concerns the ice thickness models constructed from current GIA studies which appear to be too thin to be acceptable by glaciology. The aim is to construct new ice history models that are consistent with GIA observations in a 3D mantle with composite rheology. Observations such as location and isochrone of terminal moraines, ice flow, global sealevel, 3D crustal motion, gravity changes, earth rotation, river incision, postglacial faults orientation, rock physics & other data are used as constraints to find the best ice-rheology combination using the Coupled Poisson-Finite Element numerical model of GIA. The outcome of this study helps us better understand how the ice sheet thickness has evolved in both time and space and this leads to better understanding of glaciology and climate change. It also allows us to better understand the source of global sea level change and monitor global warming. Understanding of GIA induced sea level change is also important to coastal engineering, the adoption of a dynamic geodetic height reference system, which is required in positioning and in engineering construction projects. Better knowledge of the viscosity or rheology structure of the earth is also crucial in understanding thermal evolution, mantle dynamics and plate tectonics that shaped the structure of our planet in the past, present and future. 上一個冰川期大冰川的生長和退化對地球今天的影響仍在，它使地表變形，大地傾斜，河流改道，海平面改變，使地壓誘發地震，地幔岩石流動。地幔質量以及在海洋和大地之間循環的地表水的質量的運動，改變了地球的重力場和地球的轉動。所有這些都是冰川均衡調整（GIA）過程的一部分，對它的數值模擬無論在實踐上還是學術上都非常重要。 直到最近，許多關於GIA過程的模型假定地幔流變是線性的，而且構成地球的物質的性質只在徑向有變化。但是，表面地質學和地震層析成像表明，它存在橫向不均勻性。而且，岩石物理實驗表明，地幔流動法則是線性和非線性蠕變的結合（比如，綜合流變學）。如果這是真的，那麼，我們對地幔流動模式和地殼、地幔形變率的理解或許需要改變。另一個重要的問題是關於冰厚度模型的，這個模型依據現在的GIA研究建立，但是冰厚度看起來太薄以至於無法被冰川學接受。 我們的目標是，運用綜合流變學且利用數值模擬建立冰川歷史的新模型，使其和三維地幔冰川均衡學相吻合。我們利用地質數據，比如位置，终端冰碛等时线，冰流或河流，全球海平面數據，三維地殼運動，重力變化，地球轉動，衛星測量，冰後期斷層和板內地震活動數據，作為耦合泊松有限元模型的約束條件來實現目標。 這些結果能幫助我們更好的理解冰川厚度是怎樣隨時間和空間演化，而這有助於我們更好地理解冰川學和氣候變化。而且，這也能使我們更好地理解全球海平面變化的根源并監控全球變暖。理解GIA引起的海平面變化對海岸工程學---採用動態高度測量參考系統，在定位和工程建造項目上運用，也很重要。研究GIA也能更好地理解粘度和地球的流變學結構。粘度的知識在理解熱演化，地幔動力學和決定地球過去，現在和未來的板塊構造學上是至關重要的。

17305314.label: Major findings and research outcome
17305314.value: Ice model ICE-6G, which is constructed with the assumption of linear rheology, is one of the best ice sheet models so far, and is thus highly cited in the literature. However, the assumption of linear rheology is not realistic, because creep experiments show that both linear and nonlinear creep operate in the mantle simultaneously. Here, we construct ice models with composite rheology that takes both linear and nonlinear creep laws into account, and is thus more realistic. However, the question is whether composite rheology can explain all the observations of Glaical Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) simultaneously and if the creep parameters used are consistent with the findings of creep experiments. In this work, we have constructed an ice model ICE-C in combination with a composite rheology model M_C. We show that this model combination can fit the observations of GIA simultaneously and can do it better than ICE-6G. Also, the creep parameters in model M_C are consistent with the findings of creep experiments. Since composite rheology is more realistic than linear rheology, and its presence can affect the dynamics and evolution of the Earth, it should be investigated in future models of earth dynamics. The thickness of the Fennoscandian ice sheet during the last Ice Age in ICE-C is much thicker than that in ICE-6G, and this may affect the reconstruction of paleo-climate there as the ice model provides lower boundary conditions in models of global circulation and climate change. The ICE-C(M_C) combination assumes that there is not a strong interaction between the stress of GIA and the ambient stress of plate tectonics. We have also studied the effect of such stress interaction with different levels of ambient tectonic stress. It is found that when tectonic stress level exceeds about 10 MPa, then the interaction is strong, but that would make it very difficult to explain the GIA observations. If the tectonic stress level is 10 MPa or below, the interaction is weak and GIA stress dominates. So, the ICE-C(M_C) combination is the only alternative. It is speculated that shear heating due to GIA on an Earth may trigger volcanism during the Quaternary, affect the stability of ice sheets and alter mantle viscosity. Our work with linear, nonlinear and composite mantle rheologies however demonstrates that this is not possible.

17305314.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17305314.value: In this work, the focus is on the reconstruction of ice sheets in North America and northern Eurasia but neglected the ice sheets in Greenland, Iceland and Antarctica due to the lack of GIA observations as constraints there. Future work should include the reconstruction of ice sheets in Greenland, Iceland and Antarctica with composite rheology when more GIA observations there become available. This research also opens the door for more GIA model studies with composite rheology.

17305314.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17305314.value: Reconstruction of paleo-ice sheet history is very useful in the understanding of climate change and sea level rise in the past, present and future. The changing thickness of the ice sheets on land, and the melt-water that goes into ocean, load and deform the Earth continuously. This deformation is recorded by observations such as sea-level change, land uplift rates and gravity changes in time. Thus these observations can be used to constrain and reconstruct the paleo-ice sheet history in the last Ice Age. Past ice history reconstructions assumes a flow law in the mantle that is very simple but less realistic. With a more realistic mantle flow law in model M_C, we have reconstructed the ice model ICE-C. This new ice model has thicker ice sheets in northern Europe than is generally believed and can affect the reconstruction of paleo-climate there. The more realistic flow law in the mantle may also affect the tectonics, dynamics and the evolution of the Earth.

17305614.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305614.value: There has been a long-standing interest in π-conjugated molecules given their versatility and capability to generate unique optical and electronic properties. While studies in the design and optoelectronic properties of π-conjugated molecules and materials are proliferating, most of them are focused on carbocycles and heterocycles of nitrogen and sulfur, with corresponding studies on heterocycles of other main group elements being less extensively explored. The majority of the studies on π-conjugated materials have also been mainly focused on their electronic properties, especially their semi-conducting properties, and more recently, donor-acceptor properties for light-harvesting and optoelectronic properties. The development of other functional properties, such as those of photofunctional especially photoswitching or photochromic, is much less explored; not to mention multifunctional π-conjugated systems which are even much less developed. While supramolecular assembly studies of carbocycles and heterocycles of nitrogen and sulfur are known, corresponding studies on heterocycles of other main group elements are scarce. Incorporation of metal centres into such π-conjugated systems, which is believed to add a new research dimension, is also limited, with even less attention focused on the supramolecular assembly of materials containing metal-ligand coordination. In particular, metal-ligand coordination that will lead to low-dimensional geometries will likely generate supramolecular assemblies that may show cooperative and synergistic stacking interactions. In this project, novel classes of functionalized π-conjugated heterocycles and their metal complexes and main group coordination compounds will be designed and synthesized. Their excited-state sensitization, photoswitching and supramolecular assembly properties will be studied. Attempts will be made to explore their supramolecular nanostructured assembly and to realize how a control of the supramolecular assembly and aggregation can lead to modulation of their photofunctional properties. An understanding of the factors that lead to the control of the excited state sensitization, energy transfer, photoswitching and the supramolecular assembly, architecture and morphologies of the organized structures of the π-conjugated heterocycles and their metal complexes and main group coordination compounds via a control of the aggregation of the heterocycles versus metal-ligand coordination chromophores will be made. It is envisaged that the proposed work will provide fundamental understanding of the factors that govern their design and their unique spectroscopic and photofunctional properties, which will provide insights and guiding principles for rational design of novel π-conjugated heterocycles and their metal-ligand and main group coordination compounds and assemblies, offering interesting new research dimensions for the discovery of new classes of π-conjugated heterocycles and their metal-containing and main group coordination derivatives. 鑑於π–共軛分子於產生獨特光學和電學性質方面的多變和多功能性，人們對這些分子有長期的研究興趣。π–共軛分子和材料之設計和光電性質的研究與日俱增，然而大部分研究都集中於碳環和氮硫雜環，基於其他主族元素的雜環之相關研究則相對較少。大部分的π–共軛材料研究亦主要集中於其電學性質，尤其是它們的半導體特性，以及較近期的、用於集光和光電特性的供體–受體性質。姑置勿陳極少人研究的多功能π–共軛系統，其他功能性質方面的發展，如光開關和光致變色之類的光功能特性，相關研究也很少。已知碳環和氮硫雜環的超分子組裝，基於其他主族元素的雜環的研究卻仍屬罕見。把金屬中心加入這些雜環體系之中，相信可以帶來新的研究方向，但這方面的工作也很有限，而含有金屬–配體配位的超分子組裝材料更是不太受到關注。特別的是，可構築低維度幾何構型的金屬–配體配位有機會產生具合作性及協同性堆疊相互作用的超分子組裝物。本研究項目會設計和合成新穎的功能性π–共軛雜環及它們的金屬配合物和主族元素配合物，並研究這些化合物的激態敏化作用、光開關作用和超分子組裝特性。本項目也會嘗試探索它們的超分子納米結構組裝，以實現如何透過控制超分子組裝和聚集來調節其光功能特性。通過控制雜環與其金屬–配體配位發色團的聚集，可以理解能調節雜環與其金屬配合物和主族元素配合物的激態敏化作用、電子轉移、光開關作用，以及這些分子之組織結構的超分子組裝、構築和形態的各種因素。可以預見，這項工作能提供對影響這些分子的設計和特有之光譜及光功能性質的因素的根本理解，從而為新穎π–共軛雜環和它們的金屬–配體和主族元素配合物和組裝物之理性設計帶來提示和指引，為新種類π–共軛雜環和它們的金屬–配體和主族元素配位衍生物的發現開拓出有趣的新方向。

17305714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305714.value: Reactive oxygen species (ROS), such as superoxide radical anion, hydrogen peroxide, hydroxyl radical, peroxynitrite and hypochlorous acid, are involved in fundamental biological processes including development, aging, immunity and metabolism. Since those ROS have distinct chemical properties, selective and sensitive detection of each of those species represents a powerful approach to elucidating their specific functions in biological systems. However, it has been a significant challenge to achieve high selectivity and sensitivity in detection of each of those species by using small-molecule fluorescent probes. In our previous research funded by RGC, we have successfully developed several efficient green fluorescent probes, the HKGreen and HKOCl series, for sensitive and selective detection of peroxynitrite and hypochlorous acid, respectively. In this proposal, we aim to develop fluorescent probes for highly selective and sensitive detection and imaging of superoxide radical anion, an important precursor of other ROS, in biological systems. Another objective of this project is to investigate biological functions of superoxide radical anion with our probes. This project is of great importance as it will accelerate discoveries in biomedical research on ROS by directly visualizing and detecting superoxide radical anion. It will not only provide valuable insights into the physiological and pathological roles of superoxide radical anion in human diseases but also offer new approaches for drug discovery and therapeutic intervention.

17305814.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305814.value: Multivariate analysis methods are well-established statistic tools for data exploration and data analysis. However, when the number of the variables say p is large compared with the sample size say N, we are faced with a new statistical context, namely the high-dimensional data context. In the gene network analysis described in the project, expression data at exon levels from RNA-Sequencing experiments are collected for different genes where typically the sample size is about N=50 and the number of variables (exon levels) ranges from p=4, 5 to p=29. Given the sample size N=50, a gene expression record with p=4 exon levels is typically low-dimensional and can be analysed using conventional multivariate analysis methods, while an expression record with p=29 exon levels is high-dimensional. It has been proved in recent literature that new methods from the random matrix theory are powerful tools for the analysis of such data sets. In particular, this project addresses the problem to know whether a given pair of genes are related each other (dependence) by analysing their expression data. In addition to the motivation from real-life data analysis problems, this project is also ambitious in theoretic aspects. Formally, we are given two arbitrary data sets (genes in the previous example) collected from a same sample of size N but with different dimensions p1 and p2. The question is to know whether these two data sets are related or not, i.e. to test the hypothesis of a dependence relationship among them. Classical multivariate methods apply when both p1 and p2 are small with respect to the sample size (Scenario A), while recent advances in high-dimensional statistical literature provide methods for testing the hypothesis when both p1 and p2 are large (Scenario B). However, as evidenced by the above example of RNA-Sequencing data, there are real-life situations where one of the dimensions is low and the other is high with respect to the sample size (Scenario C). This project is aimed at providing efficient methods for testing the dependence hypothesis in such an uncovered situation. On one hand, we will develop a rigorous theory of such methods by providing a full description of the properties of the proposed test procedures under the new Scenario C. On the other hand, the proposed methods will be applied to the analysis of real-life data sets like the gene expression data described in the project. 多元（多變量）統計分析方法, 例如主成分分析、相關係數分析或因子分析，都是傳統的、良好的數據分析工具。 然而, 如果變量數目 p 較大而樣本數 n 相對較小的時候, 我們面臨著一個新的統計領域， 即高維統計問題。 例如在該研究計劃裏提供的基因網絡分析的例子裏，數據的項目, RNA-實驗數據的樣本是大小不同的遺傳基因, 數目通常是n=50左右， 而變量的數目(exon 位數)的范圍是p=4、5至p=26或29。 如此樣本數等於n=50的時候，一個含有p=4個exon位數的基因表達數據集便是一個低維數據集， 它的處理可以使用常規多元分析方法； 而一個有p=29 exon 位數的數據集便是個高維數據集。 近期文獻已經證明, 基於隨機矩陣理論的新統計方法是個適用與高維數據分析的強大工具。 舉例來說, 上述基因數據裏要解決的一個問題是要知道某一特定的基因組合是否與每一個其他基因組合相關(依賴)；這個問題可以用本研究計劃提供的方法來解決。 除了上述的真實數據分析問題, 這一計劃在理論方面也會研究較難的問題。 具體來說,假設有兩個數據集(在前面的示例是基因數據)具有同一樣本數目n,但是維數不同（p1和p2）。 要探討的問題是這兩個數據集是否相關，即檢驗“不相關”、或者是“獨立性”的假設。當兩個維數p1和p2都較小的時候， 可以采用傳統統計方法（情況A)。另外， 最近高維統計方法的進展所提供的檢驗方法適用於這兩個維數p1和p2都比較大的時候（情況B)。 然而,正如上述例子裏面的RNA-數據, 實際數據裏面經常會是一個維數較小而另一個維數較大（情況C)。 本研究計劃旨在提供在該新情況C下的有效的方法來檢測上述“獨立性”假設。 一方面,我們將制訂一個嚴謹的理論来探讨新情況C下面的新的統計檢測方法,並提供充分的理論依據。 另一方面,建立的方法將適用於分析像上述基因數據集那樣的、現實生活中的重要數據

17305914.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305914.value: Two-dimensional (2D) crystals such as graphene and transition metal dichalcogenides are being intensively studied for new physics and novel device applications. When 2D crystals of the same or different types are stacked on top of each other and glued together by weak van der Waals force, they form the so called van der Waals layered structures, which are analogs of semiconductor superlattices and quantum wells that have enabled many key scientific discoveries and technological applications. Appealing new features of the van der Waals layered structures for potential device applications include: the ultimate miniaturization in thickness of both the active layers and the tunneling barriers, the accessibility to individual layers, and the possibility to integrate the advantages of different 2D crystals. Carriers in van der Waals layered structures have a variety of internal quantum degrees of freedom including the spin, the valley pseudospin and the layer pseudospin. These spin and pseudospins of carriers can play important roles to enable versatile device functionalities in future electronics. Key to the spin based electronic applications is the generation of spin and pseudospin polarizations and control of their flows, i.e. spin and pseudospin currents. In this theoretical project, we aim to develop efficient schemes for generating spin and pseudospin polarizations and currents in van der Waals layered structures using optical approaches. The key issues to be addressed include: (i) optical pumping of spin, valley and layer polarizations of electrons and holes; (ii) optical injection of charge current, spin current, valley and layer pseudospin currents; (iii) optical control of spin and pseudospin tunneling currents between the layers. We will focus on various van der Waals layered structures having monolayer TMDCs as the building blocks, where the spin and valley optical selection rules we previously discovered in monolayer TMDCs are expected to play key roles in the optical spin injection. With the rapidly growing interest on van der Waals layered structures and the established (and developing) techniques in realizing high quality homo- and hetero-structures from various 2D crystals, the research proposed here would be a timely study on the possibility of utilizing the various spin and pseudospin degrees of freedom in situ to such layered structures for the exploration of new physics and applications. 二維晶體如石墨烯和過渡金屬二硫化物中的新的物理現象和新的器件應用正在被廣泛并深入的研究。當相同或不同類型的二維晶體通過弱范德華力堆砌并粘合在一起，便形成了所謂的范德華層狀結構。此種結構類似于曾帶來關鍵科學發現和技術應用的半導體超晶格和量子阱。從器件應用角度，范德華層狀結構所俱有的獨特優勢特性包括：活躍層和隧穿勢壘層的厚度均達到理論上的最小可能（即原子尺度）；每層均可單獨調控；集成各種二維晶體的不同優勢的可能性。范德華層狀結構中的載流子有多個量子自由度，包括自旋，能谷贗自旋和層贗自旋。載流子的這些自旋和贗自旋可以發揮重要的作用，為未來電子器件帶來更加多樣的功能。要實現基於自旋或贗自旋的電子器件，關鍵突破是對自旋和贗自旋極化的調控，以及自旋和贗自旋流的產生。在這個理論研究中，我們的目標是探索在范德華層狀結構中用光學的辦法產生自旋和贗自旋極化和流的有效方案。我們計劃研究的幾個關鍵問題包括：（1）用光泵的辦法來產生電子和空穴的自旋，能谷贗自旋和層贗自旋的極化; （2）光注入電流，自旋流，能谷贗自旋流和層贗自旋流; （3）用光來調控層之間的自旋和贗自旋隧穿流。我們將集中研究以單層過渡金屬二硫化物為基本組件的各種范德華層狀結構。在單層過渡金屬二硫化物中，我們之前發現了自旋和能谷贗自旋的光學選擇定則，我們預期這個選擇定則在光控的自旋注入中將起到關鍵作用。對范德華層狀結構的研究興趣正在迅速增長，實現高品質的異質或同質層狀結構的技術正在不斷的發展和完善中，在這樣的背景下， 本項目將是對這些層狀結構中的自旋和贗自旋自由度的可能應用和新穎物理現象的一項及時的研究。

17305914.label: Realisation of objectives
17305914.value: Objective 1 This objective has been achieved. We have investigated selection rules for the optical interband transition matrix elements and interlayer hopping matrix elements in van der Waals heterobilayers formed by different transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), using both symmetry analysis and first principle calculations. In lattice-matched heterobilayers, we discovered interlayer atomic registry dependence of the valley optical selection rules for interlayer excitons. In heterobilayers with the twisting and lattice mismatch between the constituent layers, we discovered the elliptically polarized valley optical selection rules for the anomalous light cones (states that can directly couple to light under energy-momentum conservation), which have the six-fold degeneracy located at finite kinematic momentum of interlayer excitons. These anomalous light cones, together with the valley optical selection rules, lead to novel possibilities for optical manipulations of valley pseudospin, including the direct optical injection of valley current and the possibility to harness the valley Hall effect of interlayer excitons. For the intralayer excitons in individual TMDs, we have extended the well known valley selection rules for one-photon excitation to the nonlinear regime of two-photon absorption and second harmonic generation for the excited states (electron hole continuum above the band edge) of the excitonic excitation, which can be utilised for optical injection of spin and valley pseudospin current. Objective 2 This objective has been achieved. We find that the anomalous light cones at finite kinematic momentum of interlayer excitons make possible optical generation of spin/valley polarisation, as well as optical injection of pure spin/valley current. These light cones have six-fold degeneracy, three of them located at kinematic momenta that are 120 degree rotation of each other are from one valley configurations of excitons, coupled to elliptically polarized light of one helicity, while the rest three are their time-reversal counter part. Circularly polarised excitation therefore selectively populate one valley, realising the optical injection of spin/valley polarisation. Remarkably, interlayer excitons with small kinematic energy are optically inactive, so the spin/valley polarized interlayer excitons resonantly injected through these light cones can have long lifetime after relaxing to these lower energy states. Together with our experimental collaborators, we have demonstrated the optical injection of spin/valley polarisation in heterobilayers, as well as the ultra long lifetime of the injected polarisation. We have also explored the utilization of type-II band alignment in TMDs heterobilayers for optical injection of spin/valley polarization. Upon exitation at the resonance of excitons in the individual layer, circular polarized light generates spin/valley polarized excitons which, however, depolarizes fast by electron-hole exchange and disappear fast through recombination. In the type-II band alignment, electron and hole energetically favor opposite layers, quenching the electron-hole exchange and the recombination, both of which requires wavefunction overlap. The photo injected electrons and holes thus can have long population lifetime as well as spin/valley lifetime. Together with experimental groups, we have demonstrated the feasibility of optical injection of spin/valley polarization in the type-II heterobilayers, where the interlayer hopping of carriers are shown to conserve spin/valley index, and the optical injection at the same time generates a spin/valley polarized current across the heterobilayers. Objective 3 This objective has been achieved. We have discovered schemes for direct generation of spin/valley current in transition metal dicalcogenides (TMDs) monolayers as well as in their van der Waals heterobilayers. For monolayers, we found that the theory of ballistic spin current injection by quantum interference of one-photon and two-photon absorption processes, previously discovered in the non-interacting limit for III-V semiconductors, can be well generalized to the regime of strong Coulomb binding for spin/valley current injection at the spin-valley locked degenerate band-edges unique to the TMDs monolayers. Our investigation of the two-photon optical transition selection rule in 2D TMDs also discovered an interesting polarization reversal as function of energy. For TMDs heterobilayers, we found that the six-fold degenerate anomalous light cones with the elliptically polarized valley selection rules allow spin/valley current injection under one-photon excitation. Linearly polarized excitation populate both valley configurations with equal probability. Since the excitons states have finite velocity (kinematic momentum) at the light cones, the optically injected distribution directly corresponds to a pure spin/valley current of excitons, with direction controlled by the angle of the linear polarization. In addition to these optical injection schemes, we have also discovered a novel possibility of pumping valley polarization of carriers simply by scattering at the ubiquitous nonmagnetic disorders, rooted in the nature of the valley as a momentum space index: the intervalley backscattering in general has a valley contrasted rate due to the distinct momentum transfers, causing a net transfer of population from one valley to another. A sizable valley pump can be driven by charge current in monolayer TMDs, while the spin-orbit scattering by nonmagnetic disorders also realizes a spin pump for the spin-valley locked carriers.

17305914.label: Major findings and research outcome
17305914.value: (1) We discovered that, because of the inevitable twist and lattice mismatch in heterobilayers of transition metal dichalcogenides, interlayer excitons have six fold degenerate light cones anomalously located at finite velocities on the parabolic energy dispersion. The photon emissions at each light cone are elliptically polarized, with the major axis locked to the direction of exciton velocity, and helicity specified by the valley indices of the electron and the hole. These finite-velocity light cones allow unprecedented possibilities for optically injecting valley polarization and valley current, and the observation of both direct and inverse valley Hall effects. For lattice matching heterobilayers of AA-like (0° twist) or AB-like (60° twist) stacking, all light cones merge into a single one, and the quantum interference leads to dependence of the brightness and the polarization selection rules on the interlayer translation. See publication 2. (2) We discovered that valley pump of carriers can be realized by scattering at the ubiquitous nonmagnetic disorders, not relying on any specific material property. The mechanism is rooted in the nature of the valley as a momentum space index: the intervalley backscattering in general has a valley contrasted rate due to the distinct momentum transfers, causing a net transfer of population from one valley to another. As examples, we numerically demonstrate the sizable valley pump effects driven by charge current in nanoribbons of monolayer TMDs, where the spin-orbit scattering by nonmagnetic disorders also realizes a spin pump for the spin-valley locked holes. See publication 7. (3) In collaboration with experimental group, we discovered optically active interlayer exciton in WSe2/MoSe2 heterobilayers, and realized injection of spin-valley polarization of interlayer exciton by means of circularly polarized optical pumping with a valley lifetime of 40 nanoseconds. This long-lived polarization enables the visualization of the expansion of a valley-polarized exciton cloud over several micrometers. See publication 3 and 5. (4) We investigated selection rules of two-photon optical transitions in 2D TMDs, and discovered a polarization reversal as function of energy. Coulomb interaction is found to significantly enhance two-photon and second-harmonic generation above the band edge. The scheme of spin-valley current injection by one- and two-photon interference is generalized to the regime of strong Coulomb interaction. See research output 9 (to be submitted). (5) In collaboration with experimental group, we realized optical generation of spin-valley polarization of excitons in MoSe2/WSe2 heterobilayer and subsequent ultrafast transfer of spin-polarized electrons/holes between the layers. See publication 6.

17305914.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17305914.value: Our findings of the anomalous light coupling properties of interlayer excitons and the optical injection possibility of spin/valley polarization and current suggest potential excitonic circuits with valley functionalities, and unique opportunities to study exciton dynamics and condensation phenomena in semiconducting 2D heterostructures. Future works include the exploration of these ideas in the presence of superlattice potential due to the formation of long-period moire, where scanning tunneling spectroscopies have found lateral moire modulation of band-gaps that will be carried into the exciton energy. We plan to utilize such moire potential and its strain engineering for manipulating the optically injected excitonic spin-valley polarization and current. Our finding of the spin/valley pump by scattering at disorders points to a new opportunity towards valley spintronics, turning disorders from a deleterious factor to a resource of valley and spin polarization. Future works planned include the exploitation of the idea in more realistic device geometries. The scheme of optical injection of layer-separated electron and hole spin-valley polarization utilizing the type-II band alignment in the heterostructures points to a new spin-valley generation scheme in van der Waals devices, which we will exploit together with our experimental collaborators.

17305914.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17305914.value: When atomically thin 2D materials such as graphene or transition metal dichalcogenides are stacked on top of each other and bound by weak van der Waals force, they form van der Waals layered structures, which provide an exiting platform to explore fundamental physics as well as device applications. Carriers in van der Waals layered structures have a variety of internal quantum degrees of freedom such as the spin and the valley pseudospin (degenerate minima in the energy-momentum dispersion), which can play important roles to enable versatile device functionalities in future electronics. In this project, we have explored a number of possibilities to generate spin and pseudospin polarizations and to control their flows (i.e. spin and pseudospin currents), both of which are key to the spin/pseudospin based electronic applications. With the vast interest on van der Waals layered structures and the advances in experimental realization of high quality van der Waals devices, our findings here are timely contributions to facilitate the experimental exploration of spin and valley pseudospin degrees of freedom for new physics and applications.

17306014.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306014.value: Our goal is to provide evidence on the long-studied and unresolved debate on the extent to which changes in Earth’s biota are governed by changes in environmental conditions (e.g., temperature, productivity, carbonate saturation, etc.) versus biotic interactions (e.g., predation, competition, etc.). Both factors operate, but their relative importance is hotly debated, and can be tested by tracking ecosystems through environmental fluctuations in the geological past. This project seeks to exploit the excellent record of environmental and biotic changes archived in deep-sea cores to address this basic and important question about the history of life. We will focus on fossil foraminifera (protists) and ostracodes (animals), the only two groups of benthic organisms preserved in deep-sea cores at sufficient abundances to track faunal changes through space and time. We will target five time-intervals of 0.5 Myr (million years) duration that range from the early Miocene [~22 Ma (millions of years ago)] to the late Pleistocene (0.5 – 0 Ma), Ma), at up to five Atlantic deep ocean drilling locations for each interval. Within each of these time-intervals, we will target ten evenly-spaced time-horizons. For each of the 190 proposed core samples, we will study foraminifera and ostracode assemblages and quantify relative species abundances, sample diversity, and morphology (i.e., body size). We will then use a stratigraphically-adjacent, pair-wise approach to statistically analyze the relations between changes in these biotic constituents and their ambient environment, with the latter derived from five environmental proxies relevant to deep-sea benthic organisms, reflecting fluctuations in climate, oceanographic conditions, food availability, and sediment characteristics (i.e., δ18O, Mg/Ca, δ13C, benthic foraminifera accumulation rates, and % coarse-fraction of sediment). Thus, our experimental design will produce a comprehensive multidimensional dataset of biotic and environmental variables for two distinctive biotic groups through time and space. We will then use linear models to statistically assess which environmental variables elicit biotic responses as well as the extent to which biotic states can be explained by the measured environmental fluctuations. For example, if environmental conditions are the dominant “pacemakers” of biological change, then biotic responses in both groups should be correlated with changes in key environmental variables. Such fundamental questions remain largely unanswered to a “first-order” or readily generalizable scale. Our proposed research program will seek to answer these questions; notably, even a non-generalizable result will have important ecosystem-scale implications for ongoing environment change and potential mitigation in the largest habitat on Earth. 環境條件上的改變（如：溫度、生產力、碳酸鹽飽和度等）和生物相互作用（如：捕食，競爭等）對地球上的生物群之相對影響程度一直都被受爭議。今次研究的目的，就是要通過測試和追蹤地質歷史上的環境和生態系統變化，從而找出這兩個因素的相對重要性。深海沉積物岩芯詳細地記錄了環境和生物方面的變化，本研究將利用岩芯的優良紀錄，以解決這個關乎生命歷史的基礎問題。我們將集中研究有孔蟲化石（原生生物）和介形類化石（動物），因為只有這兩組底棲生物能在深海沉積物岩芯中保存完好，且有足夠數量，讓我們去追蹤其生物群在時間和空間上的變化。我們主要針對研究五個各長五十萬年的時期，由中新世早期(約二千二百萬年前)至更新世晚期(約五十萬年前至今)，並於大西洋的深海水域為每個時期作多達五次的鑽探採樣。而在每一個時期之中，我們會針對十個間隔均勻的時段來研究。我們計劃利用190個岩芯樣本來研究有孔蟲和介形類的組合，並量化品種的相對豐度、樣本多樣性及形態（如:個體大小）。然後，我們將對照地層上的關係，進行統計分析，從而找出在這些生物的組分及其周圍環境變化之間的關係。環境變化的指標有五個，包括影響着深海底棲生物的氣候變化、海洋狀況、食物供應和沉積物特徵（包括:氧同位素，鎂鈣比，碳同位素，底棲有孔蟲堆積速率和沉積物的粗粒比例。 我們將藉今次實驗為該兩個不同的生物群製作一個涵蓋時間和空間變化的全面生物和環境變量多維數據集。之後，我們將使用線性模型進行統計，找出哪幾個環境變量引起生物群反應，及其波動對生物群狀態的影響程度。舉例來說，如果環境條件是生物變化的主要「起搏器」，那這些生物群的生物反應就應該會和環境變量的變化相關。這些重要問題至今很大程度上仍沒有答案，甚至還未被深入探討。本研究計劃將嘗試找出這些問題的答案，即使是一個非普及性的結果，也將對了解地球上最大的棲息地之持續環境變化及其緩解措施有莫大的重要性。

17306014.label: Realisation of objectives
17306014.value: We revealed the kinds and severities of environmental change, their pattern, impact and relationship to biota by investigating instances of these changes in the past, namely through the use of microfossils found within Cenozoic deep-sea sediment cores (Yasuhara et al. 2017a; Huang et al. 2018a; Huang et al. 2018b; Yasuhara et al. 2018). Instances of environmental change included glacial and interglacial cycles (Huang et al. 2018a; Huang et al. 2018b), the opening and closing of oceanic pathways (Yasuhara et al. 2017b; Huang et al. 2018b) and tectonics (Yasuhara et al. 2017a). The magnitude of these impacts on sea floor biotic communities ranged from allowing certain specialized taxa to flourish and increase in abundance, for instance the active swimming ostracod Propontocypris spp. after the mid-Brunhes Event (MBE) (Huang et al. 2018b), to extirpating and replacing previous communities with those more adapted to the altered sea-floor conditions (Huang et al. 2018a; Huang et al. 2018b). The patterns and timing of these biotic shifts varied from decadal, to centennial, millennial-scales and longer (Yasuhara et al. 2016; Huang et al. 2018a; Huang et al. 2018b). We found that oxygen, its availability or lack thereof to be the most controlling factor in ostracod community dominance in a marginal sea, the Sea of Japan (Huang et al. 2018b) and that, of the four deep-sea mid-Pleistocene pathways available for ostracod migration, the Drake Passage was the most significant in affecting faunal distribution (Yasuhara et al. 2017b). As our palaeobiological studies revealed the strong connection between deep-sea benthic communities and environmental change we enhanced our understanding by investigating other similar works within the literature (Yasuhara et al. 2017c) and examined relationships with other meiofaunal taxa (Yasuhara et al. 2016; Yasuhara et al. 2017a). By researching modern benthic ostracod assemblages, their life habits, relationship with the benthos and community composition we increase the accuracy of future palaeo-related studies and current biotic community monitoring work (Yasuhara et al. 2015; Tanaka & Yasuhara 2016; Jöst et al. 2017; Yasuhara et al. 2017b; Yasuhara et al. 2017c; Jöst et al. 2018; Yasuhara et al. 2018; Jöst et al. 2017; Tanaka & Yasuhara 2016). Our research relating to extreme sea-floor settings, that is both cold-seeps and hydrothermal vents (Tanaka & Yasuhara 2016; Yasuhara et al. 2018), are doubly of interest as they reveal the extreme conditions under which benthic communities can function, shedding light on their adaptability within a changing ocean. The work presented here exemplifies the utility of model systems of ostracodes and foraminifera, in an array of modern and palaeo-related studies to uncover the relationship between environmental change and corresponding biotic response within the deep-sea ecosystem. rows: To reveal the general and quantitative relationship between the kinds and severities of environmental change and the pattern and magnitudes of biotic response

More specifically, to test the link between environmental change and biotic response in the deep-sea benthic ecosystem using model systems of fossil ostracodes and foraminifera in upper Cenozoic material obtained by deep sea drilling.

17306014.label: Major findings and research outcome
17306014.value: The main findings of the research completed for this project are as follows: • That microfossils, particularly ostracods and foraminifera, due to their high abundance and high preservation potential, exemplify useful tools in understanding our climatic past and monitoring current benthic communities through this period of global warming (Yasuhara et al. 2017b; Yasuhara et al. 2017c; Huang et al. 2018a; Huang et al. 2018b; Jöst et al. 2018). • That deep-sea communities are affected by climate change, despite previous hypotheses that they were less susceptible due to their remoteness, and that these effects extend to smaller and marginal seas and not just major oceans (Huang et al. 2018a; Huang et al. 2018b). • That is important to had a solid understanding of modern biotic communities and their biogeography to effectively understanding past communities and their development through time (Yasuhara et al. 2015; Tanaka & Yasuhara 2016; Yasuhara et al. 2016; Jöst et al. 2017; Yasuhara et al. 2017c; Jöst et al. 2018; Yasuhara et al. 2018). • That a large species pool does not enhance ecosystem stability through time but rather high abundance can be used as an indicator of higher ecosystem functioning and may enhance ecosystem stability (Yasuhara et al. 2016). • That certain ostracod species can be specifically linked to a suite of environmental conditions that can be used as a tool to isolate those same environmental conditions in the past (Yasuhara et al. 2017a; Yasuhara et al. 2018). • That sea-level highs and the corresponding opening of oceanic pathways has determined ostracod migration and their modern biogeography throughout the Cenozoic (Yasuhara et al. 2017b; Huang et al. 2018b).

17306014.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17306014.value: We are currently still in possession of further deep-sea core samples that are both currently under investigation or have not yet be examined. We would like to use these samples to further explore relationships between benthic microfossil assemblages and how they have shifted through keep points during the Cenozoic across both the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.

17306014.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17306014.value: We used tiny fossils to investigate how environmental change impacts the sea floor communities living in our deep-seas. We examined the organisms living in both modern-day communities and in the past so that we could understand their differences, how those differences have come about and how sensitive deep-sea organisms are to change. In our research, we incorporated studies into both extremely hot and extremely cold marine ecosystems to see how the organisms there lived and coped with such harsh living conditions. Our results showed that deep-sea communities are vulnerable to environmental change and how they react and cope with this change varies. In some instances, the change allows certain species to excel and flourish, and in other instances they are completely decimated and will disappear from our ocean floors. It is extremely important that we fully understand how our marine ecosystems respond to change as it directly relates to the health of our oceans. Our studies show that the Earth’s seas have changed greatly through time and as our oceans are currently undergoing a period of accelerated change, we must understand what changes we will be facing, how they will affect us and how we can best prepare for our future oceans.

17306414.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17306414.value: 共振费米子中的自旋扩散问题

17306414.label: Project Objectives
17306414.value: We will study the transverse spin diffusion behavior of a unitary Fermi gas in the polarized limit. To do that, we shall first construct the appropriate transport equations based on polaron Fermi liquid theory. In particular, we shall apply the equations to spin echo experiment and investigate the behavior of echo signal as a function initial pulse angle and compare with experimental observations. Investigations will also be carried out for the balanced unitary Fermi gas above the superfluid transition temperature and compare the Fermi liquid predictions with experimental observations. Microscopic calculation will be performed in the normal phase of the unitary Fermi gas to understand the connection between contact and magnetization. Role of dimensionality in the spin diffusion will be also discussed.

17306414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306414.value: Unitary Fermi gases, in which inter-particle interactions are tuned to a scattering resonance, have provided us with unique opportunities to investigate the physics of a strongly interacting fermion system. So far, thermodynamic properties of the unitary Fermi gas have been investigated extensively and they exhibit universal behavior. The situation with transport properties is, however, much less clearer, due to a lack of reliable transport theory in the unitary regime. The main difficulty is the apparent lack of well-defined Landau quasi-particles. In this proposal, we plan to study the transverse spin diffusion in a unitary Fermi gas, concentrating on the following two aspects (1) transverse spin diffusion in a strongly polarized gas and (2) transverse spin diffusion in a balanced unitary Fermi gas above the superfluid transition temperature. Both aspects are now being actively investigated in experiments. In the first part, we plan to make use of the polaron Fermi liquid theory, which is known to describe the thermodynamic properties of the unitary Fermi gas in the strongly polarized limit, to construct a viable transport theory and investigate the behavior of spin diffusion based on it. In the second part, we shall extend our considerations to the balanced unitary Fermi gas and see whether the experimental results on spin diffusion so far are consistent with an underlying Fermi liquid state at unitarity. This may help to revolve a current controversy in the field regarding the nature of the normal state at unitarity. Further efforts will be made to compute the relevant parameters (transverse relaxation time etc.) associated with spin diffusion in the unitary limit. In addition, we shall investigate how interactions develop as the spin diffusion proceeds, which makes a nontrivial connection between one-particle and two-particle properties of a unitary Fermi gas. The role of dimensionality in the transport of unitary Fermi gases will be also discussed. 处在散射共振点冷原子体系给我们提供了一个研究强相互作用费米子体系极好的平台。迄今为止，共振费米子体系的普适热力学性质已经在实验上得到了证实。然而，我们对于其输运性质却不是非常清楚。其中的一个原因是我们没有一个很好的输运理论可以运用到共振费米子体系中。对于共振费米子，理论上的困难是我们不能够定义一个好的准粒子，因而无法写出关于准粒子的输运方程。在一下这个研究提案中，我们将试图研究费米子自旋输运的两个方面：极化费米子中的纵向自旋扩散以及超流温度之上的自旋扩散过程。这两个方面现在在实验上有很多的进展，我们希望能够通过以上两方面的研究更多的理解强相互作用体系的输运问题。 我们的研究将分成这样几个部分。对于极化费米子中的纵向自旋扩散， 我们将采用所谓的极化子费米液体理论。该理论已经被证实在极化费米气体中成立。我们的第一任务就是去推导自旋扩散的方程。对于超流温度之上的自旋扩散过程，我们将仔细检查实验结果是否和一般费米液体理论符合并同时找出相关的理论参数。最后，我们将极化和两体关联联系起来，进一步研究共振费米气体的性质。

17306414.label: Realisation of objectives
17306414.value: Overall, both objectives have been achieved with relevant publications listed in Part C. Several related problems are also considered with the support of the GRF fund. Details are also given below. Objective 1. The main part of the objective is realized in paper No.1 in Part C. In that work, the behavior of transverse spin diffusion as a function as pulse angle is investigated experimentally, and based on the transport equation of the Leggett-Rice form, the appropriate Landau parameters for Fermi liquid theory are extracted (assuming Fermi liquid theory is still valid). Objective 2. The theoretical calculation based on (1) diagrammatic T-matrix calculation and (2) full kinetic equations with/without trap is carried out and details are given in full comparison with experiment in Figure 3 and 4 in paper No.1. Some further attempts by my then Ph.D student, Dr. Ding Shanshan, have been made to go beyond T-matrix approximation and include more medium effects in a polarized Fermi gas in normal state. This part of the calculation produced a slight better comparison with experiments, but no substantial conceptual advances. This part of the work is not published. She has presented her results in a cold atom conference in 2015 in China [her poster attached as item 5 in Part C, 9]. The connection between contact and magnetization resulted in Paper 3 in Part C. Here building on the result we had in the three-dimensional case [in our earlier paper Science 344, 722 (2014)], we made analytic and exact study of their connection in 1D and proving the conjecture made in our earlier Science paper. Several related work on the transport in unitary Fermi gas is given in paper 9 where conductivity is discussed for unitary Fermi gas close to superfluid transition temperature.

17306414.label: Major findings and research outcome
17306414.value: The major findings of this proposal include the following: 1. An elucidation of the transverse spin diffusion behavior in unitary Fermi gas in which the proper transport equation and parameters that enter the transport equation are calculated microscopically. The results are compared with actual experiments with reasonable agreements. There are several important conclusions arise from the study. (1) The transport data in the normal state of unitary Fermi gas, if interpreted in terms Landau Fermi liquid theory, gives appropriate parameters that is consistent with theoretical calculation and also internally consistent (in a sense that they satisfy the inequalities demanded by Fermi liquid theory). (2), the crucial role of upper branch at unitarity in the transport measurement. This is an aspect that was not emphasized in the original proposal, but was borne out in actual experiment. So the relevant theoretical calculation has to take this into account. 2. Related work on charge transport in the normal state of unitary Fermi gas show that fluctuation effects are crucial in determining transport through a quantum constriction and the role of closed channel molecule state [paper 9]. This research, together with two other publication in the literature [from Tokyo and Harvard], explained the curious enhancement of conductivity observed in ETH experiment. Fluctuation on Higgs mode [paper 11] is also discussed and the recent observation by Michael kohl’s group in the U. Bonn has confirmed some of its qualitative predictions. 3. In general theme of spin dynamics, an experimental and theoretical collaboration with Prof. Dajun Wang’s group in CUHK has observed the first inter-species coherence and we gave its explanation in terms spin transport equations based on random phase approximation [paper 2]. 4. As we investigated the spin diffusion behavior of unitary Fermi gas, a feature in a near-by p-wave resonance is noticed and this leads us to investigate the p-wave gas with two publications [paper 4 and paper 5] detailing the theory of p-wave contact and its experimental confirmation. One further theoretical generalization to 2D is given in paper 10. 5. Several works that were partially supported by this GRF are the study of superfluid properties of spin-orbit coupled Bose gas where we found that the superfluid density vanishes at T=0 at the transition between plane wave and zero momentum phase and derived a set of exact relations [paper 6]. We have also made a foray into collective behavior in a two-band superfluid and topological superfluid [paper 7 and paper 8].

17306414.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17306414.value: There are a few directions that is worth studying regarding transport in Fermi gases. (1) Recent experiments on charge and spin transport in optical lattices is very interesting and it has raised the possibility of studying Fermi Hubbard model in a new setting with promising results. It will be nice to extend the study to the lattice case where transport in the Mott regime can be probed. (2) 2D transport is still an open issue that requires further investigation even in the translationally invariant system. With the realization of flat trap, this might be a good opportunity to renew its study especially experimentally.

17306414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17306414.value: Understanding transport properties of materials lies in the heart of modern technological innovation. The classic example is a transistor in which transport through one set of terminals are controlled by the voltage/current at the other. Our understanding of transport is in terms of quasi-particles that carries charge, heat or whatever that is being transported, moving from one end of the wire to the other. However, this picture needs fundamental modification in quantum regime when diffraction and interference have to be considered and especially when strong interaction renders quasiparticle ill-defined. Our research effort in the proposal is to use a particular example of spin diffusion in unitary Fermi gases (strongest interaction that is allowed by quantum mechanics) to investigate the behavior of transport. Due to its well-controlled and clean nature, our study in unitary Fermi gas has shown that diffusion is limited due to strong interaction, and that interpretation in terms of Landau quasi-particles are possible.

17306714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306714.value: 过渡金属催化的卡宾转移反应可以高效地构建复杂分子，并具有优异的官能团兼容性和立体选择性，因此它在有机合成中具有重要的地位。该类反应已被用于很多药物和具有生物活性的天然产物的合成。然而卡宾前体却非常有限，目前只局限于在α位置上有吸电子基团的稳定的重氮化合物。众所周知，重氮化合物的取代基对相应的卡宾的反应性和选择性有显着的影响。因此，发展新型卡宾前体将有助于开发出新的卡宾转移反应，以及发现新的活性和选择性。从电子和空间属性而言，由于没有吸电子基团，从重氮烷烃生成的烷基卡宾的性质将不同于那些从稳定的重氮化合物产生的卡宾。然而，人们对烷基卡宾的性质却知之甚少，这是因为重氮烷烃不易合成且稳定性较差。该项目将研究重氮烷烃在卡宾转移反应中的反应活性和选择性，我们利用稳定的腙作为前体原位生成重氮烷烃。 我们的初步研究表明，N-tosylhydrazones在加热和碱性条件下很容易生成重氮烷烃，金属卟啉可以高效高非对映选择性地催化重氮烷烃进行分子内卡宾C-H键插入反应。 利用这一原位生成重氮烷烃的方法，我们将研究重氮烷烃在各种卡宾转移反应中的反应活性和选择性，这些反应将包括环丙烷化，C-H键插入，卡宾/炔烃复分解反应，烯烃合成和鎓盐转化反应。除了N-tosylhydrazones，我们还将探索新型的更活波的更具原子经济性的腙。同时，我们将研究不同的过渡金属配合物的催化活性。通过利用大位阻的过渡金属配合物或大位阻的重氮烷烃，我们将合成和结构表征一些稳定的烷基金属卡宾络合物，并研究它们的构效关系。我们的初步研究表明金属卟啉可以高效高非对映选择性地催化重氮烷烃进行分子内卡宾C-H键插入，我们将运用这一反应在天然产物和生物活性分子的合成中。这个项目的成功将会大大扩大卡宾源的范围，并会发现新的反应性质和选择性，为有机合成提供新的合成方法。

17306714.label: Realisation of objectives
17306714.value: We have realized the objectives. We have made important accomplishments in transition metal catalyzed carbene transformations of non-stabilized diazoalkanes and developed several efficient alkylcarbene transfer reactions for constructions of a diverse range of N-heterocycles with potential synthetic and biological interests. We have published five papers in leading international chemistry journals including two in Angewandte Chemie International Edition (one is VIP paper in the journal), two in Advanced Synthesis & Catalysis (one is VIP paper in the journal) and one in Chemistry-A European Journal based on the findings from this project. We found that alkyldiazomethanes generated in situ from N-tosylhydrazons are effective carbene source for intramolecular sp3 C-H bond insertion. Ruthenium porphyrins have been proved to effectively catalyze intramolecular alkylcarbene insertion to C-H bonds leading to a variety of substituted tetrahydrofurans and pyrrolidines in high yield and with high cis-selectivity. The reaction has been successfully used in a short synthesis of a pyrrolizidine alkaloid, (+)-pseudoheliotridane (Angew. Chem., Int. Ed. 2014, 53, 14175–14180). We have developed an efficient and chemoselective cobalt(II) porphyrin-catalyzed intramolecular cyclopropanation of N-alkyl indoles/pyrroles with alkyldiazomethanes in situ generated from hydrazones. The reaction enables rapid construction a series of polycyclic cyclopropane-fused indoles and pyrrolines in moderate to high yields and with high chemo-selectivity from simple starting materials. These N-containing polycyclic compounds can be readily converted to a variety of N-heterocycles with potential synthetic and biological interest. We also found that the use of bulky 2,4,6-triisopropylbenzenesulfonyl hydrazones as carbene precursor enables the cyclopropanation to occur under milder condition and with shorter time than its N-tosylhydrazones counterparts, which is of advantage for the synthesis of instable polycycles (Angew. Chem., Int. Ed. 2016, 55, 1810-1815). We have developed an efficient method for the synthesis of polysubstituted 3H-pyrrolizines and pyrrolizidines via a cobalt(II) porphyrin catalyzed intramolecular cyclopropanation/ring opening cascade reaction of hydrazones derived from pyrrolyl ketones. This Co(II) catalyzed cascade reaction provides a rapid access to polysubstituted 3H-pyrrolizines and pyrrolizidines from readily accessible starting materials (Adv. Synth. Catal. 2018, 360, 1433-1438.). We have demonstrated that alkyldiazomethanes generated in situ from N-tosylhydrazones are effective carbene source for Co(II) porphyrin catalyzed intramolecular Buchner reaction and arene cyclopropanation in chemo- and regio-selective manner. This work represents the first example of metal catalyzed Buchner reaction and arene cyclopropanation via intermediacy of alkylcarbene (Adv. Synth. Catal. 2017, 359, 2253-2258.). We have developed an efficient synthesis of biaryls by a dirhodium(II)-catalyzed aromatic C-H arylation with diazo quinones. The new biaryl synthesis can be performed under mild and neutral conditions and without directing group chelation assistance. The reaction is applicable to a broad range of aromatics. The synthetic utility of the method was demonstrated by the late-stage modifications of a series of pharmaceuticals and functional materials as well as a short synthesis of a transthyretin amyloid inhibitor (Chem.-Eur. J. 2018, 24, 4815-4819.). In collaboration with Haixu Wang, we synthesized and structurally characterized several metal porphyrin alkylcarbene complexes by reacting steric encumbered metal porphyrins with bulky diazoalkanes (unpublished results).

The reaction enables rapid construction of a series of polycycles in good yields and with high chemo-selectivity from simple starting materials (Angewandte Chemie International Edition 2016, 55, 1810-1815). 4) We developed an efficient method for the synthesis of polysubstituted 3H-pyrrolizines and pyrrolizidines via a cobalt(II) porphyrin catalyzed intramolecular cyclopropanation/ring opening cascade reaction of N-tosylhydrazones (Advanced Synthesis & Catalysis 2018, 360, 1433-1438.). 5) We demonstrated that alkyldiazomethanes generated in situ from N-tosylhydrazones are effective carbene source for Co(II) porphyrin catalyzed intramolecular Buchner reaction and arene cyclopropanation in chemo- and regio-selective manner (Advanced Synthesis & Catalysis 2017, 359, 2253-2258.). 6) We developed an efficient synthesis of biaryls by a dirhodium(II)-catalyzed aromatic C-H arylation with diazo quinones (Chemistry-A European Journal 2018, 24, 4815-4819.). 7) In collaboration with Haixu Wang, we synthesized and structurally characterized several metal porphyrin alkylcarbene complexes by reacting steric encumbered metal porphyrins with bulky diazoalkanes (unpublished results).

17306714.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17306714.value: There is a great potential for further development of transition metal-catalyzed alkylcarbene transfer reactions. Metal carbenes are versatile intermediates capable of mediating a variety of organic transformations including C-H insertion, cyclopropanation, ylide formation and olefin metathesis. These methodologies have been used in the synthesis of a range of useful compounds including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals and molecular materials. Therefore, the development of new types of metal carbenes is always an important research subject in organic and organometallic chemistry. In contrast to extensive studies of acceptor carbene, little is known about reactive profile of alkylcarbene. In this project, we have demonstrated that alkylcarbene is a versatile intermediate capable of undergoing a variety of transformations under transition metal catalysis with different reactivity and selectivity from acceptor carbene. We will continue to explore the reactive profile of alkylcarbene in transition metal catalysis. Studying this new type of metal carbenes not only enriches carbene chemistry, but also offers vast opportunities to develop a wide variety of new organic transformations and to discover new selectivity.

17306714.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17306714.value: Synthetic chemistry is the central science of different disciplines (including biomedicine, materials, new energy, agriculture, etc.). The synthesis of any substance is inseparable from synthetic chemistry, and the properties of any substance depend on the molecules that make up it. Transition metal-catalyzed carbene transfer reactions play an important role in organic synthesis due to its high efficiency for constructing complex molecules, excellent compatibility of functional groups and high stereoselectivity. The methodology has been used in the synthesis of a number of pharmaceuticals and bioactive natural products. The scope of carbene source, however, is confined to stabilized diazo compounds, little is known about reactive profile of non-stabilized diazoalkanes. In this project, we investigated the reactivity and selectivity of non-stabilized diazoalkanes and developed several efficient alkylcarbene transfer reactions. This work greatly expands scope of carbene sources, leads to the discovery of some new reactivity and selectivity of carbenoids and provides several new synthetic methods for organic synthesis.

17306814.label: Project Objectives
17306814.value: To determine the precise age, distribution, and stratigraphy of the late Neoproterozoic to early Cambrian strata in South China. To investigate the provenance, tectonic and oceanographic setting of these strata. 17306814.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306814.value: The supercontinental cycles of Rodinia and Gondwanaland during late Neoproterozoic to early Cambrian have involved extreme changes in paleogeography, paleoclimate and biosphere, as indicated in the explosion of early life in Earth’s history. The South China Craton records several hallmark events, including Neoproterozoic “Snowball Earth” and deposition of banded iron formation, followed by extensive deposition of Ediacaran to Cambrian phosphorites and black shales with Mo, V, Cr and Ni mineralization. These events occurred during the breakup of Rodinia and the assembly of Gondwanaland and are thought to be associated with the paleogeographic change of the South China Craton in supercontinental cycles. Although much work has been done in the past two decades, the paleogeographic positions of the South China Craton in Rodinia and Gondwanaland are still controversial. In addition, the role of the South China Craton in the reconstruction of the supercontinental cycles is loosely constrained. Continuous sedimentation from late Neoproterozoic (~800 Ma) to early Cambrian (~540 Ma) in the South China Craton provides a rare opportunity to examine dramatic changes in paleoclimate and biosphere. However, the provenance, tectonic setting and oceanographic environment of these sedimentary rocks, are still not well understood. In the past, we have worked on Paleo-proterozoic to Neoprotoerozic rocks of South China. As a logic continuation, we propose to undertake a detailed investigation of the late Neoproterozoic to early Cambrian sedimentary rocks in order to: 1) constrain the precise ages of these rocks; 2) determine their provenance and physical-chemical conditions of sedimentation; 3) reconstruct the paleoenvironment of deposition of these sedimentary rocks; 4) compare strata of the same age from South China and other continents and 5) ultimately provide information about the role of South China in the reconstruction of the supercontinental cycles and associated dramatic changes in paleoclimate, biosphere and mineralization. 新元古到寒武纪期间，Rodinia 和Gondwana超大陆旋回使地球的古地理，古气候和生物圈发生了巨大的变化，例如地球历史上的著名的寒武纪生命大爆发就发生在这个时期。华南克拉通记录了这个时期几次标志性的事件，如新元古代的“雪球地球”事件和条带状铁建造（BIF）的形成，以及后期从Edicaran到寒武纪的磷矿和含Mo, V, Cr and Ni矿化黑色页岩的广泛沉积事件。这些事件发生在Rodinia大陆裂解和Gondwana大陆聚合的过程之中，被认为是伴随着华南克拉通古地理变化而同时发生的。虽然在过去二十年中已经做了许多研究工作，但关于华南克拉通在Rodinia和Gondwana大陆的古地理位置仍然存在争议。而且，华南克拉通在超大陆重建中的作用还不是十分清楚。华南克拉通中从新元古到早寒武的连续沉积记录为检验这个时期古气候和生物圈的巨大变化提供了一个难得的机会。但是，这些沉积岩的源区，构造背景和古海洋背景还不是十分清楚。过去几年中，我们已经对华南的古元古到新元古的岩石做了一些研究工作。作为对前期工作的延续，我们打算对新元古代晚期到早寒武的沉积岩进行详细的研究：1）精确地限制这些岩石的年龄；2）确定他们的源区和沉积的物理-化学条件；3）重建这些沉积岩的沉积古环境；4）与华南和其他大陆的同时期地层进行对比；5）最终为确定华南在重建古大陆和恢复同期古气候，古生物和成矿巨变事件中的作用提供信息。

17306814.label: Realisation of objectives
17306814.value: This project has been going very well with the involvement of a post-doctor fellow, Chen Wei, and two PhD students, Liu Zerui and Zhao Wen. Since the start of this project, we have carried out field work and extensive laboratory work both in Mainland China and Hong Kong. Through the field work, lab work and data analyses, all of these four objectives have been reached fully or partically. 1 To determine the precise age, distribution, and stratigraphy of the late Neoproterozoic to early Cambrian strata in South China. Late-Neoproterozoic to early Cambrian strata were widely deposited on the southeastern margin of the Yangtze Block, South China. To make a detailed correlation of these strata, our work mainly focused on the lower-most glaciation-layers and uppermost early Cambrian phosphorite and black shales. Samples were collected from more than 10 sections in 6 provinces of South China, including Yunnan, Guizhou, Hubei, Hunan, Guangxi and Jiangxi provinces. U-Pb dating of detrital zircons from the Jiangkou Formation and the Nantuo Formation yield the youngest ages of the 670Ma and 630Ma, respectively, suggesting that these two formations corresponds to globally recognized Sturtian (~725- 670 Ma) and Marinoan glacial events (654-635Ma). On the other hand, according to stratigraphic correlations, we conclude that the early Cambrian phosphorites were deposited from 542Ma to 526Ma, whereas the lowest black shales were mainly deposited after 536Ma. 2 To investigate the provenance, tectonic and oceanographic setting of these strata. According to age distribution patterns of detrital zircons from the Jiangkou Formation and the Nantuo Formation, we concluded that the sediments were mainly sourced from the Yangtze block. We further interpreted that the South China block was not connected to the Rodinia supercontinent during the Late-Neoproterozoic time. 3 To provide additional information on global changes in paleogeography, paleoclimate and biosphere that took place during this period and to relate these processes to the tectonic evolution of the region. Our work mainly focused on the environmental changes during the crucial time between Ediacaran biotas extinction and Cambrian explosion. From geochemical and isotopic features of these marine sediments, we proposed that toxic Hg loading into the seawater at the end of the Ediacaran, surface water reduction and deep-water oxygenation during the early Cambrian. 4 Ultimately to yield information about the configuration and role of the South China in the reconstruction of the supercontinent cycles of Rodinia and Gondwanaland. According to stratigraphic and geochemical correlations, the South China Craton were thought to be located at the margin of the Rodinia and Gondwana supercontinent and are adjacent to the Indian block during the early Cambrian period.

17306814.label: Major findings and research outcome
17306814.value: Major findings of the project are about the redox states and circulation patterns of the early Cambrian ocean. Our studies on the early Cambrian phosphorites deposited at the Meishucun section, Yunnan province documents that the upper phosphorites have much higher redox sensitive elements than the lower phosphorite unit, indicating that the surface water was reduced from oxic condition to suboxic condition at around 536-526Ma (Liu et al., 2017). On the other hand, abundant Fe-oxides, high V concentration and extremely low 98Mo values were found in the early Cambrian black shales deposited at the Xiushui section, Jiangxi province, suggesting that the bottom water evolved from anoxic condition to suboxic condition at ~536Ma to 521Ma (Liu 2017 PhD thesis). Such a bi-directional evolution mode of the shallow and deep early Cambrian ocean is suggestive for an oceanic mixing at the early Cambrian ocean. The rapid circulation of the ocean might promote the animal diversity during the early Cambrian (Liu 2017 PhD thesis). Research outcome Overall, this project was successful with important findings published in highly ranked journals in the field of the study. There are totally 4 full articles published in international refereed journals including 1 papers in GSA Bulletin (IF-impact fact =>4) and 1 in Chemical Geology (IF>3), 1 in Journal of Asian Earth Sciences (IF=2.88) and 1 paper in Precambrian Research (IF>4).

17306814.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17306814.value: The current project is mainly focused on U-Pb dating and whole rock geochemistry feature of the Ediacaran- Cambrian strata, and our original proposals are basically obtained. To further develop the research, we plan to investigate the mineral assemblages and inner structures of these marine sediments, in order to take a deep looked at their depositional and diagenetic processes. Benefiting from the easy access to equipment, such as TEM, SEM and EPMA in HKU, the work of ultra-structures (micro- to nano- scale) observations are easily to be carried out. On the other hand, to better understand the tectonic and environmental changes of our planet during the late-Neoproterozoic to early Cambrian, researches on sedimentary successions deposited on other blocks, such as North China, North India and American are needed. At the moment, Zhou and his research group have collaborated with Chinese and oversea colleagues to continue our studies.

17306814.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17306814.value: Objectives set in our original proposal are basically obtained and all the activities related to the project were smooth. Isotopic and geochemical evidence is provided in this study. One PhD student was fully trained in this project. There is a major breakthrough in the study of early Cambrian strata, in that we proposed an oceanic mixing model to illustrate the circulation pattern of the early Cambrian ocean. The extensive vertical circulation of the seawater can possibly lead to or accelerate the early Cambrian animal diversity. Overall, this project was successful with important findings published in highly ranked journals in the field of the study.

17400514.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17400514.value: 基于增长极的发展：以大珠三角区域的新区为例

17400514.label: Project Objectives
17400514.value: To study the three new districts in the Great Pearl River Delta (GPRD) region (Qianhai, Nansha and Hengqin) against a global economic trend of a shift from manufacturing to services, and the Chinese national economic strategy of selective developments of the coastal region to serve as growth poles for the western and central regions. Through on-site observations, data collections, interviews and discussions with the various participants in the development phenomenon, the development of the new districts will be documented under the aspects of: (a) origin and background; (b) formation procedure; and (c) effect as well as social and policy impact and implications. To examine and analyze the relation and connection among the economic environment, industrial structure, spatial governance and its implementation of the three new districts, leading to identification of: (a) the rationale underlying the establishment of the new districts; (b) the key actors and their respective roles in the development of the new districts; and (c) the key features of the new districts and their relations with urban/regional development. To explore the applicability of the growth pole theory in the development of the new districts and the GPRD region, paying particular attention on the intra and inter regional spatial interactions and, having regard to the wide variation in the new districts’ spatial areas, the extent to which spatial variations may affect the application of the growth poles theory. Based on the experience of the new districts, to draw conclusions on the progress and evolution in the planning and development of the GPRD region, and to formulate suggestions for regional development policies and their implementation with particular regard to institutional establishment for regional cooperation, spatial optimization for industrial restructuring, and better planning for urban and regional development.

17400514.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17400514.value: 2009年1月，国务院发布了《珠江三角洲地区发展和改革规划纲要》（以下简称《纲要》），为大珠三角洲区域未来的发展提供了基本的指导方针。《纲要》提出了将本地区建成世界级高端制造业和现代服务业基地的目标，并以此为战略导向，引领高端发展，建设自主创新的新高地，打造若干规模和水平居世界前列的先进制造产业基地，培育一批具有国际竞争力的世界级企业和品牌，发展与香港国际金融中心相配套的现代服务业体系，建设与港澳地区错位发展的国际航运、物流、贸易、会展、旅游和创新中心。 《纲要》的实施不但事关内地城市，还聚焦香港和澳门。为实现《纲要》设定的目标，粤港澳政府同意设立主要的合作区，围绕金融财政、产业融合、基础建设、城市规划、环境保护、教育培训等方面开展合作。这些合作区的选择，揭示了区内的合作正由制造业、商贸业引领转向服务业主导的趋势。长远看来，这也将有利于实现“优质生活圈”的区域合作计划（香港特区政府，2012）中设定的目标。 本研究选择了三个新区，包括深圳的前海、广州的南沙、珠海的横琴，来研究大珠三角区域的最新发展动向。通过对这些新区的考察与分析，本研究期望对近期的区域政策及其实施开展综合评价，并全面评述转型时期的大珠三角城市和区域规划。 本研究将兼备学术上和实践上的双重意义。学术上，通过对“增长极”作为区域规划和发展助推器的回顾，评判其对大珠三角地区的生产性服务业经济的促进作用。通过不同层级的视角对城市和区域发展的研究，也将对中国的发展策略研究提供分析上的突破。本研究的经验性发现和结论，还将为新区及其所属区域的发展揭示政策指引的方向。

17400514.label: Major findings and research outcome
17400514.value: The project has produced in-depth research findings in accordance with the stated objectives. The findings were presented in over 10 conferences and invited talks, and two special paper sessions in international conferences. Publications in leading journals in the built environment discipline have been secured. Evidence of impact include contract research on the economic impacts of Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge, the Blue Book of Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Observation (2016-17) (edited by the Co-I) and further grant applications. Our analysis shows that territorial restructuring of China since 2008 is driven by strong central government imperative towards a repacking of socioeconomic assets, labor forces and institutions, resulting in variegated sub-national territories with different functions and development pathways (Project objective 1). With a holistic conceptualisation of land finance in China, we examine land financing costs, financial risks sharing and distribution of returns in three types of financing management. These are key features of the new districts with regards to regional development in the Greater Pearl River Delta (now known as the Greater Bay Area). We have identified through the study of Nanzha FTZ a new innovative collaborative financing mode that involves enterprises as strategic development partners. This reflects the recent trend, encouraged by central government, of promoting market capital participation to address the rising capital cost for acquiring land stock and to reduce local debts, and as a means to stimulate market incentives through direct or joint investment in the urban development process (Project objective 2). While taking the Growth Pole theory as an exploratory framework, our study has extended the focal point of speculative urbanism through two significant empirical findings (Project objective 3). First, innovative land governance involving the participation of stringently selected non-state-owned enterprises, who shoulder most of the financial risks, can minimise the risks and uncertainties in speculative urbanism. Second, the new public-private partnership mode of land finance that involves non-state participant has led to destatisation and a change in the regulatory capacity of the state. Decision-making and land ownership under the land banking mechanism are jointly undertaken by the local authority and the strategic partner. A new regulatory tool was introduced by central government whereby the volume of bonds to be issued every year is determined by a top-down debt allocation system. Our findings on the study of Nansha carry significant implications. Notably, the involvement of strategic investor and gain-and-risk sharing serves to fulfil the central government’s objective to attain further marketisation and financialisation. It signals a clear message that “well-round”, foresighted market player is to be expected in future land development. (Project objectives 3 and 4) Further, the collective land governance and the three mechanisms identified in our study will serve as key conductive conditions for planning, financing and managing the urban development process.

17400514.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17400514.value: Free Trade Zone (FTZ) reflects distinct spatial selectivity on the part of the central government, designed to create an innovative and market-friendly regulatory environment. The polymorphous territorial restructuring of China reflects the country’s ongoing efforts to experiment with marketization, although the socialist path-dependent philosophy has not been entirely left behind. The new land development model necessitates a paradigm shift in China’s town planning. Economic development is not solely dictated by professionals and local authorities. Development-led planning proposal is much needed to supplement the current regulatory type of planning. More case studies (not confining to China) should be carried out to examine the operation and outcome of the partnership arrangement before drawing definitive conclusion on its general application and cost-effectiveness. The Chinese experience has attracted overseas interest. The PI was invited by Nepal to research into the economic impacts of the China-Nepal Friendship Highway in 2016 and 2017. The preliminary findings were presented at an international conference in April 2018 https://aag.secure-abstracts.com/AAG%20Annual%20Meeting%202018/abstracts-gallery/12989. To continue with the study, the PI has submitted grant application (GRF, Lincoln Land Institute) to further investigate the impacts of land finance in China on endeavours under the Belt and Road Initiative.

17400514.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17400514.value: Urbanisation in China since the economic reform and opening up of the country is characterised by an unprecedented amount of land development resulting from privatisation, marketisation, and commodification of land in the urbanisation process. This study is an analysis, from the growth pole theory that probe into the dynamics of land finance, a phenomenon of financing arrangement for urban development. It reviews and compares three different modes of land finance, including that practiced in Guangzhou and Nansha FTZ. The interplays between different stakeholders are examined with the focus being on the exchange of land resources for capital. The findings carry implications for the discourse on regional development in the Greater Pearl River Delta Area.
