21202014.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21202014.value: Any item we use in our daily life such as clothing, furniture, vehicles, buildings and constructions undergoes wear and tear from external force and environmental exposure after continual usage. This aging process typically reduces the mechanical strength of the object over time. For some applications such as plastics, aged material can be replaced easily. For other applications such as buildings and bridges, aging can cause catastrophes if they are not maintained properly. The same is true for materials inside a battery. Part of the reason why battery does not last forever is because of the stress and volume expansion of the materials induced during charge and discharge, and this continual change in structure can cause cracking and fatigue that reduces the lifetime and jeopardize the safety of a battery. This project aims at designing and characterizing new structurally stable high-capacity materials that can be reversibly used with minimal mechanical degradation for battery applications. By making materials that are more structurally stable, we prolong the lifetime of a battery, reduce waste, improve safety and increase sustainability. The problem is especially severe for lithium-ion battery materials because during the incorporation of lithium into the material, they undergo dimensional and structural change. With time, material and electrode disintegration occur, which will lower battery life. How to make a material stronger? Take concrete as an example. One can make the binding strength of the concrete material stronger by changing the composition; putting reinforcement such as steel bars inside; preventing surface damage by applying a coating of paint, etc. Similar ideas can be applied to strengthen battery materials: composition variation, composite formation and surface protection. We proposed to start with silicon-based and metal-oxide anode materials. They are potential replacements to commercial graphite anodes but have demonstrated to give large volume change during charge and discharge. Alloying silicon with other elements, encapsulating silicon with fibers and surface modification are the methods we plan to implement to tackle the problem. The project will be nothing without being able to directly measure the change in material mechanics after battery cycling. In-situ measurements of electrode thickness and mechanical stiffness changes during charge and discharge will be established to characterize the mechanical behavior. An iterative process of material design and characterization will lead to new discoveries. We plan to also study crack formation in cathode materials at a later stage of the project. 我們在日常生活中使用的任何物件，如服裝，家具，汽車，房屋及建築物，都會受到環境的侵蝕而變得衰弱。有一些物件，如塑膠，老化後可以很容易地更換。但有一些物件，如建築物和橋樑，如果沒有妥善的保養,可能會導致災難。電池內部的材料亦有同樣的問題。為什麼電池不能永遠持續地用下去？其中一個原因是充放電時電池材料的膨脹和收縮，導致龜裂和物質疲勞，減低電池的壽命和安全性。這些問題對於鋰離子電池的材料尤其嚴重，因為鋰離子進入材料時會引致相當大的體積變化。該項研究的目的是設計和開発結構穩定的高容量電池材料，来延長電池的壽命和提高循環性。 如何能增強材料的韌度？以混凝土為例，可改變材料的結合強度、用鋼筋穩固內部、或用油漆防止表面的損壞等。同樣的方法亦可以應用於電池材料上：改變材料的結構、形成複合物或表面保護膜。我們建議研究矽或氧化金屬物作為電池的負極。首先測量材料在充放電時的膨脹和收縮率，然後以合金、表面保護等之方法来減低材料的體積變化並増強材料的結構穩定性能。

21202014.label: Realisation of objectives
21202014.value: Objective 1 – two characterization tools (a dilatometer and a micro-indenter) were set up to quantify the mechanical properties of battery electrodes. The dilatometer can measure thickness change of battery electrodes during charge and discharge, and the micro-indenter can quantify the mechanical strength (hardness, modulus and elasticity) of polymer and composite materials and electrodes to correlate mechanical properties with electrochemical performance. Objective 2 – from our work, we found that binder and also its interaction with the active materials are important parameters that affect the electrochemical performances of alloy-typed anode materials. Better cycling stability can be obtained by using high-modulus polyimide binder, which can be strengthened further with ion-dipole interaction between polyimide and cellulose. In addition, we also found the degree of cross-linking in the binder can affect its mechanical properties and also the electrochemical performance of the electrode with the binder. Objective 3 – mechanical changes of silicon can be suppressed by reducing particle size and alloying with Ti. In addition, volume changes during charge and discharge can be reduced by incorporating oxygen into the matrix with silicon monoxide (SiO). A detailed study was conducted to understand the charge-discharge mechanism of SiO in particularly the role of oxygen in the lattice. Objective 4 - Polyimide surface coating on SnO2, Sb and Si materials reduces volume expansion, suppresses electrode cracking and improves cycle stability. Surface coating is also extended to cathode and anode materials for sodium-ion batteries to enable long-life batteries. In addition, a new procedure to cross-link the polyimide coating with SiO material with the use of a self-assembled monolayer was developed. This robust coating structure can allow micron-sized SiO to cycle with excellent capacity retention despite the large volume change during charge and discharge.

21202014.label: Major findings and research outcome
21202014.value: The aim of the research is to study the mechanical properties of battery materials and components in order to develop technologies to prolong lifetime of batteries. The major findings and research outcomes are as below: 1. We developed a method to measure thickness change of electrodes during charge and discharge and used the method to study the effect of binder on performance of Si electrodes (D.Y.W. Yu et al. ChemElectroChem (2015) 2, 1090-1095. 2. We quantified the capacity loss in Si and SiO electrodes and clarified the charge-discharge mechanisms (P. K. Lee et al. ChemElectroChem (2015) 2, 1090-1095; T. Tan et al. J. Electrochem. Soc. (2019) 166, A5210-A5214.) 3. We reduced volume expansion during lithiation by forming agglomerate of Si nano-particles with high energy ballmilling. Cycle performance is significantly improved (P. K. Lee et al. ACS Appl. Mater. We investigated the effect of Ti alloying and O incorporation into Si materials, and found that in both cases, the volume change is suppressed and cycle performance is improved (P. K. Lee et al. We found that capacity degradation of alloy-based materials such as Si, Sb and SnO2 can be suppressed by surface coating with a high modulus polyimide surface coating, which acts as a buffer layer to accommodate the large volume changes (Y. 21202014.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21202014.value: Through this project, we have gained excellent knowledge on mechanical properties of alloy-based electrodes, in particular high-capacity Si, for battery applications. We are also able to control different factors such as electrode formulation, binder, surface coating to improve the cyclability of the electrodes. We intend to continue on the research project to further understand and characterize material-binder interaction, as well as the thermal stability of the materials. In addition, we are currently working with a local company to develop porous Si and plan to mass produce them for battery applications. The company has recently built a prototype line in Hong Kong that can produce up to 40 kg of porous Si materials per day. We are in the process of optimizing the materials for battery applications, and also determining appropriate electrode formulation for 18650 cells. We expect full commercialization of the material in one to two years.

21202014.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21202014.value: High capacity battery materials such as silicon-based materials undergo large volume change when they store and release lithium ions, leading to materials and electrode cracking and reducing the lifetime of the battery. The main achievements of the project are: first, we developed a method to quantify the volume change during change and discharge and also mechanical properties of the binder. We optimized the binder, particle size and electrode formulation to improve the integrity and stability of the electrode. Second, we engineered the Si material by alloying with Ti or addition of active/inactive matrices to reduce volume change. Lastly, we also developed new coating technologies to hold the particles together, like a balloon that can expand and contract freely together with the material volume change. All these efforts are able to improve cycle performance of the electrode. 13 journal papers were published throughout this project; 16 conference presentations were given; one patent application was submitted based on the technologies developed here; 2 PhD students, 1 master student and 5 undergraduates were trained under the project.

21202114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21202114.value: Nanofluids, which are nanoparticle dispersions in a liquid, have already seen much interest due to their heat transfer enhancements with low particle concentrations compared to the base pure fluids. Pool boiling is one of the most efficient heat transfer modes. However, the complexity of two-phase flow boiling on tube bundles presents many challenges understanding of physical phenomena taking place, especially for vertical tube bundle pool boiling, about which very few research has been done. It is important to quantify these numerous two-phase flow, heat transfer and bubble dynamics mechanisms in order to better describe tube bundle pool boiling performance with different operational conditions. A tube bundle pool boiling facility is designed and constructed with three vertical tubes bundle submerged in a water pool. This specific tube position design can allow us to use a two phase flow particle image velocimetry (PIV) system for simultaneous measurement of bubble geometry and liquid flow velocity field, and a high speed camera for bubble image capture. To better understand different nanoparticles’ performance with tube bundle pool boiling, two-step method will be used to produce Al2O3-water, SiC-water and copper-water nanofluids with different nano-particle concentrations, which are oxide, carbide, and metal, respectively. The nanofluids will then be characterized, including TEM images of nanofluids and tube surfaces before and after boiling as well, particle size distribution, surface tension, thermal conductivity and etc. Tube bundle pool boiling experiments will then be conducted with pure water and water-based nanofluids. Through the experiments under different operational conditions, different sets of data and images of temperature profiles, full velocity field measurements and bubble geometries will be obtained using the instrumentation, DAS system on the experimental loop, including PIV system and high speed camera. Analyses and comparisons will be conducted to see the tube bundle effects, nanofluids effects and other factors affecting tube bundle pool boiling. Using the experimental results obtained, bubble dynamics and tube bundle effect analysis will be conducted with and without the introduction of nanoparticles of different types and concentrations. The bubble breakup and coalescence models due to bubble dynamics and turbulent mixing effect will be developed and implemented into a commercial CFD code, ANSYS CFX. As a result of this study, a simulation tool will be developed to predict the bubble dynamics, two-phase flow and heat transfer in a vertical tube bundle pool boiling with tube bundle turbulent mixing effect considered for both pure-water and water-based nanofluids. 纳米流体是将纳米颗粒分散在液体中。由于其在低颗粒浓度时相对于基液具有显著的传热增强效果，纳米流体已经引起了广泛兴趣。池沸腾是最有效的传热方式之一。然而，管束两相流沸腾的复杂性对发生的物理现象的理解带来很多挑战，特别是对于垂直管束池沸腾，很少有相关研究完成。 大量的两相流，传热和气泡动力学机制的量化非常重要，这样可以更好地描述管束池沸腾在不同的操作条件下是的性能表现。在本项研究中，我们设计了一套管束池沸腾装置，在该装置中三个垂直管构成的管束浸入一个水池。这种特殊的直管位置设计使得我们可以使用两相流粒子图像测速（PIV）系统来同时测量气泡几何形状和液体流速场，并同时采用一个高速摄像机来采集气泡图像。 为了更好地理解不同的纳米粒子的管束池沸腾性能，我们将使用两步法来生产氧化铝 - 水，碳化硅-水和铜 - 水等具有不同纳米粒子浓度的纳米流体，这几种纳米粒子分别是氧化物，碳化物和金属。然后我们将进行纳米流体表征分析，包括纳米流体和管表面在沸腾前后的TEM图像，粒度分布，表面张力，热导率等。我们将进行纯水和水基纳米流体的管束池沸腾实验。通过不同运行条件下的实验，我们将获得不同的数据和图像集合，包括温度分布，速度场测量和气泡几何尺寸等。数据和图像的获取将使用实验回路上的仪器仪表和数据采集（DAS）系统，包括粒子图像测速（PIV）系统和高速摄像机等。我们将进行分析和比较来研究管束效应，纳米流体效应以及影响管束池沸腾的其他因素。 利用实验所得到的结果，我们将将对有和没有引入纳米粒子的不同类型和浓度的流体进行气泡动力学和管束效应分析，并将建立由于气泡动力学和湍流混合效应而造成气泡破裂和聚合的模型，植入到商业CFD软件，ANSYS CFX。这项研究的结果将是，建立模拟工具来预测纯水和水基纳米流体，在湍流混合作用下垂直管束池沸腾的气泡动力学，两相流与传热。

21202114.label: Realisation of objectives
21202114.value: A comprehensive investigation has been first performed on boiling heat transfer over plain and enhanced tube bundles which is significant to the industrial design of shell and tube heat exchanger. The flow and heat transfer mechanisms of boiling in external flow channels are distinct from the in-tube flow boiling so that the in-tube flow boiling experiences cannot be directly applied to external flow and pool boiling. This covers experimental, analytical and numerical studies which involving liquid-vapor two-phase flow dynamics, bundle effects, surface enhancement effects, heat transfer performance prediction, numerical models and computational tools development. More experimental database involving boiling two-phase flow over various bundle geometries and more test fluids (hydrocarbons and refrigerants) are required to build a deeper understanding of flow boiling regimes transition over tube bundles. More accurate local HTC correlations with simple forms are still required for the improvement of general applications. The influences of in-tube hot fluid flow on the external boiling heat transfer over bundles still needs more experimental evidence to extend the understanding of the inherent mechanisms and establish a more reliable prediction method. The number of studies on boiling over enhanced tube bundle is still limited, and the experimental database including more surfaces categories and more fluids are necessary to obtain a comprehensive view. CFD simulations for the heat transfer conjugation of in-tube condensation and tube outside boiling still require further improvement and the calculation capability is still the main limitation for the accurate simulation of large-scale geometries and complex flow structures. An experimental test facility has been developed to study multiphase flow and heat transfer of boiling and condensation in CityU. The multi-tube test facility consists of a steam generator (SG), steam and air supply line, tube bundle test section, secondary pool, condensate tank (CT), suppression pool (SP), and a storage tank. The steam is generated in the steam generator (SG), and goes into the tube bundle of the passive cooling system. The steam is condensed into water and release the heat, and the heat is removed via pool boiling in the secondary side of the water pool. Pool boiling occurs under the atmosphere pressure. The condensate water will go into the condensate tank (CT). Two-phase flow visualization plays an important role in the experimental approach, using a two phase flow particle image velocimetry (PIV) system to measure simultaneously bubble geometry and flow velocity field, in addition to a high speed camera system to capture global and local data and images for multiphase flow phenomena. Through the two phase flow particle image velocimetry (PIV) system, we can measure the fluid velocity field and bubble geometries simultaneously for the two-phase flow boiling and condensation. The test facility has also data acquisition system to read and record data during experiments, including temperatures, pressure, pressure differences, water levels and flow rates from thermocouples, pressure transducer, DP cells and vortex flow meters. The heat transfer performance has been modeled for in-tube condensation and external pool boiling respectively, as well as the heat transfer conjugation of the in-tube condensation and external pool boiling using CFD method. The VOF interface tracking method was employed under the Euler-Euler multiphase frame. The k-Ω turbulence model was used for the both tube and pool side two-phase flow and the surface tension force between the two phases was modeled with the CSF surface tension method. The mass transfer between boiling and condensation was calculated using multiple phase change models, including Rankine-Hugoniot jump condition method, Lee model and Tanasawa model. The mass transfer models were modified for the application to the specific cases and was validated for their applicability. The direct implementation of the modified mass transfer models in the ANSYS Fluent will cause numerical instabilities and resulted in divergence in calculation. A mathematical smoothing method and temporal relaxation were adopted to solve this problem. Even the smearing process will introduce deviation to the local mass conservation, it significantly improves the numerical stability and provides a reliable mass transfer prediction. In the following work, the mass transfer models will be all applied to the heat transfer conjugation simulation and a more accurate and efficient mass transfer modeling method will be developed. We also employed a system of transient single- and two-phase flow and heat transfer models to simulate the heat-up process of tube bundle pool boiling in a passive cooling system.Three-dimensional simulation was performed to show the effects on temperature distribution from geometry symmetry and asymmetry in the three-tube bundle system. To simulate boiling in a tube bundle water pool, the phenomena on the micro-scale have been modelled by appropriate closure relations. In this simulation, a constant heat flux used to represent the heat release from the steam condensation inside the tubes at this stage, and an in-tube condensation model to couple with the out-tube bundle pool boiling is under development. The heat-up transient was successfully simulated with the temperature profiles of different monitor points vs. time and temperature contours of different cross sections at different time. Condensation experiments were performed to investigate the effect of secondary water level on steam condensation heat transfer in a passive condenser tube for through-flow and complete condensation modes of operation. A single tube and tube bundle tests sections were separately tested. The condenser tubes were submerged in the secondary water pool where the condensation heat transferred from the tube was removed through boiling. Tests were carried out to investigate the effects of condenser operating pressure, and inlet stem flow rate using with pure steam and a mixture of steam and a noncondensable. The steady state tests with full and half secondary water level showed that the lower water level decreased condensation capacity of the condenser by almost 50%. For the complete condensation mode with secondary boil-off tests, the experimental data showed that system pressure increased for given inlet steam flow rate due to decrease in secondary heat removal. The condensation rate increased with increase in inlet steam flow rate and increase in the system pressure. The condensation heat transfer coefficient increased with the inlet steam flow rate, but decreased with the system pressure. The noncondensable drastically reduced the condensation rate in all cases.

21202114.label: Major findings and research outcome
21202114.value: Major research outcome: The project has generated several SCI journal publications and 1 journal manuscript under review, all with the grant acknowledgment. Four Ph.D. students have received full or partial financial support from the project. Some major findings include: - An experimental test facility has been developed to study multiphase flow and heat transfer of boiling and condensation in CityU. Two-phase flow visualization plays an important role in the experimental approach, using a two-phase flow particle image velocimetry (PIV) system to measure simultaneously bubble geometry and flow velocity field, in addition to a high-speed camera system to capture global and local data and images for multiphase flow phenomena. Through the two-phase flow particle image velocimetry (PIV) system, we can measure the fluid velocity field and bubble geometries simultaneously for the two-phase flow boiling and condensation. - The comparison of tube bundle experimental data with the single tube data by both the experiments and models shows that based on a linear fit for the trends, the single tube secondary HTC is between 25% - 35% less than what was recorded for the tube bundle, and the tube bundle condensation rates are slightly higher than the data from the single tube test sections due to turbulent mixing effect. - Higher secondary HTC happens due to the tube bundle effect on condensation heat removal. The turbulent mixing on the secondary side decreases the temperature difference between the pool water and condenser tube outer wall, causing an increase in secondary HTC. This increase in secondary HTC thus results in higher condensate mass flow rates. - The steady state tests with full and half secondary water level showed that the lower water level decreased condensation capacity of the condenser by almost 50%. For the complete condensation mode with secondary boil-off tests, the experimental data showed that system pressure increased for given inlet steam flow rate due to the decrease in secondary heat removal. The condensation rate increased with the increase in inlet steam flow rate and increase in the system pressure. The condensation heat transfer coefficient increased with the inlet steam flow rate but decreased with the system pressure. The noncondensable drastically reduced the condensation rate in all cases.

21202114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21202114.value: Pool boiling is one of the most efficient modes of heat transfer and finds application in areas such as refrigeration, power generation and nuclear reactors, where quick removal of heat energy from a hot surface is desired. Some next generation nuclear reactor designs employ a passive heat exchanger that allows the transfer of reactor decay heat via steam condensation inside the condenser tubes to the outer water pool where pool boiling occurs. Heat exchanger must be able to remove sufficient energy from reactor containment to prevent containment from exceeding its design pressure following a design basis accident. Hence a detailed knowledge of the variation of the heat transfer coefficient and its dependence on the system is necessary in order to predict the heat exchanger performance and for design optimization.

21300014.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21300014.value: This project aims to computationally investigate the interactions between the cell membrane and the actin cytoskeleton at multiple time and length scales. It will provide critical knowledge for understanding the membrane-cytoskeleton related cellular processes and functions, some of which are key pathogenic factors in a number of human diseases. Considered as a cooperative unit, the membrane–cytoskeleton system is essential for a cell to maintain its functionality. They collaboratively participate in cellular processes such as signal transduction, cell division, and cell migration. They also play important roles in viral entry, assembly, and budding. Loss of membrane-cytoskeleton connections can result in membrane blebbing, hereditary spherocytosis, and even cell death. It is therefore important to understand the mutual interactions and regulations between the membrane and cytoskeleton. Yet, a comprehensive model that describes these interactions is still lacking due to the complexity of their structural interconnectedness. In this proposed research, the PI will computationally investigate (1) at the nanometer scale the interactions between the cell membrane and the actin cytoskeleton, and (2) at the micrometer scale the influence of actin cytoskeleton on the lateral organization and properties of the cell membrane. To achieve this challenging multi-scale computational goal, the PI proposes a three-tier computational approach, where the minimal representation of the cell membrane-cytoskeleton system, i.e. the lipid membrane-actin filament system, will be examined. Firstly, the membrane-actin filament system of hundreds of nanometers will be simulated using coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations on a microsecond scale. Subsequently, the membrane-actin filament interactions will be quantified using coarse-graining methods. Lastly, the system will be scaled up to a micrometer length scale to examine the structure and dynamics of membranes on top of a dynamic actin filament network at a millisecond time scale. The multi-scale computational approach enables systematic investigation of the membrane-actin filament interactions and the effects of such interactions on the structure and properties of the membrane. The results will provide new insight into the cooperativity of cell membrane and actin cytoskeleton in various cellular processes. From the computational point of view, this proposed work represents the first attempt to place a membrane and actin filaments in the same computational ensemble. Successful completion of this project will generate a new methodology for exploring large and complex biological systems. 本項目旨在利用計算機模擬的方法研究細胞膜與細胞骨架在多時空尺度的相互作用。該研究將為很多與細胞膜和細胞骨架相關疾病的致病機理提供解釋。 作為一個協同單元，細胞膜與細胞骨架這個體系對於細胞維持它的正常功能是至關重要的。該體系協同參與細胞的諸多生命活動，例如信息傳導，細胞分裂，細胞遷移，甚至與病毒的入侵，組裝和發芽都相關。細胞膜與細胞骨架的脫離會導致細胞膜起泡，遺傳性球形紅細胞貧血，甚至死亡。因此，理解細胞膜與細胞骨架的相互作用是至關重要的。由於他們的相互連接高度複雜，目前還沒有一個完善的模型來描述二者的關係。 因此本課題將研究以下問題：（１）細胞膜與細胞骨架的肌動蛋白網絡在納米尺度的相互作用；（２）細胞膜骨架的肌動蛋白網絡在微米尺度下對細胞膜的結構和性能的調控。為了解決這兩個多尺度的問題，我們將主要研究一個簡化的模型體系：細胞膜磷脂雙分子層和肌動蛋白纖維網絡。針對這一模型，我們建議一個三階段的模擬計算方案：首先，使用粗粒化分子動力學模擬幾百納米尺度的磷脂雙分子層和肌動蛋白纖維體系。其次，分析擬合出磷脂雙分子層與肌動蛋白纖維相互作用力。最後，研究肌動蛋白在微米尺度下對細胞膜結構和動力學的調控。 該課題在多個尺度系統地研究細胞膜和肌動蛋白纖維的相互作用，以及此作用力對細胞膜結構和性能的調控。研究結果將闡明在細胞生命活動中細胞膜和細胞骨架的協同作用。本工作是第一次從計算模擬的角度出發研究這個協同體系。該課題的圓滿完成將構建一套全新的系統的研究複雜生物體系的模擬方案。

21300014.value: We have utilised all atom and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations to study actin filament and lipid membrane systems. The ordering of lipid membrane on the lateral direction has been examined as a function of time.

21300014.label: Major findings and research outcome
21300014.value: We have explored two mutations H40Y and D286G to the actin subunit and they significantly affected the properties of actin filament. H40Y stiffens the entire actin filament. H40Y partially limits actin filament extensibility upon activations, and H40Y disrupts myosin and tropomyosin function. D286G located in the actin-actin interface. Our computational study showed that D286G impairs the flexural rigidity of actin filaments. However, upon activation, D286G did not have any direct consequence on actin filament extension. Hence, H286G may alter the structure of actin filaments but when expressed together with normal actin molecules, it may only have minor effects on the ex-vivo mechanics of actin filaments. The coarse-grained analysis have been applied to actin subunits in both cases and compared with the wide type, these results revealed the structural changes at the molecular level.

21300014.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21300014.value: As the development of two dimensional (2D) nano-materials, more and more 2D nano-materials will be applied for biomedical applications. In this project we studied the actin filament and lipid membrane systems. In the future, we could introduce 2D nano-materials to actin-membrane system and explore their effects to actin-membrane system. This year the PI submitted an proposal to study the interaction of 2D nano-materials with the lipid membrane system to UGC. In the next year, the PI will take into proteins into consideration in order to explore much more complex and practical biological system interacting with nano-materials and gain insights for 2D nano-mateirals development for drug delivery and nano-toxicity.

21300014.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21300014.value: In this project, the PI explored a large and complex biological system, an actin filament, which supports the cell membrane, determines the shape of the cell and controls the motility of a cell. The computational approaches, molecular dynamics simulations and coarse-grained analysis were applied into the investigation. We found the properties of actin filament and lipid membrane properties are affected by local changes to the actin protein and the membrane. More specifically, two mutations H40Y and D286G to the actin subunit and they significantly affected the properties of actin filament. On the other hand, with the insertion of nano-materials into the membrane, the diffusion of lipid molecules slows down and the membrane become much more rigid to bend. These results revealed the structure and property relationship of protein and membrane systems.

21300114.value: 四階偏微分方程在實際中有很多應用，包括薄液膜，液面，人口動力學，和半導體表面等。其中薄液膜流體穩定性及奇異性是一個特別活躍的研究領域。相關的物理和工程學的研究提出了很多有價值的數學問題，而數學結果也很大的增加了人們對這些物理現象的理解。 雖然薄液膜方程的解的存在性和唯一性是已知的，大多數關於穩定性及奇異性的結果是通過物理直觀或數值模擬計算出來的。從嚴格的數學角度講，薄液膜穩態解的穩定性，自相似奇異解的類型，以及這些特殊解與初值的關係等，還是未知的問題。 最近，在我們研究Schrodinger/Klein-Gordon方程 (合作者O. Costin， W. Schlag) 和Painleve方程PI (合作者O. Costin， S. Tanveer)的過程中，我們發展出一個新的構造分析方法。這個方法利用近似解和指數漸進分析來研究不能直接解的常微分方程，並被合作者O. Costin， S. Tanveer應用於邊界层方程和深水波方程中。 在此，我們要用這個新方法研究多種薄液膜方程的穩定性及奇異性。這些方程可以通過自相似變量替換或者Laplace變換轉化成常微分方程。我們將證明定态解的存在性，並且研究它的穩定性。我們還會由Dupont, Goldstein等人提到的幾種可能的奇異解。最後，我們會將我們的方法擴展到偏微分方程來研究初值和穩定解或奇異解的關係。我們相信這些工作將為重要的物理和數值實驗提供數學證明。

21300214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21300214.value: 過去數十年，大氣中的化學成分已顯著受人類影響而改變。光化學煙霧（工業污染的副產品）所產生的臭氧問題，已對我們的健康和都市環境造成嚴重的影響。雖然地區性二氧化氮和一些碳氫化合物的排放是臭氧的元兇，但是它們不是唯一來源。其他來源對臭氧的影響也扮演一個重要的角色，這些包括洲際污染物經遠距離傳播，平流層臭氧入侵及雷電所產生的氮化物排放。為了有效解決區域性臭氧問題，我們必須明白這些大自然現象對臭氧的影響。 在這研究上，我們會利用WRF-CMAQ空氣質量模擬系統和GEOS-Chem全球化學傳輸模型，經不同的排放組合來研究洲際污染物對東亞區域空氣質量的影響。此外，模擬所得出的政策背景（PRB）臭氧，也可以用來幫助臭氧相關的空氣污染政策。為了提高我們對地面臭氧成分的理解，我們將使用區域空氣質量模型來進行對平流層對流層交換（STE）的關係，以及它對地面臭氧的影響，當中地理位置及季節變化的影響也會一併研究。這研究，將有助於理解遠距離運輸和平流層臭氧是如何影響我們的區域臭氧的空氣質素。

21300214.label: Major findings and research outcome
21300214.value: The concept of Policy Relevant Background (PRB) ozone has been emerged in recent years to address the air quality baseline on the theoretical limits of air pollution controls. In this study, the influence of Long-range Transport (LRT) of air pollutants from North America and the PRB ozone was investigated. Overall, the LRT impact from North America has found to be ~0.54 ppbv, while the maximum impacts were observed at the mountain stations with values of 2.27 ppbv, 3.25 ppbv, 2.28 ppbv and 2.99 ppbv for January, April, July and September, respectively. In terms of PRB ozone, the effect of stratospheric ozone transport has enhanced the background ozone at the surface, particularly during the spring. The calculated PRB ozone based on the mean values of the daily maximum 8-h average (MDA8) are 53 ppbv for Spring (April) and 22 ppbv for summer (July), respectively. From the simulation runs performed on the Continental USA domain, we have confirmed that the number of layers adopted in the CMAQ simulation may have a strong influence on the accuracy of stratospheric ozone transport. In the case when limited layers (i.e., 24) were used, it would result in overestimation of surface ozone due to rapid transport of ozone aloft. On the other hands, when abundant layers were applied, underestimation of surface ozone was observed in the mountainous stations due to insufficient transport. It is clear that there is no known solution to this problem from the existing CMAQ air quality model framework.

21300214.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21300214.value: As mentioned in the major findings, the layer structure of CMAQ has a substantial impact on vertical ozone transport. To resolve this problem, reprogramming and redesign the advection scheme to cater for the upper air transport between the stratosphere and troposphere would be necessary. As CMAQ is a model that doesn't consider stratospheric reaction nor the tropopause position. Hence, special treatment should be made to mimic the transport phenomena in the upper atmosphere.

21300214.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21300214.value: Ground-level ozone (O3) is harmful to our climate, human health, and vegetation due to its highly reactive nature and its absorption properties. Exposure to high-level ozone has been proven to have severe adverse effects on the human respiratory system and plant surfaces. In recent years, the term “Policy Relevant Background (PRB)” ozone has been emerged to address the theoretical limits of our emission control policies on ozone air pollution. In this study, we have applied different air quality models to study the background ozone. Our findings show that the highest background ozone is observed in Spring with 53 ppbv, while the lowest is observed in summer with a value of 22 ppbv.

21300314.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21300314.value: The specificity of the interactions between complementary nucleotide bases can transform DNA into useful material for nanostructure construction through the design of specific nucleotide sequences. Self-assembled DNA nanostructures have defined shapes and are capable of targeted transportation of cargo within their structure and subsequent triggered release. Intracellular delivery of DNA nanostructure is commonly achieved through endocytosis. As yet, cellular uptake of DNA assemblies through endocytic pathway faces a major shortcoming due to localization inside acidic organelles such as lysosome and endosome, severely limiting the efficacy of intracellular targeting. Target-specific DNA nano-object can play a role in carrying and delivering a drug to the targeted cell as well as its area for disease treatment, giving rise to various biomedical applications such as diagnostics, therapeutics and drug delivery. Therefore, the development of novel biocompatible and multifunctional DNA nanostructures that show a specific targeting and drug or cargo delivery capability as well as a controllable release ability of cargo is of practical significance and has recently draw great attention. Towards these goals, we propose herein to rationally design and assemble novel multifunctional 3D DNA nanocages consisting of fluorescent markers for bio-imaging, targeting agents for cancer cells recognition as well as sub-cellular organelles localization, a well-designed cavity for selective encapsulation of guests and photoresponsive molecules for opening of cages in response to light. The chemical modification of DNA cages with active functional vectors/agents would facilitate specific tumor cell targeting and sub-cellular organelles localization without destroying their intrinsic behaviors. It is expected that a low cytotoxicity, high uptake efficiency and high stability of DNA nanocage are resulted. We also propose to systemically investigate the selective encapsulation of different molecular cargos, as well as explore the possibility of trigger-release of cargo in specific organelles under multi-photon laser light excitation. From both scientific and technological points of view, finding of this proposal strongly envision that multifunctional DNA nano-object will become one of the most intelligent nano-tool for in vitro or in vivo biomedical studies in respect to targeted drug delivery and cancer therapy. 互補的核苷酸鹼基之間的相互作用的特異性可以通過特定核苷酸序列的設計改造的DNA轉化成有用材料的納米結構構造。自組裝DNA納米結構已經確定的形狀，並有能力貨物其結構中有針對性的交通和隨後引發的釋放。細胞內遞送的DNA納米結構是通過內吞作用通常實現的。到目前為止，DNA的組裝，通過內吞途徑的細胞攝取面臨的一個主要缺點是由於定位中酸性細胞器，如溶酶體和內體，嚴重限制了細胞內的靶向的療效。靶特異性DNA納米物體可以起到攜帶和將藥物遞送至靶細胞以及它的面積為疾病的治療，對各種生物醫學應用，例如診斷，治療和藥物遞送引起的作用。因此，新型生物相容性和多功能的DNA納米結構的發展，顯示一個特定的目標和藥物或貨物的交付能力，以及貨物的可控釋放能力具有現實意義，而且最近畫的高度重視。實現這些目標，我們建議在此合理設計和組裝新型多功能三維DNA納米籠，包括用於生物成像熒光標記物，靶向癌細胞的識別劑以及亞細胞器定位，精心設計的腔體的封裝選擇嘉賓和光敏分子，反應輕開籠。與活性功能載體的DNA籠子的化學修飾/代理商將有利於特定腫瘤細胞靶向和亞細胞器定位在不破壞其固有的行為。據預計，低毒性，高吸收效率和DNA納米籠的高穩定性造成的。我們也建議在全身性探討不同分子貨物的選擇性封裝，以及探索在特定細胞器的扳機釋放貨物的下多光子激光激發的可能性。從科學和技術的觀點來看，發現這個建議強烈想像到，多官能的DNA納米物體將成為最智能納米的工具，在體外或在相對於靶向藥物遞送和治療癌症的體內生物醫學研究中的一個。

21300314.label: Realisation of objectives
21300314.value: We have successfully designed and synthesized a triangular-shaped nanocage which is functionalized with a double-tailed C18 lipid chain and a pair of fluorohores. Firstly, a C18 lipid phosphoramidite molecule was synthesized and fully characterizated by NMR and mass spectroscopy. After that, standard cyanoethyl phosphoramidite chemistry was used to link the C18 lipid to the DNA strands. A hierarchical approach was used to generate the geometrically well-defined DNA nancages in a stepwise manner as characterized by native PAGE analysis. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and dynamic light scattering (DLS) studies confirmed the shape and size of these amphiphilic DNA nanocages. This hybrid DNA-lipid system exhibited high biocompatibility and bio-stability in a cellular environment (e.g. in HeLa, MCF-7 and KB cells) as confirmed by Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) and fetal bovine serum (FBS) digestion studies. We also found that these amphiphilic DNA nanocages were taken up by cells via a clathrin-mediated endocytosis pathway. Importantly, they selectively targeted and localized in mitochondria as compared to the unmodified DNA nanocages. To be a smart nanocarrier, we have tried to load different cargos such as 5 nm gold nanoparticles (AuNPs), thrombin proteins and molecular anticancer drugs onto the DNA nanocages via different mechanisms. Unfortunately, the encapsulation efficiency of AuNPs and proteins inside the cavity of the cage is quite low. Interestingly, we found that doxorubicin can efficiently load onto the fully doubled stranded DNA nanostructures via intercalation mechanism. The structural integrity of nanostructures was still retained after drug loading. We found that about 70 % of Dox was intercalated into self-assembled DNA nanocages while the loading efficiency of drug onto the unstructured dsDNA was found to be ~ 48 % lower. These lipid-functionalized DNA nanostructures are found to act as smart nanocarrier to carry the doxorubicin to the specific sub-cellular organelle mitochondria and induce enhanced cell death in MCF-7 cells even at low concentrations of drugs, in compared to the free doxorubicin in cytoplasm or doxorubicin carried to lysosomes. Our findings not only point to the facile design and assembly of the biocompatible 3D DNA nanostructures as an efficient drug nanocarrier and delivery vehicle for drug delivery to a specific intracellular organelle, but also suggest its immense potential for the treatment of specific organelle-related diseases. We strongly believe that we have successfully addressed the objectives 1, 2 and 3 in this funded project. The results of the use of DNA nanocages as nanocarriers for specific organelle delivery has been published in Small: Volume 12, Issue 6, Pages 770-781. To explore the feasibility of remote opening of the DNA nanostructures, we investigated the use of 4-nitro-4’-phenyoxy-1,1’-biphenyl (4-NB) molecules as a control agent to precisely tune the conformation of the 3D DNA nanostructures. We successfully generate a tubular 3D DNA nanostructure which is responsive to two-photon excitation at 800 nm fs laser pulses. We covalently introduced the 4-nitro-4’-phenyoxy-1,1’-biphenyl molecules into the DNA strands along the nanotube architecture. A modular approach was used to assemble the triangular-shaped DNA nanotubes which consisted of the two-photon photolabile molecules, 20 thymine nucleobases as a hairpin together with a pair of Cy3 fluorophore and an Ionwa Black FQ quencher. The photocleavable ability of the 4-NB modified DNA strands was confirmed by denaturing polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (PAGE), high resolution mass spectroscopy and HPLC analysis. According to the HPLC data, a two-photon photolysis of 4-NB along the DNA nanotubes was confirmed by a graph of log-(decreased peak area) versus log-(laser power) with a slope of close to 2. To visually investigate the opening of these DNA nanotubes under near infrared (NIR) excitation, TEM, confocal fluorescence microscopy and fluorescence enhancement studies were performed accordingly. These studies clearly showed the structural change of the irradiated DNA nanotubes from linear to bending features with some degree of curvature. The Cy3 fluorescence intensity was also dramatically restored/increased as a function of irradiation time. We strongly believe that the remote opening of the DNA nanostructures could be precisely controlled by light. Subsequently, we investigated the conformational change of the tubular 3D nanostructures in HeLa cells after light irradiation. We do observe the enhancement of Cy3 probes as a function of irradiation time. This is highly due to the opening of the cavity of the structures and increase in the distance between the quenchers and fluorescence probes. Since the encapsulation efficiency of the cargos inside the DNA nanostructures is quite low, we cannot obtained an obvious signals of the controlled release of trapped cargos in responses to the light irradiation. On the other hand, we found that the DNA nanocages could gradually release the loaded anticancer drugs to trigger the cell apoptosis due to the enzymatic degradation of the self-assembled DNA nanostructures in the cellular environment. We believe that we have addressed the objective 4 in this funded project. Some of the photo-responsive results has been published in Small: Volume 11, Issue 33, Pages 4090-4096 and Small: Volume 13, Issue 7, Pages 1602881.

21300314.label: Major findings and research outcome
21300314.value: We have demonstrated the first example of the use of amphiphilic DNA nanostructures for mitochondrial delivery of therapeutic agents without the need for ancillary transfection agents or physical delivery platforms. Functionalization of DNA nanocages with lipophilic molecules can drastically alter its cellular behaviors in terms of bio-stability and intracellular localization. Importantly, this hybrid system can, in fact, be loaded with molecular cargos/drugs via different loading mechanisms. Drug molecules delivered to mitochondria indeed induced significant cytotoxicity and cell death in MCF-7 cells compared with drug delivery to the lysosome. The finding has been published in Small: Volume 12, Issue 6, Pages 770-781. Additionally, we also demonstrated the first example of self-assembled tubular DNA nanoassembly responsive to two-photon excitation at 800 nm fs laser pulses. Two-photon photocleavable 4-nitro-4’-phenoxy-1,1’-biphenyl molecules were simply introduced longitudinally along the nanotube. Under NIR excitation, the structural change of DNA structures from linear to bending feature together with expanding the cavities along the nanotubes were clearly revealed by various microscopic studies as well as fluorescence measurements. These results indicated that incorporation of two-photon photo-cleavable moieties into DNA strands could induce photon-controllability of three-dimensional structure effectively. Additionally, these newly designed structures offered an enhanced resistance towards nucleases together with robust cellular uptake and low cytotoxicity in live cells. The finding has been published in Small: Volume 11, Issue 33, Pages 4090-4096 and Small: Volume 13, Issue 7, Pages 1602881.

21300314.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21300314.value: We believed that this work provides a novel means of designing self-assembled DNA nanocarriers for intracellular organelle targeting and specific organelle-related therapy. Additionally, this work also provides a strong basis of developing photon-responsive DNA nanostructures and offers an innovated, safe and clean strategy for active control of their conformational changes. Consequently, two-photon-regulated, shape-changing DNA nanostructures would contribute to applications in biology, particularly in remote control of cargo release from DNA nanocarriers. Collaboration has been developed between HK and France. Our group has started collaborated with Prof. Bolze at University of Strasbourg in France since 2014. We have worked close together to apply funding and published scientific research papers in the past few years. For example, 1. Z. Dai, D. Y. Tam, H. Xu, M. S. Chan, L. S. Liu, F, Bolze*, X. H. 21300314.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21300314.value: Self-assembled DNA nanostructures have defined shapes and are capable of targeted transportation of cargo and subsequent triggered release. As yet, cellular uptake of DNA assemblies through endocytic pathway faces a major shortcoming due to localization inside acidic organelles, severely limiting the efficacy of intracellular targeting. Target-specific DNA nano-objects play important role in carrying and delivering a drug to the targeted cells for disease treatment. In this project, we designed and assembled novel multifunctional 3D DNA nanocages consisting of fluorescent markers for bio-imaging, targeting agents for cancer cells recognition as well as sub-cellular organelles localization, a well-designed cavity for selective encapsulation of guests and photoresponsive molecules for opening of cavity in response to light. We found that a low cytotoxicity, high uptake efficiency and high stability of 3D DNA nanostrcutures are resulted. The selective encapsulation of different molecular cargos, as well as the possibility of trigger-release of cargo in specific organelles under multi-photon laser light excitation are also explored. We believe these findings strongly envision that multifunctional DNA nano-object will become one of the most intelligent nano-tool for in vitro or in vivo biomedical studies in respect to targeted drug delivery and cancer therapy.

21300714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21300714.value: Lysine acetylation is one of the most prevalent post-translational modifications and closely linked to the regulation of many vital cellular functions. Bromodomains (BRDs) have been identified as protein modules that can interact specifically with acetylated lysine residues in proteins. In recent years, BRDs have emerged as a group of increasingly important therapeutic targets due to their prominent roles in many diseases, such as cancer and neurological diseases. In our proposal, we seek to develop a novel combinatorial peptide microarray approach to profile the substrate specificities of BRDs. Current researches on BRDs have been generally focusing on the interactions between BRDs and histones. The interactions between BRDs and other acetylated proteins, however, are still poorly understood. By integrating combinatorial library synthesis and microarray strategy, we will gain a comprehensive understanding of how BRDs specifically recognize their substrates. The in-depth knowledge of BRD recognition and specificity will be highly useful for elucidating the roles of BRDs and protein acetylation in various cellular processes. JQ-1 and I-BET, two potent BRD4 inhibitors with excellent anti-tumor activity, were successfully discovered through random screenings. However, until now very few effective inhibitors targeting other therapeutically important BRDs have emerged. In this proposal, we will employ the combinatorial peptide microarray approach to facilitate the development of BRD inhibitors. Through the study, we will establish important groundwork for extensive and comprehensive comparison of binding preferences among different BRDs. The results will allow us to identify potent and selective peptide binders of cancer-relevant BRDs. The peptide hits identified in our study are expected to exhibit inhibitory activity against target BRDs. The inhibitory activity will be further validated with BRD inhibition assays. Subsequently, the peptides will be tested with anti-proliferation assays against various cancer cell lines. With this proposed methodology, we will take a rational and systematic approach to facilitate the development of BRD inhibitors, which will ultimately lead us to discover effective anti-cancer agents. The proposed research will generate valuable data and information on BRD substrate specificity. It will lead to further functional annotation of BRDs and rational design of selective and potent BRD inhibitors. The current research team has extensive experience in peptide chemistry, microarray technology, proteomics and cancer biology. We are confident that the research deliverables can be duly achieved and that the proposed study will contribute immensely to the advancement of BRD research. 蛋白质的乙酰化修饰与调节细胞的重要生物功能息息相关，如染色质重组、DNA 损伤、以及细胞周期的调控。Bromodomain是迄今为止唯一发现可特异性识别乙酰化赖氨酸残基的蛋白质结构域。近年来，由于Bromodomain在许多疾病中发挥着显著的作用，它们已成为重要的生物靶标。 在此项研究中，我们致力于开发一项新的组合多肽芯片技术，用于Bromodomain多肽底物的表征。通过组合化学与芯片技术的有机结合，我们将系统地剖析Bromodomain与多肽底物的相互作用，我们相信这一研究对于进一步诠释Bromodomain的生物功能具有重要的科学意义。 虽然JQ-1和IBET已被成功鉴定为BRD4的强效抑制剂并且具有抗肿瘤活性，但这两个小分子均在随机筛选的过程中获得，另一方面，针对其它Bromodomain的有效抑制剂的报道依然甚少。在这项研究中，我们将利用组合多肽芯片技术来发展基于多肽的Bromodomain抑制剂，通过详尽并系统地比较不同Bromodomain的底物选择性，我们将会鉴定出特定Bromodomain的强效且兼具选择性的多肽，并通过进一步测试来检验这些多肽是否能够抑制Bromodomain以及癌细胞生长。我们研究团队在多肽化学、芯片技术、蛋白质组学及癌症生物学方面有着丰富的经验，我们将如期完成本课题，我们相信该项课题将推动Bromodomain研究领域的进一步发展。

21300714.label: Realisation of objectives
21300714.value: All the projects have been accomplished by the completion date. Specifically, we have developed a new microarray immobilization method that allows immobilization of thiol-containing peptides without further chemical modification. We have also fabricated a combinatorial peptide array to investigate the substrate binding preferences of various bromodomains. Through our microarray analysis, a number of new and potent peptide binders were identified. Subsequently the interactions of these peptides and bromodomains were verified with isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments. Commercial bromodomain inhibition assays were performed and revealed several peptides with good inhibition potency. Furthermore, we designed a chemical probe that can be used to label and identify bromodomain in complex cellular environments. The probe can be used to differentiate bromodomains and sirtuins. Through proximity-induced protein conjugation chemistry, we achieved selective labeling of BRD4(1), which contains a unique cysteine residue at the binding site. The chemical probe we have developed can find applications in imaging BRD4(1) in living cells.

21300714.value: Through this work, we have developed a number of useful chemical tools that can help drive the development and advancement of the bromodomain field. An acetylated peptide microarray has been successfully fabricated and used to screen various bromodomains. The study has presented a more comprehensive picture of the binding preferences across the bromodomain family. Through the experimental results, we also discovered a number of peptide binders of bromodomains, which can serve as excellent starting templates for drug design and development. A total of 6 scientific papers have been published during the project period. I was invited to a number of international conferences to present the research work. In addition, 3 PhD students and 3 undergraduate students were trained. One of the undergraduate students won the “Best Oral Presentation” for the summer research scholarship.

21400114.value: 傳統上，受害和犯罪從理論或實際上都是受到獨立處理的。但是近來的研究報告證實受害者和罪犯之間有顯著的共通點，促使學者針對兩種現象之間的關係作出研究。值得注意的是，這類研究大多數是在美國進行的，主要是在北美，而亞洲方面就只提供了有限的數據。為了針對這個未被開發的領域，本研究目的是找出香港青少年「受害」和「犯罪」間的共通點。這研究會從傳統學齡、高風險和曾被判罪(曾因犯罪行為而被定罪)3個組別中抽取1,200名13-20歲的青少年作為樣本。本研究會採用定量和定性的方法來評估樣本的「受害」與「犯罪」率，以建立受害和犯罪中不同的風險及保護因素，及調查兩者的關係。擬議中的研究不但可提供更多受害和犯罪情況的理解，還可以為社會服務機構提供建議去針對這些現象以減低兩者的水平。

21400114.label: Realisation of objectives
21400114.value: Using a sample of 1,305 participants (i.e., traditional school-aged, at-risk, and adjudicated youth who aged between 13 and 20 years, a two-phase mixed-method research design was adopted to examine the proposed four research objectives. Using both quantitative and qualitative methods, Objective 1-3 were addressed through statistical analyses. Objective 4 was derived based on data-driven analyses of Objective 1-3. To sum, all proposed project objectives have been achieved.

21400114.label: Major findings and research outcome
21400114.value: 1. Out of 1,305 participants (i.e., 67.3% traditional school-aged, 21.5% at-risk, and 7.6% adjudicated), 53.6% was nonvictim-nonoffenders (N = 700; 67.3% traditional school-aged, 25.1% at-risk, and 7.6% adjudicated), 2.1% was victims (N = 28; 57.1% traditional school-aged, 28.6% at-risk, and 14.3% adjudicated), 37.1% was offenders (N = 484; 41.5% traditional school-aged, 41.3% at-risk, and 17.1% adjudicated), and 7.1% was victim-offenders (N = 93; 20.4% traditional school-aged, 34.4% at-risk, and 45.2% adjudicated). 2. Pertaining to the victim-offender overlap phenomenon, the longitudinal correlational nature between Phase 1 and Phase 2 (i.e., at least 6 months in between) was examined among randomly selected pool of at-risk and adjudicated participants. Among at-risk youth who reported to be victim-offenders in Phase 1 (N = 39), there was no victim-offenders found in Phase 2. Although 32 adjudicated youth were reported to be victim-offenders in Phase 1, only 3 victim-offenders were noted in this group of youth in Phase 2. 3. The level of self-control was found to be a significant risk and protective factor that distinguish different groups of youth (i.e., nonvictim-nonoffenders, victims only, offenders only, and victim-offenders). Particularly for the group of victim-offenders, the traits of impulsivity, risk-seeking, preference for physical activities, self-centeredness, and temperament were noted to be significant protective factors from offending behavior. Major findings derived from this project will be drafted in a number of journal manuscripts and book chapters for submission for publication.

21400114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21400114.value: The general trend in victim-offender overlap examined in this project can be further developed into projects that explore the prevalence and nature of this phenomenon for other specific offenses. For instance, the overlap between sexual victimization and sexually deviant behaviour is a worthy project. This can be an important research topic from a public health perspective, as criminal justice systems around the world face the obstacles of prison overcrowding and the need to streamline resources to address offender recidivism. This proposed research project was submitted for GRF 2017/18 and 2018/19, but was unsuccessful on both applications. It is currently funded internally by CityU.

21400114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21400114.value: Traditionally, victimisation and offending have been treated separately, both in theory and in practice. However, recent research studies have demonstrated that there is significant overlap between victims and offenders, prompting new calls for research that addresses the link between these two phenomena. Notably, most victim-offender overlap studies are conducted in North America, primarily in the US, and limited data about this phenomenon in Asia are available. To address this unexplored area, this study aims to examine the overlap between victimisation and offending among Chinese youth in Hong Kong. This study will sample 1,200 youth aged between 13 and 20, drawn from the traditional school-aged, at-risk, and adjudicated (under court jurisdiction for having engaged in delinquent behaviour) youth groups. Using both quantitative and qualitative methods, this study will assess victimization and offending rates among these youth, establish different risk and protective factors for victimisation and offending, and investigate the relationship between victimisation and offending. The proposed study is important in not only to provide a better understanding of both victimisation and offending, but also to offer suggestions to help social services to target these phenomena better and to reduce levels of both.

21400614.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21400614.value: 中國兒童的詞語學習：其機制和閱讀經驗及閱讀能力的影響

21400614.label: Project Objectives
21400614.value: To study the underlying mechanisms of Chinese word learning in children by using an innovative experimental paradigm. To examine the role of prior linguistic knowledge in Chinese word learning. To examine the influence of children’s sensitivity to print-sound-meaning mapping regularities and their ability to utilize an analytic approach in Chinese word learning. To investigate the influence of reading experience and ability on word learning and validate a phase model of Chinese word learning.
rows: To study the underlying mechanisms of Chinese word learning in children by using an innovative experimental paradigm.
To examine the role of prior linguistic knowledge in Chinese word learning.
To examine the influence of children’s sensitivity to print-sound-meaning mapping regularities and their ability to utilize an analytic approach in Chinese word learning.
To investigate the influence of reading experience and ability on word learning and validate a phase model of Chinese word learning.

21400614.label: Realisation of objectives
21400614.value: The four objectives for this project have been achieved satisfactorily. Concerning objective one, our team have developed an associative learning paradigm which allows the study of the underlying mechanisms of Chinese word learning. This paradigm includes a multi-phase experimental procedure, and sets of pseudoword and invented word items created in this project. These unique sets of novel pseudoword and invented word items not only support the manipulation of the degree of resemblance to Chinese words but also provide more precise control over participants’ prior exposure to the word items compared to the existing word items used in past research. They are important to examine learning processes that occur when the readers encounter words which they have not encountered before. This associative learning paradigm has differentiated children with higher or lower ability in learning new word items in this project. Concerning objectives two and three, 167 children (65 kindergarteners and 102 primary graders) were individually administered tasks of associative learning, nonverbal reasoning, reading-related cognitive skills and Chinese word reading. The results showed that associative learning ability significantly predicted Chinese word reading, after controlling for phonological memory and rapid automatized naming. Also, facilitative effect induced by pre-exposure to linguistic knowledge (i.e., the phonological and semantic forms of word items) was found for proficient readers, indicating the prominent role of linguistic knowledge in word learning. In addition, regularity effect (i.e., better performance in learning word items with print-sound-meaning mapping regularities compared to those without these regularities) was observed in primary school children. It has suggested that children are sensitive to print-sound-meaning mapping regularities and are able to utilize an analytic approach in Chinese word learning. Concerning objective four, this study employed a cross-sectional design including participants with different levels of reading experience and ability. This study has showed that associative learning is important to Chinese word reading in both beginning and proficient readers, after controlling for phonological memory and rapid automatized naming. However, a developmental trend in terms of the facilitative effect of linguistic knowledge on word learning was observed, such that no facilitative effect of pre-exposure to linguistic knowledge was observed in the beginning readers, but a significant facilitative effect was observed in the proficient readers. These findings have provided valuable insights into the development of Chinese word knowledge.

21400614.label: Major findings and research outcome
21400614.value: A number of important findings, leading to several journal publications and conference papers, have been obtained from this project. Major findings and research outcomes are summarized below. Firstly, we developed tests for the study of the underlying mechanisms of Chinese word learning. The associative learning tests with unique sets of novel pseudoword and invented word items provided more precise control over participants’ prior exposure to the word items as well as supported the manipulation of the degree of resemblance to Chinese word. Secondly, factors fundamental to children’s Chinese word learning have been identified. Associative learning ability significantly predicted Chinese word reading, even after controlling for important reading-related cognitive skills, including phonological memory and rapid automatized naming. Also, individual variations in Chinese reading ability were observed in Chinese kindergarteners and primary graders, and learning environment contributed to these variations. (*Chow, 2018; *Chow, Ho, Wong, Waye & Zheng, 2017; see Part C, items 8.1 and 8.2). Thirdly, reading experience and ability influences Chinese children’s reading development (*Chow, 2018; *Chow, Hui, & Chui, 2018; see Part C, items 8.1 and 8.3). For example, facilitative effect of pre-exposure to linguistic knowledge was observed for proficient readers but not in beginning readers. Fourthly, regularity effect (i.e., better performance in learning word items with print-sound-meaning mapping regularities compared to those without these regularities) was found in primary school children. The result has suggested that primary school children are sensitive to print-sound-meaning mapping regularities and are able to utilize an analytic approach in Chinese word learning (*Chow, 2015; *Chow & Wong, 2015). Lastly, a project website was developed to bring our findings to the attention of educators and parents (http://www.cityu.edu.hk/ss_psy/ecs/index.html). Overall, this project has unraveled the underlying mechanisms of Chinese word learning. Our findings have suggested ways to optimize learning of Chinese words in learners with different levels of reading experience.

21400614.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21400614.value: Findings and outcomes of this project have laid an important ground for development of future research on reading development in children. The current project has provided empirical evidence on the important roles of linguistic and orthographic knowledge in word learning. While more is known about word-level processing, much remains unknown regarding the linguistic and cognitive underpinnings of reading comprehension and the contribution of word-level processing to comprehension of text. These research ideas were developed into grant proposals and have been examined in a CityU Strategic Research Grant project and a GRF project funded in the 2016-17 exercise. Also, this project has indicated interesting results on word learning in Chinese, a script with relatively arbitrary print-sound mappings than alphabetic scripts. Future research can examine if the findings are language-specific or language-universal by comparing the roles of linguistic and orthographic knowledge in word learning in different languages.

21400614.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21400614.value: Chinese children expend a great amount of effort acquiring thousands of written words. Many of them learn Chinese words through repetitive hand-copying and rote memorization. Previous studies of Chinese reading development have recorded the growth of word knowledge across time but the underlying mechanisms of word learning remains unclear. In our study, we examined if children were able to utilize knowledge in the Chinese language in learning new words, and what knowledge was prominent to Chinese word learning. Also, we investigated the extent to which reading experience and ability influenced word learning. The findings of this study have unraveled the underlying mechanisms of Chinese word learning and are useful for building comprehensive models of Chinese word learning. Also, the findings have offered important insights into the effective methods for facilitating Chinese reading acquisition, and the ways to optimize learning of Chinese words in learners with different levels of reading experience.

21401114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21401114.value: 1948年，人權在聯合國的世界人權宣言所載的基本的權利，言論自由，包括“持有主張而不受干涉的尋求，接受和通過任何媒介傳遞信息和思想，並不分國界的。”這本來是無法預測的，65年前，在何種程度上的互聯網將改變人們的能力“尋求，接受和傳遞信息。”雖然這種轉變所帶來的好處（商業，創意，溝通）一直廣闊，它們是由不斷增加的企圖限制免費使用這一寶貴資源的平行。 香港迄今避免了許多言論在中國其他地方執行的自由的限制，但在網上的自由和隱私特區的威脅正在增加。自2010年以來，香港的新聞自由指數下跌24地方58次，與他指出：“逮捕，毆打和騷擾惡化工作條件，記者以前沒有見過的程度”（無國界記者，2012）的作者。同樣，在2012年的調查中，近90％的受訪新聞工作者認為，新聞自由已經惡化，在過去七年，近36％的人承認自我審查（香港記者協會，2012）。 雖然自由，維護軟件一直是主要的研究領域中的計算機和信息科學，人們越來越認識到，研究人員創建的工具都沒有的普通用戶。一項研究報告通過審查人口不到3％使用工具，說明在“是否這些工具滿足用戶的安全需求的巨大混亂的問題...我們有什麼特殊的安全屬性的用戶正在尋找的了解太少了”（ Naone，2010）。另外注意的是，這些故障往往是由於缺乏重視的具體需求和技能的用戶，並認為“有必要使安全管理，即使未經訓練的用戶已成為重要的”（香港，Cranor，與Sadeh，2009）。 為了解決這個日益嚴重的問題，本研究採用參與式行動研究（PAR）的方法，旨在通過讓他們參與討論，評估，規劃，行動，反映在共享問題進行了系統的過程中採取的工具，用戶的需求的系統帳戶（奧布賴恩，2001;羅德里格斯，2008年）。作為這個項目的前期工作中，筆者已經作出與有關互聯網自由的問題，包括獨立的媒體機構，創客，以及本地藝術/文化組織一些地方組織的接觸。因此，這項研究代表了互聯網工具在香港的第一個PAR為基礎的調查中，由於其作為兩個部分，除了中國之外的其他位置，獨特的語言環境。 利用考績法，地方利益相關者（新聞記者，社會活動家，企業家）將在回答下列問題方面發揮積極作用：1）什麼是希望保護他們的在線自由，用戶當前的最佳實踐？ 2）如何有現有的工具無法滿足用戶的需求？ 3）可以適應或創造來填補這些差距是什麼工具？ 4）試問，這樣的資源得到更好的服務於像香港這樣多元化的人群？ 5）什麼概括可以從香港的情況下，整個國際社會如何界定呢？該研究結果將在雜誌上的文章和會議演講報告，以及為參加者和一般公眾的在線存檔。 [Note: provisional (automatic) translation]

21401114.label: Realisation of objectives
21401114.value: We have initiated ongoing discussions with journalists, activists, and technologists at a number of local mainstream and independent media organisations on the topic of Internet freedom in Hong Kong, specifically as it relates to digital technology and software tools. These organisations include TVB Pearl, InMediaHK, and the Hong Kong Free Press, as well as 2 additional groups who have participated on the condition of anonymity. Due to decreasing press freedom in Hong Hong (Hong Kong is currently ranked 69 in the 2016 World Press Freedom Index, just below Bosnia-Herzegovina), it has proven more difficult than expected to organize recurring discussions. Thus, rather than large group meetings, we have focused our efforts on visits to the relevant organisations and on meetings with the technology managers who select the systems in use and make recommendations to journalists concerning privacy-preserving technologies. Based on concerns raised in these meetings, we have focused our development attention on a specific software tool, AdNauseam, to addresses privacy in the context of online surveillance . This tool has now been released and has garnered over 320,000 downloads on Firefox alone. This work has been described in a peer-reviewed journal article (APRJA), in conference proceedings (PETS) and in a forthcoming book chapter from Sage (Big Data and Society), and has been presented at a number of international conferences including Hope, Wikitopia, and Transmediale. Additionally, it has garnered significant media attention online, in a local TV segment on TVB Pearl, and in a radio program on National Public Radio in Canada. The work in this grant has led to a subsequent GRF grant entitled 'AdNauseam: Reclaiming User Privacy from Advertising Surveillance', project #11669616.

21401214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21401214.value: Despite its effectiveness in prevention, the influenza vaccination coverage in Hong Kong has remained around 14% in the past few years, much lower than the 30% threshold proportion required for building up basic herd immunity. The major barriers to adoption behaviors have been identified by previous studies, including fear of side effects, uncertainty about vaccines’ efficacy, and misconceptions about the vaccination (Chor, Ngai, Goggins, Wong, & Wong, 2009). These barriers lie not merely in lack of health knowledge or literacy; they are deeply rooted in particular socio-cultural values about human body and disease prevention. On the other hand, current health promotion in Hong Kong fails to address the public’s concerns for influenza vaccination (Jiang & Gong, 2013). Specially, the vaccination promotion messages are poorly designed, loosely targeted and didactically enacted. To these ends, this proposal introduces narrative persuasion as an effective tool for promoting influenza vaccine uptakes in Hong Kong. For a variety of reasons narratives are more effective than statistical information or advocacy messages in motivating behavioral changes (Slater, 2002). In particular, it has been shown that narratives can effectively model recommended behaviors, address knowledge-compliance gap, attenuate psychological reactance, and activate transportation of subjective experience (Kreuter et al., 2007). In particular, this project employs a culture-centric approach in developing influenza vaccination narratives. This approach prioritizes the target audiences’ conceptualization of vaccination and uses cultural codes to invoke personal meanings and motivate behavior changes. First, the project plans to conduct formative research with in-depth, dialogic interviews with high-risk individuals, aiming to capture shared experiences and stories, create prototypical narratives, and develop narrative interventions. Second, two experiments will be conducted to examine the effectiveness of narratives in influenza vaccination promotion. The first experiment compares the effectiveness of narrative and didactic communication via a randomized controlled trial. The second experiment seeks to establish the ecological validity of narrative persuasion in naturalistic settings via a field experiment. The findings are expected to have important practical and theoretical contributions. If supported by the empirical data, the proposed narrative approach will have practical implications for designing future campaigns to promote vaccination and other health behaviors. Theoretically, the project will enrich our understanding of the relationships among narrative persuasion, cultural embeddedness, and message processing in general. 雖然對於預防流感頗為有效，流感疫苗在香港並未被廣泛接受。過去幾年僅14%的市民曾接種疫苗，而建立群體免疫力需要至少三成人口接種。研究表明，接受流感疫苗的主要障礙在於對副作用的擔憂，對疫苗有效性的質疑，還有對接種疫苗的誤解等等。這些障礙不僅是由健康知識或者健康素養缺乏造成，更是根植於特定社會文化對人體和疾病防治的理解。另一方面，亦有研究顯示現有香港健康推廣並不能針對公眾對流感疫苗的關注。大部份推廣流感疫苗的健康信息設計不當，沒有針對性，亦流於說教。 基於以上原因，本研究提議敘事式說服可當作一種有效的傳播方式用以促進流感疫苗在香港的推廣。因為多種原因，敘事式手法比統計數據和倡導信息更能激發行為上的改變。敘事式手法能夠有效模擬建議的行為，調試知識和行為之間的差距，減輕逆反心理，並激發於主觀經驗的投射。 特別的，本研究從以文化為中心來敘述並推廣流感疫苗。這種方法將受眾對疫苗接種的理解放在第一位，並使用文化符碼來激發接種對於人們的意義和激勵行為的改變。首先，研究者將對流感高危人群進行深度訪問，以獲取共同的經歷和故事，創造對原型的敘述，並制定健康干預方案。然後研究者通過兩個實驗來檢測敘述式說服是否比倡導式推廣更有效。其中，第一個實驗通過一個隨機對照實驗來比較敘述式和倡導式傳播的效果；而第二個實驗則通過田間試驗在自然設置中檢測敘事式說服的生態效度。 研究結果將有重要的實踐意義和理論貢獻。如果敘事式說服的效果獲得數據的支持，這一方法可被用於推廣疫苗接種和其他健康行為。從理論上講，本研究將加深我們對敘事式說服，文化嵌入性，和信息處理的三者之間關係的理解。

21401214.label: Realisation of objectives
21401214.value: First, the objective of designing culturally grounded health messages for promoting influenza vaccination acceptance in Hong Kong has been achieved. According to narrative persuasion theory, to design authentic narratives that effectively persuade an audience, the first step is to incorporate the targets’ specific and detailed understanding of the health problem. My team therefore conducted in-depth interviews with 40 high-risk individuals (or household decision makers) about their experience and beliefs about influenza and vaccination. The analysis based on the in-depth interview generated several themes for preventing influenza in the local contexts, including misperception about the viral nature of influenza, keeping on postponing vaccination uptake, and easily influenced by peer opinion. These themes were used to develop health messages in public service announcement (PSA) formats. Cultural codes (e.g., living environment, daily routines) and useful quotes identified from the interviews were also incorporated into the message design. To privilege authenticity, the narrative PSA was featured with a typical Hong Kong family - a three-generation family living in a public housing sector with both grandma and grandson being vulnerable targets. The mother was portrayed as the main character who was busy with taking care of both vulnerable targets. The PSA tried to model several relating negative events in influenza prevention, including misperceptions about influenza and vaccination, over-reliance on peer opinion, failure to spot symptoms and outbreak, and etc. The main character received different information from several media and interpersonal channels and she was indecisive in taking the grandma and grandson for vaccination. The objective of experimentally examining the effectiveness of culture-centric narratives in comparison to the didactic approach in promoting seasonal influenza vaccination has also been achieved. The experiment 1 used randomized trials to compare the persuasive effects of narrative, didactic and control conditions on a sample of 440 high-risk individuals and their family members. It should be noted that in the experiment administration I reduced the compensation to $50 HKD to match with the normal level of compensation for a 20-minute online survey. The narrative condition used the narrative PSA designed based on in-depth interviews and the didactic condition used an information-based PSA that contained equivalent information. No message exposure was used in the control condition whereas the participants directly rated their health beliefs and health behaviors. The results provided partial support for two of my hypotheses. While both narrative approach and didactic approach were effective in increasing threat perceptions, efficacy beliefs and behavioral intention, the difference between the two approaches was only found for threat perceptions. Although not proposed in the research objectives, the project also sought for obtaining evidence outside of the laboratory setting by using a naturalistic design to compare the effectiveness of narrative and didactic approaches. However, as reported in the mid-term project report, my team encountered difficulty in obtaining consent to launch the two pieces of PSAs in public screens (e.g., LCD display in hospitals) including the campus clinic at City University of Hong Kong. We instead switched to an alternative approach by organizing review panels in public venues such as community centers and nursing homes. We displayed the PSAs using our own devices and recruit 126 participants (14 review panels). The research design was a simplified version of the first randomized trials, and the results provided qualitative support for the findings from the first experiment. A third objective of the investigation is to explore the role of health literacy in narrative persuasion and to examine the variability of persuasive effects of culture-centric narrative messages individuals with different levels of health literacy. As expected, health literacy moderated the effects of narrative persuasion by demonstrating greater effects on individuals with lower literacy. This finding pinpointed the necessity of incorporating narrative strategies for message design in health promotion targeted at groups with low health literacy.
