27401114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27401114.value: A Wiki-based learning environment (WBLE) is an academic environment in which Wikis are used to facilitate collaborative learning. WBLEs are widely used in various disciplines and education contexts and, in recent years, have been adopted in primary and secondary schools. However, the further adoption and effective use of WBLEs is limited by the extent to which teachers can monitor and assess learning processes in WBLEs in a timely and effective manner. WBLEs are a rich source of different types of information about learners and products, but the sheer amount of data is too overwhelming for teachers to process and use. To realize WBLEs’ pedagogical potential, teachers must have the abilities to efficiently conduct formative and summative assessment of learning for both student groups and individuals. To date, only a few studies have investigated automated assessment in WBLEs and most of them focus on tertiary level education. By exploiting WBLE data using automatic techniques guided by collaborative learning theories, this project aims to design and develop an automated framework and tool for analyzing and assessing learning in WBLEs, and so to improve our understanding of how WBLEs and related automated assessment tools can be used to improve learning in primary and secondary schools. The majority of schools in Hong Kong use Chinese as the Medium of Instruction (CMI), yet there is virtually no research on the automatic analysis or assessment of WBLEs with Chinese content. This project addresses this gap in the knowledge by situating its research entirely in the context of local schools in Hong Kong. First, based upon WBLE data collected from local CMI schools, automated analytic approaches will be developed and evaluated, with Chinese language processing techniques being applied to Wiki pages and student comments therein. Second, teachers in local CMI schools will be invited to participate in the design of an assessment tool specifically designed for WBLEs. Third, the tool prototype developed will be evaluated in classrooms in local CMI schools. This project aligns with the themes and scope of Learning Analytics, a new field of study in which data about learners and their contexts are measured, analyzed and reported to understand and optimize learning and learning environments. By developing automated techniques and measures to analyze and assess learning processes in WBLEs, this project will contribute to Learning Analytics by providing a new approach to understanding and improving the use of WBLEs in primary and secondary schools. 基於維基的學習環境（Wiki-Based Learning Environment）是指使用維基（wiki）促進協作學習的學術環境。 WBLE正被廣泛應用於不同學科和不同程度的教育中。在最近幾年更已被小學和中學採用。然而，進一步普及和有效利用WBLE很大程度上取決於教師是否能及時有效地監測和評估WBLE中的學習過程。雖然WBLE提供了學習者和學習成果的豐富信息，但過於龐大的數據量限製了教師處理和使用這些有用信息。為了實現WBLE的教學潛能，教師需要能夠有效地對學生的學習進行形成性和總結性評估。迄今為止，只有少數研究探討了自動化評估WBLE，其中大部分集中在高等教育。通過在合作學習理論指導下對WBLE數據進行自動分析，本項目旨在設計和開發一個自動化框架和工具，來分析和評估WBLE中的學習情況，并在此過程中增進我們對如何使用WBLE及相關自動化的評估工具來提高中小學教育的認識。 香港的大部分中小學校都使用中文授課，但目前幾乎沒有自動分析或評估中文WBLE的研究。本項目將填補這一空白。首先，WBLE數據將會從本港中文授課的學校收集，并將用中國語言處理技術進行分析和評估。其次，本港中文授課學校的教師將被邀請參与WBLE評估工具的設計。第三，所開發的WBLE評估工具的原型將在本港中文授課學校進行評估。 本項目涉及一個新興的研究領域，學習分析。該領域收集与學習者和學習環境有關的數據，對其進行測量，分析和報告，以了解和優化的學習和學習環境。通過用自動技術來分析和評估WBLE中的學習過程，本項目將提供一種新的方法來理解和提高WBLE在中小學教育中的作用，并將進一步推動學習分析領域的研究。

27401114.label: Realisation of objectives
27401114.value: Objective 1: Analytic approaches to assess collaborative learning process in WBLE An analytic framework was developed for automatically assessing student’s learning processes in wiki-based learning environments (WBLE). Multiple analysis methods, including but not only limited to statistical analysis, text analysis, social network analysis and information retrieval, were used to identify possible quantitative, qualitative and originality indicators of students’ collaborative learning process. Student’s contribution and participation in both individual and group levels are assessed and visualized by various statistics of their work on Wiki, including number of revisions, number of words contributed, number of words deleted, etc. Transactivity among students, defined as whether and how much students build on each other’s work, in both individual and group levels are also measured using network analysis measures such as centralities. This aspect of collaborative learning is visualized through view and revision networks formed by students who view and modify each other’s contributions in WBLE. In addition, to reflect students’ learning progress over time, the changes of the statistics (e.g., number of revisions) along the time (named “timeline”) are also included in the quantitative analytic framework. For qualitative indicators, text mining was employed for identifying qualitative indicators of student contributions on WBLE. Specifically, predictive analysis was done to automatically categorize students’ writings into different levels of thinking order (high, mid, low) in an adapted Bloom’s Taxonomy. Teachers’ judgment on the accuracy of categorization is also considered for incrementally training the text categorization model and improving its performance. Based on positive experiment results, thinking orders in student writing have been used as the analytical framework for the automated assessment of the quality of student writing. For detecting plagiarism in students’ work, the originality of their contributions is also assessed. Sentences inputted by students are compared against the search results in search engines, for calculating the similarity between students’ input and information from existing online sources. This results in the count of sentences with plagiarism in both group and individual levels. Objective 2: LA tool for automated monitoring and assessing learning progress in WBLE We designed and developed a learning analytics tool named Wikiglass for automated monitoring of student contributions and progress in WBLE with Chinese content. This tool has been used by two secondary schools and one primary school in Hong Kong and one primary school in mainland China. It supports both computer and mobile (smartphone, tablet) access. Fetching, analyzing and visualizing data from WBLEs, the features and functions of Wikiglass allowed teachers and students at any time and any place to check quantitative, qualitative and originality indicators of students’ collaborative learning process on a WBLE (e.g., PBworks). The design and development of Wikiglass adopted a design-based approach with multiple iterations. In each iteration, suggestions from teachers and students were incorporated into the refinement of the tool. Features designed based on discussions with teachers and students include visualizing the levels of thinking order in student writing (i.e., quality indicators of their contributions) on WBLE, selecting the date range for flexible display of statistics, visualizing student revision networks, and detecting and reporting cases of plagiarism along with the similarity rates on each sentence inputted on a Wiki page. Questionnaire surveys, interviews, log and learning performance analysis have been conducted to evaluate this tool. Objective 3: Improve understanding and use of WBLE and LA tool in schools During the project period, Wikis and Wikiglass have been implemented in two secondary schools and two primary schools in Hong Kong and mainland China in a total of five rounds. Group inquiry-based projects of various academic subjects were involved, including Chinese Language, Mathematics, General Studies, and Liberal Studies, delivered with Chinese as the medium of instruction (CMI). Two Wiki platforms were implemented, namely PBworks and BlueSpice, in both Traditional and Simplified Chinese versions. To improve understanding of how WBLEs and relevant automatic assessment tools can be used to support learning in schools, multiple evaluation methods were adopted, including questionnaire surveys, focus group and individual interviews, system log analysis, and learning performance analysis. Meetings with principals and department heads in the participating schools were also organized to discuss the potentials and effectiveness of using WBLE and LA tools. This project serves as a pioneer in supporting Wiki-based computer-supported collaborative learning with learning analytics in secondary and primary schools from Hong Kong and mainland China. Please refer to Section 6.1 for major evaluation findings.

27401114.label: Major findings and research outcome
27401114.value: A major research outcome is the design, development and school implementation of Wikiglass, a learning analytic tool for monitoring contributions and progress of secondary and primary school students’ collaborative work on Wiki (Hu et al., 2016; Hu et al., 2017a). The design of Wikiglass was based on original research on students’ collaboration on Wikis (Hu et al, 2018), automatic recognition of thinking orders in students’ writings (Hu, 2017; Qiao & Hu, 2018), and students’ perceptions and understanding about plagiarism (Li et al., 2017; Chu, Hu & Ng, in revision). Findings of these studies offered insights to the design of the functions in Wikiglass. More advanced learning analytics techniques were also explored, including probabilistic latent variable model (Qiao & Hu, 2018), networked representations of texts (Qiao & Hu, 2019), and deep neural network models (Qiao & Hu, in revision), which could be integrated into Wikiglass in future projects. Upon implementing WBLEs and Wikiglass in schools, triangulation of various sources of objective (logs, performance scores) and subjective data (survey, interview) were conducted to assess the effectiveness of WBLEs and learning analytics in supporting computer-supported collaborative learning, in the context of secondary and primary schools. Findings showed that Wiki-based learning analytics facilitated collaborative learning in both group and individual levels (Ng et al., 2019; Hu, Ng & Chu, in preparation). Students using Wikiglass showcased more active participation and made contributions of larger quantities and higher writing quality in WBLE than their peers who did not use Wikiglass. Wiki-based learning analytics were also effective in improving the fairness of work distribution among group members. In terms of academic performance, students who used Wikiglass for their group projects demonstrated an improvement in their exam scores, attributable to their Wikiglass-induced motivation in knowledge co-construction in WBLE (Hu, Ng & Jiang, under review). In addition, survey and interview responses showed that students’ attitudes towards digital technology and inquiry-learning improved after using Wikiglass (Ou & Hu, 2019; Hu & Ng, in preparation). Teachers’ interviews also revealed that Wikiglass helped teachers gain a straightforward overview of students’ learning progresses, facilitating them in monitoring and assessing both the learning process and products of students’ work. These findings have been presented and publicized in both international and local venues, including journals, conferences and seminars. Besides academic venues, the PI has been invited to present this project at the Carnegie Foundation for the Advancement of Teaching in California, the U.S.

27401114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27401114.value: This project has shown encouraging findings in using Wiki-based learning analytics to facilitate collaborative learning. More opportunities of implementing Wikiglass in schools can help refine the research in different contexts. In particular, students’ socioeconomic status and their parents’ attitudes towards digital technologies have been shown to be influential in other learning contexts in the literature and thus it is worthwhile exploring whether and how these factors can affect analytics-supported collaborative learning with WBLEs. Another aspect is the plagiarism detection function in Wikiglass. Teachers had different opinions on how this function could be best used. Given the growing importance of information literacy and inadequate attention on plagiarism in primary and secondary education, this function has the potential towards improving teachers’ and students’ understanding of plagiarism and thereby reducing the likelihood of its occurrence. Further funding (such as Quality Education Fund) will be applied to support further school implementation. Learning analytics is a fast-developing field. Advanced learning analytics techniques have been explored in this project and shown the potential of being integrated into Wikiglass. As these techniques may need larger datasets, further research can start from the context of higher education where teaching development grants can be applied.

27401114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27401114.value: This project addresses the knowledge gap on the automatic analysis or assessment of WBLEs with Chinese content, in the context of primary and secondary schools in Hong Kong and mainland China. Based upon WBLE data collected from schools, automated analytic approaches have been designed, developed and evaluated. Multiple data analysis methods were used to identify quantitative, qualitative and originality indicators of students’ collaborative learning. A learning analytic tool named Wikiglass has thereby been developed for automatically analyzing and visualizing such indicators of students’ participation, contribution and transactivity (i.e., building on each other’s work) in WBLE. With the aim to improve the understanding and use of WBLE and LA in schools, Wikis and Wikiglass have been implemented in four secondary and primary schools in Hong Kong and mainland China, in the context of group inquiry-based projects of various academic subjects. Various types of data including survey, interviews, system logs, and performance scores have been collected and analyzed. Evaluation findings showed that Wiki-based learning analytics facilitated collaborative learning in both group and individual levels, in terms of fairness of group work distribution, activeness of participation, quantities and writing quality of contribution, and students’ attitudes towards digital technology and inquiry-based learning.

27401214.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27401214.value: This research aims to study the phenomenon of cross-border retirement out-migration of the soon-to-be-old cohort between ages 45-65, which forms one of the largest demographic groups (31.3%) of the population of Hong Kong. (Census Statistics Department 2011). It has been identified that there is a rise in the number of retirees moving from Hong Kong to the Pearl River Delta (PRD) since the reversion of Hong Kong to Chinese sovereignty in 1997. Many elderly from Hong Kong have chosen to retire to residential communities in the PRD, especially Guangzhou, Dongguan and Zhongshan (Wang 2012). Such communities offer an alternative housing arrangement that is not available in Hong Kong. Greater housing choice, better living environment and family reunion are some of the factors for cross-border retirement. While most of the literature on ageing cities focuses on issues related to the existing elderly cohort, few studies have been conducted on the soon-to-be-old cohort and how their lifestyle affects retirement housing choice such as cross border migration. This research aims to fill a gap in knowledge by establishing a theoretical framework for the study of aging mobility and housing preference in the soon-to-be-old. It adds new knowledge to the field of housing behaviour by addressing questions in the context of cross-border age-relate migration in a multi-state / city region. The study is especially interested in investigating the role that residential clubs (co-ownership models of real estate such as gated communities, condos developments and strata-titles) have on the retirement migration decision. In particular, it tests two hypotheses arising from recent studies (Czefalvay and Webster 2011): H1: by ensuring a reliable supply of security and other local neighbourhood goods, residential clubs, foster a dispersal of middle and upper income urban populations, both into the unserviced urban fringes and into the insecure urban cores. The study also extends this idea, hypothesizing that residential club goods are substitutes for land (H2). This means that people are willing to live in higher densities if they are compensated by more shared goods and services. These ideas are interesting in the context of PRD retirement migration since HK is clearly an exceptionally high density origin for soon-to-be retirees. Even relatively high density peri-urban gated retirement communities in Guandong are likely to look like low density in comparison. This particular configuration of choice has the advantage, of allowing the study to test the land-substitute theory from an unusual perspective. 本項調查旨在研究年齡段位於45-65的即將步入晚年的香港人士退休之後跨境移居的現象，此類人群所佔比例達到全港人口的31.3%，成為比例最大的一群（人口統計部門，2011）。據證實，自從1997年香港回歸中國管轄之後，由香港移居至珠三角地區的退休者人數有所增加。許多來自香港的長者選擇退休後遷居至珠三角的居民區，尤其是廣州，東莞和中山一帶（王，2012）。這些地區能夠提供香港不具備的住宅條件。其中更多的住房選擇，更好的居住環境以及能夠與內地的家庭團聚均成為推動跨境移居的各項因素。然而，大部分的文獻均著重於老齡化城市中現階段的老年人群，而研究中年人群（即將步入晚年）以及他們的生活方式是如何影響退休後的居住計劃（例如跨境移居退休）則非常少。因此，本項調查的目的在於為研究中年人群的人口流動以及其住宅偏好建立起理論架構。通過解決年齡相關的在多個跨境移民退休, 本研究能增加環境設計和住屋要求有學術貢獻。 本研究會著重探究居民住所（聯名業主，房地產模型，例如 房屋發展 ）在居民退休移居決策上所扮演的角色。具體而言，其中出自最近研究的兩個假設會得到驗證：假設通過保證提供可靠的保安管理以及其他當地社區, 居民住所俱樂部來得以實現中產與高產城市人口於服務範圍外的城市邊緣及缺乏安全感的城市中心的分區。該項研究同時亦延伸該設想，假設居民住所俱樂部能夠成為土地的替換者 - 意思是如果人們能夠在高密度居住區得到更多的共享資源和服務，他們會更願意居住在此。 以上觀點在跨境移居珠三角的這個背景下顯得十分有趣因為對於即將退休的人士而言香港很明顯是一個特殊的高密度居住地。對比香港，而在廣東地區，即使一些相對高密度的退休社區均看起來非常的寬敞。本項調查對即將步入晚年的香港人士對生活要求, 房屋需要, 環境設計, 建築角度考慮下建立起理論架構解釋 人口流動以及老人住宅需求及跨境移居退休居住的現象。

27401314.label: Project Objectives
27401314.value: To identify and analyze representations of the constructed nature of family and romance in popular fiction, and examine how certain patterns of romance and family are repeated over the years. To illustrate the importance of popular narratives in the cross-genres of Korean popular culture – popular literature, film, and theater – and show how these narratives are in fact the dominant narratives in modern and contemporary Korea. To introduce the project’s findings to the international academic community currently researching popular culture and popular narrative and their representation of affect. Korean popular fiction shows a pattern of genre development and transformation comparable to the European and Japanese models, i.e., from theater to literature, from literature to film, and from film to literature. However, because of differences in the time of development and the colonial and postcolonial settings, the Korean case of these genre transformations is unique.

27402414.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27402414.value: This project seeks to explain if and why regional organisations (ROs) matter for China’s position on intervention at the UN Security Council (UNSC). There is a general understanding that China is particularly concerned with RO positions regarding intervention: if an RO signals its support for a particular initiative, then China will likely follow suit. Empirically, however, China only selectively follows ROs. Moreover, assertions that ROs matter for China’s position on intervention do not reflect current realities. There is often more than one RO involved in shaping UNSC perceptions of a crisis, and ROs are not unitary actors, with defectors publicly challenging the RO’s official stance. Last, this assertion does not illuminate the causal mechanism: why is it that an RO’s position can impact China’s stance? We assume that there are instrumental factors for China’s interest in RO support. However, ROs could also matter to China for non-instrumental purposes, due to China’s identity and derived image. Image concerns push China to maximize the social praise from its reference group of ROs to confirm China’s belonging with the group. Therefore, to unpack the relationship between ROs and China’s position on intervention at the UNSC, this project uses a controlled comparison of two contemporary cases of intervention at the UNSC: China’s consent to the UN intervention in Libya in 2011, in line with the position of a variety of ROs; and the repeated Chinese vetoes regarding the proposed interventions into Syria in 2012, in opposition to a number of ROs. While twin comparisons from the same time period and region, with similarly interventionist mandates under consideration in response to the same security concerns, these two cases have radically different outcomes on the dependent variable (China’s sensitivity to RO support for intervention). Each case establishes multiple within-case causal process observations, producing a rich amount of data in each mini-case. This project is the first comprehensive, theoretically-informed analysis of ROs for China’s position on intervention at the UNSC. China counterintuitively stands as a pivotal node for UNSC intervention due to its well-known reluctance to support violations of state sovereignty – when China can be convinced to cooperate on intervention, it then sends a signal of firm commitment by the whole of the international society. Therefore, this project not only contributes to academic research on China and its role in global governance during its rise, but also provides policy-relevant insights for policy-makers at the UN and elsewhere. 此項目試圖解釋區域組織能否及如何影響中國對聯合國安全理事會軍事介入的立場。國際間普遍認為中國特別重視區域組織對軍事介入的立場。若果區域組織對特定方案表示支持，中國很可能會和議。然而，實際經驗反映中國只會選擇性地跟隨區域組織的立場。此外，有關區域組織能左右中國就軍事介入的立場的斷言，亦與現實情況不符。在大多數的情況，往往是多於一個區域組織影響聯合國安理會就危機的見解，而區域組織並非單一行為體，成員有可能公開挑戰區域組織的立場。最後，該斷言沒有闡明因果關係：為什麼區域組織的立場能影響中國的取態？我們假設中國支持區域組織的立埸有其工具性因素。可是，鑑於中國的身份認同及負面形象，中國對區域組織的重視也可能有其非工具性的原因。為改善其國際形象，中國遂支持區域組織，以贏取社會最大的讚許，並確立中國與有關區域組織的聯繫。 因此，為拆解區域組織及中國就聯合國安理會軍事介入立場的關係，本項目採用控制比較法，對比兩個聯合國安理會軍事介入的個案。在2011年，中國同意聯合國軍事介入利比亞。此與多個區域組織的立場一致。然而，在2012年，中國卻多次否決有關軍事介入敘利亞的議案。這與多個區域組織的立場相左。這兩個「雙生兒」個案源自同一時期、同一區域、以軍事介入的方式回應安全問題的建議亦相仿，可是此兩個個案的因變數結果(中國對區域組織支持介入的取態)卻截然不同。每個個案都能建立內在的多重因果過程觀察，而每個迷你個案都能產生豐富的數據。 此項目為首個有關區域組織如何影響中國就聯合國軍事介入的立場的全面及以理論為本的辯證分析。眾所周之，中國一直不願意支持違反國家主權的議案。因此中國就聯合國軍事介入國際危機的立場尤其關鍵。中國能被說服與國際社會合作，展示出它的巨大承擔。故此，此項目不僅對有關崛起中的中國及其國際管治的學術研究作出貢獻，它亦為聯合國以致其他地方的決策者提供政策卓見。

27402414.label: Realisation of objectives
27402414.value: I completed my project objectives: publishing three articles in high-impact journals by the project completion date that spanned contemporary cases of intervention with a specific focus on how and why regional organisations matter for China's position on intervention at the UN Security Council. My three articles contributed to the debates on global governance, rising powers and intervention, as can be seen by the citations for my ECS-funded research. 27402414.label: Major findings and research outcome
27402414.value: My three peer-reviewed journal articles speak to how inter-related social factors like status, identity and self-image affect China's approach to intervention. The desire to take actions that comply with status, and related social factors like self-image and identity, can mean that states select policy options even if it means bearing material costs. Status – a state’s “standing or rank in a status community” – can have independent and significant effects for China’s position on intervention. Status can shape China’s response to intervention by way of China’s peer groups. Under certain conditions, China’s peer groups are able to modify China’s preferences, even getting China to permit action. China’s pursuit of status is in part driven by a consequentialist calculation to maximize China’s standing as a group member, but it is also inherently social, with China driven by a logic of appropriateness and a desire to conform to an intersubjective standard of good behavior as a member of the peer group. To this extent, status is causal (i.e. external to actors) and constitutive (i.e. part of who actors are). Status highlights the connection between social and strategic drivers in foreign policy decision-making, as states actions are framed by a normative context. The individual articles all speak to sub-puzzles of this theme: 1. 2016 Courtney J. Fung, “Global South solidarity? China, regional organisations and intervention in the Libyan and Syrian civil wars,” Third World Quarterly 37, no. 1: 33 – 50, establishes that China responds to regional organizations in part because there is a shared 'we-ness' through self-image and identity as a Global South member can help explain China's activities regarding intervention in the Libya and Syria crises 2. 2016 Courtney J. Fung, “Explaining China’s Deployment to UN Peacekeeping Operations,” International Relations of the Asia-Pacific 16, no. 3: 409 – 441, establishes that China's participation in UN peacekeeping is in part shaped by it membership in the Global South and Great Power peer groups, with actions taken partly out of identity and self-image. 3. 2018 Courtney J. Fung, “Separating Intervention From Regime Change? China’s Diplomatic Innovations at the UN Security Council Regarding the Syria Crisis,” The China Quarterly 235: 693 – 712, establishes China's response to the recent Syria crisis at the UN Security Council as a crucial case that breaks from China's recent practice of becoming more permissive regarding intervention. Instead, China worked to separate intervention from foreign-imposed regime change, in part because social pressures/incentives were limited.

In the 2018 - 2019 cycle, I was awarded a GRF grant (#17612518) for my new research agenda investigating China's response to the connections between foreign-imposed regime change and intervention at the UN Security Council. 27402414.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27402414.value: This research project investigated why regional organisations matter to China on questions of intervention at the United Nations. My key finding is that regional organisations matter in part due to inherently social reasons, with China driven by a logic of appropriateness and a desire to conform to an intersubjective standard of good behavior as a member of the peer group (i.e. that China is also a member of the developing world and wants to stand together with these regional groups). The research also found that under certain conditions, these regional groups are able to modify China’s preferences, even getting China to permit intervention action. The research looked at specific contemporary cases of intervention: the use of peacekeeping in Darfur, Sudan in 2007; armed intervention and an International Criminal Court referral for Libya in 2011, and the failed attempts to intervene in Syria since 2011.

27402514.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27402514.value: Comprehension is the goal of reading (Snow, 2002), yet we know little about how to best support it. This lack of knowledge is even more acute for bilingual children, such as Hong Kong Chinese children, who are learning to read Chinese and English in parallel. We will address this issue by examining Chinese and English reading comprehension development. We will determine the contributions made by two critical factors that support the extraction and representation of meaning: prosodic sensitivity and working memory. Prosodic sensitivity is the ability to distinguish rhyming patterns in speech, such as Chinese lexical tones and English lexical stress. Although tones and stress are not explicitly marked in written text, they convey semantic and syntactic information and, therefore, enable readers to parse text into linguistically meaningful units, supporting successful reading comprehension. Prosodic information forms part of the phonological memory representations produced during text processing. Thus, prosodic sensitivity may further support reading comprehension through its relation with memory. Reading comprehension is cognitively demanding and dependent on good working memory, in particular: readers must maintain activation of just-read information whilst processing new information and inhibiting irrelevant information. Working memory may be particularly important for bilingual readers’ comprehension because this group must inhibit the non-target language during reading. There are three goals: 1) to examine the within-language and between-language contribution of prosodic sensitivity to reading comprehension; 2) to evaluate whether working memory and prosodic sensitivity predict independent variance in reading comprehension; and 3) to examine whether poor prosodic sensitivity and working memory can explain the text processing difficulties of children with poor reading comprehension but intact word reading and vocabulary (poor comprehenders). Two hundred second graders will be assessed on comparable measures of Chinese and English prosodic sensitivity, working memory, reading comprehension and other key control measures, annually until 4th grade. Latent growth curve model analysis will be used to examine research goals 1 and 2 and multivariate analysis of variance to examine research goal 3. Critically, we will clarify the roles of prosodic sensitivity and working memory in reading comprehension development in both Chinese and English. Our findings will inform language-general and language-specific components of a theoretical model of reading comprehension and both the diagnoses and intervention of poor comprehenders. They will also inform the design of effective curricula to enable Hong Kong children to become skilled comprehenders in both languages. 理解是閱讀的最終目的[1]，然而我們對如何提高閱讀理解能力知之甚少，尤其是香港的英漢雙語兒童，這方面的研究更是少之又少。因此，本研究以英漢雙語的閱讀理解發展為研究基礎，探討音韻敏銳度以及工作記憶這兩個影響語義提取和再現的關鍵因素，對閱讀理解的作用。 音韻敏銳度指分辨言語中押韻模式的能力，例如分辨漢語的聲調以及英語的輕重音。聲調和輕重音雖然不會在書面文字上顯現，卻能表達語義和語法，讓讀者能把文章解構成一個個表意的語言單位，幫助他們理解篇章內容。大腦處理文字時會產生音韻記憶再現，而音韻的訊息便是組成音韻記憶再現的一部份，因此音韻敏銳度或能通過其與記憶的關係，從而進一步幫助閱讀理解。閱讀理解要求極高的認知能力，尤其需要良好的工作記憶為基礎，具體而言，閱讀者必須讓剛剛閱讀的資料保持活躍，同時亦要處理新的資料，又要抑制無關訊息。雙語讀者在閱讀時需要抑制非目標語言，因此工作記憶對閱讀者的理解尤其重要。 本研究的研究目的包括三個方面：(1) 探討音韻敏銳度如何影響同一語言以及不同語言之間的閱讀理解；(2) 檢驗工作記憶與音韻敏銳度能否預料閱讀理解的個別差異；以及 (3) 探討音韻敏銳度和工作記憶是否導致兒童閱讀理解障礙的主要因素。 本研究將征募二百名小二學童參與英漢雙語音韻敏銳度、工作記憶、閱讀理解的比較研究，每年一次，直至小四。我們將會採用潛變數增長曲線模型以及多變量變異數分析方法。 本研究旨在闡明音韻敏銳度以及工作記憶，在英漢雙語閱讀理解發展中所擔當的角色。研究所得能揭示構成閱讀理解理論模型的一般和特定語言成分，亦有利診斷和治療閱讀理解障礙者，並有助設計有效的課程，以協助香港學童成為英漢雙語閱讀理解的能手。 [1] Snow, C. (2002). Reading for understanding: Toward a research and development program in reading comprehension. Santa Monica, CA: RAND.

27402514.label: Realisation of objectives
27402514.value: With continuous dedication and diligence for the past three years, we have successfully achieved the proposed three objectives, as evidenced by 16 peer-reviewed, high-quality journal articles; 2 conference proceeding papers; and 6 final-year undergraduate dissertations. Specifically, to achieve the aforementioned three objectives, we successfully tested 397 second-graders in phase 1, 266 in phase 2, and 233 in phase 3, all of which resulted in a three-wave longitudinal data of 233 children. Despite the challenge of a high attrition rate in a longitudinal study, we completed the testing of 33 more children than what we had originally proposed. We also created and validated 11 new tasks that can be used to assess Hong Kong Cantonese-English bilingual children's working memory, vocabulary in Chinese and English, prosodic reading, and prosodic sensitivity. As evidenced by the eight journal articles listed below, objective 1 was successfully achieved. We first examined the common mechanism underlying the perception of Cantonese lexical tones and English lexical stress among Cantonese-English bilingual children. Specifically, we have demonstrated the positive prosodic transfer between Cantonese tone and English stress (Tong, Lee, Lee, & Burnham, 2015). Furthermore, we are the first to report that Cantonese L2 listeners of English performed better than native English listeners on stress discrimination, indicating the facilitative effect of Cantonese tone language on English lexical stress discrimination (Choi, Tong, & Samuel, 2019). Additionally, we have shown that tone language experience influenced the effect of musical training on music pitch perception among Cantonese-English speakers (Tong, Choi, & Man, 2018). Beyond the examination of the mechanism of bilingual’s perception of Cantonese lexical tone and English lexical stress, we have systematically evaluated various levels of prosodic sensitivity to word reading and reading comprehension. Specifically, we have demonstrated that Cantonese lexical tone sensitivity uniquely contributed to English word reading (Tong, He, & Deacon, 2017), and to English reading comprehension (Choi, Tong, & Singh, 2017). Furthermore, we evaluated the contribution of prosodic reading (which was indexed by the pitch patterns and pauses) to Chinese L1 and English L2 reading comprehension, and found that pitch patterns, but not pause structure, were significantly associated with English reading comprehension (Tsui, Tong, & Fung, 2016). Additionally, our longitudinal results indicated that early prosodic reading skills predicted later reading comprehension ability both within and across languages (Tong, Tsui, & Fung, 2018). 1. 27402514.label: Major findings and research outcome
27402514.value: The first set of key findings concerns the mechanism that underlies Cantonese lexical tone perception and English stress perception in Hong Kong Cantonese-English bilingual children. We demonstrated that Cantonese-English bilingual children utilized F0 as a primary acoustic cue to process both Cantonese lexical tones and English lexical stress (Choi, Tong et al., 2017; Tong, Lee, Lee, & Burnham, 2015), which indicated the possible interactive processing mechanism for perceiving Cantonese lexical tone and English lexical stress among Cantonese-English bilingual children. These key findings have been published in several internationally well-known journals, including Cognition, Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, PLoS ONE, and Frontier in Psychology. The second set of key findings focuses on within language and cross-language contributions of prosodic sensitivity to reading comprehension among Chinese-English bilingual children. We showed that suprasegmental and segmental phonological skills were essential to the reading comprehension development across L1 Chinese and L2 English in Hong Kong bilingual children (Deng, Choi, & Tong, 2019). Also, by employing a longitudinal design, we demonstrated that Cantonese-English bilingual children’s perception of Cantonese lexical tone uniquely predicted their English word reading (Tong, He, & Deacon, 2017) and reading comprehension (Choi, Tong, & Cain, 2016) even after controlling for other reading-related measures, such as nonverbal IQ and working memory. Moreover, prosodic reading, or the ability to read a passage with expression, was longitudinally related to reading comprehension in both Chinese and English (Tong, Tsui, & Fung, 2018). These results demonstrate that prosodic transfer can occur in two prosodically distinctive languages such as Chinese and English, and that prosodic reading is critical to bilingual children’s reading comprehension development. These findings have been reported in various journal papers published in Memory and Cognition, Journal of Learning Disabilities, and Journal of Experimental Child Psychology. The third key finding is that Cantonese lexical tone awareness and prosodic reading can serve as early indicators for identifying Cantonese-English bilingual children’s reading comprehension difficulties in their L1 Chinese and L2 English (Choi, Tong, & Deacon, 2016; Tong, Tsui, & Kan, 2018; Tsui, Tong, & Fung, 2016). Specifically, poor comprehenders in English performed much better than poor comprehenders in Chinese on lexical tone discrimination task (Choi, Tong, & Deacon, 2016). Additionally, early prosodic reading longitudinally predicted reading comprehension skills in both L1 Chinese and L2 English (Tong, Tsui, & Kan, 2018). These findings have been reported in journal articles and conference proceedings.

27402514.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27402514.value: The most promising avenue for further development of this project is to design an effective reading comprehension intervention program for improving reading comprehension difficulties of different types of bilingual poor comprehenders. On the basis of the present project, we have identified 46 poor comprehenders in Chinese (i.e., 21 in phase 1, 9 in phase 2, and 16 in phase 3), 50 poor comprehenders in English (i.e., 27 in phase 1, 14 in phase 2, and 9 in phase 3), and 17 poor comprehenders in both Chinese and English (i.e., 10 in phase 1, 4 in phase 2, and 3 in phase 3) across three different phases. These poor comprehenders exhibited weaknesses in lexical tone discrimination, prosodic reading, and other oral language skills. However, no bilingual reading comprehension intervention program is available for these poor comprehenders. Thus, our next step is to conduct a randomized control trial study that evaluates the efficacy of oral language and prosodic reading intervention on improving reading comprehension skills of Cantonese-English bilingual children. Such a study will not only provide an evidence-based bilingual reading comprehension intervention program, but also shed light on the nature of the relationships among oral language skills, prosodic reading, and reading comprehension.

27402514.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27402514.value: Comprehension is the ultimate goal of reading (Snow, 2002), and reading comprehension plays an important role in academic success and human well-being. By testing 233 Hong Kong Cantonese-English bilingual second-graders on various cognitive and linguistic tasks over three consecutive years, we are the first to demonstrate that prosodic reading, or the ability to read aloud the text with appropriate expression, uniquely predicted L1 Chinese and L2 English reading comprehension among Hong Kong Cantonese-English bilingual readers. Also, children’s sensitivity to Cantonese lexical tones was significantly associated with their abilities to discriminate English lexical stress and comprehend the text. Additionally, Cantonese lexical tone appeared to be a key factor distinguishing poor comprehenders in English from those who were poor in Chinese. These findings point to the necessity of incorporating prosody into contemporary models of reading comprehension, and suggest that prosodic reading intervention may help ameliorate text reading comprehension difficulties of bilingual poor comprehenders.

27402714.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27402714.value: Science typically describes nature quantitatively: a body is said to have a mass of 4.8kg, a fluid a temperature of 3.5 degrees Celsius, or light a speed of 299,792,458 meters per second. Such quantitative claims can be contrasted with other attributes we might ascribe to objects for example, being an animal, being virtuous, or being a bachelor. What are the differences between these kinds of claims, and what is the source of these differences? The intended outcome of the PI’s project is a novel answer to this question, based on a distinct account of the nature and ontological status of physical quantities. The PI will arrive at this account by employing innovative techniques from both the philosophy of science and metaphysics. A successful philosophical account of quantitative claims has to answer the following three questions: 1. What is the nature of quantities in contrast to other attributes? 2. What is the ontological status of quantities? In particular, do they exist independently of human conventions and practices, or do quantities emerge only as the result of such practices? 3. In light of the nature and ontological status of quantities, in virtue of what are quantitative claims true? The PI aims to answer all three of these question in the course of the proposed research project. As a first step in the project, the PI will develop case studies from the history of physics to generate success conditions for quantitative claims in physics. Based on these, the PI will compare and evaluate existing approaches to quantities in the metaphysics and philosophy of science literature. The PI suggests, based on preliminary research, that none of these approaches succeeds in meeting the success conditions derived from physics. In light of this negative result, the PI will develop and defend an alternative account of the nature and ontological status of quantities, and demonstrate how this new account meets the conditions set out. This novel account will be presented in a monograph on the nature of physical quantities. Such an account will enhance our understanding of science and enable us to engage critically and constructively with the scientific view of the world.

27402914.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27402914.value: Gender differences in childhood spatial and social abilities influence later life outcomes. Much research explores the causes of these gender differences and ways to reduce them. This project addresses these questions by examining the ubiquity of early gender differences in spatial and social development across population subgroups, and the relationships between these gender differences and gender-typed play. Among socialization theories, gender-typed play has long been associated with the development of gender-typed abilities. Whereas past research often assumed that gender differences are generalizable, a recent finding showed that gender differences in spatial abilities are present in children of middle and high, but not low, SES. This intriguing gender by SES interaction implicates the importance of macro-experiential factors – such as SES – in accounting for gender differences in spatial abilities. Inborn predispositions alone may not be sufficient for the gender differences to develop; opportunities to engage in gender-typed activities such as gender-typed play may be required. However, current knowledge on gender by SES interactions and on the role of gender-typed play is limited because: 1.It is unclear whether the finding of a gender by SES interaction, limited to one study on spatial abilities, is replicable or generalizable; 2.The measures used in that study showed only small gender differences. It is unclear whether gender differences in spatial abilities are absent in low SES children even when using spatial ability measures that have shown larger gender differences; 3.Research on the role of gender-typed play has focused exclusively on spatial ability outcomes. It is unclear whether gender-typed play also relates to social ability outcomes; 4.When relationships between play and spatial abilities were found, sometimes the outcome or the predictor variable showed no gender differences, and sometimes the measure of play was unreliable, weakening the conclusion that gender-typed play contributes to gender-typed abilities. This study will address these limitations with a more rigorous research design. A large sample of children will be recruited to complete measures of spatial abilities and social development that have been reported to show at least moderate to large gender differences at their specific age. Gender-typed play will be assessed using both observation and parental reports. Results will be valuable in evaluating the ubiquity of gender differences and the role of experience, especially gender-typed play, in their development. Results will also be relevant to interventions aiming at improving spatial and social abilities of under-performing groups. 財富與玩具: 如何影響兩性在空間及社交能力上的差異 幼年時兩性在空間能力和社交能力上的差異有長遠的影響。許多研究探討了這些性別差異的起源，以及縮小這些差異的方法。為研究這些課題，這項研究會探討是否不同人群中普遍存在早期空間和社會能力上的性別差異，以及這些性別差異和性別定型遊戲之間的關係。 在社會化理論中，性別定型遊戲一直被認為是導致兩性在能力上有所差異的因素之一。儘管過去的研究通常假設性別差異是普遍的，近年有調查結果顯示，兩性在空間能力上的差異只存在於來自中等收入和高收入家庭的兒童，來自低收入家庭的兒童則沒有這個兩性差異。這耐人尋味的發現顯示出宏觀經驗（如社經狀況）在兩性空間能力差異上的重要性。男女與生俱來雖有不同的傾向，這些天生的傾向可能不足以發展出性別差異; 從事性別定型活動，如玩不同的遊戲，可能是必需的附加條件。 然而，目前不能確定社經狀況如何影響兩性差異以及性別定型遊戲在其中的作用，因為：1. 只有一項研究發現了社經狀況影響兩性差異，而該研究專注在空間能力。目前還不清楚社經狀況對兩性差異的影響是否能被複製，或者是否僅限於兩性在空間能力上的差異。2.該項研究中使用的空間能力測試只呈現較小的性別差異。目前還不清楚當使用呈現較大性別差異的空間能力測試時，低收入家庭的兒童是否依然不會出現性別差異。3. 過往在性別定型遊戲方面的研究只專注其對空間能力的作用。目前還不清楚性別定型遊戲是否也對社交能力有作用 4.過往研究有找到性別定型遊戲和空間能力之間的關係，但有時候所用的測試並沒有呈現性別差異，有時候則是量度遊戲的方法不可靠，因此削弱了性別定型遊戲促成兩性能力差異的結論。 本研究將針對這些局限，採用更嚴謹的研究設計。研究將招募大量兒童去完成空間能力和社交能力的測試，而這些測試都是在過往的同齡兒童研究中呈現至少中等到大程度的性別差異的。性別定型遊戲經驗則會通過觀察和家長報告作雙重評估。 研究結果將有助了解性別差異的普遍性以及經驗，尤其是性別定型遊戲對性別差異的影響。研究結果亦會有助制定旨在改善空間能力和社會能力的干預措施。

27500114.label: Project Objectives
27500114.value: Find different forms of acquisition mode or transactional utility that can affect consumption experience in different marketing-relevant contexts. Build a latitude of acceptance model for transactional utility to understand how expectations (from the transaction/acquisition stage) affect how upcoming experiences are perceived. Explore not only how transactional utility and acquisition mode can affect level of reward-value (i.e. how pleasurable an experience was) but also how that experience was approached an experienced. Explore moderators of the effect to build understanding of boundaries and psychological mechanisms, e.g. halo effect of status, instrumentality of transaction (in context of medium maximization), etc.

27500114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27500114.value: In the proposed project, I will examine how a consumer’s transactional (or acquisitional) utility and mode can affect their experiential utility; in other words, I plan to investigate how the manner in which a consumer pays for a product can change the enjoyment elicited from consuming the product. For example, will a consumer planning to pay for dinner with a newly acquired platinum credit card (vs. a lower tiered card) make the upcoming consumer experience (the dinner) more pleasurable? Or will the feeling of getting a bad deal on a box of chocolates make the chocolate less tasty? I hypothesize that how purchases are made can change how consumers approach upcoming (frame) hedonic experiences, thereby affecting how much pleasure consumers gain from the specific consumption act. On a basic level, means of transaction can affect expectations of pleasure and amount of scrutiny given to an upcoming experience. I propose that how transactions are made can change consumers’ overall standards of quality as well as their weighting of different parts of hedonic experiences via status-related halo effects and multidimensional shifts in expectations. In particular, expectations may interact with consumers’ “latitude-of-acceptance” to affect experiential utility, where consumer experiences that fall within the latitude are more pleasurable, but those that fall without are derogated. In two proposed projects, I plan to explore these phenomena and develop a novel conceptualization of utility “latitude-of-acceptance”. For project 1, I hypothesize that goodness-of-deal will change overall evaluations of hedonic pleasure, and shift consumers’ utility functions. I predict that consumers who feel they received a good (bad) deal on a purchase will have a low (high) latitude-of-acceptance and will feel satisfied with a bigger (smaller) range of quality. Thus, a bad deal may make consumers have a worse consumption experience for products that they would have otherwise enjoyed. For project 2, I hypothesize that means of payment will change both overall- and packet-level hedonic evaluations (how specific aspects of experiences are evaluated). Besides shifting expectation levels and latitude of acceptance, I predict that means of payment will change the consumers’ weighting of specific aspects of an experience (called “packets”). For example, I predict that paying with a high status credit card will narrow consumers’ latitude of acceptance and increase weighting of prominent aspects of hedonic experiences. Thus, using a high status credit card to buy a product may ironically distort experiences to make them worse. 在所提出的项目中，我将研究消费者交易效用和方式如何影响他们的体验效用；也就是说，我准备调研消费者购物付钱方式会怎样改变他从产品消费中得到的享乐。例如，消费者用刚刚取得的白金信用卡结账（与用低一级的信用卡相比较）会不会提高他在晚餐消费中的体验效用与享受？或者，如果消费者买巧克力时吃了亏会不会感到巧克力的滋味也变得不好吃了？我假设购买方式会直接影响消费者享乐消费的过程与体验（框架效应），因此决定他们从消费体验获得多少效用与乐趣。在基本观念来讲，交易方式会影响效用与享乐的期望值以及消费者对销售体验的注意力。我提出怎样开展交易方式会通过与身份等级有关的光环影响以及期望的多维转变来改变消费者的总体质量标准和他们对体验元素不同的重度程度。尤其是，期望值跟消费者的“接受幅度”会对体验效用有交互影响作用；在消费者“接受幅度”以内的体验会变得更加享乐，但是范围以外的体验会变得更加负面。在本项目的两项研究中，我计划探讨相关的现象并发展效用“接受幅度”的新概念。 在第一项研究中，我假设“划算率”会改变享乐感受的总体评价，也会影响消费者的主观效用函数。我预测购买时划算（吃亏）的消费则会有更低（高）的“接受幅度”，并会接受更广泛（狭窄）的质量范围。因此，吃了亏会让消费者感到有更差的消费经验，而对他们在正常情况下会接受的产品体验感到不满。 在第二项研究中，我假设付钱方式会改变总体与分单元体验的享乐评价。除了改变期望水平与接受幅度，我预测付钱方式会改变消费者对消费体验不同组成部分（称为体验“单元”）的重视程度。例如，我预测消费者用高级信用卡会缩小他们接受纬度与提高他们对经验突出的部分的重度。因此，使用代表高级身份的信用卡购买一般性的产品有可能会产生相反的副作用，而扭曲消费体验的结构与享乐。

28100014.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
28100014.value: 土壤砷、汞污染已成為許多國家的最重要環境問題之一。隨著中國社會經濟的快速發展，許多工農業源頭排放的有毒金屬/類金屬經由污水灌溉或大氣沉降等原因污染農田，從而進入食物鏈。金屬/類金屬在土壤中的過量積累不僅造成了嚴重的環境污染，同時也降低了農產品的品質與產量，並對人類健康造成潛在威脅。稻田是東南亞地區重要且常見的農田生態系統。水稻是世界性的糧食作物，但近來的研究表明，中國廣東、貴州、湖南三省的礦區附近種植的水稻穀粒中砷、汞含量超出安全標準。食物鏈中過量的砷、汞會引起人類的健康問題並對生態系統的生產力造成負面影響。此外，稻米中的砷、汞存在不同的化學形態，其中無機砷（如三價砷、五價砷）和甲基汞是植物源食物中砷和汞生物毒性最大的存在形態。當前金屬/類金屬的暴露水準和人體健康風險閾值之間不存在安全邊界，因此，降低人體接觸和攝入的砷、汞是十分必要的。目前尚沒有高性價比的修復方法可以應用於大尺度上的砷/汞污染稻田，而通過種植對砷、汞穀粒低積累的水稻，以達到穩產和食品安全的目的，被認為是目前最為經濟有效的解決途徑。 為達到這一目標，非常重要的一步是闡明水稻對砷、汞吸收積累的生理機制和化學過程。本研究特別關注於土壤細菌（根際細菌）對砷、汞在水稻中的積累和存在形態的影響。當根際細菌存在時，根際土壤的化學性質，如酸鹼、營養元素可利用性、金屬/類金屬（如鐵、砷、汞）的形態等會發生顯著變化。因此，這可能預示著根際細菌會影響污染土壤中砷、汞的形態和水稻對砷、汞的吸收，從而導致水稻體內總砷和總汞積累的變化。但這些影響及相關機理尚未明確，需要進一步研究。本研究計畫分為四個部分：（1）分離具有砷、汞耐性的植物促生根際細菌；（2）探究在植物促生根際細菌作用下水稻對砷、汞吸收、積累的總量和形態的差異；（3）探究鐵氧化細菌如何誘導水稻根表鐵膜形成並影響水稻對砷、汞的積累；（4）探究土壤微生物（植物促生根際細菌和鐵氧化細菌）和金屬/類金屬間的相互關係及其降低水稻砷、汞積累的機理。本研究所涉及的領域與中國農業生產實踐息息相關，並為水稻吸收積累砷、汞的生理機制和化學行為提供深入見解。對這一領域的研究將進一步提高糧食產量並使穀粒中的砷、汞含量保持在安全限值以下。研究結果將有助於增強食品安全，並最終使人類健康受益。此外，本研究結果可應用於可持續農業項目。

28100014.label: Realisation of objectives
28100014.value: Part 1 and 2 (PGPR): To examine the possibility of using plant growth-promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR) in promoting rice growth and decreasing arsenic (As) accumulation in brown rice grown in As contaminated paddy fields, As-resistant PGPR are isolated and applied in rice during the cultivation under different environments. Rhizosphere soil samples of rice are collected from an As-contaminated paddy field near Baoshan mine (112°44'18.64"E, 25°43'4.38"N), Hunan Province, China. After minimum inhibitory concentration tests, twelve As-resistant rhizosphere bacteria are isolated and three As-resistant PGPR (strains S6, S7 and S10) are selected according to plant growth-promoting traits (IAA, siderophores, ACC deaminase, phosphates solubilization ability). The three As-resistant PGPR are identified by 16S rRNA gene sequencing. In order to investigate the effects of PGPR on rice growth, the three As-resistant PGPR are applied in two rice cultivars (Zhendao 14 and Jianyou G2), grain seed germination, root elongation bioassay and root morphological characteristics of rice are tested. Moreover, the As-resistant PGPR are also applied in two rice cultivars cultivation under different conditions, i.e. i) hydroponics, ii) pots trial with As contaminated soils and iii) As contaminated paddy fields. In hydroponics experiments, the effect of PGPR on root and shoot biomass of rice is determined. For the pot trials, the soil is collected from the surface (0 - 20 cm) of two As-contaminated paddy fields in Dabaoshan (DBS, 113°49'5.6"E, 24°28'44.1"N, Shaoguan City, Guangdong Province, PR China) and named DA and DB, respectively. A cylindrical nylon rhizobag (30-μm nylon mesh, 12 cm in diameter and 15 cm in height) is designed to separate the rhizosphere soil from the bulk soil. PGPR (bacterial suspension, 10 ^9 cfu/mL) and sterile distilled water (control) are applied to the rhizobag in three times (during the transplanting, tillering and heading stages). In pot trials, the effect of PGPR on rice grain yield, root and shoot biomass and peroxidase (POD) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) activities of rice root are examined. According to the results in pot experiments, S10 is being chosen to be applied in field experiments. Field trials are conducted at two contaminated paddy fields in DA and DB. Each treatment had four replicates, 3 m × 3 m per plot. There is a 0.6 m wide buffer strip between the two rice cultivars in each plot. All plots are randomized in each paddy field. Two rice seedlings are carefully transplanted into each rhizobag. The PGPR inoculation and control treatment are similar to the pot experiments. Field management followed the strategies employed locally, except for the addition of PGPR. In field trials, the effect of PGPR on rice grain yield, root and shoot biomass are evaluated. In order to examine the effects of PGPR on As uptake, accumulation and speciation in rice, three isolated PGPR are applied in two rice cultivars (Zhendao 14 and Jianyou G2) individually and grown in hydroponics condition, pots trials with As contaminated soil and two As contaminated paddy fields. In hydroponics experiments, the effect of PGPR on As uptake kinetics and As speciation in rice roots and shoots are examined. For the pot experiments, the soil is also collected from DA and DB. A cylindrical nylon rhizobag is also be used in pot experiments. In pot experiments, the effect of PGPR on As speciation in brown rice, total As concentrations in rice roots and shoots and rhizosphere soil properties (pH, concentrations of available phosphorus and available As concentrations in soil) are studied. According to the results in pot experiments, S10 is chosen to be applied in field experiments. The field experiments are conducted at two paddy fields in DA and DB. The PGPR inoculation and control conditions are similar to the field experiments mentioned above. In field experiments, the effect of PGPR on As speciation in brown rice, total As concentrations in rice roots and shoots are explored. Part 3 (FeOB) To assess the possibility of using iron oxidizing bacteria (FeOB) as a tool to decrease As accumulation in brown rice grown in As contaminated paddy fields, As-resistant FeOB are isolated and applied in rice cultivated under different environments. Rhizosphere soil samples of rice are collected from an As-contaminated paddy field near Baoshan mine, Chenzhou city, Hunan Province. Twelve rhizosphere FeOB are isolated from the rhizosphere soil samples and three As-resistant FeOB (strains F1, F3 and F10) are selected according to their As resistance ability, Fe oxidation ability and As fixation ability. The three As-resistant FeOB are identified by 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Next, three As-resistant FeOB are applied in two rice cultivars (Zhendao 14 and Jianyou G2) grown in hydroponics condition, pots with As contaminated soil and two As contaminated paddy fields. In hydroponics experiments, the effect of FeOB on As uptake kinetics of rice root and As speciation in rice roots and shoots are studied. For the pot trials, the soils are also collected from DA and DB. A cylindrical nylon rhizobag was also be used in pot trials. FeOB (bacterial suspension) and sterile distilled water (control) are applied to the rhizobag three times (during the transplanting, tillering and heading stages). In pot experiments, the effect of FeOB on As speciation in brown rice, total As concentrations in rice roots and shoots, As and Fe concentrations in Fe plaque on rice root surface, grain yield and rhizosphere soil properties [pH, Fe(II)/Fe(III) ratio, available As concentrations in soil and As concentrations in pore water] are investigated. According to the results in pot experiments, F1 and F10 are chosen to be applied in the field experiments. The FeOB inoculation and control conditions are similar to the pot experiments. Field experiments are conducted at two paddy fields in DA and DB. Each treatment had four replicates, 3 m × 3 m per plot. There is a 0.6 m wide buffer strip between the two rice cultivars in each plot. In field experiments, the effect of FeOB on As speciation in brown rice, total As concentrations in rice roots and shoots, As and Fe concentrations in Fe plaque on rice root surface and grain yield are examined. Part 4 (PGPR+FeOB) In order to explore the feasibility of combing rhizobacteria (i.e. PGPR and FeOB) in enhancing the As tolerance of rice and reducing As accumulation in brown rice, some strains of PGPR and FeOB (i.e. S10, F1 and F10) are selected from the bacteria used in Part 1-3 and two rice cultivars (Zhendao 14 and Jianyou G2) are chosen. The selected bacteria are applied in rice during the whole cultivation with six treatments (1) S10; 2) F1; 3) F10; 4) S10 + F1; 5) S10 + F10; and 6) control), in two As contaminated paddy fields (DA and DB). A cylindrical nylon rhizobag is used in the field experiment. The selected bacteria (bacterial suspension, 10 ^9 cfu/mL) and sterile distilled water (control) are applied to the rhizobag three times (during the transplanting, tillering and heading stages). The field experiment was the same to that mentioned above. In this field experiment, the effect of bacterial inoculation on As speciation in brown rice, total As concentrations in rice roots and shoots, As and Fe concentrations in Fe plaque on rice root surface and grain yield are investigated.

28100014.label: Major findings and research outcome
28100014.value: All three PGPR promote rice growth in pot trials and field experiments and reduce As damage in rice. Moreover, PGPR S10 also decreased As accumulation in brown rice under both greenhouse (by 3.5%-26.01%) and paddy field conditions (by 9.26%-10.5%) by significantly reducing the available As concentrations in rhizosphere soil. Our results suggested that applying a suitable PGPR (S10) as a method to mitigate two agricultural concerns, i.e. high As in brown rice and reduction of grain yield caused by As contamination, is possible after carefully selecting befitting strains (He et al., 2017; Xiao et al., under review). In addition, a biochar modified with different materials is prepared for pollutants immobilization in contaminated paddy soils (Wu et al., 2018; Zou et al., 2018; Rajendran et al., 2019). Following FeOB inoculation, the grain yield did not decrease, indicating that FeOB did not inhibit rice growth. While the FeOB significantly decreased inorganic As concentrations in brown rice grown in pots trials and paddy fields. The formation of Fe plaque is induced by FeOB, which sequestered more As on the root surface. Moreover, a significantly lower level of As(III) influx is observed in rice cultivated with FeOB than the control treatment. The inoculation of FeOB also affected the rhizosphere soil properties, by decreasing the Fe(II)/Fe(III) ratio and As concentrations in pore water, which contribute to decreasing As concentrations in brown rice. Based on our results, FeOB inoculation represents a method to decrease As accumulation in rice grown in As-contaminated paddy fields, without by-effect on grain yield (Xiao et al., under review). As the effects of PGPR and FeOB are influenced by strains and environmental factors significantly, we must carefully select the strains and the environment and conduct preliminary experiments before applying FeOB to As-contaminated paddy fields. The phenomenon that the combined effect of PGPR + FeOB is greater than the individual effect is not only achieved in higher grain yield, but also decreased As concentrations in brown rice. However, combination of FeOB and PGPR may increase As concentrations in brown rice under particular condition even only FeOB or PGPR inoculation did not increase the As concentrations in brown rice. For rice cultivar Zhendao 14, PGPR (S10) did not significantly hinder the beneficial effects of FeOB (F1 and F10) on Fe and As concentrations in Fe plaque of rice grown in paddy fields. In a word, it is valuable to be concerned with combination of FeOB and PGPR inoculation when attempt to apply the strains to As contaminated paddy fields (Xiao et al., under preparation). Besides, several studies are conducted to explore the role of i) root morphology and anatomy of rice, ii) rice cultivar × environment interaction, and iii) amendments on pollutants uptake in rice (He et al., 2017; Xiao et al., 2017; Chi et al., 2018; Huang et al., 2019). Last but not least, there are 4 to 6 undergraduate students being trained during their final year, they are also proactively assisted in a series of experiments and article preparation associated with their final year research project (Li and Chow, 2017; Li et al., 2017).

28100014.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
28100014.value: In this research, it is observed that different PGPR may have different effects on As accumulation in brown rice. It is valuable to explore which specific property of PGPR leads to the difference of As accumulation in rice and whether the effect of PGPR bacteria on As accumulation can be judged by their own characteristics (being an index of PGPR selection applying in As contaminated paddy field). It is also necessary to study the stability and continuity of the effect of PGPR or FeOB on rice properties. The effect of the selected strains on rice cultivated in different paddy fields with much different properties and on different rice cultivars are valuable to be studied. The duration of PGPR or FeOB effect on rice is also needed to be studied before application. The combined inoculation effect of FeOB and PGPR on rice growth and As accumulation might be greater than its individual inoculation. It is worthwhile exploring the reasons of the combined effect and investigating the mechanism behind from three aspects, i.e. soil, rice and strains properties. Moreover, with the known mechanism of combined effects, it is suggested to establish methodologies to screen the combined bacteria possessing greater beneficial effects on rice plants. Lastly, larger scale field trials would also be necessary to measure the dynamic changes to increase the quality of grains consumed as a staple food source in many parts of the world.

28100014.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
28100014.value: Arsenic (As) contamination is a global environmental issue for years, with the most severe problems occurring in South-east Asia. Millions of people are suffering from As contamination and hundreds of thousands of people have died of chronic As poisoning. Large areas of the paddy fields in South China have been contaminated by As, which causes serious problems, including grain yield reduction and high As concentrations in brown rice. Recent studies have shown that human As intake from consumption of rice (Oryza sativa L.) can be substantial, and in some cases exceed that from drinking water in endemic areas. Bacteria inoculation to agriculture is a promising biotechnology to solve these problems and in the present study, we confirmed that it is possible and practical of using PGPR and FeOB as mitigation method of promoting rice growth and decreasing As accumulation in brown rice grown in such contaminated paddy fields. In addition, it is observed that the combined inoculation of FeOB and PGPR may bring greater beneficial effects on promoting rice growth and decreasing As accumulation in brown rice. Compared to other (chemical) amendments, the bacterial inoculation could achieve our goal without unintended effect and the microbial benefits may last for a longer duration because of their sustainability.

28300114.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
28300114.value: In modern reliability engineering, life-test experiments are often run within a short time due to the constraints of cost and intensive global competition. In military defense manufacturing industries and national defense forces, considerable attention has been paid to predictions on reliability of military systems, so as to reduce the financial and operational risks during a system operation. Due to their military use, the systems are highly reliable and have a longer lifetime. As a result, there are very few or even no failures in life-testing under the conditions of normal use and thus the lifetime information is inadequate for analysis. However, accurate product lifetime prediction is expected in data analysis. For this reason, accelerated life testing, which is designed to collect lifetime data under higher-than-normal stress levels, has continued to flourish in the last two decades. With overstress acceleration to induce failures quickly, such life testing not only helps engineering practitioners to collect more information on system lifetime but also saves much money and time in conducting life-test experiments. A large amount of work on data analysis for accelerated life testing has appeared in literature. This analysis uses lifetime data of test products obtained from higher-than-normal stress levels to extrapolate an estimated lifetime distribution for the products under normal use condition. However, existing statistical methods may not be satisfactory for analyzing accelerated life testing data of certain kinds of products, for example, missiles, and airbags in cars. These products are destroyed after tests and are used only once, resulting in both left- and right-censored data, and so-called one-shot devices. Due to a lack of statistical models for complete censored data arising from one-shot devices, special data analysis techniques for accelerated life testing are required. Also, due to important practical purposes, there is an increasing demand for a study of statistical methods for analyzing accelerated life testing data of one-shot devices. The objective of this research is to accurately demonstrate the reliability characteristics of one-shot devices from data collected from accelerated life testing. In this research, we propose developing statistical models as well as statistical methods for accelerated life testing data of one-shot devices; this is to make statistical inference on the lifetime of one-shot devices, to assess how well the developed model fits the observed data, and to design a cost effective accelerated life testing for collecting sufficient lifetime information of one-shot devices. 在現代可靠性工程，由於時間成本和密集的全球競爭的約束，壽命測試實驗往往在很短的時間內進行。軍事製造商一直對軍事系統的可靠性預測有相當多的關注。由於它們的軍事用途，該系統是高度可靠，並具有更長的壽命。因此，只有極少數甚至沒有系統在正常使用的條件下失效，壽命測試就未能提供充分的信息來進行分析。然而，準確的產品壽命預測是需要充分的信息。出於這個原因，加速壽命試驗在過去的二十年中蓬勃發展。加速壽命試驗是在高於正常使用水平下進行，目的是迅速引起故障並收集壽命數據。加速壽命試驗不僅可以幫助工程設計人員收集大量有關系統的壽命數據，也節省了大量時間和金錢來進行實驗。 是次研究項目針對一次性使用裝置。這些產品只能使用一次，並會在測試後立即銷毀，從而導致存在不完整數據。由於缺乏一次性使用裝置在加速壽命試驗中所取得的特殊數據分析技術，所以是次研究項目將探討其加速壽命試驗數據的統計模型。本研究的目的是要從一次性使用裝置在加速壽命試驗採集的數據中，精確地預測產品壽命。在本研究中，我們建議開發統計模型以及統計方法，並評估所開發的模型對壽命預測的準確性，並以設計一個符合成本效益的加速壽命試驗。

28300114.label: Realisation of objectives
28300114.value: All the four objectives have been successfully achieved. A generalized gamma distribution is a nested model that includes log-normal, gamma and Weibull distributions as its special cases and thus is an alternative to fit data when it is not clear which lifetime distribution is more preferable for model fitting. The generalized gamma distribution that includes many useful lifetime distributions for analyzing lifetime data in reliability and survival studies has been studied. In addition, specification tests are important to accurate reliability assessment. In this regard, a likelihood ratio test to one-shot device testing data under the generalized gamma distribution has been developed and applied for a real data. The performance of the the likelihood ratio test for choosing an appropriate model to fit the observed data is determined through comprehensive simulation studies in terms of percentage of rejection under the null hypothesis. It is realized that the likelihood ratio test performed satisfactory only when the sample size is sufficiently large (>200). An application of the likelihood ratio test is illustrated with mice tumor toxicology data with three covariates such as strain of offspring, gender, and dose effects. In addition, model mis-specification analysis for one-shot device testing data has been conducted. A distance-based statistic and the Akaike information criterion as specification tests have been investigated. It is realized that the mis-specification problem is negligible only when the sample size is small and the stress levels are close to the use level. An EM algorithm has been developed for reliability estimation of one-shot device under simple step-stress accelerated life tests. The performance of the new algorithm has also been evaluated through comprehensive simulation studies with various settings. Furthermore, optimal design of simple step-stress accelerated life tests for one-shot devices has been developed. The minimum required number of tested devices can be determined to minimize the asymptotic variance of the estimate of the mean lifetime under the use level, when stress levels and experimental termination time are provided. The inspection times are also suggested in the optimal design. Moreover, the results suggested that (1) increasing the highest stress level significantly reduces sample sizes, (2) prolonging experimental termination time may not be the most cost-effective design to collect data, if the highest stress level can be set to be sufficiently high, (3) simple step-stress accelerated life tests with equally spaced inspection times are generally not the most cost-effective design, (4) more devices are recommended to be tested at the first inspection time with lower stress level and less devices to be tested at the second inspection time with higher stress level to effectively collect data.

28300114.label: Major findings and research outcome
28300114.value: There are three major findings in this research project. (1) A generalized gamma distribution is a nested model that includes log-normal, gamma and Weibull distributions as its special cases and thus is an alternative to fit data when it is not clear which lifetime distribution is more preferable for model fitting. A likelihood ratio test to one-shot device testing data under the generalized gamma distribution has been developed and applied for a real data. The likelihood ratio test performed satisfactory only when the sample size is sufficiently large (>200). (2) Model mis-specification analysis for one-shot device testing data has been conducted. A distance-based statistic and the Akaike information criterion as specification tests have been investigated. It is realized that the mis-specification problem is negligible only when the sample size is small and the stress levels are close to and the use level. (3) An EM algorithm has been developed for reliability estimation of one-shot device under simple step-stress accelerated life tests. Optimal design of simple step-stress accelerated life tests for one-shot devices has been developed. The minimum required number of tested devices can be determined to minimize the asymptotic variance of the estimate of the mean lifetime under the use level, when stress levels and experimental termination time are provided. The results suggested that (1) increasing the highest stress level significantly reduces sample sizes, (2) prolonging experimental termination time may not be the most cost-effective design to collect data, if the highest stress level can be set to be sufficiently high, (3) simple step-stress accelerated life tests with equally spaced inspection times are generally not the most cost-effective design, (4) more devices are recommended to be tested at the first inspection time with lower stress level and less devices to be tested at the second inspection time with higher stress level to effectively collect data.

28300114.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
28300114.value: The simulated results revealed that the estimates of the parameters under the generalized gamma distribution would be sparse and the precision of the estimation would be less, due to the nature of highly flexibility of the generalized gamma distribution with more model parameters. Moreover, the complicated expression of the generalized gamma distribution makes it difficult to identify the important factors that affect the mean lifetime. A stochastic expectation-maximization (SEM) algorithm may tackle the computation issue. It is therefore of great interest to investigate the algorithm for the generalized gamma distribution in future. Optimal design of simple step-stress accelerated life tests for one-shot devices under exponential distributions has been developed. It will provide more practical insights into the challenge of developing optimal design of multiple step-stress accelerated life tests. Moreover, optimal design of step-stress accelerated life tests for one-shot devices under two-parameter distributions, namely Weibull / gamma / log-normal distributionscan be extended from the success in this research project.

28300114.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
28300114.value: A generalized gamma distribution has been developed to fit one-shot device testing data when it is not clear which lifetime distribution is more preferable for model fitting. A likelihood ratio test to one-shot device testing data under the generalized gamma distribution has been developed and applied for a real data. The likelihood ratio test performed satisfactory only when the sample size is sufficiently large. Two specification tests have been investigated. Model mis-specification analysis revealed that the mis-specification problem is negligible only when the sample size is small and the stress levels are close to the use level. Cost-effective simple step-stress accelerated life tests for one-shot devices have been developed. The test plan suggested that (1) increasing the highest stress level significantly reduces sample sizes, (2) prolonging experimental termination time may not be the most cost-effective design to collect data, (3) simple step-stress accelerated life tests with equally spaced inspection times are generally not the most cost-effective design, (4) more devices are recommended to be tested at the first inspection time with lower stress level and less devices to be tested at the second inspection time with higher stress level to effectively collect data.

28400214.label: Project Title(Chinese)
28400214.value: 數學困難在華語學童中的分類及其缺損的能力

28400214.label: Project Objectives
28400214.value: To identify the cognitive profiles of subtypes of mathematical difficulties among Chinese children. To examine the stability of subtypes of mathematical difficulties in the first two elementary school years. To develop an intervention protocol for Chinese children with mathematical difficulties.
rows: To identify the cognitive profiles of subtypes of mathematical difficulties among Chinese children.
To examine the stability of subtypes of mathematical difficulties in the first two elementary school years.
To develop an intervention protocol for Chinese children with mathematical difficulties.

28400214.label: Realisation of objectives
28400214.value: 1. We conducted a longitudinal study among 565 Chinese children in Hong Kong to assess their cognitive and numerical abilities in Grades 1 and 2. Those who performed persistently below 25 percentile in the math achievement across the two grades (n=79) were classified as having math difficulties. Using cluster analyses, we found multiple subtypes of children who were characterized by different cognitive and numerical deficits. In particular we identified 4 subtypes of math difficulties in Grade 1 (i.e., number sense deficit, numerosity coding deficit, symbolic deficit, and mild difficulty) and 5 subtypes in Grade 2 (i.e., number sense deficit, numerosity coding deficit, symbolic deficit, working memory deficit, and mild difficulty). Performance below the sample mean (n=565) by at least one standard deviation is regarded as a deficit. These findings provide clear support for the multiple deficit view for math difficulties and reveal the cognitive profiles of different subtypes of math difficulties among Chinese children. 2. We further examined the stability of the subtypes of math difficulties by comparing the cognitive profiles of the children with math difficulties in our study across Grades 1 and 2. We found that about 62% of the children were consistently classified into the same deficit group in both grades, suggesting reasonable stability in the subtypes of MD across time. 3. Targeting at Chinese children with math difficulties, we developed an intervention program specifically on place-value understanding and arithmetic. The intervention program was trialed among 50 students. Compared with their counterparts in the control group, these children who learnt through our intervention program showed better improvement in math. The intervention program is now freely downloadable from the website of Education Bureau (https://www.hkedcity.net/sen/spld/subject/page_5bcecbae316e83fa103c9869). With the help of Education Bureau, we have conducted training workshop for teachers and educational psychologists on the use of the intervention program, which is now adopted by many primary schools in helping children with difficulties in math.
